    model_config = {"from_attributes": True}





@router.get("/api/datasets", response_model=list[DatasetOut])

def list_datasets(user: CurrentUser, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):

    return db.query(Dataset).order_by(Dataset.created_at.desc()).all()





@router.post("/api/datasets", response_model=DatasetOut, status_code=201)

def create_dataset(

    payload: DatasetCreate,

    request: Request,

    user: User = Depends(require_roles(*DATASET_UPLOAD_ROLES)),

    db: Session = Depends(get_db),

):

    ds = Dataset(**payload.model_dump(), created_by=user.id, status=DatasetStatus.RAW.value)

    db.add(ds)

    write_audit(

        db,

        action="dataset_create",

        resource_type="dataset",

        user_id=user.id,

        detail={"name": payload.name},

        ip_address=client_ip(request),

    )

    db.commit()

    db.refresh(ds)

    return ds





@router.patch("/api/datasets/{dataset_id}/status", response_model=DatasetOut)

def update_dataset_status(

    dataset_id: str,

    payload: DatasetStatusUpdate,

    user: User = Depends(require_roles(*RIGHTS_APPROVE_ROLES, UserRole.AI_OPERATOR)),

    db: Session = Depends(get_db),

):

    ds = db.get(Dataset, dataset_id)

    if not ds:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Dataset not found")

    if payload.status == DatasetStatus.TRAINING_READY.value:

        from app.services.rights_gate import assert_dataset_rights_for_training



        rights = (

            db.query(RightsRecord)

            .filter(RightsRecord.dataset_id == dataset_id)

            .order_by(RightsRecord.created_at.desc())

            .first()

        )

        if rights and rights.ai_training:

            ds.ai_training_permission = True

            db.add(ds)

            db.flush()

        assert_dataset_rights_for_training(db, dataset_id)

    ds.status = payload.status

    db.commit()

    db.refresh(ds)

    return ds





@router.get("/api/rights", response_model=list[RightsOut])

def list_rights(user: CurrentUser, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):

    return db.query(RightsRecord).order_by(RightsRecord.created_at.desc()).all()





@router.post("/api/rights", response_model=RightsOut, status_code=201)

def create_rights(

    payload: RightsCreate,

    request: Request,

    user: User = Depends(require_roles(*RIGHTS_APPROVE_ROLES)),

    db: Session = Depends(get_db),

):

    rec = RightsRecord(**payload.model_dump(), created_by=user.id)

    db.add(rec)

    if payload.dataset_id and payload.ai_training:

        ds = db.get(Dataset, payload.dataset_id)

        if ds:

            ds.ai_training_permission = True

    write_audit(

        db,

        action="rights_create",

        resource_type="rights",

        user_id=user.id,

        detail=payload.model_dump(),

        ip_address=client_ip(request),

    )

    db.commit()

    db.refresh(rec)

    return rec

def list_registry_models(user: CurrentUser, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):

@router.post("/api/models/registry", response_model=ModelOut, status_code=201)

def register_model(

    payload: ModelCreate,

    user: User = Depends(require_roles(*MODEL_PROMOTE_ROLES, UserRole.AI_OPERATOR)),

    db: Session = Depends(get_db),

):

    model = RegisteredModel(**payload.model_dump(), created_by=user.id, owner="Art City")

    db.add(model)

    db.commit()

    db.refresh(model)

    return model





@router.patch("/api/models/registry/{model_id}/status", response_model=ModelOut)

def promote_model(

    model_id: str,

    payload: ModelStatusUpdate,

    user: User = Depends(require_roles(*MODEL_PROMOTE_ROLES)),

    db: Session = Depends(get_db),

):

    model = db.get(RegisteredModel, model_id)

    if not model:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Model not found")

    if payload.status == ModelStatus.PRODUCTION.value and not model.checksum:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Checksum required for production")

    model.status = payload.status

    if payload.status in {ModelStatus.APPROVED.value, ModelStatus.PRODUCTION.value, ModelStatus.STAGING.value}:

        from datetime import timezone



        model.approved_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    db.commit()

    db.refresh(model)

    return model





@router.get("/api/training", response_model=list[TrainingOut])

def list_training(user: CurrentUser, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):

    return db.query(TrainingJob).order_by(TrainingJob.created_at.desc()).all()





@router.post("/api/training", response_model=TrainingOut, status_code=201)

def create_training(

    payload: TrainingCreate,

    user: User = Depends(require_roles(*TRAINING_ROLES)),

    db: Session = Depends(get_db),

):

    assert_dataset_trainable(db, payload.dataset_id)

    job = TrainingJob(

        model_type=payload.method,

        base_model=payload.base_model,

        dataset_id=payload.dataset_id,

        evaluation_dataset_id=payload.evaluation_dataset_id,

        method=payload.method,

        epochs=payload.epochs,

        learning_rate=payload.learning_rate,

        batch_size=payload.batch_size,

        seed=payload.seed,

        gpu_type=payload.gpu_type,

        estimated_cost=payload.estimated_cost,

        status=TrainingJobStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL.value,

        initiated_by=user.id,

        config_json={"model_name": payload.model_name, "character_key": payload.character_key},

    )

    db.add(job)

    db.commit()

    db.refresh(job)

    return job





@router.post("/api/training/{job_id}/approve", response_model=TrainingOut)

def approve_training(

    job_id: str,

    user: User = Depends(require_roles(*TRAINING_ROLES)),

    db: Session = Depends(get_db),

):

    job = db.get(TrainingJob, job_id)

    if not job:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Training job not found")

    assert_dataset_trainable(db, job.dataset_id)

    # Simulated training run (no GPU) — creates registered model draft

    from datetime import timezone

    from hashlib import sha256



    job.status = TrainingJobStatus.RUNNING.value

    job.approved_by = user.id

    job.started_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    db.flush()



    cfg = job.config_json or {}

    name = cfg.get("model_name") or f"AC-ADAPTER-{job.id[:8]}"

    character_key = cfg.get("character_key")

    checksum = sha256(f"{name}:{job.dataset_id}:{job.seed}".encode()).hexdigest()

    model = RegisteredModel(

        name=name,

        version="v1",

        model_type="lora",

        base_model=job.base_model,

        training_dataset_id=job.dataset_id,

        evaluation_dataset_id=job.evaluation_dataset_id,

        training_method=job.method,

        character_key=character_key,

        modality="image",

        status=ModelStatus.EVALUATING.value,

        checkpoint_path=f"models/{name}/checkpoint.safetensors",

        checksum=checksum,

        commercial_use=True,

        owner="Art City",

        created_by=user.id,

    )

    db.add(model)

    db.flush()

    job.resulting_model_id = model.id

    job.status = TrainingJobStatus.SUCCEEDED.value

    job.ended_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    job.actual_cost = job.estimated_cost or 12.0

    job.checkpoint_path = model.checkpoint_path

    job.evaluation_result = {"simulated": True, "checksum": checksum}

    db.commit()

    db.refresh(job)

    return job

class GenerationSubmit(BaseModel):

    modality: str = Field(default="image")

    prompt: str = Field(..., min_length=1)

    model: Optional[str] = "artcity-local-v1"

    provider: str = "stub"

    dialect: Optional[str] = None

    run_asr: bool = True

    duration_seconds: float = Field(default=4.0, ge=0.5, le=60.0)

    dialogue_lines: Optional[list[str]] = None

    character_name: Optional[str] = None



    @field_validator("modality", mode="before")

    @classmethod

    def normalize_modality(cls, v: object) -> object:

        if v is None or v == "":

            return "image"

        if isinstance(v, str):

            m = v.strip().lower()

            allowed = {"image", "video", "voice", "audio", "music"}

            if m not in allowed:

                raise ValueError(f"modality must be one of {sorted(allowed)}")

            return m

        return v



    @field_validator("prompt", "character_name", "model", "provider", "dialect", mode="before")

    @classmethod

    def strip_text(cls, v: object) -> object:

        if isinstance(v, str):

            return v.strip()

        return v



    @field_validator("duration_seconds", mode="before")

    @classmethod

    def coerce_duration(cls, v: object) -> object:

        if v is None or v == "":

            return 4.0

        if isinstance(v, str):

            return float(v)

        return v

class CinemaPackageCreate(BaseModel):

    campaign: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=180)

    brief: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=4000)

    cta: str = Field(default="Discover more", max_length=80)

    brand: str = Field(default="Art City", max_length=80)

    voiceover_script: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, max_length=4000)

    music_style: str = Field(default="epic")

    duration_seconds: float = Field(default=15.0, ge=5.0, le=60.0)

    initiated_by: str = Field(default="art-city-producer", max_length=120)

    dialect: Optional[str] = Field(default="sorani")

    character_key: Optional[str] = None

    character_name: Optional[str] = None

    channels: Optional[list[str]] = None

    delivery_targets: Optional[list[str]] = None

    variants: Optional[list[str]] = Field(default=None, description="A/B/C advertising variants")



    @field_validator("campaign", "brief", "cta", "brand", "voiceover_script", "initiated_by", mode="before")

    @classmethod

    def strip_cinema_text(cls, v: object) -> object:

        if isinstance(v, str):

            return v.strip()

        return v



    @field_validator("music_style", mode="before")

    @classmethod

    def normalize_music_style(cls, v: object) -> object:

        allowed = {"epic", "warm", "pulse", "soft"}

        if v is None or v == "":

            return "epic"

        if isinstance(v, str):

            m = v.strip().lower()

            return m if m in allowed else "epic"

        return "epic"



    @field_validator("duration_seconds", mode="before")

    @classmethod

    def coerce_cinema_duration(cls, v: object) -> object:

        if v is None or v == "":

            return 15.0

        if isinstance(v, str):

            return float(v)

        return v



    @field_validator("variants", mode="before")

    @classmethod

    def normalize_variants(cls, v: object) -> object:

        if v is None or v == "":

            return None

        if isinstance(v, str):

            parts = [p.strip().upper() for p in v.replace(",", " ").split() if p.strip()]

            return [p for p in parts if p in {"A", "B", "C"}] or None

        if isinstance(v, list):

            out = [str(p).strip().upper() for p in v if str(p).strip().upper() in {"A", "B", "C"}]

            return out or None

        return None

backend/app/api/speech.py
from __future__ import annotations



from typing import Optional

from uuid import uuid4



from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, Form, Query, UploadFile

from fastapi.responses import Response

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session



from app.core.config import get_settings

from app.core.db import get_db

from app.core.deps import CurrentUser

from app.services.speech import (

    SUPPORTED_DIALECTS,

    detect_language_dialect,

    get_asr_job,

    get_job_subtitle_bytes,

    get_job_transcript_bytes,

    normalize_dialect,

    run_asr,

    run_asr_job,

    segments_to_srt,

    segments_to_vtt,

    upload_speech_audio,

)



router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/ai/speech", tags=["speech"])





class AsrRequest(BaseModel):

    audio_storage_key: str = Field(..., min_length=1)

    dialect: str = "sorani"

    duration_hint: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=1.0, le=600.0)

    project_id: Optional[str] = None

    create_annotation: bool = True



    @field_validator("dialect", mode="before")

    @classmethod

    def coerce_dialect(cls, v: object) -> object:

        if isinstance(v, str):

            return normalize_dialect(v)

        return v





class DetectRequest(BaseModel):

    text: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=8000)





class SubtitleRequest(BaseModel):

    audio_storage_key: str = Field(..., min_length=1)

    dialect: str = "sorani"

    format: str = Field(default="vtt", pattern="^(vtt|srt)$")





@router.get("/dialects")

def list_dialects(user: CurrentUser) -> dict:

    settings = get_settings()

    return {

        "language": "ku",

        "dialects": [

            {"id": "sorani", "label": "Central Kurdish (Sorani)", "script": "arabic"},

            {"id": "badini", "label": "Badini / Behdini", "script": "arabic"},

            {"id": "kurmanji", "label": "Northern Kurdish (Kurmanji)", "script": "latin"},

        ],

        "model": settings.asr_model_name,

        "engine": settings.asr_engine,

        "supported": list(SUPPORTED_DIALECTS),

    }





@router.post("/detect")

def detect_text(payload: DetectRequest, user: CurrentUser) -> dict:

    return detect_language_dialect(payload.text)





@router.post("/upload")

async def upload_audio(

    user: CurrentUser,

    file: UploadFile = File(...),

    project_id: Optional[str] = Form(None),

    db: Session = Depends(get_db),

) -> dict:

    data = await file.read()

    return upload_speech_audio(

        db,

        data=data,

        filename=file.filename or f"upload-{uuid4().hex[:8]}.wav",

        content_type=file.content_type or "audio/wav",

        project_id=project_id,

        requested_by=user.id,

    )





@router.post("/asr")

def asr(payload: AsrRequest, user: CurrentUser, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict:

    return run_asr_job(

        db,

        audio_storage_key=payload.audio_storage_key,

        dialect=payload.dialect,

        duration_hint=payload.duration_hint,

        project_id=payload.project_id,

        requested_by=user.id,

        create_annotation=payload.create_annotation,

    )





@router.get("/jobs/{job_id}")

def speech_job(job_id: str, user: CurrentUser, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict:

    return get_asr_job(db, job_id)





@router.get("/jobs/{job_id}/transcript")

def speech_transcript(job_id: str, user: CurrentUser, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> Response:

    data = get_job_transcript_bytes(db, job_id)

    return Response(content=data, media_type="application/json")





@router.get("/jobs/{job_id}/subtitles")

def speech_job_subtitles(

    job_id: str,

    user: CurrentUser,

    format: str = Query(default="vtt", pattern="^(vtt|srt)$"),

    db: Session = Depends(get_db),

) -> Response:

    data, media, filename = get_job_subtitle_bytes(db, job_id, fmt=format)

    return Response(

        content=data,

        media_type=media,

        headers={"Content-Disposition": f'attachment; filename="{filename}"'},

    )





@router.post("/subtitles")

def subtitles(payload: SubtitleRequest, user: CurrentUser) -> Response:

    """Generate subtitles from an existing audio key (runs engine; does not persist job)."""

    dialect = normalize_dialect(payload.dialect)

    segments = run_asr(payload.audio_storage_key, dialect=dialect)

    if payload.format == "srt":

        body = segments_to_srt(segments)

        media = "application/x-subrip"

        filename = f"art-city-{dialect}.srt"

    else:

        body = segments_to_vtt(segments)

        media = "text/vtt"

        filename = f"art-city-{dialect}.vtt"

    return Response(

        content=body.encode("utf-8"),

        media_type=media,

        headers={"Content-Disposition": f'attachment; filename="{filename}"'},

    )


backend/app/api/studio.py
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status

from fastapi.responses import Response

from sqlalchemy import func

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session



from app.api.schemas import (

    AssetOut,

    BankBuildingGenerate,

    GenerationJobOut,

    GenerationSubmit,

    ReviewCreate,

    ReviewOut,

    StudioSummary,

)

from app.core.db import get_db

from app.core.deps import CurrentUser

from app.core.ids import load_project, require_uuid

from app.models import Asset, CostRecord, GenerationJob, Project, Review

from app.services.gateway import enqueue_generation

from app.services.storage import get_storage

from app.services.studio import add_review



router = APIRouter(tags=["studio"])



BANK_BUILDING_PROMPT = (

    "Cinematic architectural photograph of a prestigious modern bank building facade, "

    "Art City Studios production still, marble and glass tower with stone columns, "

    "gold Art City crest above the entrance, evening city lights, dramatic wide angle, "

    "photorealistic, 16:9 framing, high detail exterior architecture"

)





def _enrich_job(job: GenerationJob) -> GenerationJobOut:

    out = GenerationJobOut.model_validate(job)

    if job.result_uri:

        out.media_url = f"/api/media/{job.project_id}/{job.id}/primary"

    # Audio bed for video proxies uses convention in storage path sibling assets

    if job.modality == "video":

        out.audio_url = f"/api/media/{job.project_id}/{job.id}/audio"

    params = job.params_json or {}

    asr = params.get("asr") or {}

    if asr.get("job_id"):

        out.transcript_job_id = asr.get("job_id")

        out.transcript_url = f"/api/v1/ai/speech/jobs/{asr['job_id']}/transcript"

        out.asr_summary = asr.get("summary")

    return out





def _enrich_asset(asset: Asset) -> AssetOut:

    out = AssetOut.model_validate(asset)

    if asset.storage_path:

        out.media_url = f"/api/assets/file/{asset.id}"

    return out





@router.get("/api/projects/{project_id}/studio/summary", response_model=StudioSummary)

def studio_summary(project_id: str, user: CurrentUser, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> StudioSummary:

    project = load_project(db, project_id)



    jobs = db.query(GenerationJob).filter(GenerationJob.project_id == project.id).all()

    totals: dict[str, int] = {}

    for j in jobs:

        totals[j.modality] = totals.get(j.modality, 0) + 1



    reviewed_ids = {

        r.generation_job_id

        for r in db.query(Review)

        .join(GenerationJob, Review.generation_job_id == GenerationJob.id)

        .filter(GenerationJob.project_id == project.id)

        .all()

    }

    approved = (

        db.query(Review)

        .join(GenerationJob, Review.generation_job_id == GenerationJob.id)

        .filter(GenerationJob.project_id == project.id, Review.decision == "approve")

        .count()

    )

    pending = len([j for j in jobs if j.id not in reviewed_ids and j.status == "succeeded"])

    spent = (

        db.query(func.coalesce(func.sum(CostRecord.amount), 0.0))

        .filter(CostRecord.project_id == project.id)

        .scalar()

    )



    return StudioSummary(

        project_id=project.id,

        totals=totals,

        approved=approved,

        pending_review=pending,

        spent=float(spent or 0),

    )





@router.post(

    "/api/projects/{project_id}/studio/generate",

    response_model=GenerationJobOut,

    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,

)

def studio_generate(

    project_id: str, payload: GenerationSubmit, user: CurrentUser, db: Session = Depends(get_db)

) -> GenerationJobOut:

    project = load_project(db, project_id)

    character_key = None

    if payload.character_name:

        key = payload.character_name.strip().lower()

        if "kardokh" in key:

            character_key = "kardokh"

        elif "kurdiya" in key:

            character_key = "kurdiya"

    params: dict = {}

    if payload.dialect:

        params["dialect"] = payload.dialect

    params["run_asr"] = payload.run_asr

    job = enqueue_generation(

        db,

        project_id=project.id,

        modality=payload.modality,

        prompt=payload.prompt,

        model=payload.model,

        character_key=character_key,

        character_name=payload.character_name,

        duration_seconds=payload.duration_seconds,

        dialogue_lines=payload.dialogue_lines,

        prefer_external=payload.provider == "external-fallback",

        requested_by=user.id,

        params=params or None,

    )

    if (

        payload.run_asr

        and payload.modality == "voice"

        and job.status == "succeeded"

        and job.result_uri

    ):

        try:

            from app.services.speech import run_asr_job



            asr = run_asr_job(

                db,

                audio_storage_key=job.result_uri,

                dialect=payload.dialect or "sorani",

                project_id=project.id,

                requested_by=user.id,

                create_annotation=True,

            )

            job = db.get(GenerationJob, job.id) or job

            params_json = dict(job.params_json or {})

            params_json["asr"] = {

                "job_id": asr.get("job_id"),

                "summary": " ".join(

                    s.get("text", "") for s in (asr.get("segments") or [])[:2]

                ),

                "dialect": asr.get("dialect"),

                "average_confidence": asr.get("average_confidence"),

            }

            job.params_json = params_json

            db.add(job)

            db.commit()

            db.refresh(job)

        except Exception:

            pass

    return _enrich_job(job)





@router.post(

    "/api/studio/bank-building/generate",

    response_model=GenerationJobOut,

    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,

    summary="Generate a bank building image (Studio test)",

)

def generate_bank_building_image(

    payload: BankBuildingGenerate,

    user: CurrentUser,

    db: Session = Depends(get_db),

) -> GenerationJobOut:

    """Curated Studio image generate for a bank building facade test."""

    if payload.project_id:

        project = load_project(db, payload.project_id)

    else:

        project = Project(

            name="Bank Building Image Test",

            description="Studio bank-building image generation",

        )

        db.add(project)

        db.commit()

        db.refresh(project)



    prompt = BANK_BUILDING_PROMPT

    if payload.notes:

        prompt = f"{prompt}. Additional direction: {payload.notes}"



    job = enqueue_generation(

        db,

        project_id=project.id,

        modality="image",

        prompt=prompt,

        model="artcity-local-v1",

        prefer_external=payload.prefer_external,

        requested_by=user.id,

        params={"demo": "bank_building"},

    )

    return _enrich_job(job)





@router.get("/api/projects/{project_id}/assets", response_model=list[AssetOut])

def list_assets(project_id: str, user: CurrentUser, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> list[AssetOut]:

    project = load_project(db, project_id)

    assets = (

        db.query(Asset)

        .filter(Asset.project_id == project.id, Asset.soft_deleted.is_(False))

        .order_by(Asset.created_at.desc())

        .all()

    )

    return [_enrich_asset(a) for a in assets]





@router.post(

    "/api/projects/{project_id}/generations/{job_id}/reviews",

    response_model=ReviewOut,

    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,

)

def create_review(

    project_id: str,

    job_id: str,

    payload: ReviewCreate,

    user: CurrentUser,

    db: Session = Depends(get_db),

) -> Review:

    project = load_project(db, project_id)

    job_id = require_uuid(job_id, "job_id")

    job = db.get(GenerationJob, job_id)

    if not job or job.project_id != project.id:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Generation job not found")

    return add_review(

        db,

        job=job,

        decision=payload.decision,

        notes=payload.notes,

        quality_score=payload.quality_score,

    )





@router.get("/api/projects/{project_id}/generations/{job_id}/reviews", response_model=list[ReviewOut])

def list_reviews(project_id: str, job_id: str, user: CurrentUser, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> list[Review]:

    project = load_project(db, project_id)

    job_id = require_uuid(job_id, "job_id")

    job = db.get(GenerationJob, job_id)

    if not job or job.project_id != project.id:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Generation job not found")

    return db.query(Review).filter(Review.generation_job_id == job_id).order_by(Review.created_at.desc()).all()





@router.get("/api/media/{project_id}/{job_id}/{kind}")

def get_job_media(project_id: str, job_id: str, kind: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> Response:

    project = load_project(db, project_id)

    job_id = require_uuid(job_id, "job_id")

    job = db.get(GenerationJob, job_id)

    if not job or job.project_id != project.id:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Job not found")



    if kind == "primary":

        if not job.result_uri:

            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="No media")

        key = job.result_uri

    elif kind == "audio":

        candidates = (

            db.query(Asset)

            .filter(Asset.project_id == project.id, Asset.asset_type == "audio")

            .order_by(Asset.created_at.desc())

            .all()

        )

        asset = next(

            (a for a in candidates if (a.metadata_json or {}).get("linked_job") == job_id),

            None,

        )

        if asset and asset.storage_path:

            key = asset.storage_path

        else:

            # Fallback: audio_key stored on the primary video asset metadata

            primary = (

                db.query(Asset)

                .filter(Asset.project_id == project.id, Asset.storage_path == job.result_uri)

                .first()

            )

            audio_key = (primary.metadata_json or {}).get("audio_key") if primary else None

            if not audio_key:

                raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="No audio bed")

            key = audio_key

    else:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Unknown media kind")



    try:

        data, content_type = get_storage().get_object(key)

    except Exception as exc:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Media missing in storage") from exc

    return Response(content=data, media_type=content_type)





@router.get("/api/assets/file/{asset_id}")

def get_asset_file(asset_id: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> Response:

    asset = db.get(Asset, asset_id)

    if not asset or asset.soft_deleted or not asset.storage_path:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Asset not found")

    try:

        data, content_type = get_storage().get_object(asset.storage_path)

    except Exception as exc:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Asset missing in storage") from exc

    return Response(content=data, media_type=content_type)

"""Art City Vertical Drama IP Factory API — Sprints 0–4."""



from __future__ import annotations



import json

from typing import Any, Optional

from uuid import uuid4



from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Header, HTTPException

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session



from app.core.db import get_db

from app.core.deps import CurrentUser

from app.core.ids import load_project

from app.models import Asset, CostRecord, Project

from app.models_vd import (

    VdAssembly,

    VdCanonFact,

    VdCharacter,

    VdContributor,

    VdDeliveryPackage,

    VdDomainEvent,

    VdEpisode,

    VdEpisodeBeat,

    VdEpisodeVersion,

    VdGenerationJob,

    VdIpTitle,

    VdLocation,

    VdProject,

    VdProp,

    VdProvenanceEntry,

    VdQcRun,

    VdRightsRecord,

    VdScene,

    VdSeason,

    VdShot,

    VdStoryBible,

    VdStoryBibleVersion,

    VdSubtitleTrack,

    VdWardrobeItem,

)

from app.services.storage import get_storage

from app.services.vd_access import assert_transition, require_approve, require_edit, require_vd, vd_enabled



router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/vertical-drama", tags=["vertical-drama"])





def _event(db: Session, *, project_id: str, event_type: str, resource_type: str, resource_id: str, payload: dict, user_id: str) -> None:

    db.add(

        VdDomainEvent(

            id=str(uuid4()),

            project_id=project_id,

            event_type=event_type,

            resource_type=resource_type,

            resource_id=resource_id,

            payload=payload,

            created_by=user_id,

        )

    )





def _vd(db: Session, project_id: str) -> VdProject:

    row = db.query(VdProject).filter(VdProject.project_id == project_id, VdProject.soft_deleted.is_(False)).first()

    if not row:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Vertical Drama project not found")

    return row





class OrmOut(BaseModel):

    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)





class CreateIn(BaseModel):

    project_id: Optional[str] = None

    name: Optional[str] = None

    title: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=255)

    logline: Optional[str] = None

    source_type: str = "idea"

    production_mode: str = "ai_native"

    primary_locale: str = "en"

    content_languages: Optional[list[str]] = None

    seed_golden_a: bool = False





class CanonIn(BaseModel):

    entity_type: str = "world"

    fact_key: str

    fact_value: str





class CharacterIn(BaseModel):

    display_name: str

    locale: str = "en"

    bible_json: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None

    identity_locked: bool = False





class LocationIn(BaseModel):

    display_name: str

    locale: str = "en"

    notes: Optional[str] = None





class BibleSaveIn(BaseModel):

    sections_json: dict[str, Any]





class SeasonIn(BaseModel):

    title: str = "Season 1"

    target_episode_count: int = 10

    target_episode_seconds: int = 90





class EpisodePatchIn(BaseModel):

    title: Optional[str] = None

    hook: Optional[str] = None

    key_beat: Optional[str] = None

    reveal: Optional[str] = None

    cliffhanger: Optional[str] = None

    status: Optional[str] = None





class ScreenplayIn(BaseModel):

    title: Optional[str] = None

    elements: list[dict[str, Any]] = Field(default_factory=list)





class GenerateShotIn(BaseModel):

    capability: str = "image"

    prompt: Optional[str] = None





class LocalizeIn(BaseModel):

    language: str

    kind: str = "subtitle"

    body: str = ""





@router.get("/features")

def features(user: CurrentUser) -> dict:

    return {"enabled": vd_enabled(), "product": "AC Vertical Drama"}





@router.post("/projects", status_code=201)

def create_vd_project(payload: CreateIn, user: CurrentUser, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict:

    require_vd()

    require_edit(user)

    if payload.project_id:

        project = load_project(db, payload.project_id)

    else:

        project = Project(

            id=str(uuid4()),

            name=payload.name or payload.title,

            description=payload.logline,

            primary_locale=payload.primary_locale,

            content_languages=payload.content_languages or [payload.primary_locale],

        )

        db.add(project)

        db.flush()

    existing = db.query(VdProject).filter(VdProject.project_id == project.id).first()

    if existing:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Vertical Drama already exists for this project")

    vd = VdProject(

        id=str(uuid4()),

        project_id=project.id,

        title=payload.title,

        logline=payload.logline,

        source_type=payload.source_type,

        production_mode=payload.production_mode,

        primary_locale=payload.primary_locale,

        content_languages=payload.content_languages or [payload.primary_locale],

        created_by=user.id,

        updated_by=user.id,

    )

    db.add(vd)

    db.flush()

    ip = VdIpTitle(

        id=str(uuid4()),

        vd_project_id=vd.id,

        project_id=project.id,

        title=payload.title,

        logline=payload.logline,

        language=payload.primary_locale,

        created_by=user.id,

    )

    db.add(ip)

    db.flush()

    vd.current_ip_title_id = ip.id

    db.add(

        VdProvenanceEntry(

            id=str(uuid4()),

            ip_title_id=ip.id,

            project_id=project.id,

            kind="human_authorship",

            summary="IP title created",

            created_by=user.id,

        )

    )

    if payload.seed_golden_a:

        _seed_golden_a(db, vd=vd, ip=ip, user_id=user.id)

    _event(db, project_id=row.project_id, event_type="vd.canon.approved", resource_type="vd_canon_fact", resource_id=row.id, payload={"key": row.fact_key}, user_id=user.id)

@router.post("/canon/{fact_id}/supersede")

def supersede_canon(fact_id: str, payload: CanonIn, user: CurrentUser, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict:

    require_vd()

    require_approve(user)

    old = db.get(VdCanonFact, fact_id)

    if not old:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Fact not found")

    nxt = VdCanonFact(id=str(uuid4()), vd_project_id=old.vd_project_id, project_id=old.project_id, entity_type=payload.entity_type, fact_key=payload.fact_key or old.fact_key, fact_value=payload.fact_value, status="locked", created_by=user.id, approved_by=user.id)

    db.add(nxt)

    db.flush()

    old.status = "superseded"

    old.superseded_by = nxt.id

    for ep in db.query(VdEpisode).filter(VdEpisode.vd_project_id == old.vd_project_id, VdEpisode.status.in_(["approved", "production_ready", "locked"])).all():

        ep.stale = True

        ep.stale_reason = "OUT OF DATE — CANON SUPERSEDED"

    _event(db, project_id=old.project_id, event_type="vd.canon.superseded", resource_type="vd_canon_fact", resource_id=old.id, payload={"new_id": nxt.id}, user_id=user.id)

    db.commit()

    return _canon_out(nxt)

@router.patch("/episodes/{episode_id}")

def patch_episode(episode_id: str, payload: EpisodePatchIn, user: CurrentUser, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict:

    require_vd()

    require_edit(user)

    ep = db.get(VdEpisode, episode_id)

    if not ep:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Episode not found")

    if ep.status == "locked" and payload.status != "locked":

        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Locked episode — create a new version")

    for field in ("title", "hook", "key_beat", "reveal", "cliffhanger"):

        val = getattr(payload, field)

        if val is not None:

            setattr(ep, field, val)

    if payload.status and payload.status != ep.status:

        try:

            assert_transition(ep.status, payload.status)

        except ValueError as exc:

            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc

        ep.status = payload.status

        if payload.status == "approved":

            _event(db, project_id=ep.project_id, event_type="vd.episode.approved", resource_type="vd_episode", resource_id=ep.id, payload={}, user_id=user.id)

    db.commit()

    db.refresh(ep)

    return _ep_out(ep)





@router.post("/episodes/{episode_id}/screenplay")

    require_vd()

    require_edit(user)

    ep = db.get(VdEpisode, episode_id)

    if not ep:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Episode not found")

    if ep.status == "locked":

        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Cannot edit locked episode")

    n = db.query(VdEpisodeVersion).filter(VdEpisodeVersion.episode_id == ep.id).count()

    ver = VdEpisodeVersion(

        id=str(uuid4()),

        episode_id=ep.id,

        project_id=ep.project_id,

        version_label=f"Draft {n + 1}",

        outline_json={"hook": ep.hook, "cliffhanger": ep.cliffhanger},

        screenplay_json={"title": payload.title or ep.title, "elements": payload.elements},

        created_by=user.id,

    )

    db.add(ver)

    db.flush()

    ep.current_version_id = ver.id

    if ep.status == "planned":

        ep.status = "drafted"

    db.commit()

    return {"version_id": ver.id, "episode_id": ep.id, "status": ep.status, "elements": payload.elements}

    return {

        "beats": [{"id": b.id, "beat_type": b.beat_type, "display_text": b.display_text} for b in beats],

        "version": {"id": ver.id, "screenplay_json": ver.screenplay_json} if ver else None,

        "scenes": [_scene_out(db, s) for s in scenes],

        "shots": [_shot_out(s) for s in shots],

    }





@router.post("/episodes/{episode_id}/decoupage")

def decoupage(episode_id: str, user: CurrentUser, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict:

    require_vd()

    require_edit(user)

    ep = db.get(VdEpisode, episode_id)

    if not ep:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Not found")

    if ep.status not in {"approved", "production_ready", "drafted", "reviewed"}:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Approve or draft episode before découpage")

    db.query(VdShot).filter(VdShot.episode_id == ep.id).delete()

    db.query(VdScene).filter(VdScene.episode_id == ep.id).delete()

    ver = db.get(VdEpisodeVersion, ep.current_version_id) if ep.current_version_id else None

    elements = (ver.screenplay_json or {}).get("elements") if ver else []

    headings = [e for e in elements if e.get("element_type") == "scene_heading"] or [{"display_text": "INT. ROOM - DAY"}]

    chars = db.query(VdCharacter).filter(VdCharacter.vd_project_id == ep.vd_project_id).all()

    locked_missing = [c for c in chars if not c.identity_locked]

    scenes_out = []

    for i, h in enumerate(headings[:8], start=1):

        scene = VdScene(id=str(uuid4()), episode_id=ep.id, project_id=ep.project_id, scene_number=i, heading=h.get("display_text") or f"Scene {i}", sort_order=i, duration_seconds=8)

        db.add(scene)

        db.flush()

        for sn in range(1, 3):

            shot = VdShot(

                id=str(uuid4()),

                scene_id=scene.id,

                episode_id=ep.id,

                project_id=ep.project_id,

                shot_number=sn,

                framing="CU" if sn == 1 else "MCU",

                action=f"9:16 {scene.heading} beat {sn}",

                duration_seconds=4,

                character_id=chars[0].id if chars else None,

            )

            db.add(shot)

        scenes_out.append(scene)

    if ep.status == "approved":

        ep.status = "production_ready"

    db.commit()

    return {

        "episode_id": ep.id,

        "scenes": len(scenes_out),

        "identity_warnings": [c.display_name for c in locked_missing],

        "shots": [_shot_out(s) for s in db.query(VdShot).filter(VdShot.episode_id == ep.id).all()],

    }





@router.post("/shots/{shot_id}/generations")

def generate_shot(

    shot_id: str,

    payload: GenerateShotIn,

    user: CurrentUser,

    db: Session = Depends(get_db),

    idempotency_key: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="Idempotency-Key"),

) -> dict:

    require_vd()

    require_edit(user)

    shot = db.get(VdShot, shot_id)

    if not shot:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Shot not found")

    if shot.character_id:

        ch = db.get(VdCharacter, shot.character_id)

        if ch and not ch.identity_locked:

            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Character DNA not locked: {ch.display_name}")

    key = idempotency_key or f"shot-{shot.id}-{payload.capability}"

    existing = db.query(VdGenerationJob).filter(VdGenerationJob.idempotency_key == key).first()

    if existing:

        return _job_out(existing)

    prompt = payload.prompt or shot.action or "Vertical 9:16 cinematic still, Art City drama"

    asset = Asset(

        id=str(uuid4()),

        project_id=shot.project_id,

        asset_type="image" if payload.capability == "image" else "video",

        name=f"VD shot {shot.shot_number}",

        storage_path=f"projects/{shot.project_id}/vd/shots/{shot.id}.json",

        metadata_json={"workflow_key": f"vd.shot.{payload.capability}", "lineage": "vd_generation"},

    )

    body = json.dumps({"prompt": prompt, "aspect": "9:16", "shot_id": shot.id}, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")

    get_storage().upload_bytes(asset.storage_path, body, "application/json")

    db.add(asset)

    job = VdGenerationJob(

        id=str(uuid4()),

        project_id=shot.project_id,

        shot_id=shot.id,

        episode_id=shot.episode_id,

        workflow_key=f"vd.shot.{payload.capability}",

        capability=payload.capability,

        idempotency_key=key,

        status="succeeded",

        provider="artcity-router",

        model="ac-vd-shot",

        prompt=prompt,

        cost=0,

        result_asset_id=asset.id,

        provenance_json={"schema_version": "1", "workflow_key": f"vd.shot.{payload.capability}", "aspect": "9:16"},

        created_by=user.id,

    )

    db.add(job)

    db.add(CostRecord(project_id=shot.project_id, provider="artcity-router", model="ac-vd-shot", amount=0, currency="USD", note=job.workflow_key))

    shot.selected_asset_id = asset.id

    shot.status = "generated"

    db.commit()

    db.refresh(job)

    return _job_out(job)

@router.post("/episodes/{episode_id}/qc-runs")

def qc_run(episode_id: str, user: CurrentUser, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict:

    require_vd()

    ep = db.get(VdEpisode, episode_id)

    if not ep:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Not found")

    shots = db.query(VdShot).filter(VdShot.episode_id == episode_id).all()

    findings = []

    for s in shots:

        if s.aspect != "9:16":

            findings.append({"severity": "blocking", "code": "aspect", "message": f"Shot {s.shot_number} is not 9:16"})

        if not s.selected_asset_id:

            findings.append({"severity": "blocking", "code": "missing_media", "message": f"Shot {s.shot_number} has no selected take"})

        if s.duration_seconds <= 0:

            findings.append({"severity": "warning", "code": "duration", "message": f"Shot {s.shot_number} duration"})

    blocking = [f for f in findings if f["severity"] == "blocking"]

    warnings = [f for f in findings if f["severity"] == "warning"]

    run = VdQcRun(

        id=str(uuid4()),

        episode_id=episode_id,

        project_id=ep.project_id,

        passed=len(blocking) == 0 and len(shots) > 0,

        blocking_count=len(blocking),

        warning_count=len(warnings),

        findings_json=findings,

        created_by=user.id,

    )

    db.add(run)

    db.commit()

    db.refresh(run)

    return {"id": run.id, "passed": run.passed, "blocking_count": run.blocking_count, "warning_count": run.warning_count, "findings": findings}

@router.post("/episodes/{episode_id}/delivery-packages")

def delivery(episode_id: str, user: CurrentUser, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict:

    require_vd()

    require_approve(user)

    ep = db.get(VdEpisode, episode_id)

    if not ep:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Not found")

    rights = db.query(VdRightsRecord).filter(VdRightsRecord.project_id == ep.project_id, VdRightsRecord.blocks_delivery.is_(True)).all()

    if rights:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Rights state blocks delivery")

    last_qc = db.query(VdQcRun).filter(VdQcRun.episode_id == episode_id).order_by(VdQcRun.created_at.desc()).first()

    if not last_qc or not last_qc.passed:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Cannot mark delivery-ready while blocking QC failures remain")

    tracks = db.query(VdSubtitleTrack).filter(VdSubtitleTrack.episode_id == episode_id).all()

    shots = db.query(VdShot).filter(VdShot.episode_id == episode_id).all()

    manifest = {

        "episode_id": ep.id,

        "project_id": ep.project_id,

        "aspect": "9:16",

        "checksums": {s.id: s.selected_asset_id for s in shots},

        "subtitles": [{"language": t.language, "id": t.id} for t in tracks],

        "qc_run_id": last_qc.id,

    }

    body = json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2).encode()

    key = f"projects/{ep.project_id}/vd/delivery/{ep.id}.json"

    get_storage().upload_bytes(key, body, "application/json")

    asset = Asset(id=str(uuid4()), project_id=ep.project_id, asset_type="other", name="VD delivery package", storage_path=key, metadata_json={"lineage": "vd_delivery"})

    db.add(asset)

    pkg = VdDeliveryPackage(id=str(uuid4()), episode_id=ep.id, project_id=ep.project_id, status="ready", manifest_json=manifest, asset_id=asset.id, created_by=user.id)

    db.add(pkg)

    _event(db, project_id=ep.project_id, event_type="vd.delivery.ready", resource_type="vd_delivery_package", resource_id=pkg.id, payload={}, user_id=user.id)

    db.commit()

    return {"id": pkg.id, "status": pkg.status, "asset_id": asset.id, "manifest": manifest}

from functools import lru_cache

from pydantic import field_validator
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict

# Canonical Art City production hosts (never foreign / blockchain domains)
ARTCITY_FRONTEND_ORIGIN = "https://frontend-production-6380.up.railway.app"
ARTCITY_BACKEND_ORIGIN = "https://backend-production-9533.up.railway.app"
BLOCKED_CORS_HOST_FRAGMENTS = (
    "blockchainsystem.com",
    "alltra",
    "alltraverse",
    "nova.",
    ".nova",
)


def _normalize_database_url(url: str) -> str:
    if url.startswith("postgres://"):
        return "postgresql+psycopg://" + url[len("postgres://") :]
    if url.startswith("postgresql://"):
        return "postgresql+psycopg://" + url[len("postgresql://") :]
    return url


def _is_blocked_origin(origin: str) -> bool:
    lowered = origin.lower()
    return any(fragment in lowered for fragment in BLOCKED_CORS_HOST_FRAGMENTS)


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(
        env_file=".env",
        env_file_encoding="utf-8",
        extra="ignore",
    )

    database_url: str = "postgresql+psycopg://artcity:artcity_local@localhost:5432/artcity"
    redis_url: str = "redis://localhost:6379/0"

    minio_endpoint: str = "localhost:9000"
    minio_access_key: str = "artcity_minio"
    minio_secret_key: str = "artcity_minio_secret"
    minio_bucket: str = "art-city-assets"
    minio_secure: bool = False

    secret_key: str = "change-me-local-dev-secret"
    # Local default; production Railway sets CORS_ORIGINS to ARTCITY_FRONTEND_ORIGIN
    cors_origins: str = f"http://localhost:3000,{ARTCITY_FRONTEND_ORIGIN}"
    public_app_url: str = ARTCITY_FRONTEND_ORIGIN
    public_api_url: str = ARTCITY_BACKEND_ORIGIN
    environment: str = "development"
    auth_required: bool = True
    external_providers_enabled: bool = True
    default_admin_email: str = "admin@artcity.ai"
    default_admin_password: str = "ArtCityAdmin!2026"

    fal_api_key: str = ""
    openai_api_key: str = ""
    elevenlabs_api_key: str = ""

    asr_engine: str = "pilot"
    asr_model_name: str = "AC-KURDISH-ASR-v1"

    # Art City Edit — billing (Stripe optional; invoice path always available)
    stripe_secret_key: str = ""
    stripe_webhook_secret: str = ""
    edit_feature_publishing: bool = False
    edit_feature_trend_intelligence: bool = False
    edit_feature_multi_cam: bool = False
    # Production Hub module entitlements (enable without redeploy via env)
    hub_feature_script: bool = True
    hub_feature_storyboard: bool = False
    hub_feature_budget: bool = False
    hub_feature_call: bool = False
    # Vertical Drama IP Factory entitlement (env VD_FEATURE_ENABLED)
    vd_feature_enabled: bool = True
    # Customer signup: expose email token + phone code in API until SMTP/SMS providers are wired
    signup_expose_codes: bool = True
    signup_require_phone: bool = True
    signup_require_email_verify: bool = True
    signup_require_phone_verify: bool = True

    @field_validator("database_url", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def normalize_database_url(cls, value: object) -> object:
        if isinstance(value, str):
            return _normalize_database_url(value)
        return value

    @field_validator("cors_origins", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def strip_blocked_cors_origins(cls, value: object) -> object:
        if not isinstance(value, str):
            return value
        kept = [o.strip() for o in value.split(",") if o.strip() and not _is_blocked_origin(o.strip())]
        return ",".join(kept) if kept else f"http://localhost:3000,{ARTCITY_FRONTEND_ORIGIN}"

    @property
    def cors_origin_list(self) -> list[str]:
        origins = [o.strip() for o in self.cors_origins.split(",") if o.strip()]
        return [o for o in origins if not _is_blocked_origin(o)]


@lru_cache
def get_settings() -> Settings:
    return Settings()

from collections.abc import Generator



from sqlalchemy import create_engine

from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Session, sessionmaker



from app.core.config import get_settings



settings = get_settings()



engine = create_engine(settings.database_url, pool_pre_ping=True)

SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine, autocommit=False, autoflush=False)





class Base(DeclarativeBase):

    pass





def get_db() -> Generator[Session, None, None]:

    db = SessionLocal()

    try:

        yield db

    finally:

        db.close()

"""FastAPI dependencies for auth and RBAC."""



from __future__ import annotations



from typing import Annotated, Optional



from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, Request, status

from fastapi.security import HTTPAuthorizationCredentials, HTTPBearer, OAuth2PasswordBearer

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session



from app.core.config import get_settings

from app.core.db import get_db

from app.core.enums import UserRole

from app.core.security import safe_decode

from app.models import User



bearer = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)

# Declares Swagger password-flow Authorize (tokenUrl). Header parsing still uses HTTPBearer.

oauth2_password = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="/api/auth/token", auto_error=False)





def get_current_user_optional(

    request: Request,

    creds: Annotated[Optional[HTTPAuthorizationCredentials], Depends(bearer)],

    oauth_token: Annotated[Optional[str], Depends(oauth2_password)],

    db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)],

) -> Optional[User]:

    # Bearer header preferred; query token supports browser ZIP/manifest downloads.

    raw = (

        (creds.credentials if creds else None)

        or oauth_token

        or request.query_params.get("access_token")

        or request.query_params.get("token")

    )

    if not raw:

        return None

    payload = safe_decode(raw)

    if not payload or payload.get("type") != "access":

        return None

    user = db.get(User, payload.get("sub"))

    if not user or not user.is_active:

        return None

    return user





def get_current_user(

    user: Annotated[Optional[User], Depends(get_current_user_optional)],

    db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)],

) -> User:

    if user:

        return user

    settings = get_settings()

    if not settings.auth_required:

        # Dev bypass: use seeded admin when AUTH_REQUIRED=false

        admin = (

            db.query(User)

            .filter(User.email == settings.default_admin_email.lower(), User.is_active.is_(True))

            .first()

        )

        if admin:

            return admin

        raise HTTPException(

            status_code=status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,

            detail="Auth disabled but no active admin user is seeded",

        )

    raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Not authenticated")





def require_roles(*roles: UserRole):

    allowed = {r.value for r in roles}



    def _checker(user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)]) -> User:

        if user.role not in allowed and user.role != UserRole.SUPER_ADMIN.value:

            raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, detail="Insufficient role")

        return user



    return _checker





CurrentUser = Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)]

OptionalUser = Annotated[Optional[User], Depends(get_current_user_optional)]





def client_ip(request: Request) -> Optional[str]:

    forwarded = request.headers.get("x-forwarded-for")

    if forwarded:

        return forwarded.split(",")[0].strip()

    if request.client:

        return request.client.host

    return None

backend/app/core/errors.py
"""Production-friendly API error handlers."""



from __future__ import annotations



from typing import Any



from fastapi import FastAPI, Request

from fastapi.exceptions import RequestValidationError

from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

from sqlalchemy.exc import DataError, StatementError





def _format_validation_errors(errors: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:

    out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for err in errors:

        loc = [str(x) for x in err.get("loc", ()) if x != "body"]

        field = ".".join(loc) or "request"

        msg = err.get("msg", "Invalid value")

        # Humanize common pydantic messages

        if "Field required" in msg:

            msg = f"{field} is required"

        elif "string_too_short" in str(err.get("type")):

            msg = f"{field} is too short"

        out.append({"field": field, "message": msg, "type": err.get("type")})

    return out





def register_exception_handlers(app: FastAPI) -> None:

    @app.exception_handler(RequestValidationError)

    async def validation_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: RequestValidationError):

        items = _format_validation_errors(exc.errors())

        summary = "; ".join(f"{i['field']}: {i['message']}" for i in items[:5])

        return JSONResponse(

            status_code=422,

            content={

                "detail": items,

                "message": summary or "Validation failed",

                "path": str(request.url.path),

            },

        )



    @app.exception_handler(DataError)

    async def data_error_handler(request: Request, exc: DataError):

        return JSONResponse(

            status_code=422,

            content={

                "detail": [{"field": "id", "message": "Invalid id format (expected UUID)"}],

                "message": "Invalid id format (expected UUID)",

                "path": str(request.url.path),

            },

        )



    @app.exception_handler(StatementError)

    async def statement_error_handler(request: Request, exc: StatementError):

        text = str(exc.orig if hasattr(exc, "orig") else exc)

        if "uuid" in text.lower() or "invalid input" in text.lower():

            return JSONResponse(

                status_code=422,

                content={

                    "detail": [{"field": "id", "message": "Invalid id format (expected UUID)"}],

                    "message": "Invalid id format (expected UUID)",

                    "path": str(request.url.path),

                },

            )

        return JSONResponse(

            status_code=400,

            content={"detail": "Database statement error", "message": text[:200], "path": str(request.url.path)},

        )


backend/app/core/ids.py
"""UUID helpers for path params."""



from __future__ import annotations



import re

from uuid import UUID



from fastapi import HTTPException, status

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session



from app.models import Project



_UUID_RE = re.compile(

    r"^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$"

)





def require_uuid(value: str, field: str = "id") -> str:

    if not value or not _UUID_RE.match(value):

        raise HTTPException(

            status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,

            detail=[{"field": field, "message": f"{field} must be a valid UUID"}],

        )

    try:

        return str(UUID(value))

    except ValueError as exc:

        raise HTTPException(

            status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,

            detail=[{"field": field, "message": f"{field} must be a valid UUID"}],

        ) from exc





def load_project(db: Session, project_id: str) -> Project:

    pid = require_uuid(project_id, "project_id")

    project = db.get(Project, pid)

    if not project:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Project not found")

    return project


backend/app/core/security.py
"""Password hashing and JWT auth for Art City AI Core."""



from __future__ import annotations



from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

from typing import Any, Optional



import bcrypt

from jose import JWTError, jwt



from app.core.config import get_settings

from app.core.enums import UserRole



ALGORITHM = "HS256"

ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES = 60 * 8

REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRE_DAYS = 14



DEFAULT_ROLE = UserRole.VIEWER





def hash_password(password: str) -> str:

    return bcrypt.hashpw(password.encode("utf-8"), bcrypt.gensalt()).decode("utf-8")





def verify_password(password: str, password_hash: str) -> bool:

    if password_hash.startswith("hashed:"):

        # Legacy placeholder hashes (dev only)

        return password_hash == f"hashed:{password}"

    try:

        return bcrypt.checkpw(password.encode("utf-8"), password_hash.encode("utf-8"))

    except (ValueError, TypeError):

        return False





def create_token(subject: str, *, token_type: str, expires_delta: timedelta, extra: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None) -> str:

    settings = get_settings()

    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    payload: dict[str, Any] = {

        "sub": subject,

        "type": token_type,

        "iat": now,

        "exp": now + expires_delta,

    }

    if extra:

        payload.update(extra)

    return jwt.encode(payload, settings.secret_key, algorithm=ALGORITHM)





def create_access_token(user_id: str, role: str) -> str:

    return create_token(

        user_id,

        token_type="access",

        expires_delta=timedelta(minutes=ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES),

        extra={"role": role},

    )





def create_refresh_token(user_id: str) -> str:

    return create_token(

        user_id,

        token_type="refresh",

        expires_delta=timedelta(days=REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRE_DAYS),

    )





def decode_token(token: str) -> dict[str, Any]:

    settings = get_settings()

    return jwt.decode(token, settings.secret_key, algorithms=[ALGORITHM])





def safe_decode(token: str) -> Optional[dict[str, Any]]:

    try:

        return decode_token(token)

    except JWTError:

        return None

settings = get_settings()

API_DESCRIPTION = """
Art City AI Studio — private production OS + AI Core.

**Auth:** Click **Authorize** in Swagger (email + password), or `POST /api/auth/login` then Bearer token.

**Docs:** Full human-readable reference in repository `docs/API.md`.

**Live:** https://backend-production-9533.up.railway.app
"""

tags_metadata = [
    {"name": "auth", "description": "Login, refresh, users, RBAC"},
    {"name": "model-gateway", "description": "Art City Model Gateway — sole AI generation entry"},
    {"name": "speech", "description": "Kurdish ASR — Sorani / Badini / Kurmanji + subtitles"},
    {"name": "projects", "description": "Projects, characters, scripts, generations"},
    {"name": "studio", "description": "Studio generate, assets, reviews, media"},
    {"name": "data-bank", "description": "Project Data Bank — upload, browse, sync Studio generations"},
    {"name": "cinema", "description": "AI advertising campaigns via Model Gateway — video/audio/voice + QC + ZIP"},
    {
        "name": "edit",
        "description": "Art City Edit — long-form repurposing, access approval, entitlements, timelines, multi-ratio export",
    },
    {
        "name": "production-hub",
        "description": "Art City Production Hub — AC Script, breakdown, handoff to Cinema/Studio/Edit",
    },
    {
        "name": "vertical-drama",
        "description": "AC Vertical Drama IP Factory — governed IP, bible, episodes, shots, QC, delivery",
    },
    {"name": "publishing", "description": "Masters packaging and channel release"},
    {"name": "data-lab", "description": "Dataset ingest and annotation workspace"},
    {"name": "registries", "description": "Datasets, rights, model registry, training"},
    {"name": "knowledge", "description": "Kurdish knowledge base"},
    {"name": "evaluations", "description": "Model evaluation and human approval"},
]

app = FastAPI(
    title="Art City AI Studio",
    description=API_DESCRIPTION,
    version="1.0.0",
    openapi_tags=tags_metadata,
    contact={"name": "Art City Group", "email": "admin@artcity.ai"},
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=settings.cors_origin_list,
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

register_exception_handlers(app)

app.include_router(health_router)
app.include_router(auth_router)
app.include_router(gateway_router)
app.include_router(registries_router)
app.include_router(data_lab_router)

app.include_router(vertical_drama_router)
app.include_router(publishing_router)


@app.get("/")
def root() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {
        "name": "Art City AI Studio",
        "version": "1.0.0",
        "docs": "/docs",
        "redoc": "/redoc",
        "openapi": "/openapi.json",
        "health": "/health",
        "gateway": "/api/v1/ai",
        "hub": "/api/v1/hub",
        "vertical_drama": "/api/v1/vertical-drama",
        "api_guide": "docs/API.md",
    }


def custom_openapi():
    if app.openapi_schema:
        return app.openapi_schema
    schema = get_openapi(
        title=app.title,
        version=app.version,
        description=app.description,
        routes=app.routes,
        tags=tags_metadata,
    )
    schema["components"] = schema.get("components") or {}
    schema["components"]["securitySchemes"] = {
        "OAuth2Password": {
            "type": "oauth2",
            "description": "Swagger Authorize: username = email, password = account password",
            "flows": {
                "password": {
                    "tokenUrl": "/api/auth/token",
                    "scopes": {},
                }
            },
        },
        "BearerAuth": {
            "type": "http",
            "scheme": "bearer",
            "bearerFormat": "JWT",
            "description": "Paste access_token from POST /api/auth/login",
        },
    }
    # Do not force auth globally — login/health/root stay open in Swagger.
    schema["security"] = []
    public_paths = {
        "/",
        "/health",
        "/docs",
        "/redoc",
        "/openapi.json",
        "/api/auth/login",
        "/api/auth/refresh",
        "/api/auth/token",
    }
    for path, methods in schema.get("paths", {}).items():
        is_public = path in public_paths or path.startswith("/health")
        for method, op in methods.items():
            if method in ("get", "post", "put", "patch", "delete"):
                if is_public:
                    op["security"] = []
                else:
                    op["security"] = [{"OAuth2Password": []}, {"BearerAuth": []}]
    app.openapi_schema = schema
    return app.openapi_schema


app.openapi = custom_openapi  # type: ignore[method-assign]

"""AI Core registry and control-plane models."""

from datetime import datetime
from typing import Optional
from uuid import uuid4

from app.core.enums import (

    UserRole,
)


class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=False), primary_key=True, default=lambda: str(uuid4()))

    password_hash: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)

    email_verified_at: Mapped[Optional[datetime]] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True))
    phone_number: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(32), unique=True, index=True)
    phone_verified_at: Mapped[Optional[datetime]] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True))
    email_verify_token: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(128))
    phone_verify_code: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(16))
    account_state: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), default="active")
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now())
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), onupdate=func.now()
    )

backend/app/models_hub.py
"""Art City Production Hub — pre-production canonical models (AC Script first)."""



from __future__ import annotations



from datetime import datetime

from typing import Optional

from uuid import uuid4



from sqlalchemy import Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey, Integer, Numeric, String, Text, UniqueConstraint, func

from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import JSONB, UUID

from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column



from app.core.db import Base





class HubScript(Base):

    __tablename__ = "hub_scripts"



    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=False), primary_key=True, default=lambda: str(uuid4()))

    project_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=False), ForeignKey("projects.id"), nullable=False, index=True)

    workspace_id: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=False), nullable=True, index=True)

    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)

    entry_mode: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), default="blank")

    primary_locale: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), default="en")

    content_languages: Mapped[Optional[list]] = mapped_column(JSONB, default=list)

    current_version_id: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=False), nullable=True)

    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), default="active")

    created_by: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=False), ForeignKey("users.id"))

    updated_by: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=False), ForeignKey("users.id"))

    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now())

    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(

        DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), onupdate=func.now()

    )





class HubScriptVersion(Base):

    __tablename__ = "hub_script_versions"

    __table_args__ = (UniqueConstraint("script_id", "version_label", name="uq_hub_script_version_label"),)



    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=False), primary_key=True, default=lambda: str(uuid4()))

    version_label: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=False)

    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), default="draft")  # draft|revision|shooting|locked

    locked_at: Mapped[Optional[datetime]] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True))

    locked_by: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=False), ForeignKey("users.id"))

    parent_version_id: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=False), ForeignKey("hub_script_versions.id"))

    notes: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(Text)

    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now())

    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(

        DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), onupdate=func.now()

    )

"""Vertical Drama IP Factory — domain models (Sprints 0–4)."""



from __future__ import annotations



from datetime import datetime

from typing import Optional

from uuid import uuid4



from sqlalchemy import Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey, Integer, Numeric, String, Text, UniqueConstraint, func

from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import JSONB, UUID

from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column



from app.core.db import Base





class VdProject(Base):

    __tablename__ = "vd_projects"



    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=False), primary_key=True, default=lambda: str(uuid4()))

    project_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=False), ForeignKey("projects.id"), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)

    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)

    logline: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(Text)

    source_type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), default="idea")  # idea|generate|import

    production_mode: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), default="ai_native")

    primary_locale: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), default="en")

    content_languages: Mapped[Optional[list]] = mapped_column(JSONB, default=list)

    format_json: Mapped[Optional[dict]] = mapped_column(JSONB, default=dict)

    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), default="active")

    row_version: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, default=1)

    current_ip_title_id: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=False))

    created_by: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=False), ForeignKey("users.id"))

    updated_by: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=False), ForeignKey("users.id"))

    soft_deleted: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False)

    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now())

    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), onupdate=func.now())

"""Pluggable Art City ASR engines — pilot now, GPU worker later."""



from __future__ import annotations



from abc import ABC, abstractmethod

from dataclasses import dataclass

from typing import Optional



from app.core.config import get_settings



SUPPORTED_DIALECTS = ("sorani", "badini", "kurmanji")



_DIALECT_BANKS: dict[str, list[tuple[str, str]]] = {

    "sorani": [

        ("speaker_1", "سڵاو، بەخێربێن بۆ ئارت سیتی."),

        ("speaker_1", "ئەم چیرۆکە لە دڵی شاخەکانەوە دێت."),

        ("speaker_2", "کاردۆخ و کوردیا گەڕانەوە بۆ ماڵ."),

    ],

    "badini": [

        ("speaker_1", "سلاڤ، بەخێرهاتن بۆ ئارت سیتی."),

        ("speaker_1", "ئەڤ چیرۆک ژ دلێ چیایان دهێت."),

        ("speaker_2", "کاردۆخ و کوردیا ڤەگەڕین بۆ مال."),

    ],

    "kurmanji": [

        ("speaker_1", "Silav, hûn bi xêr hatin Art City."),

        ("speaker_1", "Ev çîrok ji dilê çiyan tê."),

        ("speaker_2", "Kardokh û Kurdiya vegeriyan malê."),

    ],

}





@dataclass

class TranscriptSegment:

    start: float

    end: float

    text: str

    speaker: Optional[str] = None

    dialect: Optional[str] = None

    confidence: float = 0.0

    language: str = "ku"





def normalize_dialect(dialect: str | None) -> str:

    raw = (dialect or "sorani").strip().lower()

    aliases = {

        "ckb": "sorani",

        "central": "sorani",

        "kmr": "kurmanji",

        "northern": "kurmanji",

        "behdini": "badini",

        "bahdini": "badini",

    }

    resolved = aliases.get(raw, raw)

    return resolved if resolved in SUPPORTED_DIALECTS else "sorani"





@dataclass

class AsrEngineResult:

    segments: list[TranscriptSegment]

    engine_name: str

    status: str

    model: str





class AsrEngine(ABC):

    name: str



    @abstractmethod

    def transcribe(

        self,

        audio_bytes: bytes,

        *,

        dialect: str = "sorani",

        audio_key: str = "",

        duration_hint: float | None = None,

    ) -> AsrEngineResult:

        raise NotImplementedError





class PilotAsrEngine(AsrEngine):

    """Art City production pilot — dialect banks keyed by audio content checksum."""



    name = "pilot"



    def transcribe(

        self,

        audio_bytes: bytes,

        *,

        dialect: str = "sorani",

        audio_key: str = "",

        duration_hint: float | None = None,

    ) -> AsrEngineResult:

        dialect = normalize_dialect(dialect)

        bank = _DIALECT_BANKS[dialect]

        seed = (sum(audio_bytes[:2048]) + sum(ord(c) for c in (audio_key or "x"))) % len(bank)

        ordered = bank[seed:] + bank[:seed]

        span = max(2.2, float(duration_hint or 8.0) / max(len(ordered), 1))

        segments: list[TranscriptSegment] = []

        t = 0.0

        for i, (speaker, text) in enumerate(ordered):

            end = t + span

            segments.append(

                TranscriptSegment(

                    start=round(t, 2),

                    end=round(end, 2),

                    text=text,

                    speaker=speaker,

                    dialect=dialect,

                    confidence=round(0.82 + (0.04 * ((i + seed) % 3)), 3),

                    language="ku",

                )

            )

            t = end

        settings = get_settings()

        return AsrEngineResult(

            segments=segments,

            engine_name=self.name,

            status="pilot",

            model=settings.asr_model_name,

        )





def resolve_asr_engine() -> AsrEngine:

    settings = get_settings()

    engine = (settings.asr_engine or "pilot").strip().lower()

    if engine == "pilot":

        return PilotAsrEngine()

    return PilotAsrEngine()


backend/app/services/audio_mix.py
"""Mix music + VO with ducking for Cinema masters (LUFS-targeted WAV)."""



from __future__ import annotations



import io

import math

import struct

import wave

from typing import Optional



from app.services.media_factory import MediaFile, _normalize_to_lufs, _wav_bytes





def _read_wav_mono(data: bytes) -> tuple[list[float], int]:

    with wave.open(io.BytesIO(data), "rb") as wf:

        rate = wf.getframerate()

        channels = wf.getnchannels()

        width = wf.getsampwidth()

        frames = wf.readframes(wf.getnframes())

    if width != 2:

        return [], rate

    samples = struct.unpack("<" + "h" * (len(frames) // 2), frames)

    if channels == 1:

        floats = [s / 32768.0 for s in samples]

    else:

        floats = []

        for i in range(0, len(samples), channels):

            floats.append(sum(samples[i : i + channels]) / channels / 32768.0)

    return floats, rate





def mix_music_and_voice(

    music_wav: bytes,

    voice_wav: bytes,

    *,

    duration_seconds: float,

    duck_db: float = -10.0,

    filename: str = "mix_master.wav",

) -> MediaFile:

    music, rate_m = _read_wav_mono(music_wav)

    voice, rate_v = _read_wav_mono(voice_wav)

    rate = rate_m or rate_v or 22050

    target = int(duration_seconds * rate)



    def fit(samples: list[float]) -> list[float]:

        if len(samples) >= target:

            return samples[:target]

        return samples + [0.0] * (target - len(samples))



    music = fit(music)

    voice = fit(voice)

    duck = 10 ** (duck_db / 20.0)

    # Simple envelope: when |voice| > threshold, duck music

    out: list[float] = []

    window = max(1, int(0.02 * rate))

    for i in range(target):

        # local voice energy

        start = max(0, i - window)

        energy = sum(abs(voice[j]) for j in range(start, i + 1)) / (i - start + 1)

        gain = duck if energy > 0.02 else 1.0

        # Smooth gain toward duck

        sample = music[i] * gain + voice[i]

        out.append(max(-1.0, min(1.0, sample)))

    out = _normalize_to_lufs(out, -14.0)

    return MediaFile(

        filename=filename,

        content_type="audio/wav",

        data=_wav_bytes(out, sample_rate=rate),

        kind="audio",

    )





def optional_external_tts(script: str, *, brand: str = "Art City") -> Optional[bytes]:

    """Try OpenAI TTS when OPENAI_API_KEY is configured; else None."""

    from app.core.config import get_settings



    settings = get_settings()

    key = (settings.openai_api_key or "").strip()

    if not key or not script.strip():

        return None

    try:

        import httpx



        # OpenAI audio/speech — fails soft if network/model unavailable

        resp = httpx.post(

            "https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/speech",

            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"},

            json={

                "model": "tts-1",

                "voice": "alloy",

                "input": script[:4000],

                "response_format": "wav",

            },

            timeout=45.0,

        )

        if resp.status_code >= 400:

            return None

        return resp.content

    except Exception:

        return None

from __future__ import annotations



from typing import Any, Optional



from sqlalchemy.orm import Session



from app.models import AuditLog





def write_audit(

    db: Session,

    *,

    action: str,

    resource_type: str,

    resource_id: Optional[str] = None,

    user_id: Optional[str] = None,

    detail: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None,

    ip_address: Optional[str] = None,

) -> AuditLog:

    entry = AuditLog(

        user_id=user_id,

        action=action,

        resource_type=resource_type,

        resource_id=resource_id,

        detail=detail or {},

        ip_address=ip_address,

    )

    db.add(entry)

    db.flush()

    return entry
