"""Art City Cinema — advertising campaign packages via Model Gateway."""



from __future__ import annotations



import json

import time

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from typing import Any, Optional

from uuid import uuid4



from sqlalchemy.orm import Session



from app.core.enums import AssetType

from app.models import Asset, GenerationJob

from app.services import media_factory

from app.services.audio_mix import mix_music_and_voice

from app.services.delivery_presets import (

    VARIANT_LABELS,

    resolve_delivery_targets,

    variant_brief,

    variant_music_style,

)

from app.services.gateway import enqueue_generation

from app.services.storage import get_storage

from app.services.timeline import apply_timeline_mix, build_timeline

from app.services.validation import EXPORT_PRESETS, load_and_validate_package

from app.services.video_mux import ffmpeg_available, mux_still_with_audio



FILE_MAP = {

    "broadcast_hero": "broadcast_hero.mp4",

    "social_vertical": "social_vertical.mp4",

    "social_square": "social_square.mp4",

    "music_master": "music_master.wav",

    "voiceover": "voiceover.wav",

    "end_card": "end_card.png",

}



CHANNEL_PRESETS = {

    "broadcast": {"aspect": "16:9", "role": "broadcast_hero", "label": "Broadcast hero"},

    "social_vertical": {"aspect": "9:16", "role": "social_vertical", "label": "Social vertical"},

    "social_square": {"aspect": "1:1", "role": "social_square", "label": "Social square"},

}





def _upload(project_id: str, package_id: str, media: media_factory.MediaFile) -> str:

    key = f"projects/{project_id}/cinema/{package_id}/{media.filename}"

    return get_storage().upload_bytes(key, media.data, media.content_type)





def build_cinematic_package(

    db: Session,

    *,

    project_id: str,

    campaign: str,

    brief: str,

    cta: str = "Discover more",

    brand: str = "Art City",

    voiceover_script: Optional[str] = None,

    music_style: str = "epic",

    duration_seconds: float = 15.0,

    initiated_by: str = "art-city-producer",

    brand_colors: Optional[dict[str, str]] = None,

    usage_rights: str = "Art City proprietary — internal + licensed broadcast/social",

    dialect: Optional[str] = "sorani",

    character_key: Optional[str] = None,

    character_name: Optional[str] = None,

    channels: Optional[list[str]] = None,

    requested_by: Optional[str] = None,

    delivery_targets: Optional[list[str]] = None,

    variants: Optional[list[str]] = None,

) -> dict[str, Any]:

    """

    Full Art City Cinema advertising campaign via Model Gateway:

    hero + social cutdowns + music + VO + end card + MP4 mux + timeline + QC.

    """

    started = time.perf_counter()

    started_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    package_id = str(uuid4())

    vo_text = voiceover_script or f"{campaign}. {brief}. {cta}."

    colors = brand_colors or {

        "ink": "#05070b",

        "gold": "#c5a15e",

        "gold_bright": "#efd39a",

        "teal": "#3aa39c",

        "paper": "#f3f6fa",

    }

    selected = channels or ["broadcast", "social_vertical", "social_square"]

    variant_ids = [v.upper() for v in (variants or ["A"]) if v]

    if not variant_ids:

        variant_ids = ["A"]

    variant_ids = variant_ids[:3]

    primary_variant = variant_ids[0]

    work_brief, work_cta = variant_brief(brief, cta, primary_variant)

    work_music = variant_music_style(music_style, primary_variant)

    deliveries = resolve_delivery_targets(delivery_targets)

    deliverables: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    generation_history: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    total_cost = 0.0

    storage = get_storage()



    def _from_job(

        job: GenerationJob,

        *,

        role: str,

        modality: str,

        name: str,

        aspect: Optional[str] = None,

        extra: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None,

    ) -> None:

        nonlocal total_cost

        cost = float(job.actual_cost or job.estimated_cost or 0)

        total_cost += cost

        audio_path = None

        if modality == "video":

            beds = (

                db.query(Asset)

                .filter(Asset.project_id == project_id, Asset.asset_type == AssetType.AUDIO.value)

                .order_by(Asset.created_at.desc())

                .all()

            )

            linked = next(

                (a for a in beds if (a.metadata_json or {}).get("linked_job") == job.id),

                None,

            )

            if linked:

                audio_path = linked.storage_path



        history = {

            "role": role,

            "job_id": job.id,

            "prompt": job.prompt,

            "prompt_version": "cinema-gateway-v1",

            "provider": job.provider,

            "model": job.model,

            "model_version": job.model_version,

            "registered_model_id": job.registered_model_id,

            "provider_job_id": job.provider_job_id,

            "estimated_cost": job.estimated_cost,

            "actual_cost": job.actual_cost,

            "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),

            "storage_path": job.result_uri,

            "audio_storage_path": audio_path,

            "route_reason": (job.params_json or {}).get("route_reason"),

            "knowledge_hits": (job.params_json or {}).get("knowledge_hits"),

            "dialect": (job.params_json or {}).get("dialect"),

        }

        generation_history.append(history)



        # Tag job assets for cinema package ownership

        for asset in (

            db.query(Asset)

            .filter(Asset.project_id == project_id)

            .order_by(Asset.created_at.desc())

            .limit(40)

            .all()

        ):

            meta = dict(asset.metadata_json or {})

            if meta.get("job_id") == job.id or meta.get("linked_job") == job.id:

                meta.update(

                    {

                        "package_id": package_id,

                        "campaign": campaign,

                        "brand": brand,

                        "cinema_role": role,

                        "product": "Art City Cinema",

                    }

                )

                asset.metadata_json = meta

                db.add(asset)



        entry: dict[str, Any] = {

            "type": role,

            "role": role,

            "modality": modality,

            "job_id": job.id,

            "label": name,

            "aspect_ratio": aspect,

            "aspect": aspect,

            "media_url": f"/api/media/{project_id}/{job.id}/primary",

            "audio_url": f"/api/media/{project_id}/{job.id}/audio" if audio_path else None,

            "video_file": FILE_MAP.get(role) if modality == "video" else None,

            "audio_file": f"{role}_audio_bed.wav" if audio_path else None,

            "file": FILE_MAP.get(role),

            "mood": work_music if role == "music_master" else None,

            "storage_path": job.result_uri,

            "generation": history,

            "export_preset": EXPORT_PRESETS.get(aspect or "", None),

            "channel": next((k for k, v in CHANNEL_PRESETS.items() if v["role"] == role), role),

            "variant": primary_variant,

            "is_mp4": bool(job.result_uri and str(job.result_uri).lower().endswith(".mp4")),

            **(extra or {}),

        }

        if entry["is_mp4"]:

            entry["file"] = FILE_MAP.get(role, f"{role}.mp4")

            entry["video_file"] = entry["file"]

        deliverables.append(entry)



    # Brand logo

    logo = media_factory.make_brand_logo()

    logo_key = _upload(project_id, package_id, logo)

    db.add(

        Asset(

            project_id=project_id,

            asset_type=AssetType.IMAGE.value,

            name="Art City Logo",

            storage_path=logo_key,

            metadata_json={"package_id": package_id, "role": "brand_logo", "brand_colors": colors},

        )

    )

    db.flush()



    # Video cutdowns via Gateway

    for channel_id in selected:

        preset = CHANNEL_PRESETS.get(channel_id)

        if not preset:

            continue

        aspect = preset["aspect"]

        role = preset["role"]

        prompt = (

            f"[{aspect} Art City advertising {role}] Campaign: {campaign}. "

            f"Brief: {work_brief}. CTA: {work_cta}. Brand: {brand}. "

            f"Variant {primary_variant}. Cinematic commercial for broadcast and social."

        )

        job = enqueue_generation(

            db,

            project_id=project_id,

            modality="video",

            prompt=prompt,

            character_key=character_key,

            character_name=character_name or campaign,

            duration_seconds=duration_seconds,

            requested_by=requested_by,

            params={

                "dialect": dialect,

                "aspect": aspect,

                "campaign": campaign,

                "cta": work_cta,

                "brand": brand,

                "cinema_role": role,

                "package_id": package_id,

                "music_style": work_music,

                "advertising": True,

                "variant": primary_variant,

                "lora_key": character_key,

            },

        )

        if job.status != "succeeded":

            raise ValueError(f"Cinema video failed for {role}: {job.error_message or job.status}")

        _from_job(job, role=role, modality="video", name=f"{campaign} · {aspect}", aspect=aspect)



    # Music master

    music_job = enqueue_generation(

        db,

        project_id=project_id,

        modality="music",

        prompt=f"Advertising music bed · {work_music} · {campaign}. {work_brief}",

        duration_seconds=duration_seconds,

        requested_by=requested_by,

        params={

            "dialect": dialect,

            "music_style": work_music,

            "campaign": campaign,

            "cinema_role": "music_master",

            "package_id": package_id,

            "advertising": True,

            "variant": primary_variant,

        },

    )

    if music_job.status != "succeeded":

        raise ValueError(f"Cinema music failed: {music_job.error_message or music_job.status}")

    _from_job(

        music_job,

        role="music_master",

        modality="music",

        name=f"{campaign} · Music",

        extra={"music_style": work_music},

    )



    # Voice-over

    vo_job = enqueue_generation(

        db,

        project_id=project_id,

        modality="voice",

        prompt=f"Advertising voice-over · {campaign}. Script: {vo_text}",

        character_key=character_key,

        character_name=character_name or brand,

        duration_seconds=min(duration_seconds, 30.0),

        requested_by=requested_by,

        params={

            "dialect": dialect,

            "campaign": campaign,

            "brand": brand,

            "cinema_role": "voiceover",

            "package_id": package_id,

            "script": vo_text,

            "advertising": True,

            "variant": primary_variant,

            "lora_key": character_key,

        },

    )

    if vo_job.status != "succeeded":

        raise ValueError(f"Cinema voice failed: {vo_job.error_message or vo_job.status}")

    vo_transcript: dict[str, Any] | None = None

    if vo_job.result_uri:

        try:

            from app.services.speech import run_asr_job



            vo_transcript = run_asr_job(

                db,

                audio_storage_key=vo_job.result_uri,

                dialect=dialect or "sorani",

                project_id=project_id,

                requested_by=requested_by,

                create_annotation=True,

            )

        except Exception:

            vo_transcript = None

    _from_job(

        vo_job,

        role="voiceover",

        modality="voice",

        name=f"{campaign} · Voiceover",

        extra={

            "script": vo_text,

            "transcript": vo_transcript,

            "transcript_job_id": (vo_transcript or {}).get("job_id"),

            "subtitle_vtt": (vo_transcript or {}).get("media_urls", {}).get("vtt"),

            "subtitle_srt": (vo_transcript or {}).get("media_urls", {}).get("srt"),

        },

    )



    # End card

    end_job = enqueue_generation(

        db,

        project_id=project_id,

        modality="image",

        prompt=(

            f"Advertising end card for {campaign}. Brand {brand}. CTA: {work_cta}. "

            f"Brief mood: {work_brief}. Clean Art City title card."

        ),

        character_key=character_key,

        character_name=character_name,

        requested_by=requested_by,

        params={

            "dialect": dialect,

            "campaign": campaign,

            "cta": work_cta,

            "brand": brand,

            "cinema_role": "end_card",

            "package_id": package_id,

            "aspect": "16:9",

            "advertising": True,

            "end_card": True,

            "variant": primary_variant,

            "lora_key": character_key,

        },

    )

    if end_job.status != "succeeded":

        raise ValueError(f"Cinema end card failed: {end_job.error_message or end_job.status}")

    _from_job(

        end_job,

        role="end_card",

        modality="image",

        name=f"{campaign} · End card",

        aspect="16:9",

        extra={"cta": work_cta},

    )



    # Alternate A/B/C stems (music + end card) when multiple variants requested

    variant_pack: list[dict[str, Any]] = [

        {

            "id": primary_variant,

            "label": VARIANT_LABELS.get(primary_variant, primary_variant),

            "brief": work_brief,

            "cta": work_cta,

            "music_style": work_music,

            "primary": True,

        }

    ]

    for vid in variant_ids[1:]:

        v_brief, v_cta = variant_brief(brief, cta, vid)

        v_music = variant_music_style(music_style, vid)

        v_music_job = enqueue_generation(

            db,

            project_id=project_id,

            modality="music",

            prompt=f"Variant {vid} music · {v_music} · {campaign}. {v_brief}",

            duration_seconds=duration_seconds,

            requested_by=requested_by,

            params={

                "music_style": v_music,

                "campaign": campaign,

                "cinema_role": f"music_master_{vid}",

                "package_id": package_id,

                "advertising": True,

                "variant": vid,

            },

        )

        v_end = enqueue_generation(

            db,

            project_id=project_id,

            modality="image",

            prompt=f"Variant {vid} end card · {campaign} · CTA {v_cta}. {v_brief}",

            character_key=character_key,

            requested_by=requested_by,

            params={

                "campaign": campaign,

                "cta": v_cta,

                "brand": brand,

                "cinema_role": f"end_card_{vid}",

                "package_id": package_id,

                "advertising": True,

                "end_card": True,

                "variant": vid,

            },

        )

        variant_pack.append(

            {

                "id": vid,

                "label": VARIANT_LABELS.get(vid, vid),

                "brief": v_brief,

                "cta": v_cta,

                "music_style": v_music,

                "primary": False,

                "music_job_id": v_music_job.id if v_music_job.status == "succeeded" else None,

                "end_card_job_id": v_end.id if v_end.status == "succeeded" else None,

            }

        )

        if v_music_job.status == "succeeded":

            total_cost += float(v_music_job.actual_cost or v_music_job.estimated_cost or 0)

        if v_end.status == "succeeded":

            total_cost += float(v_end.actual_cost or v_end.estimated_cost or 0)



    # Finishing: duck music under VO, remux channel MP4s with mixed stem when ffmpeg available

    mix_key = None

    if music_job.result_uri and vo_job.result_uri and ffmpeg_available():

        try:

            music_bytes = storage.get_object(music_job.result_uri)[0]

            vo_bytes = storage.get_object(vo_job.result_uri)[0]

            mix = mix_music_and_voice(

                music_bytes,

                vo_bytes,

                duration_seconds=duration_seconds,

                filename="mix_master.wav",

            )

            mix_key = f"projects/{project_id}/cinema/{package_id}/{mix.filename}"

            storage.upload_bytes(mix_key, mix.data, mix.content_type)

            db.add(

                Asset(

                    project_id=project_id,

                    asset_type=AssetType.AUDIO.value,

                    name=f"{campaign} · Mix master",

                    storage_path=mix_key,

                    metadata_json={

                        "package_id": package_id,

                        "role": "mix_master",

                        "cinema_role": "mix_master",

                    },

                )

            )

            for d in deliverables:

                if d.get("modality") != "video":

                    continue

                aspect = d.get("aspect") or "16:9"

                w, h = media_factory.ASPECT_SIZES.get(aspect, media_factory.ASPECT_SIZES["16:9"])

                poster = media_factory.make_cinema_poster_png(

                    campaign=campaign,

                    brief=work_brief,

                    cta=work_cta,

                    brand=brand,

                    aspect=aspect,

                    filename=f"{d['role']}_poster.png",

                )

                mp4 = mux_still_with_audio(

                    poster_png=poster.data,

                    audio_wav=mix.data,

                    duration_seconds=duration_seconds,

                    filename=FILE_MAP.get(d["role"], f"{d['role']}.mp4"),

                    width=w,

                    height=h,

                )

                if not mp4:

                    continue

                mp4_key = f"projects/{project_id}/cinema/{package_id}/{mp4.filename}"

                storage.upload_bytes(mp4_key, mp4.data, mp4.content_type)

                job = db.get(GenerationJob, d["job_id"])

                if job:

                    job.result_uri = mp4_key

                    db.add(job)

                d["storage_path"] = mp4_key

                d["is_mp4"] = True

                d["file"] = mp4.filename

                d["video_file"] = mp4.filename

                d["mp4_url"] = f"/api/media/{project_id}/{d['job_id']}/primary"

                d["mix_audio_path"] = mix_key

                db.add(

                    Asset(

                        project_id=project_id,

                        asset_type=AssetType.VIDEO.value,

                        name=f"{campaign} · {d['role']} MP4",

                        storage_path=mp4_key,

                        metadata_json={

                            "package_id": package_id,

                            "job_id": d["job_id"],

                            "cinema_role": d["role"],

                            "kind": "mp4_master",

                        },

                    )

                )

            db.flush()

        except Exception:

            mix_key = None



    timeline = build_timeline(

        duration_seconds=duration_seconds,

        deliverables=deliverables,

        duck_music_under_vo=True,

    )



    jobs_by_id: dict[str, GenerationJob] = {}

    enriched: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for d in deliverables:

        job = db.get(GenerationJob, d["job_id"])

        if job:

            jobs_by_id[job.id] = job

        item = dict(d)

        if d.get("audio_url"):

            beds = (

                db.query(Asset)

                .filter(Asset.project_id == project_id, Asset.asset_type == AssetType.AUDIO.value)

                .order_by(Asset.created_at.desc())

                .all()

            )

            linked = next((a for a in beds if (a.metadata_json or {}).get("linked_job") == d["job_id"]), None)

            if linked and linked.storage_path:

                try:

                    item["_audio_bytes"] = storage.get_object(linked.storage_path)[0]

                except Exception:

                    pass

        enriched.append(item)



    validation = load_and_validate_package(

        storage.get_object,

        enriched,

        expected_duration=duration_seconds,

        brand=brand,

        cta=work_cta,

        jobs_by_id=jobs_by_id,

        channels=selected,

    )



    elapsed = round(time.perf_counter() - started, 3)

    finished_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)



    campaign_manifest = {

        "product": "Art City Cinema",

        "kind": "advertising_campaign",

        "campaign_id": package_id,

        "project_id": project_id,

        "campaign_name": campaign,

        "brand": brand,

        "brand_colors": colors,

        "brief": brief,

        "brief_variant": work_brief,

        "cta": cta,

        "cta_variant": work_cta,

        "voiceover_script": vo_text,

        "voiceover_transcript": vo_transcript,

        "music_style": work_music,

        "dialect": dialect,

        "character_key": character_key,

        "lora_key": character_key,

        "channels": selected,

        "delivery_targets": deliveries,

        "variants": variant_pack,

        "timeline": timeline,

        "mix_master_path": mix_key,

        "mp4_mux": ffmpeg_available(),

        "duration_seconds": duration_seconds,

        "frame_rate_fps": 24.0,

        "export_presets": EXPORT_PRESETS,

        "gateway": "Art City Model Gateway",

        "initiated_by": initiated_by,

        "started_at": started_at.isoformat(),

        "completed_at": finished_at.isoformat(),

        "production_time_seconds": elapsed,

        "total_cost": total_cost,

        "currency": "USD",

        "usage_rights": usage_rights,

        "approval_status": "pending_review",

        "technical_validation_passed": validation.get("passed"),

        "deliverables": [

            {

                "type": d.get("type"),

                "channel": d.get("channel"),

                "aspect_ratio": d.get("aspect_ratio"),

                "video_file": d.get("video_file"),

                "audio_file": d.get("audio_file"),

                "file": d.get("file"),

                "is_mp4": d.get("is_mp4"),

                "mp4_url": d.get("mp4_url"),

                "mood": d.get("mood"),

                "variant": d.get("variant"),

                "storage_location": d.get("storage_path"),

                "job_id": d.get("job_id"),

                "checksum_sha256": next(

                    (

                        r["technical"].get("sha256")

                        for r in validation.get("deliverables", [])

                        if r.get("role") == d.get("role")

                    ),

                    None,

                ),

                "cost": (d.get("generation") or {}).get("actual_cost"),

                "provider": (d.get("generation") or {}).get("provider"),

                "model": (d.get("generation") or {}).get("model"),

                "prompt_version": (d.get("generation") or {}).get("prompt_version"),

                "generated_at": (d.get("generation") or {}).get("generated_at"),

            }

            for d in deliverables

        ],

        "generation_history": generation_history,

        "ownership": "Art City owns campaign package, masters, stems, prompts, and metadata.",

    }



    public_deliverables = [{k: v for k, v in d.items() if not k.startswith("_")} for d in deliverables]



    manifest_key = f"projects/{project_id}/cinema/{package_id}/CAMPAIGN_MANIFEST.json"

    storage.upload_bytes(manifest_key, json.dumps(campaign_manifest, indent=2).encode("utf-8"), "application/json")

    validation_key = f"projects/{project_id}/cinema/{package_id}/TECHNICAL_VALIDATION.json"

    storage.upload_bytes(validation_key, json.dumps(validation, indent=2).encode("utf-8"), "application/json")



    package_asset = Asset(

        project_id=project_id,

        asset_type=AssetType.OTHER.value,

        name=f"Art City Cinema · {campaign}"[:255],

        storage_path=manifest_key,

        metadata_json={

            "kind": "cinematic_package",

            "product": "Art City Cinema",

            "package_id": package_id,

            "campaign": campaign,

            "brief": brief,

            "cta": cta,

            "brand": brand,

            "brand_colors": colors,

            "music_style": work_music,

            "dialect": dialect,

            "character_key": character_key,

            "channels": selected,

            "delivery_targets": deliveries,

            "variants": variant_pack,

            "timeline": timeline,

            "mix_master_path": mix_key,

            "duration_seconds": duration_seconds,

            "voiceover_script": vo_text,

            "voiceover_transcript": vo_transcript,

            "formats": [CHANNEL_PRESETS[c]["aspect"] for c in selected if c in CHANNEL_PRESETS],

            "deliverables": public_deliverables,

            "total_cost": total_cost,

            "production_time_seconds": elapsed,

            "initiated_by": initiated_by,

            "usage_rights": usage_rights,

            "campaign_manifest": campaign_manifest,

            "validation": validation,

            "manifest_key": manifest_key,

            "validation_key": validation_key,

            "pipeline": [

                "brief",

                "model_gateway",

                "advertising_video_cutdowns",

                "music",

                "voiceover",

                "end_card",

                "variants",

                "mix_and_mp4_mux",

                "finishing_timeline",

                "campaign_manifest",

                "technical_validation",

                "review_ready",

            ],

        },

    )

    db.add(package_asset)

    db.commit()

    db.refresh(package_asset)

    return serialize_package(package_asset)





def serialize_package(asset: Asset) -> dict[str, Any]:

    meta = asset.metadata_json or {}

    return {

        "package_id": meta.get("package_id"),

        "asset_id": asset.id,

        "product": meta.get("product", "Art City Cinema"),

        "campaign": meta.get("campaign"),

        "brief": meta.get("brief"),

        "cta": meta.get("cta"),

        "brand": meta.get("brand"),

        "brand_colors": meta.get("brand_colors"),

        "music_style": meta.get("music_style"),

        "dialect": meta.get("dialect"),

        "character_key": meta.get("character_key"),

        "channels": meta.get("channels", []),

        "delivery_targets": meta.get("delivery_targets", []),

        "variants": meta.get("variants", []),

        "timeline": meta.get("timeline"),

        "mix_master_path": meta.get("mix_master_path"),

        "duration_seconds": meta.get("duration_seconds"),

        "formats": meta.get("formats", []),

        "deliverables": meta.get("deliverables", []),

        "total_cost": meta.get("total_cost", 0),

        "production_time_seconds": meta.get("production_time_seconds"),

        "initiated_by": meta.get("initiated_by"),

        "usage_rights": meta.get("usage_rights"),

        "campaign_manifest": meta.get("campaign_manifest"),

        "validation": meta.get("validation"),

        "validation_passed": (meta.get("validation") or {}).get("passed"),

        "manifest_url": f"/api/projects/{asset.project_id}/cinema/packages/{meta.get('package_id')}/manifest",

        "validation_url": f"/api/projects/{asset.project_id}/cinema/packages/{meta.get('package_id')}/validation",

        "zip_url": f"/api/projects/{asset.project_id}/cinema/packages/{meta.get('package_id')}/zip",

        "created_at": asset.created_at.isoformat() if asset.created_at else None,

    }





def update_package_timeline(

    db: Session,

    project_id: str,

    package_id: str,

    mix: dict[str, Any],

) -> dict[str, Any]:

    assets = (

        db.query(Asset)

        .filter(Asset.project_id == project_id, Asset.soft_deleted.is_(False))

        .all()

    )

    package_asset = next(

        (

            a

            for a in assets

            if (a.metadata_json or {}).get("kind") == "cinematic_package"

            and (a.metadata_json or {}).get("package_id") == package_id

        ),

        None,

    )

    if not package_asset:

        raise ValueError("Cinema package not found")

    meta = dict(package_asset.metadata_json or {})

    timeline = apply_timeline_mix(meta.get("timeline") or {}, mix)

    meta["timeline"] = timeline

    if meta.get("campaign_manifest"):

        meta["campaign_manifest"] = dict(meta["campaign_manifest"])

        meta["campaign_manifest"]["timeline"] = timeline

        storage = get_storage()

        storage.upload_bytes(

            meta.get("manifest_key")

            or f"projects/{project_id}/cinema/{package_id}/CAMPAIGN_MANIFEST.json",

            json.dumps(meta["campaign_manifest"], indent=2).encode("utf-8"),

            "application/json",

        )

    package_asset.metadata_json = meta

    db.add(package_asset)

    db.commit()

    db.refresh(package_asset)

    return serialize_package(package_asset)





def list_cinematic_packages(db: Session, project_id: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:

    assets = (

        db.query(Asset)

        .filter(Asset.project_id == project_id, Asset.soft_deleted.is_(False))

        .order_by(Asset.created_at.desc())

        .all()

    )

    return [

        serialize_package(a)

        for a in assets

        if (a.metadata_json or {}).get("kind") == "cinematic_package"

    ]





def get_cinematic_package(db: Session, project_id: str, package_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:

    for pkg in list_cinematic_packages(db, project_id):

        if pkg.get("package_id") == package_id:

            return pkg

    raise ValueError("Cinema package not found")





def revalidate_package(db: Session, project_id: str, package_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:

    assets = (

        db.query(Asset)

        .filter(Asset.project_id == project_id, Asset.soft_deleted.is_(False))

        .all()

    )

    package_asset = next(

        (

            a

            for a in assets

            if (a.metadata_json or {}).get("kind") == "cinematic_package"

            and (a.metadata_json or {}).get("package_id") == package_id

        ),

        None,

    )

    if not package_asset:

        raise ValueError("Cinema package not found")



    meta = dict(package_asset.metadata_json or {})

    deliverables = meta.get("deliverables") or []

    storage = get_storage()

    jobs_by_id: dict[str, GenerationJob] = {}

    enriched = []

    for d in deliverables:

        job = db.get(GenerationJob, d.get("job_id"))

        if job:

            jobs_by_id[job.id] = job

        item = dict(d)

        if d.get("audio_url"):

            beds = (

                db.query(Asset)

                .filter(Asset.project_id == project_id, Asset.asset_type == AssetType.AUDIO.value)

                .order_by(Asset.created_at.desc())

                .all()

            )

            linked = next((a for a in beds if (a.metadata_json or {}).get("linked_job") == d.get("job_id")), None)

            if linked and linked.storage_path:

                try:

                    item["_audio_bytes"] = storage.get_object(linked.storage_path)[0]

                except Exception:

                    pass

        enriched.append(item)



    validation = load_and_validate_package(

        storage.get_object,

        enriched,

        expected_duration=float(meta.get("duration_seconds") or 15),

        brand=meta.get("brand") or "Art City",

        cta=meta.get("cta") or "",

        jobs_by_id=jobs_by_id,

        channels=list(meta.get("channels") or []),

    )

    meta["validation"] = validation

    if meta.get("campaign_manifest"):

        meta["campaign_manifest"]["technical_validation_passed"] = validation.get("passed")

    storage.upload_bytes(

        meta.get("validation_key")

        or f"projects/{project_id}/cinema/{package_id}/TECHNICAL_VALIDATION.json",

        json.dumps(validation, indent=2).encode("utf-8"),

        "application/json",

    )

    package_asset.metadata_json = meta

    db.add(package_asset)

    db.commit()

    db.refresh(package_asset)

    return serialize_package(package_asset)


backend/app/services/data_bank.py
"""Project Data Bank — catalog of project media (uploads + Studio generations)."""



from __future__ import annotations



import hashlib

import re

from typing import Any, Optional

from uuid import uuid4



from sqlalchemy import or_

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session



from app.core.enums import AssetType, GenerationStatus

from app.models import Asset, GenerationJob, Project

from app.services.gateway import enqueue_generation

from app.services.storage import get_storage



BANK_PROJECT_NAME = "Art City Data Bank"



BANK_BUILDING_PROMPT = (

    "Cinematic architectural photograph of a prestigious modern bank building facade, "

    "Art City Studios production still, marble and glass tower with stone columns, "

    "gold Art City crest above the entrance, evening city lights, dramatic wide angle, "

    "photorealistic, 16:9 framing, high detail exterior architecture"

)



_SAFE_NAME = re.compile(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+")





def _safe_filename(name: str) -> str:

    base = name.rsplit("/", 1)[-1].rsplit("\\", 1)[-1].strip() or "upload.bin"

    cleaned = _SAFE_NAME.sub("_", base)[:180]

    return cleaned or "upload.bin"





def _guess_asset_type(filename: str, content_type: str) -> str:

    ct = (content_type or "").lower()

    lower = filename.lower()

    if ct.startswith("image/") or lower.endswith((".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".webp", ".gif")):

        return AssetType.IMAGE.value

    if ct.startswith("video/") or lower.endswith((".mp4", ".mov", ".webm", ".mkv")):

        return AssetType.VIDEO.value

    if "audio" in ct or lower.endswith((".wav", ".mp3", ".m4a", ".ogg", ".flac")):

        if "music" in lower:

            return AssetType.MUSIC.value

        return AssetType.AUDIO.value

    if lower.endswith((".srt", ".vtt")):

        return AssetType.SUBTITLE.value

    if lower.endswith((".txt", ".md", ".pdf", ".docx")):

        return AssetType.SCRIPT.value

    return AssetType.OTHER.value





def enrich_asset(asset: Asset) -> dict[str, Any]:

    meta = dict(asset.metadata_json or {})

    return {

        "id": asset.id,

        "project_id": asset.project_id,

        "asset_type": asset.asset_type,

        "name": asset.name,

        "storage_path": asset.storage_path,

        "checksum": asset.checksum,

        "metadata_json": meta,

        "soft_deleted": asset.soft_deleted,

        "created_at": asset.created_at,

        "media_url": f"/api/assets/file/{asset.id}" if asset.storage_path else None,

        "source": meta.get("source") or ("generation" if meta.get("job_id") else "upload"),

        "tags": meta.get("tags") or [],

        "prompt": meta.get("prompt"),

        "size_bytes": meta.get("size_bytes"),

        "content_type": meta.get("content_type"),

    }





def list_bank_assets(

    db: Session,

    project_id: str,

    *,

    q: Optional[str] = None,

    asset_type: Optional[str] = None,

    source: Optional[str] = None,

    limit: int = 200,

) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:

    query = db.query(Asset).filter(Asset.project_id == project_id, Asset.soft_deleted.is_(False))

    if asset_type:

        query = query.filter(Asset.asset_type == asset_type.strip().lower())

    if q:

        term = f"%{q.strip()}%"

        query = query.filter(

            or_(

                Asset.name.ilike(term),

                Asset.storage_path.ilike(term),

            )

        )

    rows = query.order_by(Asset.created_at.desc()).limit(max(1, min(limit, 500))).all()

    out = [enrich_asset(a) for a in rows]

    if source:

        src = source.strip().lower()

        out = [r for r in out if (r.get("source") or "").lower() == src]

    if q:

        ql = q.strip().lower()

        out = [

            r

            for r in out

            if ql in (r.get("name") or "").lower()

            or ql in (r.get("prompt") or "").lower()

            or any(ql in str(t).lower() for t in (r.get("tags") or []))

        ]

    return out





def bank_summary(db: Session, project_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:

    rows = (

        db.query(Asset)

        .filter(Asset.project_id == project_id, Asset.soft_deleted.is_(False))

        .all()

    )

    by_type: dict[str, int] = {}

    by_source: dict[str, int] = {}

    for a in rows:

        by_type[a.asset_type] = by_type.get(a.asset_type, 0) + 1

        meta = a.metadata_json or {}

        src = meta.get("source") or ("generation" if meta.get("job_id") else "upload")

        by_source[src] = by_source.get(src, 0) + 1

    return {

        "project_id": project_id,

        "total": len(rows),

        "by_type": by_type,

        "by_source": by_source,

    }





def upload_to_bank(

    db: Session,

    *,

    project_id: str,

    filename: str,

    data: bytes,

    content_type: str,

    name: Optional[str] = None,

    tags: Optional[list[str]] = None,

    notes: Optional[str] = None,

) -> Asset:

    safe = _safe_filename(filename)

    checksum = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

    key = f"projects/{project_id}/data-bank/{uuid4().hex[:12]}_{safe}"

    storage = get_storage()

    storage.upload_bytes(key, data, content_type or "application/octet-stream")

    asset_type = _guess_asset_type(safe, content_type)

    asset = Asset(

        project_id=project_id,

        asset_type=asset_type,

        name=(name or safe)[:255],

        storage_path=key,

        checksum=checksum,

        metadata_json={

            "source": "upload",

            "original_filename": filename,

            "content_type": content_type,

            "size_bytes": len(data),

            "tags": tags or ["data-bank"],

            "notes": notes,

            "bank": True,

        },

    )

    db.add(asset)

    db.commit()

    db.refresh(asset)

    return asset





def sync_generations_into_bank(db: Session, project_id: str) -> dict[str, int]:

    """Index succeeded Studio/Cinema generation outputs that are missing as bank assets."""

    jobs = (

        db.query(GenerationJob)

        .filter(

            GenerationJob.project_id == project_id,

            GenerationJob.status == GenerationStatus.SUCCEEDED.value,

            GenerationJob.result_uri.isnot(None),

        )

        .all()

    )

    existing_paths = {

        a.storage_path

        for a in db.query(Asset)

        .filter(Asset.project_id == project_id, Asset.soft_deleted.is_(False))

        .all()

        if a.storage_path

    }

    linked_jobs = {

        (a.metadata_json or {}).get("job_id")

        for a in db.query(Asset).filter(Asset.project_id == project_id).all()

        if (a.metadata_json or {}).get("job_id")

    }

    created = 0

    skipped = 0

    for job in jobs:

        if job.id in linked_jobs or (job.result_uri and job.result_uri in existing_paths):

            skipped += 1

            continue

        modality = (job.modality or AssetType.OTHER.value).lower()

        asset_type = modality if modality in {t.value for t in AssetType} else AssetType.OTHER.value

        asset = Asset(

            project_id=project_id,

            asset_type=asset_type,

            name=f"{modality}: {(job.prompt or job.id)[:60]}",

            storage_path=job.result_uri,

            metadata_json={

                "source": "generation",

                "job_id": job.id,

                "provider": job.provider,

                "prompt": job.prompt,

                "provider_job_id": job.provider_job_id,

                "tags": ["data-bank", "synced", modality],

                "bank": True,

            },

        )

        db.add(asset)

        created += 1

    db.commit()

    return {"created": created, "skipped": skipped, "jobs_scanned": len(jobs)}





def soft_delete_bank_asset(db: Session, project_id: str, asset_id: str) -> Asset:

    asset = db.get(Asset, asset_id)

    if not asset or asset.project_id != project_id or asset.soft_deleted:

        raise ValueError("Asset not found")

    asset.soft_deleted = True

    db.add(asset)

    db.commit()

    db.refresh(asset)

    return asset





def get_or_create_bank_project(db: Session) -> Project:

    existing = (

        db.query(Project)

        .filter(Project.name == BANK_PROJECT_NAME)

        .order_by(Project.created_at.desc())

        .first()

    )

    if existing:

        return existing

    project = Project(

        name=BANK_PROJECT_NAME,

        description="Central project media data bank — uploads, Studio stills, and synced generations",

    )

    db.add(project)

    db.commit()

    db.refresh(project)

    return project





def seed_data_bank(db: Session, *, requested_by: Optional[str] = None) -> dict[str, Any]:

    """Ensure bank project exists, seed a bank-building image, sync generations."""

    project = get_or_create_bank_project(db)

    job = enqueue_generation(

        db,

        project_id=project.id,

        modality="image",

        prompt=BANK_BUILDING_PROMPT,

        model="artcity-local-v1",

        prefer_external=True,

        requested_by=requested_by,

        params={"demo": "bank_building", "bank": True, "tags": ["bank-building", "seed"]},

    )

    # Tag the primary asset if present

    assets = (

        db.query(Asset)

        .filter(Asset.project_id == project.id, Asset.storage_path == job.result_uri)

        .all()

    )

    for asset in assets:

        meta = dict(asset.metadata_json or {})

        meta["source"] = meta.get("source") or "generation"

        meta["job_id"] = job.id

        meta["bank"] = True

        meta["tags"] = list({*(meta.get("tags") or []), "bank-building", "seed", "data-bank"})

        meta["prompt"] = job.prompt

        asset.metadata_json = meta

        if not asset.name.startswith("bank"):

            asset.name = f"bank-building · {(job.prompt or '')[:40]}"

        db.add(asset)

    db.commit()

    sync = sync_generations_into_bank(db, project.id)

    summary = bank_summary(db, project.id)

    return {

        "project": {

            "id": project.id,

            "name": project.name,

            "description": project.description,

        },

        "seed_job_id": job.id,

        "seed_status": job.status,

        "seed_media_url": f"/api/media/{project.id}/{job.id}/primary" if job.result_uri else None,

        "sync": sync,

        "summary": summary,

    }





def hub_overview(db: Session) -> dict[str, Any]:

    projects = db.query(Project).order_by(Project.created_at.desc()).limit(50).all()

    items = []

    total_assets = 0

    for p in projects:

        s = bank_summary(db, p.id)

        if s["total"] == 0:

            continue

        total_assets += s["total"]

        items.append({"project_id": p.id, "name": p.name, **s})

    bank = (

        db.query(Project)

        .filter(Project.name == BANK_PROJECT_NAME)

        .order_by(Project.created_at.desc())

        .first()

    )

    return {

        "projects_with_assets": len(items),

        "total_assets": total_assets,

        "bank_project_id": bank.id if bank else None,

        "projects": items,

    }


backend/app/services/data_lab.py
"""Art City Data Lab — ingest, inventory, annotation helpers, export."""



from __future__ import annotations



import csv

import hashlib

import io

import json

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from typing import Any, Optional

from uuid import uuid4



from fastapi import HTTPException, UploadFile, status

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session



from app.core.enums import AnnotationStatus, DatasetStatus, RightsStatus

from app.models import AnnotationTask, Dataset, DatasetFile, IngestionRun, RightsRecord, User

from app.services.speech import detect_language_dialect, wav_duration_seconds

from app.services.storage import get_storage



TEXT_EXTENSIONS = {".txt", ".md", ".srt", ".vtt", ".csv", ".json", ".jsonl"}

AUDIO_EXTENSIONS = {".wav", ".mp3", ".m4a", ".ogg", ".flac", ".aac"}

IMAGE_EXTENSIONS = {".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".webp", ".gif", ".bmp"}

VIDEO_EXTENSIONS = {".mp4", ".mov", ".webm", ".mkv"}

SUBTITLE_EXTENSIONS = {".srt", ".vtt"}





def sniff_media_type(filename: str, content_type: str | None) -> str:

    name = (filename or "").lower()

    ctype = (content_type or "").lower()

    ext = ""

    if "." in name:

        ext = "." + name.rsplit(".", 1)[-1]

    if ext in SUBTITLE_EXTENSIONS or "subrip" in ctype or "vtt" in ctype:

        return "subtitle"

    if ext in TEXT_EXTENSIONS or ctype.startswith("text/") or "json" in ctype:

        return "text"

    if ext in AUDIO_EXTENSIONS or ctype.startswith("audio/"):

        return "speech" if ext in {".wav", ".mp3", ".m4a", ".flac"} else "audio"

    if ext in IMAGE_EXTENSIONS or ctype.startswith("image/"):

        return "image"

    if ext in VIDEO_EXTENSIONS or ctype.startswith("video/"):

        return "video"

    if "music" in name:

        return "music"

    return "other"





def dataset_rights_status(db: Session, dataset_id: str) -> str:

    rights = (

        db.query(RightsRecord)

        .filter(RightsRecord.dataset_id == dataset_id)

        .order_by(RightsRecord.created_at.desc())

        .first()

    )

    if not rights:

        return RightsStatus.UNKNOWN.value

    return rights.legal_status or RightsStatus.UNKNOWN.value





def _existing_checksums(db: Session, dataset_id: str) -> set[str]:

    rows = (

        db.query(DatasetFile.checksum)

        .filter(DatasetFile.dataset_id == dataset_id, DatasetFile.soft_deleted.is_(False))

        .all()

    )

    return {r[0] for r in rows if r[0]}





async def ingest_uploads(

    db: Session,

    *,

    user: User,

    files: list[UploadFile],

    dataset_id: str | None = None,

    dataset_name: str | None = None,

    language: str | None = "ku",

    dialect: str | None = None,

) -> IngestionRun:

    if not files:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="At least one file is required")



    run = IngestionRun(source_type="upload", status="processing", operator_id=user.id, report={})

    db.add(run)

    db.flush()



    if dataset_id:

        dataset = db.get(Dataset, dataset_id)

        if not dataset:

            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Dataset not found")

    else:

        dataset = Dataset(

            name=dataset_name or f"Ingest {datetime.now(timezone.utc).date()}",

            category="archive",

            media_type="mixed",

            owner="Art City",

            status=DatasetStatus.INGESTING.value,

            created_by=user.id,

            language=language or "ku",

            dialect=dialect,

        )

        db.add(dataset)

        db.flush()



    storage = get_storage()

    rights_status = dataset_rights_status(db, dataset.id)

    known = _existing_checksums(db, dataset.id)

    batch_seen: set[str] = set()



    imported = 0

    failed = 0

    duplicates = 0

    unknown_rights = 0

    total_bytes = 0

    text_samples: list[str] = []

    dialect_votes: dict[str, int] = {}

    file_ids: list[str] = []

    media_counts: dict[str, int] = {}

    start = datetime.now(timezone.utc)



    for f in files:

        try:

            data = await f.read()

            if not data:

                failed += 1

                continue

            digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

            if digest in batch_seen or digest in known:

                duplicates += 1

                continue

            batch_seen.add(digest)

            known.add(digest)



            filename = (f.filename or f"file-{uuid4().hex[:8]}").replace("/", "_").replace("\\", "_")

            content_type = f.content_type or "application/octet-stream"

            media_type = sniff_media_type(filename, content_type)

            key = f"datasets/{dataset.id}/raw/{digest[:16]}_{filename}"

            storage.upload_bytes(key, data, content_type)



            file_lang = language or dataset.language

            file_dialect = dialect or dataset.dialect

            duration = wav_duration_seconds(data) if media_type in {"speech", "audio"} else None

            sample_text: str | None = None



            if media_type in {"text", "subtitle"}:

                try:

                    sample_text = data[:8000].decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")

                    if sample_text.strip():

                        text_samples.append(sample_text)

                        detected = detect_language_dialect(sample_text)

                        file_lang = detected.get("language") or file_lang

                        file_dialect = detected.get("dialect") or file_dialect

                        dialect_votes[detected["dialect"]] = dialect_votes.get(detected["dialect"], 0) + 1

                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001

                    pass



            df = DatasetFile(

                id=str(uuid4()),

                dataset_id=dataset.id,

                ingestion_run_id=run.id,

                filename=filename,

                storage_key=key,

                checksum=digest,

                content_type=content_type,

                media_type=media_type,

                size_bytes=len(data),

                language=file_lang,

                dialect=file_dialect,

                rights_status=rights_status,

                duration_seconds=duration,

                metadata_json={

                    "original_filename": f.filename,

                    "operator_id": user.id,

                },

            )

            db.add(df)

            db.flush()

            file_ids.append(df.id)

            imported += 1

            total_bytes += len(data)

            media_counts[media_type] = media_counts.get(media_type, 0) + 1

            if rights_status == RightsStatus.UNKNOWN.value:

                unknown_rights += 1



            if media_type in {"text", "subtitle"} and sample_text and sample_text.strip():

                db.add(

                    AnnotationTask(

                        dataset_id=dataset.id,

                        media_type=media_type,

                        payload={

                            "text": sample_text[:4000],

                            "language": file_lang or "ku",

                            "file_id": df.id,

                            "storage_key": key,

                            "filename": filename,

                        },

                        labels={

                            "dialect": file_dialect,

                            "source": "ingest",

                            "file_id": df.id,

                        },

                        status=AnnotationStatus.PENDING.value,

                        assignee_id=user.id,

                        comments=[{"note": "Auto-created from Data Lab ingest"}],

                        revision_history=[],

                    )

                )

            elif media_type == "speech":

                db.add(

                    AnnotationTask(

                        dataset_id=dataset.id,

                        media_type="speech",

                        payload={

                            "text": "",

                            "language": file_lang or "ku",

                            "file_id": df.id,

                            "storage_key": key,

                            "filename": filename,

                            "duration_seconds": duration,

                        },

                        labels={

                            "dialect": file_dialect or dialect or "sorani",

                            "source": "ingest",

                            "file_id": df.id,

                            "needs_transcript": True,

                        },

                        status=AnnotationStatus.PENDING.value,

                        assignee_id=user.id,

                        comments=[{"note": "Speech file ingested — transcript pending"}],

                        revision_history=[],

                    )

                )

        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001

            failed += 1



    detected_dialect = dialect

    detected_language = language or "ku"

    detection_confidence = None

    if dialect_votes:

        detected_dialect = max(dialect_votes, key=dialect_votes.get)

        detection_confidence = round(

            dialect_votes[detected_dialect] / max(sum(dialect_votes.values()), 1), 3

        )

    elif text_samples:

        detected = detect_language_dialect("\n".join(text_samples[:3]))

        detected_dialect = detected["dialect"]

        detected_language = detected["language"]

        detection_confidence = detected["confidence"]



    if detected_language and not dataset.language:

        dataset.language = detected_language

    if detected_dialect and not dataset.dialect:

        dataset.dialect = detected_dialect



    dataset.record_count = (dataset.record_count or 0) + imported

    dataset.size_bytes = (dataset.size_bytes or 0) + total_bytes

    dataset.status = DatasetStatus.NEEDS_REVIEW.value

    dataset.storage_path = f"datasets/{dataset.id}/raw/"

    dataset.checksum = hashlib.sha256(",".join(sorted(batch_seen | known)).encode()).hexdigest() if imported else dataset.checksum



    finished = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    run.dataset_id = dataset.id

    run.status = "completed"

    run.finished_at = finished

    run.report = {

        "imported": imported,

        "duplicates": duplicates,

        "failed": failed,

        "unknown_rights": unknown_rights,

        "needs_review": imported,

        "total_bytes": total_bytes,

        "duration_seconds": (finished - start).total_seconds(),

        "operator": user.email,

        "language": detected_language,

        "dialect": detected_dialect,

        "dialect_votes": dialect_votes,

        "detection_confidence": detection_confidence,

        "text_files_scanned": len(text_samples),

        "media_counts": media_counts,

        "file_ids": file_ids,

        "dataset_id": dataset.id,

        "rights_status": rights_status,

    }

    db.commit()

    db.refresh(run)

    return run





def get_dataset_detail(db: Session, dataset_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:

    dataset = db.get(Dataset, dataset_id)

    if not dataset:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Dataset not found")

    file_count = (

        db.query(DatasetFile)

        .filter(DatasetFile.dataset_id == dataset_id, DatasetFile.soft_deleted.is_(False))

        .count()

    )

    approved = (

        db.query(AnnotationTask)

        .filter(

            AnnotationTask.dataset_id == dataset_id,

            AnnotationTask.status == AnnotationStatus.APPROVED.value,

        )

        .count()

    )

    pending = (

        db.query(AnnotationTask)

        .filter(

            AnnotationTask.dataset_id == dataset_id,

            AnnotationTask.status.in_(

                [AnnotationStatus.PENDING.value, AnnotationStatus.IN_REVIEW.value]

            ),

        )

        .count()

    )

    rights = (

        db.query(RightsRecord)

        .filter(RightsRecord.dataset_id == dataset_id)

        .order_by(RightsRecord.created_at.desc())

        .first()

    )

    latest = (

        db.query(IngestionRun)

        .filter(IngestionRun.dataset_id == dataset_id)

        .order_by(IngestionRun.created_at.desc())

        .first()

    )

    return {

        "id": dataset.id,

        "name": dataset.name,

        "description": dataset.description,

        "category": dataset.category,

        "media_type": dataset.media_type,

        "language": dataset.language,

        "dialect": dataset.dialect,

        "owner": dataset.owner,

        "status": dataset.status,

        "version": dataset.version,

        "record_count": dataset.record_count,

        "size_bytes": dataset.size_bytes,

        "checksum": dataset.checksum,

        "storage_path": dataset.storage_path,

        "ai_training_permission": dataset.ai_training_permission,

        "commercial_use": dataset.commercial_use,

        "voice_cloning_permission": dataset.voice_cloning_permission,

        "intended_model_use": dataset.intended_model_use,

        "created_at": dataset.created_at.isoformat() if dataset.created_at else None,

        "file_count": file_count,

        "approved_annotations": approved,

        "pending_annotations": pending,

        "rights": (

            {

                "id": rights.id,

                "copyright_owner": rights.copyright_owner,

                "legal_status": rights.legal_status,

                "ai_training": rights.ai_training,

                "commercial_use": rights.commercial_use,

            }

            if rights

            else None

        ),

        "latest_ingestion": (

            {

                "id": latest.id,

                "status": latest.status,

                "report": latest.report,

                "created_at": latest.created_at.isoformat() if latest.created_at else None,

            }

            if latest

            else None

        ),

    }





def list_dataset_files(db: Session, dataset_id: str, limit: int = 200) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:

    if not db.get(Dataset, dataset_id):

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Dataset not found")

    rows = (

        db.query(DatasetFile)

        .filter(DatasetFile.dataset_id == dataset_id, DatasetFile.soft_deleted.is_(False))

        .order_by(DatasetFile.created_at.desc())

        .limit(limit)

        .all()

    )

    return [

        {

            "id": f.id,

            "dataset_id": f.dataset_id,

            "ingestion_run_id": f.ingestion_run_id,

            "filename": f.filename,

            "storage_key": f.storage_key,

            "checksum": f.checksum,

            "content_type": f.content_type,

            "media_type": f.media_type,

            "size_bytes": f.size_bytes,

            "language": f.language,

            "dialect": f.dialect,

            "rights_status": f.rights_status,

            "duration_seconds": f.duration_seconds,

            "media_url": f"/api/media/datasets/{f.dataset_id}/files/{f.id}",

            "created_at": f.created_at.isoformat() if f.created_at else None,

        }

        for f in rows

    ]





def get_ingestion(db: Session, run_id: str) -> IngestionRun:

    run = db.get(IngestionRun, run_id)

    if not run:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Ingestion not found")

    return run





def get_dataset_file_bytes(db: Session, dataset_id: str, file_id: str) -> tuple[bytes, str, str]:

    df = db.get(DatasetFile, file_id)

    if not df or df.dataset_id != dataset_id or df.soft_deleted:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Dataset file not found")

    try:

        data, content_type = get_storage().get_object(df.storage_key)

    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="File missing in storage") from exc

    return data, content_type or df.content_type or "application/octet-stream", df.filename





def build_training_manifest(db: Session, dataset_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:

    detail = get_dataset_detail(db, dataset_id)

    files = list_dataset_files(db, dataset_id, limit=5000)

    approved = (

        db.query(AnnotationTask)

        .filter(

            AnnotationTask.dataset_id == dataset_id,

            AnnotationTask.status == AnnotationStatus.APPROVED.value,

        )

        .all()

    )

    return {

        "product": "Art City Data Lab",

        "kind": "training_manifest",

        "dataset": {

            "id": detail["id"],

            "name": detail["name"],

            "version": detail["version"],

            "status": detail["status"],

            "language": detail["language"],

            "dialect": detail["dialect"],

            "media_type": detail["media_type"],

            "checksum": detail["checksum"],

            "ai_training_permission": detail["ai_training_permission"],

        },

        "rights": detail["rights"],

        "file_count": detail["file_count"],

        "approved_annotation_count": len(approved),

        "pending_annotation_count": detail["pending_annotations"],

        "files": [

            {

                "id": f["id"],

                "filename": f["filename"],

                "storage_key": f["storage_key"],

                "checksum": f["checksum"],

                "media_type": f["media_type"],

                "size_bytes": f["size_bytes"],

            }

            for f in files

        ],

        "approved_annotations": [

            {

                "id": t.id,

                "media_type": t.media_type,

                "payload": t.payload,

                "labels": t.labels,

            }

            for t in approved

        ],

        "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),

        "ownership": "Art City owns dataset records, labels, and export manifests.",

    }





def export_dataset(

    db: Session,

    dataset_id: str,

    *,

    fmt: str = "jsonl",

    persist: bool = False,

) -> tuple[bytes, str, str]:

    if fmt not in {"jsonl", "csv"}:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="format must be jsonl or csv")

    if not db.get(Dataset, dataset_id):

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Dataset not found")



    tasks = (

        db.query(AnnotationTask)

        .filter(

            AnnotationTask.dataset_id == dataset_id,

            AnnotationTask.status == AnnotationStatus.APPROVED.value,

        )

        .order_by(AnnotationTask.created_at.asc())

        .all()

    )

    records = []

    for t in tasks:

        payload = t.payload or {}

        labels = t.labels or {}

        records.append(

            {

                "annotation_id": t.id,

                "dataset_id": dataset_id,

                "media_type": t.media_type,

                "text": payload.get("text"),

                "language": payload.get("language"),

                "dialect": labels.get("dialect"),

                "translation": labels.get("translation"),

                "labels": labels,

                "payload": payload,

                "file_id": payload.get("file_id") or labels.get("file_id"),

                "storage_key": payload.get("storage_key"),

                "source_job_id": labels.get("source_job_id"),

            }

        )



    if fmt == "jsonl":

        body = ("\n".join(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False) for r in records) + ("\n" if records else "")).encode(

            "utf-8"

        )

        media = "application/x-ndjson"

        filename = f"art-city-{dataset_id[:8]}-export.jsonl"

    else:

        buf = io.StringIO()

        writer = csv.DictWriter(

            buf,

            fieldnames=[

                "annotation_id",

                "dataset_id",

                "media_type",

                "text",

                "language",

                "dialect",

                "translation",

                "file_id",

                "storage_key",

                "source_job_id",

            ],

            extrasaction="ignore",

        )

        writer.writeheader()

        for r in records:

            writer.writerow(r)

        body = buf.getvalue().encode("utf-8")

        media = "text/csv"

        filename = f"art-city-{dataset_id[:8]}-export.csv"



    if persist:

        ts = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

        key = f"datasets/{dataset_id}/exports/{ts}.{fmt}"

        get_storage().upload_bytes(key, body, media)



    return body, media, filename





def get_annotation(db: Session, task_id: str) -> AnnotationTask:

    task = db.get(AnnotationTask, task_id)

    if not task:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Annotation not found")

    return task





def annotation_stats(db: Session, dataset_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:

    q = db.query(AnnotationTask)

    if dataset_id:

        q = q.filter(AnnotationTask.dataset_id == dataset_id)

    tasks = q.order_by(AnnotationTask.created_at.desc()).limit(2000).all()

    by_status: dict[str, int] = {}

    by_media: dict[str, int] = {}

    asr_sourced = 0

    ingest_sourced = 0

    for t in tasks:

        by_status[t.status] = by_status.get(t.status, 0) + 1

        by_media[t.media_type] = by_media.get(t.media_type, 0) + 1

        labels = t.labels or {}

        if labels.get("source_job_id") or labels.get("source") == "asr":

            asr_sourced += 1

        if labels.get("source") == "ingest":

            ingest_sourced += 1

    return {

        "total": len(tasks),

        "by_status": by_status,

        "by_media": by_media,

        "asr_sourced": asr_sourced,

        "ingest_sourced": ingest_sourced,

        "dataset_id": dataset_id,

    }





def update_annotation_task(

    db: Session,

    *,

    task_id: str,

    user: User,

    labels: Optional[dict] = None,

    status_value: Optional[str] = None,

    comment: Optional[str] = None,

    payload: Optional[dict] = None,

) -> AnnotationTask:

    task = db.get(AnnotationTask, task_id)

    if not task:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Annotation not found")



    allowed = {s.value for s in AnnotationStatus}

    if status_value is not None and status_value not in allowed:

        raise HTTPException(

            status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,

            detail=f"Invalid status. Allowed: {sorted(allowed)}",

        )

    if status_value == AnnotationStatus.REJECTED.value and not (comment or "").strip():

        raise HTTPException(

            status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,

            detail="comment is required when rejecting an annotation",

        )



    history = list(task.revision_history or [])

    history.append(

        {

            "at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),

            "by": user.email,

            "before_labels": task.labels,

            "before_status": task.status,

            "before_payload": task.payload if payload is not None else None,

        }

    )

    task.revision_history = history

    if labels is not None:

        task.labels = labels

    if payload is not None:

        merged = dict(task.payload or {})

        merged.update(payload)

        task.payload = merged

    if status_value is not None:

        task.status = status_value

    if comment:

        comments = list(task.comments or [])

        comments.append(

            {"by": user.email, "text": comment, "at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}

        )

        task.comments = comments

    db.commit()

    db.refresh(task)

    return task

    },

    "ctv": {

        "label": "CTV / Connected TV",

        "channel": "broadcast",

        "aspect": "16:9",

        "width": 1920,

        "height": 1080,

        "fps": 24.0,

        "codec": "h264",

        "audio": "aac_stereo",

        "loudness_lufs": -24.0,

        "max_duration_seconds": 30,

        "captions": "sidecar_vtt",

    },

}





VARIANT_LABELS = {

    "A": "Control — primary brief",

    "B": "Alt CTA emphasis",

    "C": "Alt music / emotional beat",

}





def resolve_delivery_targets(targets: list[str] | None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:

    if not targets:

        return [dict(v, id=k) for k, v in DELIVERY_PRESETS.items() if k in {"youtube", "meta_stories", "broadcast_tv"}]

    out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for t in targets:

        preset = DELIVERY_PRESETS.get(t)

        if preset:

            out.append(dict(preset, id=t))

    return out or resolve_delivery_targets(None)





def variant_brief(base_brief: str, base_cta: str, variant: str) -> tuple[str, str]:

    if variant == "B":

        return (

            f"{base_brief} Emphasize the call to action and brand payoff.",

            f"{base_cta} — now",

        )

    if variant == "C":

        return (

            f"{base_brief} Softer emotional open, stronger human beat before brand.",

            base_cta,

        )

    return base_brief, base_cta





def variant_music_style(base: str, variant: str) -> str:

    if variant == "C":

        return {"epic": "warm", "warm": "soft", "pulse": "warm", "soft": "warm"}.get(base, "warm")

    return base


backend/app/services/edit_access.py
"""Art City Edit — access applications, plans, and subscription activation."""



from __future__ import annotations



from datetime import datetime, timezone

from typing import Any, Optional

from uuid import uuid4



from sqlalchemy.orm import Session



from app.core.enums import EditAccountState, EditWorkspaceRole

from app.models import User

from app.models_edit import (

    EditAccessApplication,

    EditMembership,

    EditOrganisation,

    EditPlan,

    EditSubscription,

    EditWorkspace,

)

from app.services.audit import write_audit

from app.services.edit_entitlements import is_platform_admin, issue_plan_entitlements



DEFAULT_PLANS: list[dict[str, Any]] = [

    {

        "code": "creator",

        "name": "Creator",

        "description": "Approved individual creator or small team.",

        "price_usd_monthly": 49.0,

        "feature_flags": {"exports": "standard", "review": "basic"},

        "limits_json": {

            "processing_minutes": 120,

            "storage_gb": 50,

            "workspaces": 1,

            "seats": 3,

            "exports_per_month": 40,

        },

    },

    {

        "code": "professional",

        "name": "Professional",

        "description": "Production company, agency, label or media team.",

        "price_usd_monthly": 199.0,

        "feature_flags": {"exports": "advanced", "review": "advanced", "analytics": True},

        "limits_json": {

            "processing_minutes": 600,

            "storage_gb": 500,

            "workspaces": 5,

            "seats": 15,

            "exports_per_month": 200,

        },

    },

    {

        "code": "broadcast",

        "name": "Broadcast / Enterprise",

        "description": "Broadcaster, archive, government or large organisation.",

        "price_usd_monthly": None,

        "feature_flags": {"exports": "broadcast", "sso": True, "audit_export": True},

        "limits_json": {

            "processing_minutes": 5000,

            "storage_gb": 5000,

            "workspaces": 50,

            "seats": 100,

            "exports_per_month": 2000,

        },

    },

    {

        "code": "internal_art_city",

        "name": "Internal Art City",

        "description": "Art City Group brands and approved departments.",

        "price_usd_monthly": 0.0,

        "feature_flags": {"exports": "broadcast", "internal": True},

        "limits_json": {

            "processing_minutes": 100000,

            "storage_gb": 100000,

            "workspaces": 100,

            "seats": 500,

            "exports_per_month": 100000,

        },

    },

]





def list_plans(db: Session) -> list[EditPlan]:

    return db.query(EditPlan).filter(EditPlan.is_active.is_(True)).order_by(EditPlan.name).all()





def ensure_default_plans(db: Session) -> list[EditPlan]:

    plans: list[EditPlan] = []

    for spec in DEFAULT_PLANS:

        plan = db.query(EditPlan).filter(EditPlan.code == spec["code"]).first()

        if plan:

            plan.name = spec["name"]

            plan.description = spec["description"]

            plan.feature_flags = spec["feature_flags"]

            plan.limits_json = spec["limits_json"]

            plan.price_usd_monthly = spec["price_usd_monthly"]

            plan.is_active = True

        else:

            plan = EditPlan(

                id=str(uuid4()),

                code=spec["code"],

                name=spec["name"],

                description=spec["description"],

                feature_flags=spec["feature_flags"],

                limits_json=spec["limits_json"],

                price_usd_monthly=spec["price_usd_monthly"],

                is_active=True,

            )

            db.add(plan)

        plans.append(plan)

    db.flush()

    return plans





def submit_application(db: Session, user: User, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> EditAccessApplication:

    org_name = (payload.get("organisation_name") or "").strip()

    if not org_name:

        raise ValueError("organisation_name is required")

    if not payload.get("declarations_accepted"):

        raise ValueError("declarations_accepted must be true")



    plan_code = payload.get("requested_plan_code") or "creator"

    ensure_default_plans(db)

    plan = db.query(EditPlan).filter(EditPlan.code == plan_code, EditPlan.is_active.is_(True)).first()

    if not plan:

        raise ValueError(f"Unknown plan: {plan_code}")



    org = EditOrganisation(

        id=str(uuid4()),

        legal_name=org_name,

        display_name=payload.get("display_name") or org_name,

        country=payload.get("country"),

        org_type=payload.get("business_type") or "creator",

        status=EditAccountState.PENDING_ART_CITY_REVIEW.value,

        owner_user_id=user.id,

        website=payload.get("website"),

        ai_training_opt_in=bool(payload.get("ai_training_opt_in", False)),

        metadata_json=payload.get("metadata_json") or {},

    )

    db.add(org)

    db.flush()



    application = EditAccessApplication(

        id=str(uuid4()),

        organisation_id=org.id,

        applicant_user_id=user.id,

        requested_plan_code=plan_code,

        use_case=payload.get("use_case"),

        expected_monthly_minutes=payload.get("expected_monthly_minutes"),

        country=payload.get("country"),

        website=payload.get("website"),

        organisation_name=org_name,

        business_type=payload.get("business_type"),

        billing_contact_email=payload.get("billing_contact_email") or user.email,

        declarations_accepted=True,

        state=EditAccountState.PENDING_ART_CITY_REVIEW.value,

        documents_json=payload.get("documents_json") or {},

        conditions_json={},

    )

    db.add(application)

    db.flush()



    write_audit(

        db,

        action="edit.application.submitted",

        resource_type="edit_access_application",

        resource_id=application.id,

        user_id=user.id,

        detail={"organisation_id": org.id, "plan": plan_code},

    )

    db.flush()

    return application





def _activate_org_with_plan(

    db: Session,

    *,

    org: EditOrganisation,

    plan: EditPlan,

    actor_user_id: str,

    billing_method: str = "invoice",

    workspace_name: Optional[str] = None,

) -> tuple[EditSubscription, EditWorkspace]:

    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    sub = EditSubscription(

        id=str(uuid4()),

        organisation_id=org.id,

        plan_id=plan.id,

        billing_method=billing_method,

        status="active",

        period_start=now,

        metadata_json={"activated_by": actor_user_id},

    )

    db.add(sub)



    org.status = EditAccountState.ACTIVE.value

    db.add(org)



    issue_plan_entitlements(db, org.id, plan)



    workspace = (

        db.query(EditWorkspace)

        .filter(EditWorkspace.organisation_id == org.id)

        .order_by(EditWorkspace.created_at.asc())

        .first()

    )

    if not workspace:

        workspace = EditWorkspace(

            id=str(uuid4()),

            organisation_id=org.id,

            name=workspace_name or f"{org.display_name} Workspace",

            status=EditAccountState.ACTIVE.value,

        )

        db.add(workspace)

        db.flush()



    owner_membership = (

        db.query(EditMembership)

        .filter(

            EditMembership.organisation_id == org.id,

            EditMembership.user_id == org.owner_user_id,

            EditMembership.role == EditWorkspaceRole.OWNER.value,

        )

        .first()

    )

    if org.owner_user_id and not owner_membership:

        db.add(

            EditMembership(

                id=str(uuid4()),

                organisation_id=org.id,

                workspace_id=workspace.id,

                user_id=org.owner_user_id,

                role=EditWorkspaceRole.OWNER.value,

                status="active",

                invited_by=actor_user_id,

            )

        )

    db.flush()

    return sub, workspace





def review_application(

    db: Session,

    application_id: str,

    reviewer: User,

    action: str,

    reason: Optional[str] = None,

    plan_code: Optional[str] = None,

    conditions: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None,

) -> EditAccessApplication:

    if not is_platform_admin(reviewer):

        raise ValueError("Only platform admins may review applications")



    application = db.get(EditAccessApplication, application_id)

    if not application:

        raise ValueError("Application not found")

    org = db.get(EditOrganisation, application.organisation_id) if application.organisation_id else None

    if not org:

        raise ValueError("Organisation not found for application")



    action = action.lower().strip()

    ensure_default_plans(db)

    chosen_code = plan_code or application.requested_plan_code or "creator"

    plan = db.query(EditPlan).filter(EditPlan.code == chosen_code).first()

    if not plan:

        raise ValueError(f"Unknown plan: {chosen_code}")



    application.reviewer_user_id = reviewer.id

    application.decision_reason = reason

    if conditions is not None:

        application.conditions_json = conditions



    if action == "approve":

        application.requested_plan_code = chosen_code

        if chosen_code == "internal_art_city":

            application.state = EditAccountState.ACTIVE.value

            _activate_org_with_plan(

                db,

                org=org,

                plan=plan,

                actor_user_id=reviewer.id,

                billing_method="internal",

                workspace_name="Art City Edit",

            )

        else:

            application.state = EditAccountState.APPROVED_PENDING_BILLING.value

            org.status = EditAccountState.APPROVED_PENDING_BILLING.value

            db.add(org)

            # Pending subscription record (not active until billing)

            pending = EditSubscription(

                id=str(uuid4()),

                organisation_id=org.id,

                plan_id=plan.id,

                billing_method="invoice",

                status="pending",

                metadata_json={"approved_by": reviewer.id, "conditions": conditions or {}},

            )

            db.add(pending)

    elif action == "reject":

        if not reason:

            raise ValueError("reason is required for reject")
