        application.state = EditAccountState.REJECTED.value

        org.status = EditAccountState.REJECTED.value

        db.add(org)

    elif action == "request_info":

        application.state = EditAccountState.MORE_INFORMATION_REQUIRED.value

        org.status = EditAccountState.MORE_INFORMATION_REQUIRED.value

        db.add(org)

    elif action == "suspend":

        if not reason:

            raise ValueError("reason is required for suspend")

        application.state = EditAccountState.SUSPENDED.value

        org.status = EditAccountState.SUSPENDED.value

        db.add(org)

        for sub in (

            db.query(EditSubscription)

            .filter(

                EditSubscription.organisation_id == org.id,

                EditSubscription.status == "active",

            )

            .all()

        ):

            sub.status = "suspended"

            db.add(sub)

    else:

        raise ValueError(f"Unknown action: {action}")



    db.add(application)

    db.flush()

    write_audit(

        db,

        action=f"edit.application.{action}",

        resource_type="edit_access_application",

        resource_id=application.id,

        user_id=reviewer.id,

        detail={

            "organisation_id": org.id,

            "plan": chosen_code,

            "reason": reason,

            "state": application.state,

        },

    )

    db.flush()

    return application





def activate_subscription_invoice(

    db: Session,

    organisation_id: str,

    plan_code: str,

    actor_user_id: str,

) -> EditSubscription:

    org = db.get(EditOrganisation, organisation_id)

    if not org:

        raise ValueError("Organisation not found")

    if org.status not in {

        EditAccountState.APPROVED_PENDING_BILLING.value,

        EditAccountState.ACTIVE.value,

        EditAccountState.PAST_DUE.value,

    }:

        raise ValueError(f"Organisation status {org.status} cannot activate billing")



    ensure_default_plans(db)

    plan = db.query(EditPlan).filter(EditPlan.code == plan_code, EditPlan.is_active.is_(True)).first()

    if not plan:

        raise ValueError(f"Unknown plan: {plan_code}")



    # Supersede prior pending/active rows

    for sub in (

        db.query(EditSubscription)

        .filter(

            EditSubscription.organisation_id == organisation_id,

            EditSubscription.status.in_(["pending", "active"]),

        )

        .all()

    ):

        sub.status = "superseded"

        db.add(sub)



    sub, _workspace = _activate_org_with_plan(

        db,

        org=org,

        plan=plan,

        actor_user_id=actor_user_id,

        billing_method="invoice",

    )

    write_audit(

        db,

        action="edit.subscription.activated",

        resource_type="edit_subscription",

        resource_id=sub.id,

        user_id=actor_user_id,

        detail={"organisation_id": organisation_id, "plan": plan_code, "method": "invoice"},

    )

    db.flush()

    return sub





def seed_internal_art_city(db: Session, admin_user: User) -> EditOrganisation:

    ensure_default_plans(db)

    plan = db.query(EditPlan).filter(EditPlan.code == "internal_art_city").first()

    if not plan:

        raise ValueError("internal_art_city plan missing")



    org = (

        db.query(EditOrganisation)

        .filter(EditOrganisation.display_name == "Art City Group")

        .first()

    )

    if org and org.status == EditAccountState.ACTIVE.value:

        return org



    if not org:

        org = EditOrganisation(

            id=str(uuid4()),

            legal_name="Art City Group",

            display_name="Art City Group",

            country="IQ",

            org_type="internal",

            status=EditAccountState.ACTIVE.value,

            owner_user_id=admin_user.id,

            risk_level="internal",

            ai_training_opt_in=False,

            metadata_json={"seeded": True},

        )

        db.add(org)

        db.flush()

    else:

        org.status = EditAccountState.ACTIVE.value

        org.owner_user_id = org.owner_user_id or admin_user.id

        db.add(org)



    _activate_org_with_plan(

        db,

        org=org,

        plan=plan,

        actor_user_id=admin_user.id,

        billing_method="internal",

        workspace_name="Art City Edit",

    )



    # Ensure dedicated Art City Edit workspace + owner membership

    workspace = (

        db.query(EditWorkspace)

        .filter(

            EditWorkspace.organisation_id == org.id,

            EditWorkspace.name == "Art City Edit",

        )

        .first()

    )

    if not workspace:

        workspace = EditWorkspace(

            id=str(uuid4()),

            organisation_id=org.id,

            name="Art City Edit",

            status=EditAccountState.ACTIVE.value,

        )

        db.add(workspace)

        db.flush()



    membership = (

        db.query(EditMembership)

        .filter(

            EditMembership.workspace_id == workspace.id,

            EditMembership.user_id == admin_user.id,

        )

        .first()

    )

    if not membership:

        db.add(

            EditMembership(

                id=str(uuid4()),

                organisation_id=org.id,

                workspace_id=workspace.id,

                user_id=admin_user.id,

                role=EditWorkspaceRole.OWNER.value,

                status="active",

                invited_by=admin_user.id,

            )

        )



    write_audit(

        db,

        action="edit.org.seed_internal",

        resource_type="edit_organisation",

        resource_id=org.id,

        user_id=admin_user.id,

        detail={"workspace": "Art City Edit", "plan": "internal_art_city"},

    )

    db.flush()

    return org


backend/app/services/edit_entitlements.py
"""Art City Edit — entitlement and workspace access checks."""



from __future__ import annotations



from datetime import datetime, timezone

from typing import Optional, Sequence

from uuid import uuid4



from sqlalchemy.orm import Session



from app.core.enums import EDIT_APPROVAL_ROLES, EditAccountState, UserRole

from app.models import User

from app.models_edit import (

    EditEntitlement,

    EditMembership,

    EditOrganisation,

    EditPlan,

    EditSubscription,

    EditUsageRecord,

    EditWorkspace,

)





def is_platform_admin(user: User) -> bool:

    role = getattr(user, "role", None)

    if isinstance(role, UserRole):

        return role in EDIT_APPROVAL_ROLES

    return role in {UserRole.SUPER_ADMIN.value, UserRole.ADMINISTRATOR.value}





def get_user_memberships(db: Session, user_id: str) -> list[EditMembership]:

    return (

        db.query(EditMembership)

        .filter(EditMembership.user_id == user_id, EditMembership.status == "active")

        .all()

    )





def require_workspace_access(

    db: Session,

    user: User,

    workspace_id: str,

    roles: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None,

) -> EditMembership:

    if is_platform_admin(user):

        workspace = db.get(EditWorkspace, workspace_id)

        if not workspace:

            raise ValueError("Workspace not found")

        membership = (

            db.query(EditMembership)

            .filter(

                EditMembership.user_id == user.id,

                EditMembership.workspace_id == workspace_id,

                EditMembership.status == "active",

            )

            .first()

        )

        if membership:

            return membership

        # Synthetic admin membership for platform operators

        return EditMembership(

            id=str(uuid4()),

            organisation_id=workspace.organisation_id,

            workspace_id=workspace_id,

            user_id=user.id,

            role="admin",

            status="active",

        )



    q = db.query(EditMembership).filter(

        EditMembership.user_id == user.id,

        EditMembership.status == "active",

        EditMembership.workspace_id == workspace_id,

    )

    membership = q.first()

    if not membership:

        # Org-level membership without workspace scoping

        workspace = db.get(EditWorkspace, workspace_id)

        if not workspace:

            raise ValueError("Workspace not found")

        membership = (

            db.query(EditMembership)

            .filter(

                EditMembership.user_id == user.id,

                EditMembership.organisation_id == workspace.organisation_id,

                EditMembership.status == "active",

                EditMembership.workspace_id.is_(None),

            )

            .first()

        )

    if not membership:

        raise ValueError("Workspace access denied")

    if roles and membership.role not in roles and not is_platform_admin(user):

        raise ValueError(f"Role required: {', '.join(roles)}")

    return membership





def org_is_processable(db: Session, org_id: str) -> bool:

    org = db.get(EditOrganisation, org_id)

    if not org or org.status != EditAccountState.ACTIVE.value:

        return False

    sub = (

        db.query(EditSubscription)

        .filter(

            EditSubscription.organisation_id == org_id,

            EditSubscription.status == "active",

        )

        .order_by(EditSubscription.created_at.desc())

        .first()

    )

    return sub is not None





def assert_entitled(

    db: Session,

    organisation_id: str,

    feature: str = "processing_minutes",

    amount: float = 0,

) -> EditEntitlement:

    org = db.get(EditOrganisation, organisation_id)

    if not org:

        raise ValueError("Organisation not found")

    if org.status in {

        EditAccountState.SUSPENDED.value,

        EditAccountState.TERMINATED.value,

        EditAccountState.CANCELLED.value,

        EditAccountState.REJECTED.value,

    }:

        raise ValueError(f"Organisation is {org.status}")

    if not org_is_processable(db, organisation_id):

        raise ValueError("Organisation is not processable — inactive subscription or status")



    entitlement = (

        db.query(EditEntitlement)

        .filter(

            EditEntitlement.organisation_id == organisation_id,

            EditEntitlement.feature == feature,

        )

        .order_by(EditEntitlement.created_at.desc())

        .first()

    )

    if not entitlement:

        raise ValueError(f"No entitlement for feature '{feature}'")

    if entitlement.limit_value >= 0 and (entitlement.used_value + amount) > entitlement.limit_value:

        raise ValueError(f"Entitlement limit exceeded for '{feature}'")

    return entitlement





def record_usage(

    db: Session,

    organisation_id: str,

    metric: str,

    quantity: float,

    cost_usd: float = 0,

    workspace_id: Optional[str] = None,

    job_id: Optional[str] = None,

) -> EditUsageRecord:

    period = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m")

    record = EditUsageRecord(

        id=str(uuid4()),

        organisation_id=organisation_id,

        workspace_id=workspace_id,

        job_id=job_id,

        metric=metric,

        quantity=quantity,

        cost_usd=cost_usd,

        billing_period=period,

    )

    db.add(record)



    entitlement = (

        db.query(EditEntitlement)

        .filter(

            EditEntitlement.organisation_id == organisation_id,

            EditEntitlement.feature == metric,

        )

        .order_by(EditEntitlement.created_at.desc())

        .first()

    )

    if entitlement:

        entitlement.used_value = float(entitlement.used_value or 0) + float(quantity)

        db.add(entitlement)



    db.flush()

    return record





def issue_plan_entitlements(

    db: Session,

    organisation_id: str,

    plan: EditPlan,

) -> list[EditEntitlement]:

    limits = plan.limits_json or {}

    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    issued: list[EditEntitlement] = []

    for feature, limit_value in limits.items():

        try:

            numeric = float(limit_value)

        except (TypeError, ValueError):

            continue

        existing = (

            db.query(EditEntitlement)

            .filter(

                EditEntitlement.organisation_id == organisation_id,

                EditEntitlement.feature == feature,

            )

            .order_by(EditEntitlement.created_at.desc())

            .first()

        )

        if existing:

            existing.limit_value = numeric

            existing.used_value = 0

            existing.effective_from = now

            db.add(existing)

            issued.append(existing)

        else:

            ent = EditEntitlement(

                id=str(uuid4()),

                organisation_id=organisation_id,

                feature=feature,

                limit_value=numeric,

                used_value=0,

                reset_rule="monthly",

                effective_from=now,

            )

            db.add(ent)

            issued.append(ent)

    db.flush()

    return issued


backend/app/services/edit_media.py
"""Art City Edit — media upload, projects, and analysis jobs."""



from __future__ import annotations



import hashlib

import json

import shutil

import subprocess

import tempfile

from pathlib import Path

from typing import Any, Optional

from uuid import uuid4



import httpx

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session



from app.core.config import get_settings

from app.core.enums import EditJobStatus, EditProjectStatus, EditVersionReviewStatus

from app.models import User

from app.models_edit import (

    EditAnalysisJob,

    EditCandidateClip,

    EditMediaAsset,

    EditProject,

    EditTimelineVersion,

    EditWorkspace,

)

from app.services.edit_entitlements import assert_entitled, org_is_processable, record_usage, require_workspace_access

from app.services.queue import enqueue_edit_job

from app.services.storage import get_storage





def _safe_filename(filename: str) -> str:

    return (filename or "upload.bin").replace("/", "_").replace("\\", "_").strip() or "upload.bin"





def _probe_duration(file_bytes: bytes, filename: str) -> Optional[float]:

    if not shutil.which("ffprobe"):

        return None

    suffix = Path(filename).suffix or ".bin"

    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=suffix, delete=False) as tmp:

        tmp.write(file_bytes)

        path = tmp.name

    try:

        result = subprocess.run(

            [

                "ffprobe",

                "-v",

                "quiet",

                "-print_format",

                "json",

                "-show_format",

                path,

            ],

            capture_output=True,

            text=True,

            timeout=60,

            check=False,

        )

        if result.returncode != 0:

            return None

        data = json.loads(result.stdout or "{}")

        duration = data.get("format", {}).get("duration")

        return float(duration) if duration is not None else None

    except (OSError, ValueError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired, json.JSONDecodeError):

        return None

    finally:

        Path(path).unlink(missing_ok=True)





def upload_source(

    db: Session,

    workspace_id: str,

    user: User,

    file_bytes: bytes,

    filename: str,

    content_type: str,

    rights_attested: bool,

    rights_notes: Optional[str] = None,

) -> EditMediaAsset:

    if not rights_attested:

        raise ValueError("rights_attested is required to upload source media")

    if not file_bytes:

        raise ValueError("Empty file")



    require_workspace_access(db, user, workspace_id)

    workspace = db.get(EditWorkspace, workspace_id)

    if not workspace:

        raise ValueError("Workspace not found")

    if not org_is_processable(db, workspace.organisation_id):

        raise ValueError("Organisation is not processable")

    assert_entitled(db, workspace.organisation_id, feature="storage_gb", amount=0)



    asset_id = str(uuid4())

    safe_name = _safe_filename(filename)

    checksum = hashlib.sha256(file_bytes).hexdigest()

    storage_key = f"edit/{workspace_id}/{asset_id}/master/{safe_name}"

    storage = get_storage()

    storage.upload_bytes(storage_key, file_bytes, content_type or "application/octet-stream")



    duration = _probe_duration(file_bytes, safe_name)

    if duration is None:

        # Text / non-media sources: estimate from size for pacing

        if (content_type or "").startswith("text/") or safe_name.endswith(".txt"):

            duration = max(15.0, min(180.0, len(file_bytes) / 12.0))

        else:

            duration = 30.0

    asset = EditMediaAsset(

        id=asset_id,

        workspace_id=workspace_id,

        owner_user_id=user.id,

        filename=safe_name,

        storage_key=storage_key,

        checksum=checksum,

        content_type=content_type or "application/octet-stream",

        size_bytes=len(file_bytes),

        duration_seconds=duration,

        rights_attested=True,

        rights_notes=rights_notes,

        rights_status="declared",

        technical_metadata={"uploaded_by": user.id},

    )

    db.add(asset)

    db.flush()

    create_proxy(db, asset, file_bytes)

    record_usage(

        db,

        workspace.organisation_id,

        metric="storage_gb",

        quantity=round(len(file_bytes) / (1024**3), 6),

        workspace_id=workspace_id,

    )

    db.flush()

    return asset





def create_proxy(db: Session, asset: EditMediaAsset, file_bytes: Optional[bytes] = None) -> EditMediaAsset:

    """Create an H.264 proxy when ffmpeg is available; otherwise master passthrough."""

    storage = get_storage()

    if file_bytes is None:

        try:

            file_bytes, _ = storage.get_object(asset.storage_key)

        except Exception:

            file_bytes = b""



    ct = (asset.content_type or "").lower()

    is_av = ct.startswith("video/") or ct.startswith("audio/") or asset.filename.lower().endswith(

        (".mp4", ".mov", ".mkv", ".webm", ".wav", ".mp3", ".m4a")

    )



    if is_av and file_bytes and shutil.which("ffmpeg"):

        suffix = Path(asset.filename).suffix or ".bin"

        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="artcity-proxy-") as tmp:

            root = Path(tmp)

            src = root / f"src{suffix}"

            out = root / "proxy.mp4"

            src.write_bytes(file_bytes)

            cmd = [

                "ffmpeg",

                "-y",

                "-hide_banner",

                "-loglevel",

                "error",

                "-i",

                str(src),

                "-vf",

                "scale=1280:-2",

                "-c:v",

                "libx264",

                "-preset",

                "veryfast",

                "-crf",

                "28",

                "-c:a",

                "aac",

                "-b:a",

                "128k",

                "-movflags",

                "+faststart",

                str(out),

            ]

            try:

                subprocess.run(cmd, check=True, capture_output=True, timeout=180)

                if out.exists() and out.stat().st_size > 32:

                    proxy_key = f"edit/{asset.workspace_id}/{asset.id}/proxy/proxy.mp4"

                    storage.upload_bytes(proxy_key, out.read_bytes(), "video/mp4")

                    asset.proxy_key = proxy_key

                    asset.technical_metadata = {

                        **(asset.technical_metadata or {}),

                        "proxy_mode": "ffmpeg_h264",

                        "ffmpeg_available": True,

                    }

                    db.add(asset)

                    db.flush()

                    return asset

            except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired, OSError):

                pass



    asset.proxy_key = asset.storage_key

    asset.technical_metadata = {

        **(asset.technical_metadata or {}),

        "proxy_mode": "master_passthrough",

        "ffmpeg_available": bool(shutil.which("ffmpeg")),

    }

    db.add(asset)

    db.flush()

    return asset





# Back-compat alias for older imports/tests

create_proxy_stub = create_proxy





def create_project(

    db: Session,

    workspace_id: str,

    user: User,

    title: str,

    source_asset_id: str,

    brand_profile_version_id: Optional[str] = None,

    production_project_id: Optional[str] = None,

    brief: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None,

) -> EditProject:

    require_workspace_access(db, user, workspace_id)

    asset = db.get(EditMediaAsset, source_asset_id)

    if not asset or asset.workspace_id != workspace_id:

        raise ValueError("Source asset not found in workspace")

    if not asset.rights_attested:

        raise ValueError("Source asset lacks rights attestation")



    project = EditProject(

        id=str(uuid4()),

        workspace_id=workspace_id,

        title=title.strip() or "Untitled Edit",

        status=EditProjectStatus.DRAFT.value,

        brand_profile_version_id=brand_profile_version_id,

        source_asset_id=source_asset_id,

        production_project_id=production_project_id,

        brief_json=brief or {},

        created_by=user.id,

    )

    db.add(project)

    db.flush()

    return project





def start_analysis(db: Session, project_id: str, user: User) -> EditAnalysisJob:

    project = db.get(EditProject, project_id)

    if not project:

        raise ValueError("Project not found")

    require_workspace_access(db, user, project.workspace_id)

    if not project.source_asset_id:

        raise ValueError("Project has no source asset")



    workspace = db.get(EditWorkspace, project.workspace_id)

    if not workspace:

        raise ValueError("Workspace not found")

    assert_entitled(db, workspace.organisation_id, feature="processing_minutes", amount=1)



    settings = get_settings()

    model_name = "openai-whisper-1" if (settings.openai_api_key or "").strip() else "artcity-analysis-v1"

    job = EditAnalysisJob(

        id=str(uuid4()),

        project_id=project.id,

        asset_id=project.source_asset_id,

        job_type="full",

        provider="artcity-edit",

        model=model_name,

        state=EditJobStatus.QUEUED.value,

        outputs_json={},

    )

    db.add(job)

    project.status = EditProjectStatus.ANALYSING.value

    db.add(project)

    db.flush()

    try:

        enqueue_edit_job("analysis", job.id)

    except Exception:

        pass

    # Inline like Model Gateway so production works without a separate worker.

    process_analysis_job(db, job.id)

    db.refresh(job)

    return job





def _whisper_transcript(file_bytes: bytes, filename: str) -> Optional[dict[str, Any]]:

    settings = get_settings()

    key = (settings.openai_api_key or "").strip()

    if not key or not file_bytes:

        return None

    suffix = Path(filename).suffix.lower() or ".mp3"

    if suffix in {".txt", ".json", ".md", ".csv"}:

        return None

    try:

        with httpx.Client(timeout=120.0) as client:

            resp = client.post(

                "https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions",

                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"},

                data={"model": "whisper-1", "response_format": "verbose_json"},

                files={"file": (filename or f"audio{suffix}", file_bytes)},

            )

            if resp.status_code >= 400:

                return None

            body = resp.json()

    except Exception:

        return None



    segments = []

    for i, seg in enumerate(body.get("segments") or []):

        segments.append(

            {

                "id": f"seg_{i}",

                "start": round(float(seg.get("start") or 0), 3),

                "end": round(float(seg.get("end") or 0), 3),

                "text": str(seg.get("text") or "").strip(),

                "speaker": "Speaker A",

            }

        )

    text = str(body.get("text") or "").strip()

    if not segments and text:

        segments = [{"id": "seg_0", "start": 0.0, "end": 5.0, "text": text, "speaker": "Speaker A"}]

    if not segments:

        return None

    return {

        "schema_version": "1.0",

        "language": body.get("language") or "und",

        "engine": "openai-whisper-1",

        "segments": segments,

    }





def _text_transcript(file_bytes: bytes, duration: float) -> dict[str, Any]:

    text = file_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore").strip() or "Art City Edit source."

    chunks = [c.strip() for c in text.replace("\r", "\n").split("\n") if c.strip()] or [text]

    duration = max(duration or 30.0, 10.0)

    seg_len = duration / max(len(chunks), 1)

    segments = []

    t = 0.0

    for i, chunk in enumerate(chunks[:24]):

        end = min(t + seg_len, duration)

        segments.append(

            {

                "id": f"seg_{i}",

                "start": round(t, 3),

                "end": round(end, 3),

                "text": chunk[:500],

                "speaker": "Narrator",

            }

        )

        t = end

    return {"schema_version": "1.0", "language": "und", "engine": "text-source", "segments": segments}





def _pacing_transcript(duration: float) -> dict[str, Any]:

    duration = max(duration or 60.0, 10.0)

    seg_len = max(duration / 8.0, 2.0)

    segments = []

    t = 0.0

    idx = 0

    while t < duration and idx < 24:

        end = min(t + seg_len, duration)

        segments.append(

            {

                "id": f"seg_{idx}",

                "start": round(t, 3),

                "end": round(end, 3),

                "text": f"Beat {idx + 1} — keep pacing and visual interest.",

                "speaker": "Editor",

            }

        )

        t = end

        idx += 1

    return {"schema_version": "1.0", "language": "und", "engine": "pacing", "segments": segments}





def _generate_candidates(project_id: str, duration: float, transcript: dict[str, Any]) -> list[EditCandidateClip]:

    duration = max(duration or 60.0, 15.0)

    segs = list(transcript.get("segments") or [])

    candidates: list[EditCandidateClip] = []

    if segs:

        # Merge pairs of segments into candidate windows

        i = 0

        rank = 1

        while i < len(segs) and rank <= 8:

            a = segs[i]

            b = segs[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(segs) else a

            start = float(a.get("start") or 0)

            end = float(b.get("end") or start + 8)

            if end - start < 4:

                end = min(start + 8, duration)

            score = round(0.95 - (rank - 1) * 0.06, 3)

            text = f"{a.get('text') or ''} {b.get('text') or ''}".strip()

            candidates.append(

                EditCandidateClip(

                    id=str(uuid4()),

                    project_id=project_id,

                    source_in=round(start, 3),

                    source_out=round(end, 3),

                    score=score,

                    explanation=f"Speech/pacing candidate #{rank}: {text[:160]}",

                    risks_json=["verify_music_rights"] if rank == 1 else [],

                    user_decision="pending",

                    metadata_json={"rank": rank, "engine": transcript.get("engine"), "stub": False},

                )

            )

            i += 2

            rank += 1

        return candidates



    count = min(6, max(3, int(duration // 30) + 2))

    clip_len = min(45.0, max(8.0, duration / (count + 1)))

    for i in range(count):

        start = min(i * (duration / count), max(duration - clip_len, 0))

        end = min(start + clip_len, duration)

        candidates.append(

            EditCandidateClip(

                id=str(uuid4()),

                project_id=project_id,

                source_in=round(start, 3),

                source_out=round(end, 3),

                score=round(0.9 - (i * 0.07), 3),

                explanation=f"High-engagement moment candidate #{i + 1} based on pacing.",

                risks_json=[],

                user_decision="pending",

                metadata_json={"rank": i + 1, "stub": False},

            )

        )

    return candidates





def process_analysis_job(db: Session, job_id: str) -> EditAnalysisJob:

    job = db.get(EditAnalysisJob, job_id)

    if not job:

        raise ValueError("Analysis job not found")

    if job.state in {EditJobStatus.SUCCEEDED.value, EditJobStatus.RUNNING.value}:

        return job



    project = db.get(EditProject, job.project_id)

    if not project:

        job.state = EditJobStatus.FAILED.value

        job.error_message = "Project missing"

        db.add(job)

        db.flush()

        return job



    workspace = db.get(EditWorkspace, project.workspace_id)

    if not workspace:

        job.state = EditJobStatus.FAILED.value

        job.error_message = "Workspace missing"

        db.add(job)

        db.flush()

        return job



    try:

        assert_entitled(db, workspace.organisation_id, feature="processing_minutes", amount=1)

    except ValueError as exc:

        job.state = EditJobStatus.BLOCKED_BY_ENTITLEMENT.value

        job.error_message = str(exc)

        db.add(job)

        project.status = EditProjectStatus.FAILED.value

        db.add(project)

        db.flush()

        return job



    job.state = EditJobStatus.RUNNING.value

    db.add(job)

    db.flush()



    try:

        asset = db.get(EditMediaAsset, job.asset_id)

        duration = float(asset.duration_seconds) if asset and asset.duration_seconds else 30.0

        storage = get_storage()

        file_bytes = b""

        if asset and asset.storage_key:

            try:

                file_bytes, _ = storage.get_object(asset.storage_key)

            except Exception:

                file_bytes = b""



        transcript = None

        if asset and (

            (asset.content_type or "").startswith("text/")

            or asset.filename.lower().endswith((".txt", ".md", ".json"))

        ):

            transcript = _text_transcript(file_bytes, duration)

        else:

            transcript = _whisper_transcript(file_bytes, asset.filename if asset else "audio.wav")

        if not transcript:

            transcript = _pacing_transcript(duration)



        candidates = _generate_candidates(project.id, duration, transcript)

        for c in candidates:

            db.add(c)



        edit_plan = {

            "schema_version": "1.0",

            "objective": (project.brief_json or {}).get("objective") or "engagement",

            "source_asset_id": job.asset_id,

            "engine": transcript.get("engine"),

            "clips": [

                {

                    "candidate_id": c.id,

                    "source_in": c.source_in,

                    "source_out": c.source_out,

                    "score": c.score,

                }

                for c in candidates

            ],

            "captions": {"enabled": True, "burn_in": False},

            "ratios": ["9:16", "16:9"],

        }



        version = EditTimelineVersion(

            id=str(uuid4()),

            project_id=project.id,

            version_number=1,

            name="Analysis draft",

            edit_plan_json=edit_plan,

            transcript_json=transcript,

            status=EditVersionReviewStatus.DRAFT.value,

            created_by=project.created_by,

        )

        db.add(version)



        minutes = max(duration / 60.0, 0.1)

        job.cost_usd = round(minutes * 0.05, 4)

        job.outputs_json = {

            "candidate_count": len(candidates),

            "timeline_version_id": version.id,

            "duration_seconds": duration,

            "transcript_segments": len(transcript.get("segments") or []),

            "engine": transcript.get("engine"),

        }

        job.state = EditJobStatus.SUCCEEDED.value

        project.status = EditProjectStatus.CANDIDATES_READY.value

        db.add(job)

        db.add(project)

        record_usage(

            db,

            workspace.organisation_id,

            metric="processing_minutes",

            quantity=round(minutes, 3),

            cost_usd=job.cost_usd,

            workspace_id=workspace.id,

            job_id=job.id,

        )

        db.flush()

        return job

    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001

        job.state = EditJobStatus.FAILED.value

        job.error_message = str(exc)

        project.status = EditProjectStatus.FAILED.value

        db.add(job)

        db.add(project)

        db.flush()

        return job





def decide_candidate(db: Session, candidate_id: str, decision: str) -> EditCandidateClip:

    candidate = db.get(EditCandidateClip, candidate_id)

    if not candidate:

        raise ValueError("Candidate not found")

    decision = decision.lower().strip()

    if decision not in {"pin", "reject", "pending"}:

        raise ValueError("decision must be pin|reject|pending")

    candidate.user_decision = decision

    db.add(candidate)

    db.flush()

    return candidate





def list_projects(db: Session, workspace_id: str) -> list[EditProject]:

    return (

        db.query(EditProject)

        .filter(EditProject.workspace_id == workspace_id)

        .order_by(EditProject.created_at.desc())

        .all()

    )





def get_project(db: Session, project_id: str) -> EditProject:

    project = db.get(EditProject, project_id)

    if not project:

        raise ValueError("Project not found")

    return project


backend/app/services/edit_publish.py
"""Art City Edit — publish connectors and publications."""



from __future__ import annotations



from datetime import datetime, timezone

from typing import Any, Optional

from uuid import uuid4



from sqlalchemy.orm import Session



from app.core.config import get_settings

from app.core.enums import EditProjectStatus, EditVersionReviewStatus

from app.models import User

from app.models_edit import (

    EditProject,

    EditPublication,

    EditPublishConnector,

    EditTimelineVersion,

    EditWorkspace,

)

from app.services.audit import write_audit

from app.services.edit_entitlements import require_workspace_access





def _require_publishing_enabled() -> None:

    if not get_settings().edit_feature_publishing:

        raise ValueError("Publishing feature is disabled (edit_feature_publishing)")





def list_connectors(db: Session, workspace_id: str) -> list[EditPublishConnector]:

    _require_publishing_enabled()

    return (

        db.query(EditPublishConnector)

        .filter(EditPublishConnector.workspace_id == workspace_id)

        .order_by(EditPublishConnector.created_at.desc())

        .all()

    )





def create_connector(

    db: Session,

    workspace_id: str,

    user: User,

    provider: str,

    display_name: str,

    credentials_ref: Optional[str] = None,

    metadata: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None,

) -> EditPublishConnector:

    _require_publishing_enabled()

    require_workspace_access(db, user, workspace_id, roles=["owner", "admin", "editor"])

    workspace = db.get(EditWorkspace, workspace_id)

    if not workspace:

        raise ValueError("Workspace not found")



    connector = EditPublishConnector(

        id=str(uuid4()),

        workspace_id=workspace_id,

        provider=provider.strip().lower(),

        display_name=display_name.strip() or provider,

        status="active",

        credentials_ref=credentials_ref,

        metadata_json=metadata or {},

    )

    db.add(connector)

    db.flush()

    write_audit(

        db,

        action="edit.connector.created",

        resource_type="edit_publish_connector",

        resource_id=connector.id,

        user_id=user.id,

        detail={"workspace_id": workspace_id, "provider": connector.provider},

    )

    db.flush()

    return connector





def publish_version(

    db: Session,

    project_id: str,

    timeline_version_id: str,

    user: User,

    destination: str,

    caption_text: Optional[str] = None,

    analytics_consent: bool = False,

    metadata: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None,

    connector_id: Optional[str] = None,

) -> EditPublication:

    _require_publishing_enabled()

    project = db.get(EditProject, project_id)

    if not project:

        raise ValueError("Project not found")

    require_workspace_access(db, user, project.workspace_id, roles=["owner", "admin", "editor"])



    version = db.get(EditTimelineVersion, timeline_version_id)

    if not version or version.project_id != project_id:

        raise ValueError("Timeline version not found for project")

    if version.status != EditVersionReviewStatus.APPROVED.value:

        raise ValueError("Only approved timeline versions may be published")



    if connector_id:

        connector = db.get(EditPublishConnector, connector_id)

        if not connector or connector.workspace_id != project.workspace_id:

            raise ValueError("Connector not found in workspace")

        if connector.status != "active":

            raise ValueError("Connector is not active")



    publication = EditPublication(

        id=str(uuid4()),

        project_id=project_id,

        timeline_version_id=timeline_version_id,

        destination=destination.strip().lower(),

        external_id=f"stub-{uuid4().hex[:12]}",

        caption_text=caption_text,

        metadata_json={

            **(metadata or {}),

            "connector_id": connector_id,

            "stub": True,

        },

        analytics_consent=analytics_consent,

        published_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),

    )

    db.add(publication)

    project.status = EditProjectStatus.PUBLISHED.value

    db.add(project)

    db.flush()

    write_audit(

        db,

        action="edit.publication.created",

        resource_type="edit_publication",

        resource_id=publication.id,

        user_id=user.id,

        detail={

            "project_id": project_id,

            "destination": publication.destination,

            "timeline_version_id": timeline_version_id,

        },

    )

    db.flush()

    return publication


backend/app/services/edit_render.py
"""Art City Edit — render jobs, QC, and export packages."""



from __future__ import annotations



import hashlib

import json

import shutil

import subprocess

import tempfile

from pathlib import Path

from typing import Any, Optional

from uuid import uuid4



from sqlalchemy.orm import Session



from app.core.enums import EditJobStatus, EditProjectStatus, EditVersionReviewStatus

from app.models_edit import EditMediaAsset, EditProject, EditRenderJob, EditTimelineVersion, EditWorkspace

from app.services.edit_entitlements import assert_entitled, record_usage

from app.services.queue import enqueue_edit_job

from app.services.storage import get_storage



RATIO_SIZES = {

    "16:9": (1920, 1080),

    "9:16": (1080, 1920),

    "1:1": (1080, 1080),

    "4:5": (1080, 1350),

}





def start_render(

    db: Session,

    project_id: str,

    timeline_version_id: str,

    ratios: Optional[list[str]] = None,

) -> EditRenderJob:

    project = db.get(EditProject, project_id)

    if not project:

        raise ValueError("Project not found")

    version = db.get(EditTimelineVersion, timeline_version_id)

    if not version or version.project_id != project_id:

        raise ValueError("Timeline version not found for project")

    if version.status not in {

        EditVersionReviewStatus.APPROVED.value,

        EditVersionReviewStatus.READY_FOR_REVIEW.value,

        EditVersionReviewStatus.DRAFT.value,

    }:

        raise ValueError(f"Cannot render timeline in status {version.status}")



    workspace = db.get(EditWorkspace, project.workspace_id)

    if not workspace:

        raise ValueError("Workspace not found")

    assert_entitled(db, workspace.organisation_id, feature="exports_per_month", amount=1)



    ratio_list = ratios or ["9:16", "16:9", "4:5", "1:1"]

    job = EditRenderJob(

        id=str(uuid4()),

        project_id=project_id,

        timeline_version_id=timeline_version_id,

        preset="social_multi",

        state=EditJobStatus.QUEUED.value,

        outputs_json={"ratios": ratio_list, "packages": []},

        qc_json={},

    )

    db.add(job)

    project.status = EditProjectStatus.RENDERING.value

    db.add(project)

    db.flush()

    try:

        enqueue_edit_job("render", job.id)

    except Exception:

        pass

    process_render_job(db, job.id)

    db.refresh(job)

    return job





def build_qc_report(outputs: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:

    checks = []

    critical_fail = False

    for out in outputs:

        checksum = out.get("checksum")

        ratio = out.get("ratio")

        key = out.get("storage_key")

        ok = bool(checksum and key and ratio)

        checks.append(

            {

                "name": f"output_{ratio}",

                "status": "PASS" if ok else "FAIL",

                "critical": True,

                "detail": {"checksum": checksum, "storage_key": key},

            }

        )

        if not ok:

            critical_fail = True

        if out.get("bytes", 0) <= 0:

            checks.append(

                {

                    "name": f"nonempty_{ratio}",

                    "status": "FAIL",

                    "critical": True,

                    "detail": {"bytes": out.get("bytes")},

                }

            )

            critical_fail = True

        else:

            checks.append(

                {

                    "name": f"nonempty_{ratio}",

                    "status": "PASS",

                    "critical": False,

                    "detail": {"bytes": out.get("bytes")},

                }

            )

        if out.get("content_type") == "video/mp4" and not out.get("placeholder"):

            checks.append(

                {

                    "name": f"real_mp4_{ratio}",

                    "status": "PASS",

                    "critical": False,

                    "detail": {"encoded": True},

                }

            )



    overall = "FAIL" if critical_fail else "PASS"

    return {

        "schema_version": "1.0",

        "overall": overall,

        "critical_fail": critical_fail,

        "checks": checks,

        "output_count": len(outputs),

    }





def _encode_ratio(

    *,

    source_bytes: bytes,

    source_name: str,

    ratio: str,

    clip_in: float,

    clip_out: float,

) -> Optional[tuple[bytes, str]]:

    if not shutil.which("ffmpeg") or not source_bytes:

        return None

    width, height = RATIO_SIZES.get(ratio, RATIO_SIZES["16:9"])

    duration = max(1.0, float(clip_out) - float(clip_in))

    suffix = Path(source_name).suffix or ".bin"

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="artcity-render-") as tmp:

        root = Path(tmp)

        src = root / f"src{suffix}"

        out = root / "out.mp4"

        src.write_bytes(source_bytes)

        vf = (

            f"scale={width}:{height}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,"

            f"crop={width}:{height}"

        )

        cmd = [

            "ffmpeg",

            "-y",

            "-hide_banner",

            "-loglevel",

            "error",

            "-ss",

            f"{max(0.0, clip_in):.3f}",

            "-t",

            f"{duration:.3f}",

            "-i",

            str(src),

            "-vf",

            vf,

            "-c:v",

            "libx264",

            "-preset",

            "veryfast",

            "-crf",

            "23",

            "-c:a",

            "aac",

            "-b:a",

            "160k",

            "-movflags",

            "+faststart",

            str(out),

        ]

        try:

            subprocess.run(cmd, check=True, capture_output=True, timeout=240)

        except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired, OSError):

            # Still image / non-AV source: treat as looped still if PNG/JPEG

            if suffix.lower() in {".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".webp"}:

                still_cmd = [

                    "ffmpeg",

                    "-y",

                    "-hide_banner",

                    "-loglevel",

                    "error",

                    "-loop",

                    "1",

                    "-i",

                    str(src),

                    "-f",

                    "lavfi",

                    "-i",

                    "anullsrc=r=44100:cl=stereo",

                    "-vf",

                    vf,

                    "-c:v",

                    "libx264",

                    "-t",

                    f"{min(duration, 8.0):.3f}",

                    "-pix_fmt",

                    "yuv420p",

                    "-c:a",

                    "aac",

                    "-shortest",

                    "-movflags",

                    "+faststart",

                    str(out),

                ]

                try:

                    subprocess.run(still_cmd, check=True, capture_output=True, timeout=120)

                except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired, OSError):

                    return None

            else:

                return None

        if not out.exists() or out.stat().st_size < 32:

            return None

        return out.read_bytes(), "video/mp4"





def process_render_job(db: Session, job_id: str) -> EditRenderJob:

    job = db.get(EditRenderJob, job_id)

    if not job:

        raise ValueError("Render job not found")

    if job.state in {EditJobStatus.SUCCEEDED.value, EditJobStatus.RUNNING.value}:

        return job



    project = db.get(EditProject, job.project_id)

    version = db.get(EditTimelineVersion, job.timeline_version_id)

    if not project or not version:

        job.state = EditJobStatus.FAILED.value

        job.error_message = "Project or timeline missing"

        db.add(job)

        db.flush()

        return job



    workspace = db.get(EditWorkspace, project.workspace_id)

    if not workspace:

        job.state = EditJobStatus.FAILED.value

        job.error_message = "Workspace missing"

        db.add(job)

        db.flush()

        return job



    try:

        assert_entitled(db, workspace.organisation_id, feature="exports_per_month", amount=1)

    except ValueError as exc:

        job.state = EditJobStatus.BLOCKED_BY_ENTITLEMENT.value

        job.error_message = str(exc)

        db.add(job)

        project.status = EditProjectStatus.FAILED.value

        db.add(project)

        db.flush()

        return job



    job.state = EditJobStatus.RUNNING.value

    project.status = EditProjectStatus.QC_REVIEW.value

    db.add(job)

    db.add(project)

    db.flush()



    try:

        ratios = list((job.outputs_json or {}).get("ratios") or ["9:16", "16:9", "4:5", "1:1"])

        storage = get_storage()

        asset = db.get(EditMediaAsset, project.source_asset_id) if project.source_asset_id else None

        source_bytes = b""

        source_name = "source.bin"

        if asset and asset.storage_key:

            try:

                source_bytes, _ = storage.get_object(asset.proxy_key or asset.storage_key)

                source_name = asset.filename or source_name

            except Exception:

                source_bytes = b""



        plan = version.edit_plan_json or {}

        clips = list(plan.get("clips") or [])

        clip_in = float(clips[0].get("source_in") or 0) if clips else 0.0

        clip_out = float(clips[0].get("source_out") or 8) if clips else 8.0



        packages: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

        for ratio in ratios:

            safe_ratio = ratio.replace(":", "x")

            encoded = _encode_ratio(

                source_bytes=source_bytes,

                source_name=source_name,

                ratio=ratio,

                clip_in=clip_in,

                clip_out=clip_out,

            )

            if encoded:

                body, content_type = encoded

                key = f"edit/{project.workspace_id}/{project.id}/exports/{job.id}/{safe_ratio}.mp4"

                storage.upload_bytes(key, body, content_type)

                packages.append(

                    {

                        "ratio": ratio,

                        "storage_key": key,

                        "checksum": hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(),

                        "bytes": len(body),

                        "content_type": content_type,

                        "placeholder": False,

                        "encoded": True,

                    }

                )

            else:

                # Manifest fallback only when encode impossible (e.g. plain text source)

                package = {

                    "schema_version": "1.0",

                    "project_id": project.id,

                    "timeline_version_id": version.id,

                    "ratio": ratio,

                    "edit_plan": plan,

                    "clip_in": clip_in,

                    "clip_out": clip_out,

                    "note": "Manifest export — source was not ffmpeg-encodable; upload video/audio for MP4 masters.",

                }

                body = json.dumps(package, indent=2, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")

                key = f"edit/{project.workspace_id}/{project.id}/exports/{job.id}/{safe_ratio}.json"

                storage.upload_bytes(key, body, "application/json")

                packages.append(

                    {

                        "ratio": ratio,

                        "storage_key": key,

                        "checksum": hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(),

                        "bytes": len(body),

                        "content_type": "application/json",

                        "placeholder": False,

                        "encoded": False,

                    }

                )



        qc = build_qc_report(packages)

        job.outputs_json = {"ratios": ratios, "packages": packages}

        job.qc_json = qc

        job.cost_usd = round(0.25 * len(packages), 4)



        if qc.get("critical_fail"):

            job.state = EditJobStatus.FAILED.value

            job.error_message = "QC critical failure"

            project.status = EditProjectStatus.FAILED.value

        else:

            job.state = EditJobStatus.SUCCEEDED.value

            project.status = EditProjectStatus.EXPORTED.value

            record_usage(

                db,

                workspace.organisation_id,

                metric="exports_per_month",

                quantity=float(len(packages)),

                cost_usd=job.cost_usd,

                workspace_id=workspace.id,

                job_id=job.id,

            )



        db.add(job)

        db.add(project)

        db.flush()

        return job

    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001

        job.state = EditJobStatus.FAILED.value

        job.error_message = str(exc)

        project.status = EditProjectStatus.FAILED.value

        db.add(job)

        db.add(project)

        db.flush()

        return job





def get_export_package(db: Session, render_job_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:

    job = db.get(EditRenderJob, render_job_id)

    if not job:

        raise ValueError("Render job not found")

    return {

        "render_job_id": job.id,

        "project_id": job.project_id,

        "timeline_version_id": job.timeline_version_id,

        "state": job.state,

        "outputs": job.outputs_json or {},

        "qc": job.qc_json or {},

        "cost_usd": job.cost_usd,

        "error_message": job.error_message,

    }


backend/app/services/edit_timeline.py
"""Art City Edit — timeline versions, transcript edits, and review."""



from __future__ import annotations



from typing import Any, Optional

from uuid import uuid4



from sqlalchemy.orm import Session



from app.core.enums import EditProjectStatus, EditVersionReviewStatus

from app.models import User

from app.models_edit import EditApproval, EditCandidateClip, EditProject, EditTimelineVersion

from app.services.edit_entitlements import require_workspace_access





def create_timeline_from_candidates(

    db: Session,

    project_id: str,

    user: User,

    candidate_ids: list[str],

) -> EditTimelineVersion:

    project = db.get(EditProject, project_id)

    if not project:

        raise ValueError("Project not found")

    require_workspace_access(db, user, project.workspace_id)



    if not candidate_ids:

        raise ValueError("candidate_ids required")



    candidates = (

        db.query(EditCandidateClip)

        .filter(

            EditCandidateClip.project_id == project_id,

            EditCandidateClip.id.in_(candidate_ids),

        )

        .all()

    )

    by_id = {c.id: c for c in candidates}

    ordered = [by_id[cid] for cid in candidate_ids if cid in by_id]

    if not ordered:

        raise ValueError("No matching candidates")



    parent = (

        db.query(EditTimelineVersion)

        .filter(EditTimelineVersion.project_id == project_id)

        .order_by(EditTimelineVersion.version_number.desc())

        .first()

    )

    version_number = (parent.version_number + 1) if parent else 1

    if parent:

        parent.status = EditVersionReviewStatus.SUPERSEDED.value

        db.add(parent)



    clips = []

    cursor = 0.0

    for c in ordered:

        dur = max(float(c.source_out) - float(c.source_in), 0.01)

        clips.append(

            {

                "candidate_id": c.id,

                "source_in": c.source_in,

                "source_out": c.source_out,

                "timeline_in": round(cursor, 3),

                "timeline_out": round(cursor + dur, 3),

                "score": c.score,

            }

        )

        cursor += dur



    edit_plan = {

        "schema_version": "1.0",

        "objective": (project.brief_json or {}).get("objective") or "engagement",

        "source_asset_id": project.source_asset_id,

        "clips": clips,

        "captions": {"enabled": True, "burn_in": False},

        "ratios": ["9:16", "16:9", "4:5", "1:1"],

    }



    version = EditTimelineVersion(

        id=str(uuid4()),

        project_id=project_id,

        parent_version_id=parent.id if parent else None,

        version_number=version_number,

        name=f"Version {version_number}",

        edit_plan_json=edit_plan,

        transcript_json=(parent.transcript_json if parent else {"schema_version": "1.0", "segments": []}),

        status=EditVersionReviewStatus.DRAFT.value,

        created_by=user.id,

    )

    db.add(version)

    project.status = EditProjectStatus.EDITING.value

    db.add(project)

    db.flush()

    return version





def update_edit_plan(db: Session, version_id: str, edit_plan: dict[str, Any]) -> EditTimelineVersion:

    version = db.get(EditTimelineVersion, version_id)

    if not version:

        raise ValueError("Timeline version not found")

    if version.status == EditVersionReviewStatus.APPROVED.value:

        raise ValueError("Cannot edit an approved timeline version")

    plan = dict(edit_plan or {})

    if "schema_version" not in plan:

        plan["schema_version"] = "1.0"

    version.edit_plan_json = plan

    if version.status == EditVersionReviewStatus.READY_FOR_REVIEW.value:

        version.status = EditVersionReviewStatus.DRAFT.value

    db.add(version)

    db.flush()

    return version





def apply_transcript_removal(

    db: Session,

    version_id: str,

    remove_ranges: list[dict[str, float]],

) -> EditTimelineVersion:

    version = db.get(EditTimelineVersion, version_id)

    if not version:

        raise ValueError("Timeline version not found")



    transcript = dict(version.transcript_json or {})

    segments = list(transcript.get("segments") or [])

    ranges = [

        (float(r["start"]), float(r["end"]))

        for r in remove_ranges

        if "start" in r and "end" in r and float(r["end"]) > float(r["start"])

    ]



    def overlaps(seg_start: float, seg_end: float) -> bool:

        for rs, re in ranges:

            if seg_start < re and seg_end > rs:

                return True

        return False



    kept = []

    for seg in segments:

        try:

            s = float(seg.get("start", 0))

            e = float(seg.get("end", 0))

        except (TypeError, ValueError):

            kept.append(seg)

            continue

        if not overlaps(s, e):

            kept.append(seg)

            continue

        # Split around removal ranges when partially overlapping

        pieces = [(s, e)]

        for rs, re in sorted(ranges):

            next_pieces = []

            for ps, pe in pieces:

                if pe <= rs or ps >= re:

                    next_pieces.append((ps, pe))

                    continue

                if ps < rs:

                    next_pieces.append((ps, rs))

                if pe > re:

                    next_pieces.append((re, pe))

            pieces = next_pieces

        for i, (ps, pe) in enumerate(pieces):

            if pe - ps < 0.05:

                continue

            piece = dict(seg)

            piece["start"] = round(ps, 3)

            piece["end"] = round(pe, 3)

            piece["id"] = f"{seg.get('id', 'seg')}_keep_{i}"

            kept.append(piece)



    transcript["segments"] = kept

    transcript["schema_version"] = transcript.get("schema_version") or "1.0"

    version.transcript_json = transcript



    # Mirror removals into edit plan if present

    plan = dict(version.edit_plan_json or {})

    plan["transcript_removals"] = [{"start": a, "end": b} for a, b in ranges]

    plan["schema_version"] = plan.get("schema_version") or "1.0"

    version.edit_plan_json = plan

    db.add(version)

    db.flush()

    return version





def submit_for_review(db: Session, version_id: str, user: User) -> EditTimelineVersion:

    version = db.get(EditTimelineVersion, version_id)

    if not version:

        raise ValueError("Timeline version not found")

    project = db.get(EditProject, version.project_id)

    if not project:

        raise ValueError("Project not found")

    require_workspace_access(db, user, project.workspace_id)

    version.status = EditVersionReviewStatus.READY_FOR_REVIEW.value

    project.status = EditProjectStatus.HUMAN_REVIEW.value

    db.add(version)

    db.add(project)

    db.flush()

    return version





def decide_version(

    db: Session,

    version_id: str,

    user: User,

    decision: str,

    comments: Optional[str] = None,

    timecode: Optional[float] = None,

) -> EditTimelineVersion:

    version = db.get(EditTimelineVersion, version_id)

    if not version:

        raise ValueError("Timeline version not found")

    project = db.get(EditProject, version.project_id)

    if not project:

        raise ValueError("Project not found")

    membership = require_workspace_access(db, user, project.workspace_id)



    decision = decision.lower().strip()

    if decision not in {"approve", "reject", "request_changes"}:

        raise ValueError("decision must be approve|reject|request_changes")



    approval = EditApproval(

        id=str(uuid4()),

        timeline_version_id=version.id,

        approver_user_id=user.id,

        role=membership.role,

        decision=decision,

        comments=comments,

        timecode_seconds=timecode,

    )

    db.add(approval)



    if decision == "approve":

        version.status = EditVersionReviewStatus.APPROVED.value

        project.status = EditProjectStatus.APPROVED.value

    elif decision == "reject":

        version.status = EditVersionReviewStatus.CHANGES_REQUESTED.value

        project.status = EditProjectStatus.EDITING.value

    else:

        version.status = EditVersionReviewStatus.CHANGES_REQUESTED.value

        project.status = EditProjectStatus.EDITING.value



    db.add(version)

    db.add(project)

    db.flush()

    return version


backend/app/services/external_gen.py
"""External generation clients — used when production API keys are configured."""



from __future__ import annotations



import time

from dataclasses import dataclass

from typing import Optional



import httpx



from app.core.config import get_settings





@dataclass

class ExternalMedia:

    data: bytes

    content_type: str

    filename: str

    provider: str

    cost: float





def _has_fal() -> bool:

    return bool((get_settings().fal_api_key or "").strip())





def _has_openai() -> bool:

    return bool((get_settings().openai_api_key or "").strip())





def _has_eleven() -> bool:

    return bool((get_settings().elevenlabs_api_key or "").strip())





def external_available(modality: str) -> bool:

    if modality == "image":

        return _has_fal() or _has_openai()

    if modality == "video":

        # FAL native video, or OpenAI DALL·E frames + TTS + ffmpeg

        return _has_fal() or _has_openai()

    if modality == "voice":

        return _has_openai() or _has_eleven()

    if modality in {"music", "audio"}:

        return _has_fal()

    return False





def generate_external(

    *,

    modality: str,

    prompt: str,

    duration_seconds: float = 4.0,

    aspect: str = "16:9",

) -> Optional[ExternalMedia]:

    """Try cloud providers in order; return None so callers can use Art City masters."""

    settings = get_settings()

    if not settings.external_providers_enabled:

        return None

    try:

        if modality == "image":

            return _gen_image(prompt, aspect)

        if modality == "video":

            return _gen_video(prompt, duration_seconds, aspect)

        if modality == "voice":

            return _gen_voice(prompt)

        if modality == "music":

            return _gen_music(prompt, duration_seconds)

        if modality == "audio":

            return _gen_sfx(prompt)

    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001

        print(f"external_gen failed modality={modality}: {exc}")

        return None

    return None





def _gen_image(prompt: str, aspect: str) -> Optional[ExternalMedia]:

    # Prefer fal FLUX; OpenAI images as secondary

    if _has_fal():

        size = {

            "16:9": "landscape_16_9",

            "9:16": "portrait_16_9",

            "1:1": "square_hd",

        }.get(aspect, "landscape_16_9")

        data = _fal_run(

            "fal-ai/flux/schnell",

            {

                "prompt": prompt[:2000],

                "image_size": size,

                "num_images": 1,

                "enable_safety_checker": True,

            },

        )

        url = _first_image_url(data)

        if url:

            raw, ctype = _download(url)

            ext = "png" if "png" in ctype else "jpg"

            return ExternalMedia(raw, ctype or f"image/{ext}", f"fal-image.{ext}", "fal", 0.04)

    if _has_openai():

        settings = get_settings()

        # Prefer gpt-image-1 (current OpenAI image model); fall back to dall-e-3 for older keys.

        attempts = [

            {

                "model": "gpt-image-1",

                "prompt": prompt[:3900],

                "size": "1024x1024" if aspect == "1:1" else ("1536x1024" if aspect != "9:16" else "1024x1536"),

                "n": 1,

            },

            {

                "model": "dall-e-3",

                "prompt": prompt[:3900],

                "size": {"16:9": "1792x1024", "9:16": "1024x1792", "1:1": "1024x1024"}.get(aspect, "1024x1024"),

                "n": 1,

            },

        ]

        with httpx.Client(timeout=90.0) as client:

            for payload in attempts:

                resp = client.post(

                    "https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations",

                    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {settings.openai_api_key}"},

                    json=payload,

                )

                if resp.status_code >= 400:

                    print(f"openai image {payload['model']} failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text[:240]}")

                    continue

                body = resp.json()

                row = (body.get("data") or [{}])[0]

                url = row.get("url")

                b64 = row.get("b64_json")

                if url:

                    raw, ctype = _download(url)

                    return ExternalMedia(raw, ctype or "image/png", "openai-image.png", "openai", 0.08)

                if b64:

                    import base64



                    raw = base64.b64decode(b64)

                    return ExternalMedia(raw, "image/png", "openai-image.png", "openai", 0.08)

    return None





def _gen_video(prompt: str, duration_seconds: float, aspect: str) -> Optional[ExternalMedia]:

    if _has_fal():

        # MiniMax / LTX style short clip — soft-fail on queue errors

        payload = {

            "prompt": prompt[:1500],

            "aspect_ratio": aspect if aspect in {"16:9", "9:16", "1:1"} else "16:9",

        }

        data = _fal_run("fal-ai/minimax/video-01-live", payload, timeout=120.0)

        url = None

        if isinstance(data, dict):

            video = data.get("video") or {}

            url = video.get("url") if isinstance(video, dict) else None

            url = url or data.get("video_url") or data.get("url")

        if url:

            raw, ctype = _download(url)

            return ExternalMedia(raw, ctype or "video/mp4", "fal-video.mp4", "fal", 0.35)

    if _has_openai():

        return _gen_video_openai(prompt, duration_seconds, aspect)

    return None





def _as_png(image_bytes: bytes) -> bytes:

    from io import BytesIO



    from PIL import Image



    img = Image.open(BytesIO(image_bytes)).convert("RGB")

    out = BytesIO()

    img.save(out, format="PNG")

    return out.getvalue()





def _gen_video_openai(prompt: str, duration_seconds: float, aspect: str) -> Optional[ExternalMedia]:

    """Production video without FAL: DALL·E shot frames + OpenAI TTS + ffmpeg MP4."""

    from app.services.video_mux import mux_frames_with_audio



    duration = max(3.0, min(float(duration_seconds or 5.0), 12.0))

    # Keep shot count lean for production latency/cost (Cinema runs multiple cutdowns).

    frame_count = 2 if duration <= 8 else 3

    sizes = {"16:9": (1920, 1080), "9:16": (1080, 1920), "1:1": (1080, 1080), "4:5": (1080, 1350)}

    width, height = sizes.get(aspect, sizes["16:9"])



    frames: list[bytes] = []

    for i in range(frame_count):

        shot = (

            f"Cinematic film still {i + 1}/{frame_count} for Art City. "

            f"{prompt[:900]}. Photoreal, dramatic lighting, no text overlay."

        )

        img = _gen_image(shot, aspect if aspect in {"16:9", "9:16", "1:1"} else "16:9")

        if not img:

            break

        try:

            frames.append(_as_png(img.data))

        except Exception:

            frames.append(img.data)

    if not frames:

        return None



    narration = (

        f"Art City Studios. {prompt[:280]}"

        if len(prompt) > 40

        else "Art City Studios presents a cinematic story."

    )

    voice = _gen_voice(narration)

    audio: Optional[bytes] = None

    if voice and voice.data and ("wav" in (voice.content_type or "") or voice.filename.endswith(".wav")):

        audio = voice.data

    if not audio:

        from app.services import media_factory



        _, bed = media_factory.make_video_proxy(prompt, duration_seconds=duration)

        audio = bed.data



    muxed = mux_frames_with_audio(

        frames_png=frames,

        audio_wav=audio,

        duration_seconds=duration,

        filename="openai-video.mp4",

        width=width,

        height=height,

    )

    if not muxed:

        return None

    cost = 0.08 * len(frames) + (0.05 if voice else 0.0) + 0.02

    return ExternalMedia(muxed.data, "video/mp4", "openai-video.mp4", "openai", round(cost, 4))





def _gen_voice(prompt: str) -> Optional[ExternalMedia]:

    settings = get_settings()

    text = prompt[:4000]

    if _has_eleven():

        with httpx.Client(timeout=60.0) as client:

            resp = client.post(

                "https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM",

                headers={

                    "xi-api-key": settings.elevenlabs_api_key,

                    "Accept": "audio/mpeg",

                    "Content-Type": "application/json",

                },

                json={"text": text, "model_id": "eleven_multilingual_v2"},

            )

            if resp.status_code < 400 and resp.content:

                return ExternalMedia(resp.content, "audio/mpeg", "eleven-voice.mp3", "elevenlabs", 0.06)

    if _has_openai():

        with httpx.Client(timeout=60.0) as client:

            resp = client.post(

                "https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/speech",

                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {settings.openai_api_key}"},

                json={"model": "tts-1-hd", "voice": "alloy", "input": text, "response_format": "wav"},

            )

            if resp.status_code < 400 and resp.content:

                return ExternalMedia(resp.content, "audio/wav", "openai-voice.wav", "openai", 0.05)

    return None





def _gen_music(prompt: str, duration_seconds: float) -> Optional[ExternalMedia]:

    if not _has_fal():

        return None

    data = _fal_run(

        "fal-ai/stable-audio",

        {

            "prompt": prompt[:1000],

            "seconds_total": max(5, min(int(duration_seconds), 30)),

        },

        timeout=90.0,

    )

    url = None

    if isinstance(data, dict):

        audio = data.get("audio_file") or data.get("audio") or {}

        if isinstance(audio, dict):

            url = audio.get("url")

        url = url or data.get("url")

    if not url:

        return None

    raw, ctype = _download(url)

    return ExternalMedia(raw, ctype or "audio/wav", "fal-music.wav", "fal", 0.1)





def _gen_sfx(prompt: str) -> Optional[ExternalMedia]:

    return _gen_music(f"sound effect, short: {prompt}", 3.0)





def _fal_run(model_id: str, payload: dict, timeout: float = 60.0) -> Optional[dict]:

    settings = get_settings()

    key = settings.fal_api_key.strip()

    headers = {"Authorization": f"Key {key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}

    with httpx.Client(timeout=timeout) as client:

        # Sync endpoint first

        resp = client.post(f"https://fal.run/{model_id}", headers=headers, json=payload)

        if resp.status_code < 400:

            return resp.json()

        # Queue fallback

        q = client.post(f"https://queue.fal.run/{model_id}", headers=headers, json=payload)

        if q.status_code >= 400:

            return None

        body = q.json()

        status_url = body.get("status_url") or body.get("response_url")

        request_id = body.get("request_id")

        if not status_url and request_id:

            status_url = f"https://queue.fal.run/{model_id}/requests/{request_id}/status"

        if not status_url:

            return body if "images" in body or "video" in body else None

        deadline = time.time() + timeout

        while time.time() < deadline:

            st = client.get(status_url, headers=headers)

            if st.status_code >= 400:

                return None

            info = st.json()

            status = str(info.get("status") or "").upper()

            if status in {"COMPLETED", "OK", "SUCCESS"}:

                resp_url = info.get("response_url") or status_url.replace("/status", "")

                out = client.get(resp_url, headers=headers)

                if out.status_code < 400:

                    return out.json()

                return info

            if status in {"FAILED", "ERROR"}:

                return None

            time.sleep(1.5)

    return None





def _first_image_url(data: Optional[dict]) -> Optional[str]:

    if not data:

        return None

    images = data.get("images") or []

    if images and isinstance(images[0], dict):

        return images[0].get("url")

    if isinstance(data.get("image"), dict):

        return data["image"].get("url")

    return data.get("image_url") or data.get("url")





def _download(url: str) -> tuple[bytes, str]:

    with httpx.Client(timeout=90.0, follow_redirects=True) as client:

        resp = client.get(url)

        resp.raise_for_status()

        return resp.content, resp.headers.get("content-type") or "application/octet-stream"


backend/app/services/gateway.py
"""Art City Model Gateway — single entry for all AI generation."""



from __future__ import annotations



from typing import Any, Optional



from sqlalchemy.orm import Session



from app.core.enums import AssetType, GenerationStatus

from app.models import Asset, CostRecord, GenerationJob

from app.services import media_factory

from app.services.providers import get_provider

from app.services.router_engine import resolve_route

from app.services.storage import get_storage





MODALITY_ASSET = {

    "image": AssetType.IMAGE,

    "video": AssetType.VIDEO,

    "voice": AssetType.VOICE,

    "audio": AssetType.AUDIO,

    "music": AssetType.MUSIC,

}





def enqueue_generation(

    db: Session,

    *,

    project_id: str,

    modality: str,

    prompt: str,

    model: Optional[str] = None,

    character_key: Optional[str] = None,

    character_name: Optional[str] = None,

    duration_seconds: float = 4.0,

    dialogue_lines: Optional[list[str]] = None,

    prefer_external: bool = False,

    requested_by: Optional[str] = None,

    params: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None,

) -> GenerationJob:

    decision = resolve_route(

        db,

        modality=modality,

        character_key=character_key,

        model=model,

        prefer_external=prefer_external,

    )

    provider = get_provider(decision.provider)

    estimated = provider.estimate_cost(prompt, modality)



    job = GenerationJob(

        project_id=project_id,

        modality=modality,

        provider=decision.provider,

        model=decision.model_name or model,

        model_version=decision.model_version,

        registered_model_id=decision.registered_model_id,

        character_key=decision.character_key,

        requested_by=requested_by,

        prompt=prompt,

        status=GenerationStatus.QUEUED.value,

        estimated_cost=estimated,

        params_json={

            **(params or {}),

            "duration_seconds": duration_seconds,

            "dialogue_lines": dialogue_lines or [],

            "character_name": character_name,

            "route_reason": decision.reason,

        },

    )

    db.add(job)

    db.commit()

    db.refresh(job)



    # Push to Redis for optional workers; always execute inline so API works

    # without a separate worker process (worker becomes optional scale-out).

    try:

        from app.services.queue import enqueue_job



        enqueue_job(job.id)

    except Exception:

        pass

    process_generation_job(db, job.id)

    db.refresh(job)

    return job





def process_generation_job(db: Session, job_id: str) -> GenerationJob:

    job = db.get(GenerationJob, job_id)

    if not job:

        raise ValueError("job not found")

    if job.status in {

        GenerationStatus.CANCELLED.value,

        GenerationStatus.SUCCEEDED.value,

        GenerationStatus.RUNNING.value,

    }:

        return job



    job.status = GenerationStatus.RUNNING.value

    db.commit()



    params = dict(job.params_json or {})

    provider = get_provider(job.provider)

    try:

        from app.services.knowledge_enrich import enrich_prompt



        base_prompt = job.prompt or ""

        enriched_prompt, knowledge_hits = enrich_prompt(

            db,

            base_prompt,

            character_key=job.character_key,

            dialect=params.get("dialect"),

        )

        if knowledge_hits:

            params["knowledge_hits"] = knowledge_hits

            params["prompt_enriched"] = True

            job.params_json = params



        result = provider.submit_generation(

            enriched_prompt,

            job.modality,

            job.model,

            duration_seconds=params.get("duration_seconds", 4.0),

            character_name=params.get("character_name"),

            character_key=job.character_key,

            dialogue_lines=params.get("dialogue_lines"),

            dialect=params.get("dialect"),

            aspect=params.get("aspect"),

            campaign=params.get("campaign"),

            cta=params.get("cta"),

            brand=params.get("brand"),

            music_style=params.get("music_style"),

            script=params.get("script"),

            advertising=params.get("advertising"),

            end_card=params.get("end_card"),

        )

        job.provider_job_id = result.provider_job_id



        primary_key = _materialize_output(db, job, result, params)

        job.result_uri = primary_key

        job.actual_cost = result.actual_cost

        job.status = GenerationStatus.SUCCEEDED.value

        job.error_message = None



        db.add(

            CostRecord(

                project_id=job.project_id,

                generation_job_id=job.id,

                provider=job.provider,

                model=job.model,

                amount=float(result.actual_cost or job.estimated_cost or 0),

                note=f"gateway:{job.modality}",

            )

        )

        db.commit()

        db.refresh(job)

        return job

    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001

        job.status = GenerationStatus.FAILED.value

        job.error_message = str(exc)

        db.commit()

        db.refresh(job)

        return job





def _materialize_output(db: Session, job: GenerationJob, result, params: dict) -> str:

    storage = get_storage()

    modality = job.modality

    title = params.get("character_name") or job.character_key or modality.upper()

    prompt = job.prompt or ""

    duration = float(params.get("duration_seconds") or 4.0)

    dialogue_lines = params.get("dialogue_lines") or []



    # Video always needs a linked audio bed for /api/media/.../audio and Cinema packaging.

    if modality == "video":

        aspect = str(params.get("aspect") or "16:9")

        brand = str(params.get("brand") or "Art City")

        campaign = str(params.get("campaign") or title)

        cta = str(params.get("cta") or "Art City Studios")

        # Prefer real provider output (OpenAI/FAL) — only synthesize when missing.

        if result.output_bytes and result.filename:

            visual_name = result.filename

            visual_data = result.output_bytes

            visual_ct = result.content_type or "video/mp4"

            if getattr(result, "sidecar_bytes", None) and getattr(result, "sidecar_filename", None):

                bed_name = result.sidecar_filename

                bed_data = result.sidecar_bytes

                bed_ct = result.sidecar_content_type or "audio/wav"

            else:

                _, bed = media_factory.make_video_proxy(prompt, duration_seconds=duration)

                bed_name = bed.filename

                bed_data = bed.data

                bed_ct = bed.content_type

        elif duration >= 6 or params.get("advertising"):

            visual, bed = media_factory.make_cinematic_video(

                prompt,
