                aspect=aspect,

                duration_seconds=duration,

                brand=brand,

                campaign=campaign,

                cta=cta,

            )

            visual_name = visual.filename

            visual_data = visual.data

            visual_ct = visual.content_type

            bed_name = bed.filename

            bed_data = bed.data

            bed_ct = bed.content_type

        else:

            visual, bed = media_factory.make_video_proxy(prompt, duration_seconds=duration)

            visual_name = visual.filename

            visual_data = visual.data

            visual_ct = visual.content_type

            bed_name = bed.filename

            bed_data = bed.data

            bed_ct = bed.content_type

        key = f"projects/{job.project_id}/jobs/{job.id}/{visual_name}"

        audio_key = f"projects/{job.project_id}/jobs/{job.id}/{bed_name}"

        storage.upload_bytes(key, visual_data, visual_ct)

        storage.upload_bytes(audio_key, bed_data, bed_ct)

        _add_asset(

            db,

            job,

            key,

            modality,

            prompt,

            title,

            {

                "preview_kind": "video_proxy",

                "audio_key": audio_key,

                "provider_job_id": result.provider_job_id,

                "cinematic": duration >= 8,

                "external": bool(result.output_bytes and str(result.provider_job_id or "").startswith("ext-")),

            },

        )

        db.add(

            Asset(

                project_id=job.project_id,

                asset_type=AssetType.AUDIO.value,

                name=f"video-bed · {title}",

                storage_path=audio_key,

                metadata_json={

                    "linked_job": job.id,

                    "role": "video_audio_bed",

                    "job_id": job.id,

                    "provider": job.provider,

                },

            )

        )

        return key



    if modality == "image" and params.get("end_card") and not (result.output_bytes and result.filename):

        media = media_factory.make_end_card(

            str(params.get("campaign") or title),

            str(params.get("cta") or "Discover more"),

            brand=str(params.get("brand") or "Art City"),

            prompt=prompt,

        )

        key = f"projects/{job.project_id}/jobs/{job.id}/{media.filename}"

        storage.upload_bytes(key, media.data, media.content_type)

        _add_asset(db, job, key, modality, prompt, title, {"preview_kind": "image", "end_card": True})

        return key



    if result.output_bytes and result.filename:

        key = f"projects/{job.project_id}/jobs/{job.id}/{result.filename}"

        storage.upload_bytes(key, result.output_bytes, result.content_type or "application/octet-stream")

        _add_asset(db, job, key, modality, prompt, title, {"provider_job_id": result.provider_job_id})

        return key



    # Stub / legacy path — synthesize via media_factory

    if modality == "image":

        if params.get("end_card"):

            media = media_factory.make_end_card(

                str(params.get("campaign") or title),

                str(params.get("cta") or "Discover more"),

                brand=str(params.get("brand") or "Art City"),

                prompt=prompt,

            )

        else:

            media = media_factory.make_image(prompt, title=str(title))

        key = f"projects/{job.project_id}/jobs/{job.id}/{media.filename}"

        storage.upload_bytes(key, media.data, media.content_type)

        _add_asset(db, job, key, modality, prompt, title, {"preview_kind": "image"})

        return key

    if modality == "voice":

        if dialogue_lines:

            media = media_factory.make_voice_conversation(prompt, dialogue_lines)

        else:

            media = media_factory.make_ad_voiceover(

                str(params.get("script") or prompt),

                brand=str(params.get("brand") or title),

            )

        key = f"projects/{job.project_id}/jobs/{job.id}/{media.filename}"

        storage.upload_bytes(key, media.data, media.content_type)

        _add_asset(db, job, key, modality, prompt, title, {"preview_kind": "audio"})

        return key

    if modality == "music":

        style = str(params.get("music_style") or "warm")

        media = media_factory.make_cinematic_music(

            prompt, duration_seconds=max(duration, 8.0), style=style

        )

        key = f"projects/{job.project_id}/jobs/{job.id}/{media.filename}"

        storage.upload_bytes(key, media.data, media.content_type)

        _add_asset(db, job, key, modality, prompt, title, {"preview_kind": "audio"})

        return key

    media = media_factory.make_sfx(prompt)

    key = f"projects/{job.project_id}/jobs/{job.id}/{media.filename}"

    storage.upload_bytes(key, media.data, media.content_type)

    _add_asset(db, job, key, modality, prompt, title, {"preview_kind": "audio"})

    return key





def _add_asset(db: Session, job: GenerationJob, key: str, modality: str, prompt: str, title: str, meta: dict) -> None:

    db.add(

        Asset(

            project_id=job.project_id,

            asset_type=MODALITY_ASSET.get(modality, AssetType.OTHER).value,

            name=f"{title} · {modality}",

            storage_path=key,

            metadata_json={

                "prompt": prompt,

                "job_id": job.id,

                "model": job.model,

                "model_version": job.model_version,

                "provider": job.provider,

                "character_key": job.character_key,

                **meta,

            },

        )

    )





def cancel_job(db: Session, job_id: str) -> GenerationJob:

    job = db.get(GenerationJob, job_id)

    if not job:

        raise ValueError("job not found")

    if job.status in {GenerationStatus.SUCCEEDED.value, GenerationStatus.FAILED.value}:

        return job

    job.status = GenerationStatus.CANCELLED.value

    if job.provider_job_id:

        get_provider(job.provider).cancel_generation(job.provider_job_id)

    db.commit()

    db.refresh(job)

    return job





def retry_job(db: Session, job_id: str) -> GenerationJob:

    job = db.get(GenerationJob, job_id)

    if not job:

        raise ValueError("job not found")

    return enqueue_generation(

        db,

        project_id=job.project_id,

        modality=job.modality,

        prompt=job.prompt or "",

        model=job.model,

        character_key=job.character_key,

        character_name=(job.params_json or {}).get("character_name"),

        duration_seconds=float((job.params_json or {}).get("duration_seconds") or 4.0),

        dialogue_lines=(job.params_json or {}).get("dialogue_lines"),

        requested_by=job.requested_by,

        params=job.params_json,

    )


backend/app/services/hub_access.py
"""Production Hub entitlements and permission helpers."""



from __future__ import annotations



from fastapi import HTTPException, status



from app.core.config import get_settings

from app.core.enums import UserRole

from app.models import User





HUB_MODULES = ("script", "storyboard", "budget", "call")





def hub_features() -> dict[str, bool]:

    s = get_settings()

    return {

        "script": bool(s.hub_feature_script),

        "storyboard": bool(s.hub_feature_storyboard),

        "budget": bool(s.hub_feature_budget),

        "call": bool(s.hub_feature_call),

    }





def require_hub_module(module: str) -> None:

    features = hub_features()

    if module not in features:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Unknown hub module: {module}")

    if not features[module]:

        raise HTTPException(

            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,

            detail=f"Hub module '{module}' is not entitled on this deployment",

        )





def is_elevated(user: User) -> bool:

    role = getattr(user, "role", None)

    if isinstance(role, UserRole):

        return role in {UserRole.SUPER_ADMIN, UserRole.ADMINISTRATOR, UserRole.PRODUCER}

    return role in {

        UserRole.SUPER_ADMIN.value,

        UserRole.ADMINISTRATOR.value,

        UserRole.PRODUCER.value,

        UserRole.PROJECT_MANAGER.value,

        UserRole.CREATIVE_DIRECTOR.value,

        UserRole.WRITER.value,

        UserRole.EDITOR.value,

    }





def require_script_edit(user: User) -> None:

    if not is_elevated(user) and getattr(user, "role", None) not in {

        UserRole.WRITER.value,

        UserRole.EDITOR.value,

        "writer",

        "editor",

    }:

        # Authenticated users with active accounts can edit scripts in MVP;

        # platform admins always can.

        if not getattr(user, "is_active", True):

            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="script.edit denied")





def require_script_lock(user: User) -> None:

    role = getattr(user, "role", None)

    allowed = {

        UserRole.SUPER_ADMIN.value,

        UserRole.ADMINISTRATOR.value,

        UserRole.PRODUCER.value,

        UserRole.PROJECT_MANAGER.value,

        UserRole.CREATIVE_DIRECTOR.value,

        "super_admin",

        "administrator",

        "producer",

        "project_manager",

        "creative_director",

    }

    if role not in allowed and not (

        isinstance(role, UserRole) and role.value in allowed

    ):

        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="script.lock denied")
