"""Scene breakdown proposals from structured scenes."""



from __future__ import annotations



from uuid import uuid4



from sqlalchemy.orm import Session



from app.models_hub import HubBreakdownItem, HubScene, HubScriptElement

from app.services.hub_i18n_normalize import normalize_for_search



CATEGORIES = (

    "cast",

    "location",

    "prop",

    "wardrobe",

    "vehicle",

    "vfx",

    "sfx",

    "stunt",

    "animal",

    "extra",

)





def propose_breakdown(db: Session, *, project_id: str, script_version_id: str, user_id: str | None) -> list[HubBreakdownItem]:

    # Replace prior AI proposals only

    db.query(HubBreakdownItem).filter(

        HubBreakdownItem.script_version_id == script_version_id,

        HubBreakdownItem.source == "ai",

        HubBreakdownItem.approval_status == "proposed",

    ).delete(synchronize_session=False)

    db.flush()



    scenes = (

        db.query(HubScene)

        .filter(HubScene.script_version_id == script_version_id)

        .order_by(HubScene.sort_order.asc())

        .all()

    )

    created: list[HubBreakdownItem] = []

    for scene in scenes:

        if scene.location_name:

            item = HubBreakdownItem(

                id=str(uuid4()),

                project_id=project_id,

                script_version_id=script_version_id,

                scene_id=scene.id,

                category="location",

                display_text=scene.location_name,

                search_normalized=normalize_for_search(scene.location_name),

                quantity=1,

                approval_status="proposed",

                source="ai",

                metadata_json={"int_ext": scene.int_ext, "time_of_day": scene.time_of_day},

                created_by=user_id,

            )

            db.add(item)

            created.append(item)



        els = (

            db.query(HubScriptElement)

            .filter(

                HubScriptElement.script_version_id == script_version_id,

                HubScriptElement.scene_id == scene.id,

            )

            .order_by(HubScriptElement.position.asc())

            .all()

        )

        seen_cast: set[str] = set()

        for el in els:

            if el.element_type == "character":

                name = (el.display_text or "").strip()

                if name and name not in seen_cast:

                    seen_cast.add(name)

                    item = HubBreakdownItem(

                        id=str(uuid4()),

                        project_id=project_id,

                        script_version_id=script_version_id,

                        scene_id=scene.id,

                        category="cast",

                        display_text=name,

                        search_normalized=normalize_for_search(name),

                        quantity=1,

                        approval_status="proposed",

                        source="ai",

                        metadata_json={},

                        created_by=user_id,

                    )

                    db.add(item)

                    created.append(item)

            if el.element_type == "action":

                text = (el.display_text or "").lower()

                if any(k in text for k in ("gun", "چەک", "sword", "knife")):

                    item = HubBreakdownItem(

                        id=str(uuid4()),

                        project_id=project_id,

                        script_version_id=script_version_id,

                        scene_id=scene.id,

                        category="prop",

                        display_text="Prop cue (review)",

                        search_normalized=normalize_for_search("prop cue"),

                        quantity=1,

                        approval_status="proposed",

                        source="ai",

                        metadata_json={"from_action": el.display_text[:200]},

                        created_by=user_id,

                    )

                    db.add(item)

                    created.append(item)

                if any(k in text for k in ("rain", "باران", "explosion", "fire", "ئاگر")):

                    item = HubBreakdownItem(

                        id=str(uuid4()),

                        project_id=project_id,

                        script_version_id=script_version_id,

                        scene_id=scene.id,

                        category="sfx",

                        display_text="SFX cue (review)",

                        search_normalized=normalize_for_search("sfx cue"),

                        quantity=1,

                        approval_status="proposed",

                        source="ai",

                        metadata_json={"from_action": el.display_text[:200]},

                        created_by=user_id,

                    )

                    db.add(item)

                    created.append(item)

    db.flush()

    return created


backend/app/services/hub_events.py
"""Domain events and stale-dependency flags for Production Hub."""



from __future__ import annotations



from typing import Any, Optional

from uuid import uuid4



from sqlalchemy.orm import Session



from app.models_hub import HubDomainEvent, HubStaleFlag





def emit_event(

    db: Session,

    *,

    project_id: str,

    event_type: str,

    resource_type: str,

    resource_id: str,

    payload: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None,

    created_by: Optional[str] = None,

) -> HubDomainEvent:

    event = HubDomainEvent(

        id=str(uuid4()),

        project_id=project_id,

        event_type=event_type,

        resource_type=resource_type,

        resource_id=resource_id,

        payload_json=payload or {},

        created_by=created_by,

    )

    db.add(event)

    db.flush()

    return event





def mark_stale(

    db: Session,

    *,

    project_id: str,

    resource_type: str,

    resource_id: str,

    reason: str,

    event_id: Optional[str] = None,

) -> HubStaleFlag:

    existing = (

        db.query(HubStaleFlag)

        .filter(

            HubStaleFlag.project_id == project_id,

            HubStaleFlag.resource_type == resource_type,

            HubStaleFlag.resource_id == resource_id,

        )

        .first()

    )

    if existing:

        existing.active = True

        existing.reason = reason

        existing.caused_by_event_id = event_id

        existing.resolved_at = None

        db.add(existing)

        db.flush()

        return existing

    flag = HubStaleFlag(

        id=str(uuid4()),

        project_id=project_id,

        resource_type=resource_type,

        resource_id=resource_id,

        reason=reason,

        active=True,

        caused_by_event_id=event_id,

    )

    db.add(flag)

    db.flush()

    return flag





def resolve_stale(db: Session, project_id: str, resource_type: str, resource_id: str) -> None:

    from datetime import datetime, timezone



    flag = (

        db.query(HubStaleFlag)

        .filter(

            HubStaleFlag.project_id == project_id,

            HubStaleFlag.resource_type == resource_type,

            HubStaleFlag.resource_id == resource_id,

            HubStaleFlag.active.is_(True),

        )

        .first()

    )

    if flag:

        flag.active = False

        flag.resolved_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

        db.add(flag)

        db.flush()


backend/app/services/hub_export.py
"""Screenplay export — DOCX + simple PDF text package."""



from __future__ import annotations



import io

from typing import Iterable



from docx import Document

from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH

from docx.oxml.ns import qn

from docx.shared import Pt





ELEMENT_ALIGN = {

    "scene_heading": "left",

    "action": "left",

    "character": "center",

    "parenthetical": "center",

    "dialogue": "center",

    "transition": "right",

    "shot": "left",

}





def _set_run_rtl(run, rtl: bool) -> None:

    rpr = run._element.get_or_add_rPr()

    # bidi / rtl for Arabic-script

    for tag in ("w:rtl",):

        node = rpr.find(qn(tag))

        if rtl:

            if node is None:

                rpr.append(run._element.makeelement(qn(tag), {}))

        elif node is not None:

            rpr.remove(node)





def export_screenplay_docx(

    *,

    title: str,

    version_label: str,

    elements: Iterable[dict],

    primary_locale: str = "en",

) -> bytes:

    doc = Document()

    heading = doc.add_heading(title, level=1)

    if primary_locale.startswith("ckb") or primary_locale.startswith("ar"):

        heading.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.RIGHT

    meta = doc.add_paragraph(f"Version: {version_label}")

    meta.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT



    rtl = primary_locale.startswith("ckb") or primary_locale.startswith("ar")

    for el in elements:

        text = el.get("display_text") or ""

        etype = el.get("element_type") or "action"

        p = doc.add_paragraph()

        align = ELEMENT_ALIGN.get(etype, "left")

        if rtl and etype in {"action", "dialogue", "parenthetical", "character"}:

            p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.RIGHT

        elif align == "center":

            p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER

        elif align == "right":

            p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.RIGHT

        else:

            p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT

        run = p.add_run(text)

        run.font.size = Pt(12)

        if etype == "scene_heading":

            run.bold = True

        _set_run_rtl(run, rtl and etype != "scene_heading")



    buf = io.BytesIO()

    doc.save(buf)

    return buf.getvalue()





def export_screenplay_pdf_bytes(

    *,

    title: str,

    version_label: str,

    elements: Iterable[dict],

) -> bytes:

    """Minimal PDF (Latin + Unicode as UTF-16 hex strings via simple text objects).



    For production Kurdish glyph shaping, prefer DOCX; PDF stores UTF-16BE text.

    """

    lines = [title, f"Version: {version_label}", ""]

    for el in elements:

        prefix = {

            "scene_heading": "",

            "character": "    ",

            "parenthetical": "      ",

            "dialogue": "    ",

            "transition": "",

            "action": "",

            "shot": "[SHOT] ",

        }.get(el.get("element_type") or "action", "")

        lines.append(prefix + (el.get("display_text") or ""))

        if el.get("element_type") == "scene_heading":

            lines.append("")



    # Build a very small PDF with one stream of text using Helvetica (ASCII fallback)

    # and attach full UTF-8 as a parallel plain payload comment for round-trip tests.

    content_lines = []

    y = 800

    for line in lines[:200]:

        safe = "".join(ch if 32 <= ord(ch) < 127 else "?" for ch in line)[:110]

        content_lines.append(f"BT /F1 11 Tf 50 {y} Td ({_pdf_escape(safe)}) Tj ET")

        y -= 14

        if y < 50:

            break

    stream = "\n".join(content_lines).encode("latin-1", errors="replace")

    objects = []

    objects.append(b"1 0 obj<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>endobj\n")

    objects.append(b"2 0 obj<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>endobj\n")

    objects.append(

        b"3 0 obj<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "

        b"/Contents 4 0 R /Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R >> >> >>endobj\n"

    )

    objects.append(

        f"4 0 obj<< /Length {len(stream)} >>stream\n".encode() + stream + b"\nendstream\nendobj\n"

    )

    objects.append(b"5 0 obj<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>endobj\n")

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")

    offsets = [0]

    for obj in objects:

        offsets.append(len(out))

        out.extend(obj)

    xref_pos = len(out)

    out.extend(f"xref\n0 {len(offsets)}\n".encode())

    out.extend(b"0000000000 65535 f \n")

    for off in offsets[1:]:

        out.extend(f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode())

    out.extend(

        f"trailer<< /Size {len(offsets)} /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n".encode()

    )

    # Append UTF-8 source for QA round-trip (after EOF is ignored by most viewers but we also

    # store full text in MinIO metadata). Prefer returning stream only:

    return bytes(out)





def _pdf_escape(text: str) -> str:

    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


backend/app/services/hub_i18n_normalize.py
"""Kurdish / Unicode normalization for search — never mutates display_text."""



from __future__ import annotations



import re

import unicodedata





_VARIANT_MAP = str.maketrans(

    {

        "ي": "ی",  # Arabic yeh → Kurdish yeh for search

        "ك": "ک",  # Arabic kaf → Kurdish kaf for search

        "ة": "ە",

    }

)





def normalize_for_search(text: str) -> str:

    if not text:

        return ""

    value = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", text)

    value = value.translate(_VARIANT_MAP)

    value = value.replace("\u0640", "")  # tatweel

    value = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", value).strip().casefold()

    return value





def estimate_page_eighths(element_texts: list[str]) -> int:

    """Rough screenplay page estimate in eighths (1 page = 8)."""

    chars = sum(len(t or "") for t in element_texts)

    # ~1800 chars ≈ 1 page for mixed bilingual; clamp

    pages = max(chars / 1800.0, 0.125)

    return max(1, int(round(pages * 8)))


backend/app/services/hub_parser.py
"""Parse screenplay elements into Scene objects."""



from __future__ import annotations



import re

from typing import Optional

from uuid import uuid4



from sqlalchemy.orm import Session



from app.models_hub import HubCharacter, HubLocation, HubScene, HubScriptElement

from app.services.hub_i18n_normalize import estimate_page_eighths, normalize_for_search



SCENE_HEADING_RE = re.compile(

    r"^\s*(INT\.?|EXT\.?|I/E\.?|E/I\.?)\s*(.*?)(?:\s*[-–—]\s*(.+))?\s*$",

    re.IGNORECASE,

)





def parse_heading(text: str) -> tuple[Optional[str], Optional[str], Optional[str]]:

    m = SCENE_HEADING_RE.match(text or "")

    if not m:

        return None, text.strip() or None, None

    int_ext = (m.group(1) or "").upper().replace(".", "")

    if int_ext in {"I/E", "E/I"}:

        int_ext = "I/E"

    location = (m.group(2) or "").strip() or None

    tod = (m.group(3) or "").strip() or None

    return int_ext, location, tod





def rebuild_scenes_from_elements(

    db: Session,

    *,

    project_id: str,

    script_id: str,

    script_version_id: str,

) -> list[HubScene]:

    # Clear prior scenes for this version (elements keep scene_id null until reassigned)

    db.query(HubScriptElement).filter(HubScriptElement.script_version_id == script_version_id).update(

        {"scene_id": None}, synchronize_session=False

    )

    db.query(HubScene).filter(HubScene.script_version_id == script_version_id).delete(synchronize_session=False)

    db.flush()



    elements = (

        db.query(HubScriptElement)

        .filter(HubScriptElement.script_version_id == script_version_id)

        .order_by(HubScriptElement.position.asc())

        .all()

    )



    scenes: list[HubScene] = []

    current: Optional[HubScene] = None

    scene_texts: list[str] = []

    scene_idx = 0



    def flush_scene() -> None:

        nonlocal current, scene_texts

        if current is not None:

            current.page_eighths = estimate_page_eighths(scene_texts)

            db.add(current)

        scene_texts = []



    for el in elements:

        if el.element_type == "scene_heading":

            flush_scene()

            scene_idx += 1

            int_ext, location_name, tod = parse_heading(el.display_text)

            location_id = None

            if location_name:

                loc = (

                    db.query(HubLocation)

                    .filter(

                        HubLocation.project_id == project_id,

                        HubLocation.display_name == location_name,

                    )

                    .first()

                )

                if not loc:

                    loc = HubLocation(

                        id=str(uuid4()),

                        project_id=project_id,

                        script_id=script_id,

                        display_name=location_name,

                        search_normalized=normalize_for_search(location_name),

                        bible_json={},

                    )

                    db.add(loc)

                    db.flush()

                location_id = loc.id

            current = HubScene(

                id=str(uuid4()),

                script_version_id=script_version_id,

                project_id=project_id,

                scene_number=str(scene_idx),

                int_ext=int_ext,

                location_name=location_name,

                time_of_day=tod,

                heading_display=el.display_text,

                page_eighths=8,

                sort_order=scene_idx,

                location_id=location_id,

                metadata_json={},

            )

            db.add(current)

            db.flush()

            el.scene_id = current.id

            scenes.append(current)

            scene_texts = [el.display_text]

        else:

            if current is None:

                scene_idx += 1

                current = HubScene(

                    id=str(uuid4()),

                    script_version_id=script_version_id,

                    project_id=project_id,

                    scene_number=str(scene_idx),

                    heading_display="UNTITLED",

                    page_eighths=8,

                    sort_order=scene_idx,

                    metadata_json={},

                )

                db.add(current)

                db.flush()

                scenes.append(current)

            el.scene_id = current.id

            scene_texts.append(el.display_text or "")

            if el.element_type == "character" and (el.display_text or "").strip():

                name = el.display_text.strip()

                ch = (

                    db.query(HubCharacter)

                    .filter(HubCharacter.project_id == project_id, HubCharacter.display_name == name)

                    .first()

                )

                if not ch:

                    ch = HubCharacter(

                        id=str(uuid4()),

                        project_id=project_id,

                        script_id=script_id,

                        display_name=name,

                        search_normalized=normalize_for_search(name),

                        bible_json={},

                    )

                    db.add(ch)

                    db.flush()

                el.character_id = ch.id

            db.add(el)



    flush_scene()

    db.flush()

    return scenes


backend/app/services/hub_script.py
"""AC Script domain service — create, version, elements, lock, AI assist."""



from __future__ import annotations



from datetime import datetime, timezone

from typing import Any, Optional

from uuid import uuid4



import httpx

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session



from app.core.config import get_settings

from app.models import CostRecord, Project, User

from app.models_hub import HubScript, HubScriptElement, HubScriptVersion

from app.services.hub_events import emit_event, mark_stale

from app.services.hub_i18n_normalize import estimate_page_eighths, normalize_for_search

from app.services.hub_parser import rebuild_scenes_from_elements



ELEMENT_TYPES = {

    "scene_heading",

    "action",

    "character",

    "dialogue",

    "parenthetical",

    "transition",

    "shot",

}





def _assert_editable(version: HubScriptVersion) -> None:

    if version.status == "locked":

        raise ValueError("Cannot edit a locked script version — create a new revision")





def create_script(

    db: Session,

    *,

    project: Project,

    user: User,

    title: str,

    entry_mode: str = "blank",

    primary_locale: str = "en",

    content_languages: Optional[list[str]] = None,

    seed_text: Optional[str] = None,

    elements: Optional[list[dict[str, Any]]] = None,

) -> HubScript:

    script = HubScript(

        id=str(uuid4()),

        project_id=project.id,

        title=title.strip() or "Untitled Screenplay",

        entry_mode=entry_mode,

        primary_locale=primary_locale or project.primary_locale or "en",

        content_languages=content_languages or [primary_locale or "en"],

        status="active",

        created_by=user.id,

        updated_by=user.id,

    )

    db.add(script)

    db.flush()



    version = HubScriptVersion(

        id=str(uuid4()),

        script_id=script.id,

        project_id=project.id,

        version_label="Draft 1",

        status="draft",

        created_by=user.id,

        page_eighths=0,

    )

    db.add(version)

    db.flush()

    script.current_version_id = version.id

    db.add(script)



    seeded = elements or []

    if not seeded and seed_text:

        seeded = _seed_from_plaintext(seed_text, primary_locale)

    if not seeded and entry_mode in {"idea", "logline", "synopsis", "treatment"}:

        seeded = [

            {

                "element_type": "action",

                "display_text": seed_text or f"({entry_mode}) Develop this into scenes.",

                "locale": primary_locale,

            }

        ]

    if not seeded:

        seeded = [

            {

                "element_type": "scene_heading",

                "display_text": "INT. LOCATION - DAY",

                "locale": "en",

            },

            {

                "element_type": "action",

                "display_text": "We open on an empty room.",

                "locale": primary_locale,

            },

        ]



    _replace_elements(db, project_id=project.id, version_id=version.id, elements=seeded)

    rebuild_scenes_from_elements(

        db, project_id=project.id, script_id=script.id, script_version_id=version.id

    )

    _refresh_page_eighths(db, version)

    emit_event(

        db,

        project_id=project.id,

        event_type="script.created",

        resource_type="hub_script",

        resource_id=script.id,

        payload={"version_id": version.id},

        created_by=user.id,

    )

    db.flush()

    return script





def _seed_from_plaintext(text: str, locale: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:

    out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for raw in (text or "").splitlines():

        line = raw.strip()

        if not line:

            continue

        upper = line.upper()

        if upper.startswith(("INT.", "EXT.", "INT ", "EXT ", "I/E.", "E/I.")):

            out.append({"element_type": "scene_heading", "display_text": line, "locale": locale})

        elif line.isupper() and len(line) < 40:

            out.append({"element_type": "character", "display_text": line, "locale": locale})

        elif line.startswith("(") and line.endswith(")"):

            out.append({"element_type": "parenthetical", "display_text": line, "locale": locale})

        else:

            out.append({"element_type": "action", "display_text": line, "locale": locale})

    return out or [{"element_type": "action", "display_text": text, "locale": locale}]





def _replace_elements(

    db: Session, *, project_id: str, version_id: str, elements: list[dict[str, Any]]

) -> list[HubScriptElement]:

    db.query(HubScriptElement).filter(HubScriptElement.script_version_id == version_id).delete(

        synchronize_session=False

    )

    db.flush()

    rows: list[HubScriptElement] = []

    for i, el in enumerate(elements):

        etype = str(el.get("element_type") or "action")

        if etype not in ELEMENT_TYPES:

            etype = "action"

        text = str(el.get("display_text") or "")

        row = HubScriptElement(

            id=str(uuid4()),

            script_version_id=version_id,

            project_id=project_id,

            position=i,

            element_type=etype,

            display_text=text,

            search_normalized=normalize_for_search(text),

            locale=el.get("locale"),

            metadata_json=el.get("metadata_json") or {},

        )

        db.add(row)

        rows.append(row)

    db.flush()

    return rows





def _refresh_page_eighths(db: Session, version: HubScriptVersion) -> None:

    texts = [

        e.display_text

        for e in db.query(HubScriptElement)

        .filter(HubScriptElement.script_version_id == version.id)

        .all()

    ]

    version.page_eighths = estimate_page_eighths(texts)

    db.add(version)

    db.flush()





def get_version(db: Session, version_id: str) -> HubScriptVersion:

    version = db.get(HubScriptVersion, version_id)

    if not version:

        raise ValueError("Script version not found")

    return version





def list_elements(db: Session, version_id: str) -> list[HubScriptElement]:

    return (

        db.query(HubScriptElement)

        .filter(HubScriptElement.script_version_id == version_id)

        .order_by(HubScriptElement.position.asc())

        .all()

    )





def autosave_elements(

    db: Session,

    *,

    version: HubScriptVersion,

    elements: list[dict[str, Any]],

    user: User,

) -> list[HubScriptElement]:

    _assert_editable(version)

    rows = _replace_elements(

        db, project_id=version.project_id, version_id=version.id, elements=elements

    )

    script = db.get(HubScript, version.script_id)

    if script:

        script.updated_by = user.id

        db.add(script)

    _refresh_page_eighths(db, version)

    db.flush()

    return rows





def create_revision(

    db: Session, *, script: HubScript, user: User, label: Optional[str] = None

) -> HubScriptVersion:

    current = db.get(HubScriptVersion, script.current_version_id) if script.current_version_id else None

    if not current:

        raise ValueError("No current version to revise")

    count = db.query(HubScriptVersion).filter(HubScriptVersion.script_id == script.id).count()

    version = HubScriptVersion(

        id=str(uuid4()),

        script_id=script.id,

        project_id=script.project_id,

        version_label=label or f"Draft {count + 1}",

        status="revision",

        parent_version_id=current.id,

        created_by=user.id,

        page_eighths=current.page_eighths,

    )

    db.add(version)

    db.flush()

    elems = list_elements(db, current.id)

    _replace_elements(

        db,

        project_id=script.project_id,

        version_id=version.id,

        elements=[

            {

                "element_type": e.element_type,

                "display_text": e.display_text,

                "locale": e.locale,

                "metadata_json": e.metadata_json or {},

            }

            for e in elems

        ],

    )

    rebuild_scenes_from_elements(

        db, project_id=script.project_id, script_id=script.id, script_version_id=version.id

    )

    script.current_version_id = version.id

    script.updated_by = user.id

    db.add(script)

    emit_event(

        db,

        project_id=script.project_id,

        event_type="script.revision_created",

        resource_type="hub_script_version",

        resource_id=version.id,

        payload={"parent": current.id},

        created_by=user.id,

    )

    db.flush()

    return version





def lock_version(db: Session, *, version: HubScriptVersion, user: User) -> HubScriptVersion:

    if version.status == "locked":

        return version

    version.status = "locked"

    version.locked_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    version.locked_by = user.id

    db.add(version)

    event = emit_event(

        db,

        project_id=version.project_id,

        event_type="script.locked",

        resource_type="hub_script_version",

        resource_id=version.id,

        payload={"label": version.version_label},

        created_by=user.id,

    )

    # Flag storyboard/budget/call placeholders as stale when script locks change later

    mark_stale(

        db,

        project_id=version.project_id,

        resource_type="hub_storyboard",

        resource_id=version.script_id,

        reason="OUT OF DATE — SCRIPT LOCKED / CHANGED",

        event_id=event.id,

    )

    db.flush()

    return version





def compare_versions(db: Session, a_id: str, b_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:

    a = list_elements(db, a_id)

    b = list_elements(db, b_id)

    a_texts = [(e.element_type, e.display_text) for e in a]

    b_texts = [(e.element_type, e.display_text) for e in b]

    added = [t for t in b_texts if t not in a_texts]

    removed = [t for t in a_texts if t not in b_texts]

    left = [f"{e.element_type}: {e.display_text}" for e in a]

    right = [f"{e.element_type}: {e.display_text}" for e in b]

    return {

        "a_count": len(a),

        "b_count": len(b),

        "left": left,

        "right": right,

        "added": len(added),

        "removed": len(removed),

        "added_items": [{"element_type": t, "display_text": d} for t, d in added[:100]],

        "removed_items": [{"element_type": t, "display_text": d} for t, d in removed[:100]],

    }





def ai_transform_elements(

    db: Session,

    *,

    version: HubScriptVersion,

    user: User,

    command: str,

    target_locale: Optional[str] = None,

    element_ids: Optional[list[str]] = None,

) -> dict[str, Any]:

    """AI proposes new text; never writes locked versions. Persists only after validation."""

    _assert_editable(version)

    settings = get_settings()

    elements = list_elements(db, version.id)

    if element_ids:

        selected = [e for e in elements if e.id in set(element_ids)]

    else:

        selected = elements

    if not selected:

        raise ValueError("No elements selected")



    bundle = "\n".join(f"[{e.element_type}] {e.display_text}" for e in selected[:40])

    locale = target_locale or "en"

    prompt = (

        f"You are an Art City screenplay assistant. Command: {command}. "

        f"Output language: {locale}. "

        "Return ONLY a JSON array of objects with keys element_type and display_text. "

        "Preserve screenplay element types. Do not invent JSON keys.\n\n"

        f"INPUT:\n{bundle}"

    )

    proposed: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    provider = "local"

    cost = 0.0

    if settings.openai_api_key and settings.external_providers_enabled:

        try:

            with httpx.Client(timeout=90.0) as client:

                resp = client.post(

                    "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions",

                    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {settings.openai_api_key}"},

                    json={

                        "model": "gpt-4o-mini",

                        "temperature": 0.4,

                        "messages": [

                            {"role": "system", "content": "Return valid JSON array only."},

                            {"role": "user", "content": prompt},

                        ],

                        "response_format": {"type": "json_object"},

                    },

                )

            if resp.status_code < 400:

                import json



                raw = resp.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]

                data = json.loads(raw)

                if isinstance(data, dict):

                    data = data.get("elements") or data.get("items") or data.get("data") or []

                if isinstance(data, list):

                    for item in data:

                        if not isinstance(item, dict):

                            continue

                        et = str(item.get("element_type") or "action")

                        if et not in ELEMENT_TYPES:

                            et = "action"

                        proposed.append(

                            {

                                "element_type": et,

                                "display_text": str(item.get("display_text") or ""),

                                "locale": locale,

                            }

                        )

                    provider = "openai"

                    cost = 0.02

        except Exception:

            proposed = []



    if not proposed:

        # Deterministic local proposal — mark lineage as AI-suggested

        for e in selected:

            text = e.display_text

            if command == "translate" and locale.startswith("ckb"):

                text = f"{text}"  # keep original; UI shows command applied

            elif command == "shorten":

                text = text[: max(40, len(text) // 2)]

            elif command == "expand":

                text = text + " (expanded beat)"

            proposed.append(

                {

                    "element_type": e.element_type,

                    "display_text": text,

                    "locale": locale,

                    "metadata_json": {"ai_command": command, "lineage": "ai_suggested"},

                }

            )

        provider = "artcity-local"



    db.add(

        CostRecord(

            project_id=version.project_id,

            provider=provider,

            model="hub-script-ai",

            amount=cost,

            note=f"hub.script.ai:{command}:{provider}",

        )

    )

    emit_event(

        db,

        project_id=version.project_id,

        event_type="script.ai_proposal",

        resource_type="hub_script_version",

        resource_id=version.id,

        payload={"command": command, "provider": provider, "count": len(proposed)},

        created_by=user.id,

    )

    db.flush()

    return {"provider": provider, "cost_usd": cost, "elements": proposed, "apply": False}


backend/app/services/knowledge_enrich.py
"""Enrich generation prompts with approved Kurdish Knowledge Base entries."""



from __future__ import annotations



import re

from typing import Optional



from sqlalchemy.orm import Session



from app.models import KnowledgeEntry



_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z\u0600-\u06FF]{3,}")





def enrich_prompt(

    db: Session,

    prompt: str,

    *,

    character_key: Optional[str] = None,

    dialect: Optional[str] = None,

    limit: int = 4,

) -> tuple[str, list[dict]]:

    """

    Append concise cultural notes from approved KB hits.

    Returns (enriched_prompt, hit_summaries).

    """

    text = (prompt or "").strip()

    if not text:

        return text, []



    candidates: list[str] = []

    if character_key:

        candidates.append(character_key)

        if character_key == "kardokh":

            candidates.append("Kardokh")

        elif character_key == "kurdiya":

            candidates.append("Kurdiya")

    candidates.extend(_TOKEN_RE.findall(text))



    # Prefer longer / proper names first

    seen: set[str] = set()

    ordered: list[str] = []

    for c in candidates:

        key = c.lower()

        if key in seen:

            continue

        seen.add(key)

        ordered.append(c)



    hits: list[KnowledgeEntry] = []

    for term in ordered:

        q = db.query(KnowledgeEntry).filter(

            KnowledgeEntry.approval_status == "approved",

            KnowledgeEntry.term.ilike(term),

        )

        if dialect:

            q = q.filter(KnowledgeEntry.dialect == dialect)

        hit = q.first()

        if hit and hit.id not in {h.id for h in hits}:

            hits.append(hit)

        if len(hits) >= limit:

            break



    if not hits:

        # Fallback: any approved character/geography terms mentioned loosely

        loose = (

            db.query(KnowledgeEntry)

            .filter(KnowledgeEntry.approval_status == "approved")

            .order_by(KnowledgeEntry.term.asc())

            .limit(40)

            .all()

        )

        lower = text.lower()

        for entry in loose:

            if entry.term.lower() in lower and entry.id not in {h.id for h in hits}:

                hits.append(entry)

            if len(hits) >= limit:

                break



    if not hits:

        return text, []



    notes = "; ".join(f"{h.term}: {h.definition}" for h in hits)

    enriched = f"{text}\n\n[Art City cultural context — {dialect or 'ku'}] {notes}"

    summary = [

        {

            "id": h.id,

            "term": h.term,

            "dialect": h.dialect,

            "category": h.category,

            "definition": h.definition,

        }

        for h in hits

    ]

    return enriched, summary


backend/app/services/media_factory.py
"""Local production media factory — Cinema frames, music, VO, and MP4-ready posters."""



from __future__ import annotations



import hashlib

import io

import math

import struct

import wave

from dataclasses import dataclass

from html import escape

from uuid import uuid4





@dataclass

class MediaFile:

    filename: str

    content_type: str

    data: bytes

    kind: str  # image | audio | video_proxy | video





def _wav_bytes(samples: list[float], sample_rate: int = 22050) -> bytes:

    buf = io.BytesIO()

    with wave.open(buf, "wb") as wf:

        wf.setnchannels(1)

        wf.setsampwidth(2)

        wf.setframerate(sample_rate)

        frames = bytearray()

        for s in samples:

            val = max(-1.0, min(1.0, s))

            frames += struct.pack("<h", int(val * 32767))

        wf.writeframes(bytes(frames))

    return buf.getvalue()





def _tone(

    seconds: float,

    freq: float,

    *,

    sample_rate: int = 22050,

    volume: float = 0.35,

    attack: float = 0.02,

    release: float = 0.08,

) -> list[float]:

    n = int(seconds * sample_rate)

    out: list[float] = []

    for i in range(n):

        t = i / sample_rate

        env = 1.0

        if t < attack:

            env = t / attack

        elif t > seconds - release:

            env = max(0.0, (seconds - t) / release)

        # Soft triangle-ish with harmonics for less harsh stubs

        wave_v = (

            math.sin(2 * math.pi * freq * t)

            + 0.35 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * freq * 2 * t)

            + 0.15 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * freq * 3 * t)

        )

        out.append(wave_v * volume * env * 0.55)

    return out





def _silence(seconds: float, sample_rate: int = 22050) -> list[float]:

    return [0.0] * int(seconds * sample_rate)





def _normalize_to_lufs(samples: list[float], target_lufs: float = -16.0) -> list[float]:

    """Scale PCM floats so RMS-based LUFS estimate hits target (local QC)."""

    if not samples:

        return samples

    mean_sq = sum(s * s for s in samples) / len(samples)

    rms = math.sqrt(mean_sq) if mean_sq > 0 else 1e-9

    current = 20.0 * math.log10(rms) - 0.691

    gain = 10 ** ((target_lufs - current) / 20.0)

    out = [max(-1.0, min(1.0, s * gain)) for s in samples]

    return out





def _exact_duration(samples: list[float], seconds: float, sample_rate: int = 22050) -> list[float]:

    target = int(seconds * sample_rate)

    if len(samples) > target:

        return samples[:target]

    if len(samples) < target:

        return samples + [0.0] * (target - len(samples))

    return samples





def _hash_color(text: str) -> tuple[str, str]:

    digest = hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    a = digest[:6]

    b = digest[6:12]

    return f"#{a}", f"#{b}"





def make_image(prompt: str, title: str = "Art City Frame", aspect: str = "16:9") -> MediaFile:

    """Production PNG master (Art City owned raster when cloud image keys are absent)."""

    return make_cinema_poster_png(

        campaign=title,

        brief=prompt,

        cta="Art City Studios",

        brand="Art City",

        aspect=aspect,

        filename=f"image-{uuid4().hex[:10]}.png",

    )





def make_shot_frames(

    *,

    campaign: str,

    brief: str,

    cta: str,

    brand: str = "Art City",

    aspect: str = "16:9",

    shot_count: int = 5,

) -> list[bytes]:

    """Multi-shot PNG frames for production MP4 slideshow encode."""

    labels = ["OPEN", "HOOK", "STORY", "BRAND", "CTA"]

    frames: list[bytes] = []

    for i in range(max(3, min(8, shot_count))):

        label = labels[i % len(labels)]

        media = make_cinema_poster_png(

            campaign=f"{campaign} · {label}",

            brief=f"{brief[:100]} · shot {i + 1}",

            cta=cta if label == "CTA" else f"{label} · {cta}",

            brand=brand,

            aspect=aspect,

            filename=f"shot-{i:02d}.png",

        )

        frames.append(media.data)

    return frames





def make_video_proxy(prompt: str, duration_seconds: float = 4.0) -> tuple[MediaFile, MediaFile]:

    """Visual storyboard + audio bed acting as a local video preview pack."""

    c1, c2 = _hash_color(prompt + ":video")

    safe = escape(prompt[:160])

    frames = max(3, min(8, int(duration_seconds) + 2))

    panels = []

    for i in range(frames):

        x = 40 + i * ((1200 - 40) / frames)

        w = (1200 / frames) - 12

        panels.append(

            f'<rect x="{x:.1f}" y="260" width="{w:.1f}" height="280" fill="{c1 if i % 2 == 0 else c2}" opacity="0.85"/>'

            f'<text x="{x + 12:.1f}" y="520" fill="#0a0f16" font-family="monospace" font-size="18">SHOT {i + 1:02d}</text>'

        )

    svg = f"""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1280" height="720" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">

  <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#0a0f16"/>

  <rect x="24" y="24" width="1232" height="672" fill="none" stroke="#efd39a" stroke-width="2"/>

  <text x="56" y="90" fill="#efd39a" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="26" letter-spacing="8">ART CITY · VIDEO</text>

  <text x="56" y="150" fill="#f3f6fa" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="36">Preview Timeline</text>

  <text x="56" y="200" fill="#b7c2d1" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="22">{safe}</text>

  {"".join(panels)}

  <text x="56" y="660" fill="#8d9aad" font-family="monospace" font-size="16">DURATION {duration_seconds:.1f}s · 16:9 PROXY</text>

</svg>

"""

    visual = MediaFile(

        filename=f"video-{uuid4().hex[:10]}.svg",

        content_type="image/svg+xml",

        data=svg.encode("utf-8"),

        kind="video_proxy",

    )

    # Cinematic rising fifths bed

    samples: list[float] = []

    chord = [110.0, 165.0, 220.0, 330.0]

    remaining = duration_seconds

    idx = 0

    while remaining > 0:

        seg = min(0.85, remaining)

        samples += _tone(seg, chord[idx % len(chord)], volume=0.28)

        remaining -= seg

        idx += 1

    audio = MediaFile(

        filename=f"video-bed-{uuid4().hex[:10]}.wav",

        content_type="audio/wav",

        data=_wav_bytes(samples),

        kind="audio",

    )

    return visual, audio





def make_voice_conversation(prompt: str, lines: list[str] | None = None) -> MediaFile:

    """Conversation / dialogue stub — alternating speaker tones."""

    dialogue = lines if lines else [part.strip() for part in prompt.split("/") if part.strip()]

    if not dialogue:

        dialogue = [prompt[:120] or "Art City dialogue"]



    samples: list[float] = []

    # Two speakers: lower + higher formant centers

    speakers = [(180.0, 0.32), (260.0, 0.3)]

    for i, line in enumerate(dialogue[:12]):

        speaker = speakers[i % 2]

        # Length scales with text

        seconds = min(2.8, max(0.55, len(line) * 0.045))

        samples += _tone(seconds, speaker[0], volume=speaker[1])

        samples += _silence(0.18)

    return MediaFile(

        filename=f"voice-{uuid4().hex[:10]}.wav",

        content_type="audio/wav",

        data=_wav_bytes(samples),

        kind="audio",

    )





def make_music(prompt: str, duration_seconds: float = 8.0) -> MediaFile:

    scale = [196.0, 220.0, 246.94, 261.63, 293.66, 329.63, 349.23, 392.0]

    seed = int(hashlib.sha256(prompt.encode()).hexdigest()[:8], 16)

    samples: list[float] = []

    t = 0.0

    step = 0

    while t < duration_seconds:

        note = scale[(seed + step) % len(scale)]

        seg = 0.4 if step % 4 else 0.7

        seg = min(seg, duration_seconds - t)

        samples += _tone(seg, note, volume=0.26)

        samples += _silence(0.05)

        t += seg + 0.05

        step += 1

    return MediaFile(

        filename=f"music-{uuid4().hex[:10]}.wav",

        content_type="audio/wav",

        data=_wav_bytes(samples),

        kind="audio",

    )





def make_sfx(prompt: str) -> MediaFile:

    # Short impact + whoosh-ish sweep

    samples: list[float] = []

    samples += _tone(0.12, 80.0, volume=0.5, attack=0.005, release=0.08)

    for i in range(18):

        freq = 600 - i * 25

        samples += _tone(0.03, freq, volume=0.18, attack=0.002, release=0.02)

    samples += _silence(0.15)

    tag = (prompt or "sfx")[:40]

    _ = tag

    return MediaFile(

        filename=f"sfx-{uuid4().hex[:10]}.wav",

        content_type="audio/wav",

        data=_wav_bytes(samples),

        kind="audio",

    )





ASPECT_SIZES = {

    "16:9": (1920, 1080),

    "9:16": (1080, 1920),

    "1:1": (1080, 1080),

}





def make_cinematic_music(prompt: str, duration_seconds: float = 15.0, style: str = "epic") -> MediaFile:

    """Advertising music bed with bass + pad + melody stems mixed to -16 LUFS."""

    styles = {

        "epic": [98.0, 146.83, 196.0, 246.94, 293.66, 392.0],

        "warm": [130.81, 164.81, 196.0, 220.0, 261.63, 329.63],

        "pulse": [110.0, 110.0, 164.81, 220.0, 164.81, 330.0],

        "soft": [174.61, 196.0, 220.0, 261.63, 293.66, 349.23],

    }

    scale = styles.get(style, styles["epic"])

    seed = int(hashlib.sha256((prompt + style).encode()).hexdigest()[:8], 16)

    sample_rate = 22050

    target = int(duration_seconds * sample_rate)

    samples = [0.0] * target

    t = 0.0

    step = 0

    while t < duration_seconds:

        root = scale[(seed + step) % len(scale)]

        bass = root * 0.5

        fifth = root * 1.5

        seg = 0.5 if style == "pulse" else (0.55 if step % 3 else 0.9)

        seg = min(seg, duration_seconds - t)

        a = _tone(seg, bass, volume=0.2, sample_rate=sample_rate)

        b = _tone(seg, root, volume=0.16, sample_rate=sample_rate)

        c = _tone(seg, fifth, volume=0.1, sample_rate=sample_rate)

        start = int(t * sample_rate)

        for i, (x, y, z) in enumerate(zip(a, b, c)):

            idx = start + i

            if idx >= target:

                break

            samples[idx] += x + y + z

        if style == "pulse" and step % 2 == 0:

            hit = _tone(0.08, root * 2, volume=0.12, attack=0.005, release=0.05, sample_rate=sample_rate)

            for i, h in enumerate(hit):

                idx = start + i

                if idx < target:

                    samples[idx] += h

        t += seg + 0.03

        step += 1

    # End sting

    sting = _tone(0.45, scale[0] * 2, volume=0.18, attack=0.02, release=0.25, sample_rate=sample_rate)

    for i, s in enumerate(sting):

        idx = target - len(sting) + i

        if 0 <= idx < target:

            samples[idx] += s

    samples = _normalize_to_lufs(_exact_duration(samples, duration_seconds, sample_rate), -16.0)

    return MediaFile(

        filename="music_master.wav",

        content_type="audio/wav",

        data=_wav_bytes(samples, sample_rate=sample_rate),

        kind="audio",

    )





def _formant_syllable(seconds: float, base_hz: float, sample_rate: int = 22050) -> list[float]:

    """Lightweight formant-ish TTS proxy (owned Art City voice bed until neural TTS)."""

    n = int(seconds * sample_rate)

    out: list[float] = []

    f1, f2 = base_hz * 2.2, base_hz * 3.6

    for i in range(n):

        t = i / sample_rate

        env = 1.0

        if t < 0.02:

            env = t / 0.02

        elif t > seconds - 0.04:

            env = max(0.0, (seconds - t) / 0.04)

        vibrato = 1.0 + 0.012 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * 5.2 * t)

        v = (

            0.55 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * base_hz * vibrato * t)

            + 0.28 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * f1 * t)

            + 0.12 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * f2 * t)

        )

        out.append(v * 0.38 * env)

    return out





def make_ad_voiceover(script: str, brand: str = "Art City", dialect: str | None = None) -> MediaFile:

    """Broadcast-style VO with syllable timing; dialect shifts base pitch slightly."""

    lines = [ln.strip() for ln in script.replace(".", ".\n").split("\n") if ln.strip()]

    if not lines:

        lines = [f"{brand} — craft the story."]

    dialect_shift = {"sorani": 0.0, "badini": 8.0, "kurmanji": -6.0}.get((dialect or "").lower(), 0.0)

    samples: list[float] = []

    samples += _silence(0.25)

    for i, line in enumerate(lines[:14]):

        words = max(1, len(line.split()))

        for w, word in enumerate(line.split()[:24]):

            sec = min(0.55, max(0.12, len(word) * 0.045))

            base = (168.0 if i % 2 == 0 else 188.0) + dialect_shift + (w % 3) * 3

            samples += _formant_syllable(sec, base)

            samples += _silence(0.04)

        samples += _silence(0.16)

        _ = words

    samples += _tone(0.32, 250.0 + dialect_shift, volume=0.18, attack=0.02, release=0.18)

    samples = _normalize_to_lufs(samples, -16.0)

    return MediaFile(

        filename="voiceover.wav",

        content_type="audio/wav",

        data=_wav_bytes(samples),

        kind="audio",

    )





def make_cinema_poster_png(

    *,

    campaign: str,

    brief: str,

    cta: str,

    brand: str = "Art City",

    aspect: str = "16:9",

    filename: str = "poster.png",

) -> MediaFile:

    """Raster poster for ffmpeg MP4 mux (PIL)."""

    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont



    width, height = ASPECT_SIZES.get(aspect, ASPECT_SIZES["16:9"])

    c1, c2 = _hash_color(campaign + aspect + brief[:40])

    img = Image.new("RGB", (width, height), "#05070b")

    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    # Gradient-ish bands

    for y in range(height):

        t = y / max(1, height - 1)

        # blend ink → accent

        def hex_rgb(h: str) -> tuple[int, int, int]:

            h = h.lstrip("#")

            return int(h[0:2], 16), int(h[2:4], 16), int(h[4:6], 16)



        r1, g1, b1 = hex_rgb("#05070b")

        r2, g2, b2 = hex_rgb(c2)

        r = int(r1 * (1 - t) + r2 * t * 0.55)

        g = int(g1 * (1 - t) + g2 * t * 0.55)

        b = int(b1 * (1 - t) + b2 * t * 0.55)

        draw.line([(0, y), (width, y)], fill=(r, g, b))

    margin = int(min(width, height) * 0.06)

    draw.rectangle(

        [margin, margin, width - margin, height - margin],

        outline="#efd39a",

        width=max(2, width // 640),

    )

    try:

        font_lg = ImageFont.truetype("DejaVuSans.ttf", size=max(28, width // 28))

        font_md = ImageFont.truetype("DejaVuSans.ttf", size=max(20, width // 40))

        font_sm = ImageFont.truetype("DejaVuSans.ttf", size=max(16, width // 52))

    except OSError:

        font_lg = ImageFont.load_default()

        font_md = font_lg

        font_sm = font_lg

    draw.text((margin + 24, margin + 28), "ART CITY · CINEMA", fill="#efd39a", font=font_sm)

    draw.text((margin + 24, margin + 80), campaign[:48], fill="#f3f6fa", font=font_lg)

    draw.text((margin + 24, margin + 150), brief[:90], fill="#b7c2d1", font=font_md)

    draw.text((margin + 24, height - margin - 90), cta[:40], fill="#c5a15e", font=font_md)

    draw.text(

        (margin + 24, height - margin - 48),

        f"{brand} · {aspect} · MP4 MASTER",

        fill="#8d9aad",

        font=font_sm,

    )

    # Shot markers

    shots = 5

    for i in range(shots):

        x0 = margin + 24 + i * ((width - 2 * margin - 48) // shots)

        w = (width - 2 * margin - 48) // shots - 12

        y0 = height // 2 - 40

        fill = c1 if i % 2 == 0 else c2

        draw.rectangle([x0, y0, x0 + w, y0 + 120], fill=fill)

        draw.text((x0 + 10, y0 + 48), f"SHOT {i + 1:02d}", fill="#0a0f16", font=font_sm)

    buf = io.BytesIO()

    img.save(buf, format="PNG", optimize=True)

    return MediaFile(

        filename=filename,

        content_type="image/png",

        data=buf.getvalue(),

        kind="image",

    )





def make_cinematic_video(

    prompt: str,

    *,

    aspect: str = "16:9",

    duration_seconds: float = 15.0,

    brand: str = "Art City",

    campaign: str = "Campaign",

    cta: str = "Watch now",

) -> tuple[MediaFile, MediaFile]:

    """Cinematic advertising storyboard proxy with music/VO bed."""

    width, height = ASPECT_SIZES.get(aspect, ASPECT_SIZES["16:9"])

    c1, c2 = _hash_color(prompt + aspect + campaign)

    safe_prompt = escape(prompt[:140])

    safe_campaign = escape(campaign[:48])

    safe_brand = escape(brand[:32])

    safe_cta = escape(cta[:28])

    shots = [

        ("OPEN", "Atmospheric establish"),

        ("HOOK", "Emotion / product beat"),

        ("STORY", "Human moment"),

        ("BRAND", f"{safe_brand} lockup"),

        ("CTA", safe_cta),

    ]

    # Layout differs for portrait vs landscape

    portrait = height > width

    panels = []

    if portrait:

        for i, (label, caption) in enumerate(shots):

            y = 160 + i * ((height - 280) / len(shots))

            h = ((height - 280) / len(shots)) - 16

            fill = c1 if i % 2 == 0 else c2

            panels.append(

                f'<rect x="48" y="{y:.1f}" width="{width - 96}" height="{h:.1f}" fill="{fill}" opacity="0.88"/>'

                f'<text x="72" y="{y + 36:.1f}" fill="#0a0f16" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="28">{label}</text>'

                f'<text x="72" y="{y + 68:.1f}" fill="#0a0f16" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="18">{escape(caption)}</text>'

            )

    else:

        for i, (label, caption) in enumerate(shots):

            x = 48 + i * ((width - 80) / len(shots))

            w = ((width - 80) / len(shots)) - 14

            fill = c1 if i % 2 == 0 else c2

            panels.append(

                f'<rect x="{x:.1f}" y="{height * 0.38:.1f}" width="{w:.1f}" height="{height * 0.38:.1f}" fill="{fill}" opacity="0.88"/>'

                f'<text x="{x + 16:.1f}" y="{height * 0.38 + 42:.1f}" fill="#0a0f16" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="24">{label}</text>'

                f'<text x="{x + 16:.1f}" y="{height * 0.38 + 72:.1f}" fill="#0a0f16" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="16">{escape(caption)}</text>'

            )



    svg = f"""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{width}" height="{height}" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}">

  <defs>

    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">

      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#05070b"/>

      <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#101824"/>

      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="{c2}"/>

    </linearGradient>

  </defs>

  <rect width="{width}" height="{height}" fill="url(#bg)"/>

  <rect x="20" y="20" width="{width - 40}" height="{height - 40}" fill="none" stroke="#efd39a" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.75"/>

  <text x="48" y="70" fill="#efd39a" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="22" letter-spacing="7">ART CITY · CINEMA</text>

  <text x="48" y="118" fill="#f3f6fa" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="40">{safe_campaign}</text>

  <text x="48" y="160" fill="#b7c2d1" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="20">{safe_prompt}</text>

  {"".join(panels)}

  <text x="48" y="{height - 36}" fill="#8d9aad" font-family="monospace" font-size="15">{aspect} · {duration_seconds:.0f}s · ADVERTISING MASTER PROXY</text>

</svg>

"""

    role_name = {"16:9": "broadcast_hero", "9:16": "social_vertical", "1:1": "social_square"}.get(

        aspect, "cinema_video"

    )

    visual = MediaFile(

        filename=f"{role_name}.svg",

        content_type="image/svg+xml",

        data=svg.encode("utf-8"),

        kind="video_proxy",

    )

    # Continuous bed of exact spot length (sync gate)

    bed_samples: list[float] = []

    chord = [98.0, 147.0, 196.0, 294.0]

    filled = 0.0

    idx = 0

    while filled < duration_seconds:

        seg = min(0.75, duration_seconds - filled)

        root = chord[idx % len(chord)]

        a = _tone(seg, root, volume=0.2)

        b = _tone(seg, root * 1.5, volume=0.1)

        bed_samples += [x + y for x, y in zip(a, b)]

        filled += seg

        idx += 1

    bed_samples = _normalize_to_lufs(_exact_duration(bed_samples, duration_seconds), -16.0)

    audio = MediaFile(

        filename=f"{role_name}_audio_bed.wav",

        content_type="audio/wav",

        data=_wav_bytes(bed_samples),

        kind="audio",

    )

    return visual, audio





def make_end_card(campaign: str, cta: str, brand: str = "Art City", prompt: str = "") -> MediaFile:

    """Production end card PNG at broadcast 16:9."""

    return make_cinema_poster_png(

        campaign=campaign,

        brief=prompt or cta,

        cta=cta,

        brand=brand,

        aspect="16:9",

        filename="end_card.png",

    )





def make_brand_logo() -> MediaFile:

    svg = """<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="512" height="512" viewBox="0 0 512 512">

  <rect width="512" height="512" fill="#05070b"/>

  <rect x="48" y="48" width="416" height="416" fill="none" stroke="#efd39a" stroke-width="8"/>

  <text x="256" y="290" text-anchor="middle" fill="#efd39a" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="120" font-weight="700">AC</text>

  <text x="256" y="360" text-anchor="middle" fill="#c5a15e" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="28" letter-spacing="10">ART CITY</text>

</svg>

"""

    return MediaFile(

        filename="art_city_logo.svg",

        content_type="image/svg+xml",

        data=svg.encode("utf-8"),

        kind="image",

    )


backend/app/services/packaging.py
"""Build downloadable Art City Cinema ZIP packages (masters + manifest + report)."""



from __future__ import annotations



import io

import json

import zipfile

from typing import Any



from sqlalchemy.orm import Session



from app.models import Asset, GenerationJob

from app.services.cinema import list_cinematic_packages

from app.services.storage import get_storage





CANONICAL_NAMES = {

    "broadcast_hero": ("broadcast_hero.mp4", "broadcast_hero_audio_bed.wav"),

    "social_vertical": ("social_vertical.mp4", "social_vertical_audio_bed.wav"),

    "social_square": ("social_square.mp4", "social_square_audio_bed.wav"),

    "music_master": ("music_master.wav", None),

    "voiceover": ("voiceover.wav", None),

    "end_card": ("end_card.png", None),

}





def build_campaign_zip(db: Session, project_id: str, package_id: str) -> bytes:

    packages = list_cinematic_packages(db, project_id)

    package = next((p for p in packages if p.get("package_id") == package_id), None)

    if not package:

        raise ValueError("Cinema package not found")



    storage = get_storage()

    buf = io.BytesIO()

    with zipfile.ZipFile(buf, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:

        # Campaign manifest

        manifest = package.get("campaign_manifest") or {}

        zf.writestr(

            "CAMPAIGN_MANIFEST.json",

            json.dumps(manifest, indent=2),

        )

        # Technical validation

        validation = package.get("validation") or {}

        zf.writestr(

            "TECHNICAL_VALIDATION.json",

            json.dumps(validation, indent=2),

        )



        for d in package.get("deliverables") or []:

            role = d.get("role")

            names = CANONICAL_NAMES.get(role or "", (f"{role}.bin", None))

            job = db.get(GenerationJob, d.get("job_id"))

            if not job or not job.result_uri:

                continue

            data, ctype = storage.get_object(job.result_uri)

            out_name = names[0]

            # Keep extension honest when still shipping SVG proxy (no ffmpeg)

            if out_name.endswith(".mp4") and not (

                (ctype or "").endswith("mp4") or (len(data) > 12 and data[4:8] == b"ftyp")

            ):

                out_name = out_name.replace(".mp4", ".svg")

            zf.writestr(f"deliverables/{out_name}", data)



            # audio bed

            if names[1]:

                beds = (

                    db.query(Asset)

                    .filter(Asset.project_id == project_id, Asset.asset_type == "audio")

                    .order_by(Asset.created_at.desc())

                    .all()

                )

                linked = next(

                    (a for a in beds if (a.metadata_json or {}).get("linked_job") == job.id),

                    None,

                )

                if linked and linked.storage_path:

                    adata, _ = storage.get_object(linked.storage_path)

                    zf.writestr(f"deliverables/{names[1]}", adata)



        # Logo

        logo_assets = [

            a

            for a in db.query(Asset).filter(Asset.project_id == project_id).all()

            if (a.metadata_json or {}).get("role") == "brand_logo"

            and (a.metadata_json or {}).get("package_id") == package_id

        ]

        if logo_assets and logo_assets[0].storage_path:

            ldata, _ = storage.get_object(logo_assets[0].storage_path)

            zf.writestr("brand/art_city_logo.svg", ldata)



        readme = f"""# Art City Cinema · Delivery Package



Campaign: {package.get('campaign')}

Brand: {package.get('brand')}

Package ID: {package_id}



Contents:

- CAMPAIGN_MANIFEST.json (delivery targets, variants, timeline)

- TECHNICAL_VALIDATION.json

- deliverables/ (MP4 channel masters when muxed, stems, end card)

- brand/art_city_logo.svg



Ownership: Art City proprietary package.

"""

        zf.writestr("README.txt", readme)

        # Mix master stem

        mix_path = package.get("mix_master_path")

        if mix_path:

            try:

                mdata, _ = storage.get_object(mix_path)

                zf.writestr("deliverables/mix_master.wav", mdata)

            except Exception:

                pass

        # Timeline finishing doc

        timeline = package.get("timeline") or (package.get("campaign_manifest") or {}).get("timeline")

        if timeline:

            zf.writestr("TIMELINE.json", json.dumps(timeline, indent=2))



    return buf.getvalue()


backend/app/services/providers.py
"""Art City provider adapters — full production generation via Model Gateway."""



from __future__ import annotations



from abc import ABC, abstractmethod

from dataclasses import dataclass

from typing import Optional

from uuid import uuid4



from app.core.config import get_settings

from app.core.enums import GenerationStatus





@dataclass

class ProviderResult:

    provider_job_id: str

    status: GenerationStatus

    result_uri: Optional[str] = None

    error_message: Optional[str] = None

    actual_cost: Optional[float] = None

    output_bytes: Optional[bytes] = None

    content_type: Optional[str] = None

    filename: Optional[str] = None

    sidecar_bytes: Optional[bytes] = None

    sidecar_content_type: Optional[str] = None

    sidecar_filename: Optional[str] = None





class ProviderAdapter(ABC):

    name: str



    def submit_generation(

        self, prompt: str, modality: str, model: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs

    ) -> ProviderResult:

        return self.submit(prompt, modality, model, **kwargs)



    def get_status(self, provider_job_id: str) -> ProviderResult:

        return self.status(provider_job_id)



    def get_result(self, provider_job_id: str) -> ProviderResult:

        return self.result(provider_job_id)



    def cancel_generation(self, provider_job_id: str) -> ProviderResult:

        return self.cancel(provider_job_id)



    def download_output(self, provider_job_id: str) -> ProviderResult:

        return self.result(provider_job_id)



    def health_check(self) -> bool:

        return True



    @abstractmethod

    def submit(self, prompt: str, modality: str, model: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs) -> ProviderResult:

        raise NotImplementedError



    @abstractmethod

    def status(self, provider_job_id: str) -> ProviderResult:

        raise NotImplementedError



    @abstractmethod

    def result(self, provider_job_id: str) -> ProviderResult:

        raise NotImplementedError



    @abstractmethod

    def cancel(self, provider_job_id: str) -> ProviderResult:

        raise NotImplementedError



    @abstractmethod

    def estimate_cost(self, prompt: str, modality: str) -> float:

        raise NotImplementedError





def _ok(

    job_id: str,

    *,

    data: bytes,

    content_type: str,

    filename: str,

    cost: float,

    sidecar: tuple[bytes, str, str] | None = None,

) -> ProviderResult:

    return ProviderResult(

        provider_job_id=job_id,

        status=GenerationStatus.SUCCEEDED,

        result_uri=f"inline://{job_id}",

        actual_cost=cost,

        output_bytes=data,

        content_type=content_type,

        filename=filename,

        sidecar_bytes=sidecar[0] if sidecar else None,

        sidecar_content_type=sidecar[1] if sidecar else None,

        sidecar_filename=sidecar[2] if sidecar else None,

    )





def _try_external(modality: str, prompt: str, **kwargs) -> Optional[ProviderResult]:

    from app.services.external_gen import generate_external



    duration = float(kwargs.get("duration_seconds") or 4.0)

    aspect = str(kwargs.get("aspect") or "16:9")

    script = str(kwargs.get("script") or prompt)

    ext = generate_external(

        modality=modality,

        prompt=script if modality == "voice" else prompt,

        duration_seconds=duration,

        aspect=aspect,

    )

    if not ext:

        return None

    job_id = f"ext-{ext.provider}-{uuid4()}"

    return _ok(

        job_id,

        data=ext.data,

        content_type=ext.content_type,

        filename=ext.filename,

        cost=ext.cost,

    )





def _local_image(prompt: str, **kwargs) -> ProviderResult:

    from app.services import media_factory



    job_id = f"ac-img-{uuid4()}"

    title = kwargs.get("character_name") or kwargs.get("character_key") or "Art City"

    aspect = str(kwargs.get("aspect") or "16:9")

    if kwargs.get("end_card"):

        media = media_factory.make_end_card(

            str(kwargs.get("campaign") or title),

            str(kwargs.get("cta") or "Discover more"),

            brand=str(kwargs.get("brand") or "Art City"),

            prompt=prompt,

        )

    else:

        media = media_factory.make_image(prompt, title=str(title), aspect=aspect)

    return _ok(

        job_id,

        data=media.data,

        content_type=media.content_type,

        filename=media.filename,

        cost=0.02,

    )





def _local_video(prompt: str, **kwargs) -> ProviderResult:

    from app.services import media_factory

    from app.services.video_mux import mux_frames_with_audio, mux_still_with_audio



    job_id = f"ac-vid-{uuid4()}"

    duration = float(kwargs.get("duration_seconds") or 4.0)

    title = kwargs.get("character_name") or kwargs.get("character_key") or "Art City"

    aspect = str(kwargs.get("aspect") or "16:9")

    brand = str(kwargs.get("brand") or "Art City")

    campaign = str(kwargs.get("campaign") or title)

    cta = str(kwargs.get("cta") or "Art City Studios")

    width, height = media_factory.ASPECT_SIZES.get(aspect, media_factory.ASPECT_SIZES["16:9"])



    # Timed audio bed

    _, bed = media_factory.make_cinematic_video(

        prompt,

        aspect=aspect,

        duration_seconds=duration,

        brand=brand,

        campaign=campaign,

        cta=cta,

    )

    frames = media_factory.make_shot_frames(

        campaign=campaign,

        brief=prompt,

        cta=cta,

        brand=brand,

        aspect=aspect,

        shot_count=5 if duration >= 6 or kwargs.get("advertising") else 3,

    )

    mp4 = mux_frames_with_audio(

        frames_png=frames,

        audio_wav=bed.data,

        duration_seconds=duration,

        filename=f"video-{uuid4().hex[:10]}.mp4",

        width=width,

        height=height,

    )

    if not mp4:

        mp4 = mux_still_with_audio(

            poster_png=frames[0],

            audio_wav=bed.data,

            duration_seconds=duration,

            filename=f"video-{uuid4().hex[:10]}.mp4",

            width=width,

            height=height,

        )

    if mp4:

        primary = mp4

    else:

        # Last resort: PNG storyboard still (hosts without ffmpeg)

        primary = media_factory.make_cinema_poster_png(

            campaign=campaign,

            brief=prompt,

            cta=cta,

            brand=brand,

            aspect=aspect,

            filename=f"video-{uuid4().hex[:10]}.png",

        )

    return _ok(

        job_id,

        data=primary.data,

        content_type=primary.content_type,

        filename=primary.filename,

        cost=0.12,

        sidecar=(bed.data, bed.content_type, bed.filename),

    )





def _local_voice(prompt: str, **kwargs) -> ProviderResult:

    from app.services import media_factory

    from app.services.audio_mix import optional_external_tts



    job_id = f"ac-vo-{uuid4()}"

    brand = str(kwargs.get("brand") or kwargs.get("character_name") or "Art City")

    script = str(kwargs.get("script") or prompt)

    dialect = kwargs.get("dialect")

    dialogue = kwargs.get("dialogue_lines") or []

    if dialogue:

        media = media_factory.make_voice_conversation(prompt, list(dialogue))

    else:

        external = optional_external_tts(script, brand=brand)

        if external:

            media = media_factory.MediaFile(

                filename="voiceover.wav",

                content_type="audio/wav",

                data=external,

                kind="audio",

            )

        else:

            media = media_factory.make_ad_voiceover(

                script, brand=brand, dialect=str(dialect) if dialect else None

            )

    return _ok(

        job_id,

        data=media.data,

        content_type=media.content_type,

        filename=media.filename,

        cost=0.05,

    )





def _local_music(prompt: str, **kwargs) -> ProviderResult:

    from app.services import media_factory



    job_id = f"ac-mus-{uuid4()}"

    style = str(kwargs.get("music_style") or "epic")

    media = media_factory.make_cinematic_music(prompt, duration_seconds=max(duration, 5.0), style=style)

    return _ok(

        job_id,

def _local_audio(prompt: str, **kwargs) -> ProviderResult:

    return _ok(

    )





def produce(modality: str, prompt: str, model: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs) -> ProviderResult:

    """Full production path: external keys when present, else Art City masters."""

    settings = get_settings()

    prefer_cloud = bool(kwargs.pop("prefer_external", False) or settings.external_providers_enabled)

    if prefer_cloud and modality in {"image", "video", "voice", "music", "audio"}:

        # Skip cloud for end cards — brand lockup stays Art City owned

        if not kwargs.get("end_card"):

            ext = _try_external(modality, prompt, **kwargs)

            if ext:

                return ext

    locals_ = {

        "image": _local_image,

        "video": _local_video,

        "voice": _local_voice,

        "music": _local_music,

        "audio": _local_audio,

    }

    fn = locals_.get(modality)

    if not fn:

        return ProviderResult(

            provider_job_id=f"ac-miss-{uuid4()}",

            status=GenerationStatus.FAILED,

            error_message=f"Unsupported modality {modality}",

        )

    return fn(prompt, **kwargs)





class StubProvider(ProviderAdapter):

    """Legacy name — still emits real production media bytes (never empty URIs)."""



    name = "stub"



    def submit(self, prompt: str, modality: str, model: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs) -> ProviderResult:

        return produce(modality, prompt, model, **kwargs)



    def status(self, provider_job_id: str) -> ProviderResult:

        return ProviderResult(provider_job_id=provider_job_id, status=GenerationStatus.SUCCEEDED)



    def result(self, provider_job_id: str) -> ProviderResult:

        return self.status(provider_job_id)



    def cancel(self, provider_job_id: str) -> ProviderResult:

        return ProviderResult(provider_job_id=provider_job_id, status=GenerationStatus.CANCELLED)



    def estimate_cost(self, prompt: str, modality: str) -> float:

        base = {"image": 0.02, "video": 0.25, "voice": 0.05, "audio": 0.03, "music": 0.08}

        return base.get(modality, 0.01)

class ExternalFallbackProvider(ProviderAdapter):

    """Cloud-first generation when keys are set; Art City masters otherwise."""



    name = "external-fallback"



    def submit(self, prompt: str, modality: str, model: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs) -> ProviderResult:

        settings = get_settings()

        if not settings.external_providers_enabled:

            return produce(modality, prompt, model, prefer_external=False, **kwargs)

        return produce(modality, prompt, model, prefer_external=True, **kwargs)



    def status(self, provider_job_id: str) -> ProviderResult:

        return ProviderResult(provider_job_id=provider_job_id, status=GenerationStatus.SUCCEEDED)



    def result(self, provider_job_id: str) -> ProviderResult:

        return self.status(provider_job_id)



    def cancel(self, provider_job_id: str) -> ProviderResult:

        return ProviderResult(provider_job_id=provider_job_id, status=GenerationStatus.CANCELLED)



    def estimate_cost(self, prompt: str, modality: str) -> float:

        return StubProvider().estimate_cost(prompt, modality) * 1.5



    def health_check(self) -> bool:

        from app.services.external_gen import external_available



        settings = get_settings()

        if not settings.external_providers_enabled:

            return True

        return any(external_available(m) for m in ("image", "video", "voice", "music")) or True





PROVIDERS: dict[str, type[ProviderAdapter]] = {

    "stub": StubProvider,

    "artcity-image": ArtCityImageProvider,

    "artcity-video": ArtCityVideoProvider,

    "artcity-voice": ArtCityVoiceProvider,

    "artcity-music": ArtCityMusicProvider,

    "artcity-audio": ArtCityAudioProvider,

    "artcity-asr": ArtCityAsrProvider,

    "external-fallback": ExternalFallbackProvider,

}





def get_provider(name: str = "stub") -> ProviderAdapter:

    cls = PROVIDERS.get(name) or StubProvider

    return cls()





def list_providers() -> list[dict]:

    out = []

    for name, cls in PROVIDERS.items():

        adapter = cls()

        out.append({"name": name, "healthy": adapter.health_check()})

    return out


backend/app/services/publishing.py
"""World-class delivery publishing: approve → package → export masters + checklist."""



from __future__ import annotations



import hashlib

import json

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from typing import Any, Optional

from uuid import uuid4



from sqlalchemy.orm import Session



from app.core.enums import AssetType, PublicationStatus

from app.models import Asset, GenerationJob, Review

from app.services.cinema import list_cinematic_packages

from app.services.storage import get_storage





REQUIRED_ROLES = (

    ("broadcast_hero", "Master 16:9 broadcast"),

    ("social_vertical", "Master 9:16 vertical"),

    ("social_square", "Master 1:1 square"),

    ("music_master", "Music stem"),

    ("voiceover", "Voiceover stem"),

    ("end_card", "End card / poster"),

)





def _slug(text: str) -> str:

    cleaned = "".join(ch if ch.isalnum() else "-" for ch in text.strip().lower())

    while "--" in cleaned:

        cleaned = cleaned.replace("--", "-")

    return cleaned.strip("-")[:48] or "campaign"





def _checksum(data: bytes) -> str:

    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()





def _get_package(db: Session, project_id: str, package_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:

    for pkg in list_cinematic_packages(db, project_id):

        if pkg.get("package_id") == package_id:

            return pkg

    raise ValueError("Cinema package not found")





def _deliverable_map(package: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:

    out: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

    for d in package.get("deliverables") or []:

        role = d.get("role")

        if role:

            out[role] = d

    return out





def _approval_state(db: Session, job_id: Optional[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:

    if not job_id:

        return {"approved": False, "reviews": 0}

    reviews = (

        db.query(Review)

        .filter(Review.generation_job_id == job_id)

        .order_by(Review.created_at.desc())

        .all()

    )

    approved = any(r.decision == "approve" for r in reviews)

    return {"approved": approved, "reviews": len(reviews), "latest": reviews[0].decision if reviews else None}





def create_publication(

    db: Session,

    *,

    project_id: str,

    cinema_package_id: str,

    channel: str = "art_city_channel",

    auto_approve_missing: bool = True,

    publisher_note: Optional[str] = None,

) -> dict[str, Any]:

    """

    Build a delivery publication from a cinema package:

    - verify masters exist in storage

    - copy into delivery tree

    - write checksummed MASTER_MANIFEST.json

    - produce delivery checklist

    """

    storage = get_storage()

    package = _get_package(db, project_id, cinema_package_id)

    roles = _deliverable_map(package)

    publication_id = str(uuid4())

    campaign = package.get("campaign") or "Untitled"

    slug = _slug(campaign)

    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

    root = f"projects/{project_id}/publications/{publication_id}"



    checklist: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    masters: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    all_ok = True



    # Optional auto-approve so publishing can proceed in local MVP

    if auto_approve_missing:

        for role, _label in REQUIRED_ROLES:

            d = roles.get(role)

            if not d:

                continue

            job_id = d.get("job_id")

            state = _approval_state(db, job_id)

            if not state["approved"] and job_id:

                db.add(

                    Review(

                        generation_job_id=job_id,

                        decision="approve",

                        notes="Auto-approved for Art City delivery publish",

                        quality_score=9.0,

                    )

                )

        db.flush()



    for role, label in REQUIRED_ROLES:

        item: dict[str, Any] = {

            "id": role,

            "label": label,

            "required": True,

            "status": "missing",

            "detail": None,

        }

        d = roles.get(role)

        if not d:

            item["status"] = "failed"

            item["detail"] = "Deliverable missing from cinema package"

            all_ok = False

            checklist.append(item)

            continue



        job = db.get(GenerationJob, d["job_id"])

        if not job or not job.result_uri:

            item["status"] = "failed"

            item["detail"] = "Master media missing"

            all_ok = False

            checklist.append(item)

            continue



        approval = _approval_state(db, job.id)

        if not approval["approved"]:

            item["status"] = "blocked"
