""".strip()



VOICEOVER = """

Some friendships rewrite the map of home.

Kardokh. Kurdiya.

A new season of wonder — only on Art City Channel.

Watch the story.

""".strip()





def main() -> int:

    db = SessionLocal()

    try:

        project = (

            db.query(Project)

            .filter(Project.name.ilike("%Kardokh%"))

            .order_by(Project.created_at.desc())

            .first()

        )

        if not project:

            project = Project(

                name="Art City Channel · Kardokh & Kurdiya",

                description="Official Art City brand production project",

            )

            db.add(project)

            db.commit()

            db.refresh(project)



        package = build_cinematic_package(

            db,

            project_id=project.id,

            campaign="Kardokh & Kurdiya · Season of Homecoming",

            brief=ART_CITY_BRIEF,

            cta="Watch on Art City Channel",

            brand="Art City",

            voiceover_script=VOICEOVER,

            music_style="warm",

            duration_seconds=15,

            initiated_by="art-city-producer",

            brand_colors={

                "ink": "#05070b",

                "gold": "#c5a15e",

                "gold_bright": "#efd39a",

                "teal": "#3aa39c",

                "paper": "#f3f6fa",

            },

            usage_rights="Art City Channel — proprietary broadcast and social advertising rights",

        )



        passed = package.get("validation_passed")

        print("project_id:", project.id)

        print("package_id:", package["package_id"])

        print("validation_passed:", passed)

        print("total_cost:", package.get("total_cost"))

        print("production_time_seconds:", package.get("production_time_seconds"))



        validation = package.get("validation") or {}

        for d in validation.get("deliverables", []):

            status = "PASS" if d.get("passed") else "FAIL"

            print(f"  [{status}] {d.get('role')}")

            for c in d.get("checks", []):

                if not c.get("passed"):

                    print(f"      - FAIL {c.get('id')}: expected={c.get('expected')} actual={c.get('actual')}")



        completeness = validation.get("completeness") or {}

        print("completeness:", completeness.get("passed"), completeness.get("detail"))



        zip_bytes = build_campaign_zip(db, project.id, package["package_id"])

        out = ROOT / "demo_output" / f"art-city-cinema-{package['package_id'][:8]}.zip"

        out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        out.write_bytes(zip_bytes)

        print("zip_bytes:", len(zip_bytes))

        print("zip_path:", out)



        manifest_path = ROOT / "demo_output" / f"CAMPAIGN_MANIFEST-{package['package_id'][:8]}.json"

        manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(package.get("campaign_manifest"), indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

        print("manifest_path:", manifest_path)



        return 0 if passed else 2

    finally:

        db.close()





if __name__ == "__main__":

    raise SystemExit(main())


backend/scripts/e2e_200.py
"""Art City production E2E — every critical path must be HTTP 200/201."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys
import wave
from io import BytesIO
from typing import Any

import httpx

BASE = os.environ.get("ARTCITY_API_URL", "https://backend-production-9533.up.railway.app").rstrip("/")
APP = os.environ.get("ARTCITY_APP_URL", "https://frontend-production-6380.up.railway.app").rstrip("/")
EMAIL = os.environ.get("ARTCITY_ADMIN_EMAIL", "admin@artcity.ai")
PASSWORD = os.environ.get("ARTCITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD", "ArtCityAdmin!2026")


def _wav(duration: float = 1.0, rate: int = 16000) -> bytes:
    frames = max(1, int(rate * duration))
    buf = BytesIO()
    with wave.open(buf, "wb") as wf:
        wf.setnchannels(1)
        wf.setsampwidth(2)
        wf.setframerate(rate)
        wf.writeframes(b"\x00\x00" * frames)
    return buf.getvalue()


def main() -> int:
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    def ok(name: str, code: int, detail: str = "") -> None:
        passed = code in {200, 201}
        rows.append({"name": name, "code": code, "pass": passed, "detail": detail[:200]})
        mark = "OK" if passed else "FAIL"
        print(f"{mark}  {name}  {code}  {detail[:100]}")

    def assert_true(name: str, cond: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
        rows.append({"name": name, "code": 200 if cond else 0, "pass": cond, "detail": detail[:200]})
        mark = "OK" if cond else "FAIL"
        print(f"{mark}  {name}  {'200' if cond else '0'}  {detail[:100]}")

    client = httpx.Client(base_url=BASE, timeout=180.0)

    # Public API
    for path in ("/", "/health", "/docs", "/openapi.json", "/redoc"):
        r = client.get(path)
        ok(f"API GET {path}", r.status_code)

    # Frontend pages
    app = httpx.Client(base_url=APP, timeout=60.0, follow_redirects=True)
    for path in (
        "/",
        "/login",
        "/dashboard",
        "/advertising",
        "/cinema",
        "/studio",
        "/studio/bank-building",
        "/data-bank",
        "/edit",
        "/edit/apply",
        "/edit/admin",
        "/edit/admin/applications",
        "/publish",
        "/speech",
        "/knowledge",
        "/projects",
    ):
        r = app.get(path)
        ok(f"UI GET {path}", r.status_code)
        if path == "/dashboard" and r.status_code == 200:
            body = r.text
            assert_true(
                "dashboard shows Edit",
                'href="/edit"' in body or "Art City Edit" in body or ">Edit<" in body,
            )
            assert_true(
                "dashboard shows Data Bank",
                'href="/data-bank"' in body or "Data Bank" in body,
            )

    # Auth — JSON login + OAuth2 token (Swagger)
    login = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": EMAIL, "password": PASSWORD})
    ok("POST /api/auth/login", login.status_code)
    if login.status_code != 200:
        print(json.dumps({"all_green": False, "fail": len(rows)}, indent=2))
        return 1
    token = login.json()["access_token"]
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}

    oauth = client.post(
        "/api/auth/token",
        data={"username": EMAIL, "password": PASSWORD},
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"},
    )
    ok("POST /api/auth/token", oauth.status_code)

    me = client.get("/api/auth/me", headers=headers)
    ok("GET /api/auth/me", me.status_code)
    assert_true("admin is_active", bool(me.json().get("is_active")), me.text[:80])

    # Project
    proj = client.post(
        "/api/projects",
        headers=headers,
        json={"name": "E2E 200 Full Prod", "description": "green suite"},
    )
    ok("POST /api/projects", proj.status_code)
    project_id = proj.json()["id"]

    # Studio modalities
    for modality in ("image", "video", "voice", "audio", "music"):
        r = client.post(
            f"/api/projects/{project_id}/studio/generate",
            headers=headers,
            json={
                "modality": modality,
                "prompt": f"E2E {modality} Kardokh Newroz",
                "duration_seconds": 5,
                "dialect": "sorani",
                "character_key": "kardokh",
                "character_name": "Kardokh",
                "run_asr": modality == "voice",
            },
        )
        ok(f"studio/{modality}", r.status_code)
        if r.status_code in {200, 201}:
            media = r.json().get("media_url")
            if media:
                mr = client.get(media)
                ok(f"studio/{modality}/media", mr.status_code)
                ctype = mr.headers.get("content-type", "")
                if modality == "video":
                    assert_true("studio/video is mp4", "mp4" in ctype or mr.content[4:8] == b"ftyp", ctype)
                if modality == "image":
                    assert_true(
                        "studio/image is png or jpeg",
                        "png" in ctype or "jpeg" in ctype or "jpg" in ctype or "svg" in ctype,
                        ctype,
                    )
                if modality in {"voice", "music", "audio"}:
                    assert_true(
                        f"studio/{modality} is audio",
                        "audio" in ctype or "wav" in ctype or "mpeg" in ctype,
                        ctype,
                    )

    # Gateway
    for path in (
        "/api/v1/ai/images/generate",
        "/api/v1/ai/videos/generate",
        "/api/v1/ai/voices/generate",
        "/api/v1/ai/audio/generate",
        "/api/v1/ai/music/generate",
    ):
        r = client.post(
            path,
            headers=headers,
            json={
                "project_id": project_id,
                "prompt": f"E2E gateway {path}",
                "duration_seconds": 4,
                "dialect": "sorani",
                "character_key": "kurdiya",
            },
        )
        ok(f"gateway {path}", r.status_code)

    # Cinema full production package
    cinema = client.post(
        f"/api/projects/{project_id}/cinema/packages",
        headers=headers,
        json={
            "campaign": "E2E Full Prod Ad",
            "brief": "Kardokh Kurdiya Newroz advertising production masters",
            "cta": "Watch the story",
            "duration_seconds": 12,
            "dialect": "sorani",
            "character_key": "kardokh",
            "character_name": "Kardokh",
            "channels": ["broadcast", "social_vertical", "social_square"],
            "variants": ["A", "B"],
            "delivery_targets": ["youtube", "meta_stories", "broadcast_tv"],
            "music_style": "epic",
        },
    )
    ok("cinema package", cinema.status_code)
    package_id = cinema.json().get("package_id") if cinema.status_code in {200, 201} else None
    if package_id:
        body = cinema.json()
        assert_true("cinema QC passed", bool(body.get("validation_passed")), str(body.get("validation"))[:120])
        assert_true("cinema has variants", len(body.get("variants") or []) >= 2, str(len(body.get("variants") or [])))
        assert_true(
            "cinema has delivery targets",
            len(body.get("delivery_targets") or []) >= 2,
            str(len(body.get("delivery_targets") or [])),
        )
        assert_true(
            "cinema has timeline",
            bool((body.get("timeline") or {}).get("clips")),
            str(body.get("timeline"))[:80],
        )
        videos = [d for d in (body.get("deliverables") or []) if d.get("modality") == "video"]
        assert_true("cinema has video cutdowns", len(videos) >= 3, str(len(videos)))
        if videos:
            media = videos[0].get("mp4_url") or videos[0].get("media_url")
            if media:
                mr = client.get(media, headers=headers)
                ok("cinema video media", mr.status_code)
                ctype = mr.headers.get("content-type", "")
                assert_true("cinema master is mp4", "mp4" in ctype or mr.content[4:8] == b"ftyp", ctype)

        tl = client.patch(
            f"/api/projects/{project_id}/cinema/packages/{package_id}/timeline",
            headers=headers,
            json={"music_gain_db": -1.5, "voice_gain_db": 1.0, "duck_music_under_vo": True},
        )
        ok("cinema timeline patch", tl.status_code)

        zip_r = client.get(
            f"/api/projects/{project_id}/cinema/packages/{package_id}/zip",
            headers=headers,
        )
        ok("cinema zip", zip_r.status_code)
        assert_true("cinema zip non-empty", len(zip_r.content) > 1000, str(len(zip_r.content)))

        man = client.get(
            f"/api/projects/{project_id}/cinema/packages/{package_id}/manifest",
            headers=headers,
        )
        ok("cinema manifest", man.status_code)

        pub = client.post(
            f"/api/projects/{project_id}/publications",
            headers=headers,
            json={"cinema_package_id": package_id, "channel": "art_city_channel"},
        )
        ok("publication create", pub.status_code)
        if pub.status_code in {200, 201}:
            pub_id = pub.json()["publication_id"]
            rel = client.post(
                f"/api/projects/{project_id}/publications/{pub_id}/publish",
                headers=headers,
            )
            ok("publication publish", rel.status_code)

    # Speech / ASR — always 200 (including missing key)
    dialects = client.get("/api/v1/ai/speech/dialects", headers=headers)
    ok("speech dialects", dialects.status_code)
    detect = client.post(
        "/api/v1/ai/speech/detect",
        headers=headers,
        json={"text": "Silav Newroz Zagros"},
    )
    ok("speech detect", detect.status_code)

    for dialect in ("sorani", "badini", "kurmanji"):
        up = client.post(
            "/api/v1/ai/speech/upload",
            headers=headers,
            files={"file": (f"e2e-{dialect}.wav", _wav(1.0), "audio/wav")},
            data={"project_id": project_id},
        )
        ok(f"speech upload {dialect}", up.status_code)
        key = up.json().get("audio_storage_key") if up.status_code in {200, 201} else f"e2e/{dialect}.wav"
        asr = client.post(
            "/api/v1/ai/speech/asr",
            headers=headers,
            json={"audio_storage_key": key, "dialect": dialect, "project_id": project_id},
        )
        ok(f"speech asr {dialect}", asr.status_code)
        if asr.status_code in {200, 201} and asr.json().get("job_id"):
            jid = asr.json()["job_id"]
            ok(f"speech job {dialect}", client.get(f"/api/v1/ai/speech/jobs/{jid}", headers=headers).status_code)

    missing = client.post(
        "/api/v1/ai/speech/asr",
        headers=headers,
        json={"audio_storage_key": "e2e/does-not-exist.wav", "dialect": "sorani"},
    )
    ok("speech asr missing-key", missing.status_code)

    kb = client.get("/api/knowledge/cultural-pack", headers=headers)
    ok("knowledge cultural-pack", kb.status_code)

    providers = client.get("/api/v1/ai/providers", headers=headers)
    ok("providers", providers.status_code)

    models = client.get("/api/v1/ai/models", headers=headers)
    ok("models registry", models.status_code)
    if models.status_code == 200:
        names = {m.get("name") for m in models.json()}
        assert_true(
            "lora models seeded",
            any("LORA" in (n or "").upper() or "KARDOKH" in (n or "").upper() for n in names),
            str(sorted(names)[:8]),
        )

    # Art City Edit
    edit_summary = client.get("/api/edit/summary", headers=headers)
    ok("GET /api/edit/summary", edit_summary.status_code)
    edit_plans = client.get("/api/edit/plans", headers=headers)
    ok("GET /api/edit/plans", edit_plans.status_code)
    edit_seed = client.post("/api/edit/seed/internal", headers=headers)
    ok("POST /api/edit/seed/internal", edit_seed.status_code)
    edit_ws = client.get("/api/edit/workspaces", headers=headers)
    ok("GET /api/edit/workspaces", edit_ws.status_code)
    if edit_seed.status_code in {200, 201}:
        wid = edit_seed.json()["id"]
        up = client.post(
            f"/api/edit/workspaces/{wid}/assets",
            headers=headers,
            files={"file": ("e2e_edit.txt", b"Art City Edit e2e source", "text/plain")},
            data={"rights_attested": "true", "rights_notes": "e2e"},
        )
        ok("POST /api/edit/workspaces/{id}/assets", up.status_code)
        if up.status_code in {200, 201}:
            proj_e = client.post(
                f"/api/edit/workspaces/{wid}/projects",
                headers=headers,
                json={"title": "E2E Edit", "source_asset_id": up.json()["id"]},
            )
            ok("POST /api/edit/workspaces/{id}/projects", proj_e.status_code)
            if proj_e.status_code in {200, 201}:
                eid = proj_e.json()["id"]
                ok(
                    "GET /api/edit/projects/{id}",
                    client.get(f"/api/edit/projects/{eid}", headers=headers).status_code,
                )
                ok(
                    "POST /api/edit/projects/{id}/analyse",
                    client.post(f"/api/edit/projects/{eid}/analyse", headers=headers).status_code,
                )

    # Project Data Bank + bank-building image
    db_seed = client.post("/api/data-bank/seed", headers=headers)
    ok("POST /api/data-bank/seed", db_seed.status_code)
    ok("GET /api/data-bank", client.get("/api/data-bank", headers=headers).status_code)
    bank_pid = None
    if db_seed.status_code in {200, 201}:
        bank_pid = (db_seed.json().get("project") or {}).get("id")
        assert_true("data-bank seed succeeded job", db_seed.json().get("seed_status") == "succeeded")
    if bank_pid:
        ok(
            "GET /api/projects/{id}/data-bank/summary",
            client.get(f"/api/projects/{bank_pid}/data-bank/summary", headers=headers).status_code,
        )
        bank_list = client.get(f"/api/projects/{bank_pid}/data-bank", headers=headers)
        ok("GET /api/projects/{id}/data-bank", bank_list.status_code)
        assert_true("data-bank has assets", isinstance(bank_list.json(), list) and len(bank_list.json()) >= 1)
        ok(
            "POST /api/projects/{id}/data-bank/sync",
            client.post(f"/api/projects/{bank_pid}/data-bank/sync", headers=headers).status_code,
        )
        up_bank = client.post(
            f"/api/projects/{bank_pid}/data-bank/upload",
            headers=headers,
            files={"file": ("e2e-bank.txt", b"E2E Data Bank brief", "text/plain")},
            data={"name": "E2E bank brief", "tags": "e2e,data-bank"},
        )
        ok("POST /api/projects/{id}/data-bank/upload", up_bank.status_code)
        ok(
            f"UI GET /projects/{bank_pid}/data-bank",
            app.get(f"/projects/{bank_pid}/data-bank").status_code,
        )

    bb = client.post(
        "/api/studio/bank-building/generate",
        headers=headers,
        json={"notes": "e2e night plaza", "prefer_external": True},
    )
    ok("POST /api/studio/bank-building/generate", bb.status_code)
    if bb.status_code in {200, 201}:
        media = bb.json().get("media_url")
        if media:
            mr = client.get(media)
            ok("bank-building/media", mr.status_code)
            assert_true(
                "bank-building is image",
                "image/" in (mr.headers.get("content-type") or "").lower()
                or mr.content[:8].startswith(b"\x89PNG")
                or mr.content[:3] == b"\xff\xd8\xff",
                mr.headers.get("content-type", ""),
            )

    failed = [r for r in rows if not r["pass"]]
    out = {
        "api": BASE,
        "app": APP,
        "total": len(rows),
        "pass": len(rows) - len(failed),
        "fail": len(failed),
        "all_green": len(failed) == 0,
        "failed": failed,
    }
    print(json.dumps({k: out[k] for k in ("api", "app", "total", "pass", "fail", "all_green")}, indent=2))
    if failed:
        print("FAILURES:")
        for f in failed:
            print(f"  {f['name']} -> {f['code']} {f.get('detail')}")
    path = os.environ.get("E2E_OUT", "e2e_200_report.json")
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(out, fh, indent=2)
    print("wrote", path)
    return 0 if out["all_green"] else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

backend/scripts/export_source_pdf.py
"""Export Art City AI Studio first-party source into an HTML + PDF report."""



from __future__ import annotations



import html

import subprocess

import sys

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from pathlib import Path



ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

HTML_OUT = ROOT / "Art-City-AI-Studio-Full-Source-Code-Report.html"

PDF_OUT = ROOT / "Art-City-AI-Studio-Full-Source-Code-Report.pdf"



SKIP_DIRS = {

    ".git",

    ".next",

    ".venv",

    "venv",

    "node_modules",

    "__pycache__",

    ".pytest_cache",

    "dist",

    "build",

    "coverage",

    ".cursor",

    "agent-transcripts",

    "terminals",

}

SKIP_NAMES = {

    "package-lock.json",

    "pnpm-lock.yaml",

    "yarn.lock",

    ".env",

    ".env.local",

    "live_products_200_report.json",

    "smoke_200_report.json",

}

SKIP_SUFFIXES = {

    ".pdf",

    ".docx",

    ".png",

    ".jpg",

    ".jpeg",

    ".gif",

    ".webp",

    ".mp4",

    ".zip",

    ".woff",

    ".woff2",

    ".ico",

    ".bin",

    ".pt",

    ".safetensors",

    ".pkl",

}

INCLUDE_SUFFIXES = {

    ".py",

    ".ts",

    ".tsx",

    ".js",

    ".jsx",

    ".css",

    ".json",

    ".md",

    ".toml",

    ".yml",

    ".yaml",

    ".ini",

    ".txt",

    ".sql",

    ".bat",

    ".ps1",

    ".sh",

    ".css",

}

INCLUDE_NAMES = {

    "Dockerfile",

    "docker-compose.yml",

    "railway.toml",

    ".gitignore",

    "AGENTS.md",

    "README.md",

}

MAX_BYTES = 400_000





def collect_files() -> list[Path]:

    files: list[Path] = []

    for path in ROOT.rglob("*"):

        if not path.is_file():

            continue

        if any(part in SKIP_DIRS for part in path.parts):

            continue

        if path.name in SKIP_NAMES or path.name.startswith(".env"):

            continue

        if path.suffix.lower() in SKIP_SUFFIXES:

            continue

        if path.name not in INCLUDE_NAMES and path.suffix.lower() not in INCLUDE_SUFFIXES:

            continue

        if path.stat().st_size > MAX_BYTES:

            continue

        files.append(path)

    return sorted(files, key=lambda p: str(p.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/").lower())





def rel(path: Path) -> str:

    return str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/")





def read_text(path: Path) -> str:

    raw = path.read_bytes()

    for enc in ("utf-8", "utf-8-sig", "cp1252"):

        try:

            return raw.decode(enc)

        except UnicodeDecodeError:

            continue

    return raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")





def section_files(files: list[Path], prefix: str) -> list[Path]:

    return [p for p in files if rel(p).startswith(prefix)]





def main() -> int:

    files = collect_files()

    backend = section_files(files, "backend/")

    frontend = section_files(files, "frontend/")

    docs = section_files(files, "docs/")

    other = [p for p in files if p not in backend and p not in frontend and p not in docs]

    generated = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC")



    parts: list[str] = []

    parts.append(

        """<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"/>

<title>Art City AI Studio — Full Source Code Report</title>

<style>

  @page { size: A4; margin: 16mm 14mm; }

  body { font-family: Calibri, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: #111; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.45; }

  h1 { font-size: 26px; margin: 0 0 8px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }

  h2 { font-size: 16px; margin: 28px 0 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #c5a15e; padding-bottom: 4px; color: #3a2e16; }

  h3 { font-size: 13px; margin: 18px 0 6px; color: #222; }

  .gold { color: #8a6a2a; }

  table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; margin: 8px 0 16px; }

  th, td { border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 5px 7px; text-align: left; vertical-align: top; }

  th { background: #f6f1e6; }

  .cover { margin-bottom: 28px; }

  .muted { color: #555; }

  ul.toc { columns: 2; column-gap: 24px; }

  pre { background: #f7f7f5; border: 1px solid #e4e0d6; padding: 8px; font-size: 8.2px; line-height: 1.35;

        white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; font-family: Consolas, "Courier New", monospace; }

  .file { page-break-inside: avoid; }

  .file h3 { font-family: Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11px; }

</style></head><body>

"""

    )

    parts.append(

        f"""<div class="cover">

<h1>ART CITY AI STUDIO</h1>

<p class="gold"><strong>Full source code report — backend and frontend</strong></p>

<p>Private Art City product. Cinema · Studio · Vertical Drama · Edit · Hub · Publish.</p>

<p class="muted">Generated: {html.escape(generated)}<br/>

Workspace: {html.escape(str(ROOT))}<br/>

Files in this export: {len(files)} (excludes node_modules, venv, .git, secrets, binaries)<br/>

Production app: https://frontend-production-6380.up.railway.app<br/>

Production API: https://backend-production-9533.up.railway.app</p>

</div>

"""

    )

    parts.append(

        """<h2>1. Product map</h2>

<table><tr><th>Product</th><th>UI</th><th>API</th><th>Role</th></tr>

<tr><td>Art City Cinema</td><td>/cinema</td><td>/api/cinema, /api/v1/ai</td><td>Advertising campaigns, QC, ZIP</td></tr>

<tr><td>Art City Studio</td><td>/studio</td><td>/api/studio, /api/projects</td><td>Single image/video/voice/music takes</td></tr>

<tr><td>AC Vertical Drama</td><td>/vertical-drama</td><td>/api/v1/vertical-drama</td><td>IP factory: vault, bible, episodes, 9:16, QC, delivery</td></tr>

<tr><td>Art City Edit</td><td>/edit</td><td>/api/edit</td><td>Long-form analyse, timeline, multi-ratio export</td></tr>

<tr><td>Production Hub</td><td>/hub</td><td>/api/v1/hub</td><td>AC Script, breakdown, handoff</td></tr>

<tr><td>Publish</td><td>/publish</td><td>/api/publications</td><td>Masters, checksums, channel release</td></tr>

<tr><td>Model Gateway</td><td>—</td><td>/api/v1/ai</td><td>Sole inference entry; cost ledger</td></tr>

<tr><td>Data Bank / Data Lab</td><td>/data-bank, /data-lab</td><td>/api/data-bank, /api/data-lab</td><td>Assets, ingest, annotation, rights</td></tr>

</table>

<p>Shared core: auth/RBAC, projects, MinIO assets, Postgres, Redis, ckb-IQ/RTL, Model Gateway. Domain modules own their tables and routes. AI is never called from the UI.</p>

"""

    )

    parts.append(

        """<h2>2. Architecture freeze</h2>

<table><tr><th>Layer</th><th>Implementation</th></tr>

<tr><td>Frontend</td><td>Next.js App Router under frontend/src (TypeScript)</td></tr>

<tr><td>Backend</td><td>FastAPI under backend/app; Alembic migrations 0001–0007</td></tr>

<tr><td>Data</td><td>PostgreSQL (projects + domain tables), Redis queue, MinIO/S3 assets</td></tr>

<tr><td>Auth</td><td>JWT access + refresh; session validate/refresh in frontend/src/lib/auth.ts and api.ts</td></tr>

<tr><td>Vertical Drama identity</td><td>Shared project_id + domain vd_project_id; flag VD_FEATURE_ENABLED</td></tr>

<tr><td>Deploy</td><td>Railway Docker: railway up backend|frontend --path-as-root</td></tr>

<tr><td>Out of scope</td><td>Nova, Alltra, foreign chains, shared monorepos</td></tr>

</table>

<h3>Alembic</h3>

<ul>

<li>0001_initial — platform projects, users, generations, costs</li>

<li>0002_ai_core — datasets, models, knowledge, evaluations</li>

<li>0003_data_lab_files — Data Lab file inventory</li>

<li>0004_art_city_edit — Edit workspaces and timelines</li>

<li>0005_customer_signup — signup verification</li>

<li>0006_production_hub — Hub scripts, versions, breakdown, events</li>

<li>0007_vertical_drama — IP vault, canon, bible, seasons, shots, QC, delivery</li>

</ul>

"""

    )

    parts.append("<h2>3. File inventory</h2>")

    for title, group in (

        ("Backend", backend),

        ("Frontend", frontend),

        ("Docs", docs),

        ("Root / deploy", other),

    ):

        parts.append(f"<h3>{html.escape(title)} ({len(group)} files)</h3><ul class='toc'>")

        for p in group:

            parts.append(f"<li>{html.escape(rel(p))}</li>")

        parts.append("</ul>")



    parts.append("<h2>4. Full source listing</h2>")

    parts.append("<p class='muted'>Each first-party text file follows. Binary, lockfiles, caches, and secrets are omitted.</p>")

    for p in files:

        body = html.escape(read_text(p))

        parts.append(

            f"<div class='file'><h3>{html.escape(rel(p))}</h3><pre>{body}</pre></div>"

        )



    parts.append("</body></html>")

    HTML_OUT.write_text("".join(parts), encoding="utf-8")

    print(f"Wrote {HTML_OUT} ({len(files)} files)")



    edge_candidates = [

        Path(r"C:\Program Files\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe"),

        Path(r"C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe"),

        Path(r"C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"),

    ]

    browser = next((c for c in edge_candidates if c.exists()), None)

    if not browser:

        print("No Edge/Chrome found; HTML report is ready.", file=sys.stderr)

        return 2



    cmd = [

        str(browser),

        "--headless=new",

        "--disable-gpu",

        f"--print-to-pdf={PDF_OUT}",

        "--no-pdf-header-footer",

        HTML_OUT.resolve().as_uri(),

    ]

    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)

    if proc.returncode != 0 or not PDF_OUT.exists():

        print(proc.stdout)

        print(proc.stderr, file=sys.stderr)

        print("PDF conversion failed; HTML report is ready.", file=sys.stderr)

        return 3

    print(f"Wrote {PDF_OUT} ({PDF_OUT.stat().st_size} bytes)")

    return 0





if __name__ == "__main__":

    raise SystemExit(main())


backend/scripts/live_products_200.py
"""Live production test — signup auth + Studio + Cinema + Edit + video."""



from __future__ import annotations



import json

import os

import sys

import time

import uuid



import httpx



BASE = os.environ.get("ARTCITY_API_URL", "https://backend-production-9533.up.railway.app").rstrip("/")

APP = os.environ.get("ARTCITY_APP_URL", "https://frontend-production-6380.up.railway.app").rstrip("/")

ADMIN_EMAIL = os.environ.get("ARTCITY_ADMIN_EMAIL", "admin@artcity.ai")

ADMIN_PASSWORD = os.environ.get("ARTCITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD", "ArtCityAdmin!2026")





def main() -> int:

    rows: list[dict] = []



    def ok(name: str, code: int, detail: str = "") -> None:

        passed = code in {200, 201}

        rows.append({"name": name, "code": code, "pass": passed, "detail": detail[:200]})

        print(f"{'OK' if passed else 'FAIL'}  {name}  {code}  {detail[:100]}")



    def assert_true(name: str, cond: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:

        rows.append({"name": name, "code": 200 if cond else 0, "pass": cond, "detail": detail[:200]})

        print(f"{'OK' if cond else 'FAIL'}  {name}  {'200' if cond else '0'}  {detail[:100]}")



    client = httpx.Client(base_url=BASE, timeout=300.0)

    app = httpx.Client(base_url=APP, timeout=60.0, follow_redirects=True)



    for path in (

        "/",

        "/login",

        "/signup",

        "/cinema",

        "/studio",

        "/studio/bank-building",

        "/data-bank",

        "/edit",

        "/dashboard",

        "/hub",

        "/vertical-drama",

    ):

        ok(f"UI GET {path}", app.get(path).status_code)



    # Customer signup with email + phone

    suffix = uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]

    email = f"customer.{suffix}@artcity.ai"

    phone = f"+964750{secrets_digits()}"

    password = "ArtCityCust!2026"



    signup = client.post(

        "/api/auth/signup",

        json={

            "email": email,

            "full_name": "Live Test Customer",

            "phone_number": phone,

            "password": password,

            "accept_terms": True,

        },

    )

    ok("POST /api/auth/signup", signup.status_code, signup.text[:120])

    if signup.status_code not in {200, 201}:

        return _finish(rows)

    body = signup.json()

    assert_true("signup returns email_token", bool(body.get("email_token")), str(body.keys()))

    assert_true("signup returns phone_code", bool(body.get("phone_code")), str(body.keys()))



    blocked = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": email, "password": password})

    assert_true(

        "login blocked before verify",

        blocked.status_code == 403,

        f"expected 403 got {blocked.status_code}",

    )



    ve = client.post("/api/auth/verify-email", json={"email": email, "token": body["email_token"]})

    ok("POST /api/auth/verify-email", ve.status_code)

    vp = client.post("/api/auth/verify-phone", json={"email": email, "code": body["phone_code"]})

    ok("POST /api/auth/verify-phone", vp.status_code)



    login = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": email, "password": password})

    ok("customer login after verify", login.status_code)

    if login.status_code != 200:

        # Fallback admin for product tests if customer role restricted

        login = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": ADMIN_EMAIL, "password": ADMIN_PASSWORD})

        ok("admin login fallback", login.status_code)

    if login.status_code != 200:

        return _finish(rows)



    token = login.json()["access_token"]

    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}

    ok("GET /api/auth/me", client.get("/api/auth/me", headers=headers).status_code)



    # Admin path for full product generation (cinema/studio privileges)

    admin_login = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": ADMIN_EMAIL, "password": ADMIN_PASSWORD})

    ok("admin login", admin_login.status_code)

    if admin_login.status_code != 200:

        return _finish(rows)

    admin_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {admin_login.json()['access_token']}"}



    proj = client.post(

        "/api/projects",

        headers=admin_headers,

        json={"name": f"Live Products {suffix}", "description": "studio cinema edit video"},

    )

    ok("POST /api/projects", proj.status_code)

    project_id = proj.json()["id"]



    # Studio video

    studio_video = client.post(

        f"/api/projects/{project_id}/studio/generate",

        headers=admin_headers,

        json={

            "modality": "video",

            "prompt": "Art City live test cinematic village dusk, 5 seconds",

            "duration_seconds": 5,

        },

    )

    ok("Studio video generate", studio_video.status_code, studio_video.text[:100])

    if studio_video.status_code in {200, 201}:

        job = studio_video.json()

        assert_true(

            "Studio video used cloud path or succeeded",

            job.get("status") in {"succeeded", "queued", "running"} or bool(job.get("id")),

            str(job.get("status")),

        )

        media = job.get("media_url") or job.get("result_uri")

        if media and str(media).startswith("http"):

            mr = httpx.get(media, timeout=60, follow_redirects=True)

            ok("Studio video media", mr.status_code)

            assert_true("Studio video is mp4", "mp4" in (mr.headers.get("content-type") or "").lower() or mr.content[:12].find(b"ftyp") >= 0)

        elif job.get("id"):

            # poll job

            for _ in range(40):

                jr = client.get(f"/api/v1/ai/jobs/{job['id']}", headers=admin_headers)

                if jr.status_code == 200 and jr.json().get("status") in {"succeeded", "failed"}:

                    body = jr.json()

                    ok("Studio video job", 200 if body.get("status") == "succeeded" else 0, body.get("status", ""))

                    # Cloud provider jobs are tagged ext-* when OpenAI/FAL used

                    pid = str(body.get("provider_job_id") or "")

                    assert_true(

                        "Studio video provider is external or artcity",

                        pid.startswith("ext-") or pid.startswith("ac-") or bool(pid),

                        pid,

                    )

                    break

                time.sleep(2)



    # Gateway video

    gw = client.post(

        "/api/v1/ai/videos/generate",

        headers=admin_headers,

        json={"prompt": "Art City live gateway video test", "project_id": project_id, "duration_seconds": 4},

    )

    ok("Gateway video generate", gw.status_code)



    # Cinema

    cinema = client.post(

        f"/api/projects/{project_id}/cinema/packages",

        headers=admin_headers,

        json={

            "campaign": f"Live Cinema {suffix}",

            "brief": "Live production cinema package for Art City",

            "cta": "Watch on Art City",

            "brand": "Art City",

            "voiceover_script": "Art City brings stories to life.",

            "music_style": "warm documentary",

            "duration_seconds": 8,

        },

    )

    ok("Cinema package", cinema.status_code, cinema.text[:100])

    if cinema.status_code in {200, 201}:

        pkg = cinema.json()

        package_id = pkg.get("package_id") or pkg.get("id")

        assert_true("Cinema QC passed", bool(pkg.get("validation_passed") or (pkg.get("validation") or {}).get("passed")), str(pkg.get("validation_passed")))

        if package_id:

            ok(

                "Cinema zip",

                client.get(

                    f"/api/projects/{project_id}/cinema/packages/{package_id}/zip",

                    headers=admin_headers,

                ).status_code,

            )



    # Edit

    seed = client.post("/api/edit/seed/internal", headers=admin_headers)

    ok("Edit seed", seed.status_code)

    wid = seed.json().get("id") if seed.status_code in {200, 201} else None

    if not wid:

        ws = client.get("/api/edit/workspaces", headers=admin_headers)

        ok("Edit workspaces", ws.status_code)

        wid = (ws.json() or [{}])[0].get("id")

    if wid:

        up = client.post(

            f"/api/edit/workspaces/{wid}/assets",

            headers=admin_headers,

            files={"file": ("live_edit.txt", b"Art City live edit source", "text/plain")},

            data={"rights_attested": "true", "rights_notes": "live"},

        )

        ok("Edit upload", up.status_code)

        if up.status_code in {200, 201}:

            ep = client.post(

                f"/api/edit/workspaces/{wid}/projects",

                headers=admin_headers,

                json={"title": f"Live Edit {suffix}", "source_asset_id": up.json()["id"]},

            )

            ok("Edit project", ep.status_code)

            if ep.status_code in {200, 201}:

                eid = ep.json()["id"]

                ok("Edit analyse", client.post(f"/api/edit/projects/{eid}/analyse", headers=admin_headers).status_code)



    # Data Bank

    db_seed = client.post("/api/data-bank/seed", headers=admin_headers)

    ok("Data Bank seed", db_seed.status_code)

    ok("Data Bank hub", client.get("/api/data-bank", headers=admin_headers).status_code)

    bank_pid = (db_seed.json().get("project") or {}).get("id") if db_seed.status_code in {200, 201} else None

    if bank_pid:

        ok(

            "Data Bank summary",

            client.get(f"/api/projects/{bank_pid}/data-bank/summary", headers=admin_headers).status_code,

        )

        ok(

            "Data Bank list",

            client.get(f"/api/projects/{bank_pid}/data-bank", headers=admin_headers).status_code,

        )

        up = client.post(

            f"/api/projects/{bank_pid}/data-bank/upload",

            headers=admin_headers,

            files={"file": ("live-bank.txt", b"Live Data Bank brief", "text/plain")},

            data={"name": "Live bank brief", "tags": "live,data-bank"},

        )

        ok("Data Bank upload", up.status_code)

        ok(

            "Data Bank sync",

            client.post(f"/api/projects/{bank_pid}/data-bank/sync", headers=admin_headers).status_code,

        )



    bb = client.post(

        "/api/studio/bank-building/generate",

        headers=admin_headers,

        json={"notes": "live production bank building", "prefer_external": True},

    )

    ok("Bank building image", bb.status_code, bb.text[:100])

    if bb.status_code in {200, 201}:

        media = bb.json().get("media_url")

        if media:

            mr = client.get(media, headers=admin_headers)

            ok("Bank building media", mr.status_code)

            pid = str(bb.json().get("provider_job_id") or "")

            assert_true(

                "Bank building provider is external or artcity",

                pid.startswith("ext-") or pid.startswith("ac-"),

                pid,

            )



    # Production Hub — AC Script

    ok("Hub features", client.get("/api/v1/hub/features", headers=admin_headers).status_code)

    hub_script = client.post(

        f"/api/v1/hub/projects/{project_id}/scripts",

        headers=admin_headers,

        json={

            "title": f"Live Hub Script {suffix}",

            "entry_mode": "synopsis",

            "primary_locale": "ckb-IQ",

            "content_languages": ["ckb-IQ", "en"],

            "seed_text": (

                "INT. قاوەخانە - ڕۆژ\n"

                "دایک دەچێتە ژوورەوە.\n\n"

                "دایک\n"

                "سڵاو، کوڕم.\n\n"

                "EXT. شەقام - شەو\n"

                "باسیش دەڕوات."

            ),

        },

    )

    ok("Hub create script", hub_script.status_code, hub_script.text[:120])

    if hub_script.status_code in {200, 201}:

        script = hub_script.json()

        script_id = script["id"]

        version_id = script.get("current_version_id")

        assert_true("Hub script has version", bool(version_id), str(script))

        if version_id:

            els = client.get(f"/api/v1/hub/versions/{version_id}/elements", headers=admin_headers)

            ok("Hub list elements", els.status_code)

            save = client.put(

                f"/api/v1/hub/versions/{version_id}/elements",

                headers=admin_headers,

                json={

                    "elements": [

                        {"element_type": "scene_heading", "display_text": "INT. CAFE - DAY", "locale": "en"},

                        {"element_type": "action", "display_text": "Mother enters.", "locale": "en"},

                        {"element_type": "character", "display_text": "MOTHER", "locale": "en"},

                        {"element_type": "dialogue", "display_text": "سڵاو، کوڕم.", "locale": "ckb-IQ"},

                        {"element_type": "scene_heading", "display_text": "EXT. STREET - NIGHT", "locale": "en"},

                        {"element_type": "action", "display_text": "Rain falls.", "locale": "en"},

                    ]

                },

            )

            ok("Hub save elements", save.status_code)

            scenes = client.post(

                f"/api/v1/hub/versions/{version_id}/parse-scenes",

                headers=admin_headers,

            )

            ok("Hub parse scenes", scenes.status_code, scenes.text[:100])

            if scenes.status_code == 200:

                assert_true("Hub parsed scenes", len(scenes.json()) >= 1, str(len(scenes.json())))

            breakdown = client.post(

                f"/api/v1/hub/versions/{version_id}/breakdown/propose",

                headers=admin_headers,

            )

            ok("Hub propose breakdown", breakdown.status_code)

            if breakdown.status_code == 200 and breakdown.json():

                item = breakdown.json()[0]

                dec = client.post(

                    f"/api/v1/hub/breakdown/{item['id']}/decision",

                    headers=admin_headers,

                    json={"approval_status": "approved"},

                )

                ok("Hub approve breakdown", dec.status_code)

            lock = client.post(f"/api/v1/hub/versions/{version_id}/lock", headers=admin_headers)

            ok("Hub lock version", lock.status_code)

            blocked = client.put(

                f"/api/v1/hub/versions/{version_id}/elements",

                headers=admin_headers,

                json={"elements": [{"element_type": "action", "display_text": "should fail"}]},

            )

            assert_true(

                "Hub lock blocks edit",

                blocked.status_code == 400,

                f"expected 400 got {blocked.status_code} {blocked.text[:80]}",

            )

            # revise after lock

            rev = client.post(f"/api/v1/hub/scripts/{script_id}/versions", headers=admin_headers)

            ok("Hub new revision", rev.status_code)

            export = client.get(

                f"/api/v1/hub/versions/{version_id}/export/docx",

                headers=admin_headers,

            )

            ok("Hub export docx", export.status_code)

            for target in ("cinema", "studio", "edit"):

                ho = client.post(

                    f"/api/v1/hub/projects/{project_id}/handoff/{target}",

                    headers=admin_headers,

                    json={"script_version_id": version_id},

                )

                ok(f"Hub handoff {target}", ho.status_code, ho.text[:80])

            ok(

                "Hub UI script",

                app.get(f"/hub/{project_id}/script").status_code,

            )



    ok("VD features", client.get("/api/v1/vertical-drama/features", headers=admin_headers).status_code)

    vd = client.post(

        "/api/v1/vertical-drama/projects",

        headers=admin_headers,

        json={

            "title": f"Golden A {suffix}",

            "logline": "دڵخواز نهێنی خێزان دەدۆزێتەوە.",

            "source_type": "generate",

            "primary_locale": "ckb-IQ",

            "content_languages": ["ckb-IQ", "en"],

            "seed_golden_a": True,

        },

    )

    ok("VD create golden A", vd.status_code, vd.text[:120])

    if vd.status_code in {200, 201}:

        vdid = vd.json()["id"]

        ok("VD UI", app.get("/vertical-drama").status_code)

        ok("VD UI project", app.get(f"/vertical-drama/{vdid}").status_code)

        bible = client.post(

            f"/api/v1/vertical-drama/projects/{vdid}/story-bible",

            headers=admin_headers,

            json={"sections_json": {"world": "سلێمانی", "tone": "drama", "language": "ckb-IQ"}},

        )

        ok("VD story bible", bible.status_code)

        if bible.status_code in {200, 201}:

            vid = (bible.json().get("version") or {}).get("id") or bible.json().get("current_version_id")

            if vid:

                ok(

                    "VD bible lock",

                    client.post(f"/api/v1/vertical-drama/story-bibles/{vid}/approve", headers=admin_headers).status_code,

                )

        season = client.post(

            f"/api/v1/vertical-drama/projects/{vdid}/seasons",

            headers=admin_headers,

            json={"title": "Season 1", "target_episode_count": 2, "target_episode_seconds": 60},

        )

        ok("VD season grid", season.status_code)

        if season.status_code in {200, 201}:

            eps = season.json().get("episodes") or []

            assert_true("VD two episodes", len(eps) >= 2, str(len(eps)))

            eid = eps[0]["id"]

            for st in ("drafted", "reviewed", "approved"):

                pr = client.patch(

                    f"/api/v1/vertical-drama/episodes/{eid}",

                    headers=admin_headers,

                    json={"status": st},

                )

                ok(f"VD episode {st}", pr.status_code)

            sp = client.post(

                f"/api/v1/vertical-drama/episodes/{eid}/screenplay",

                headers=admin_headers,

                json={

                    "title": "EP1",

                    "elements": [

                        {"element_type": "scene_heading", "display_text": "INT. قاوەخانە - ڕۆژ"},

                        {"element_type": "action", "display_text": "دڵخواز دێتە ژوورەوە."},

                    ],

                },

            )

            ok("VD screenplay", sp.status_code)

            dc = client.post(f"/api/v1/vertical-drama/episodes/{eid}/decoupage", headers=admin_headers)

            ok("VD decoupage", dc.status_code, dc.text[:80])

            shots = (dc.json() or {}).get("shots") or []

            qc_fail = client.post(f"/api/v1/vertical-drama/episodes/{eid}/qc-runs", headers=admin_headers)

            ok("VD QC before media", qc_fail.status_code)

            if qc_fail.status_code == 200:

                assert_true("VD QC fails without takes", qc_fail.json().get("passed") is False, str(qc_fail.json()))

            if shots:

                gen = client.post(

                    f"/api/v1/vertical-drama/shots/{shots[0]['id']}/generations",

                    headers=admin_headers,

                    json={"capability": "image"},

                )

                ok("VD generate shot", gen.status_code)

                for sh in shots[1:]:

                    client.post(

                        f"/api/v1/vertical-drama/shots/{sh['id']}/generations",

                        headers=admin_headers,

                        json={"capability": "image"},

                    )

            loc = client.post(

                f"/api/v1/vertical-drama/episodes/{eid}/localize",

                headers=admin_headers,

                json={"language": "en", "kind": "subtitle", "body": "Mother waits."},

            )

            ok("VD localize", loc.status_code)

            asm = client.post(f"/api/v1/vertical-drama/episodes/{eid}/assembly", headers=admin_headers)

            ok("VD assembly", asm.status_code)

            qc = client.post(f"/api/v1/vertical-drama/episodes/{eid}/qc-runs", headers=admin_headers)

            ok("VD QC", qc.status_code)

            if qc.status_code == 200:

                assert_true("VD QC passed after generates", bool(qc.json().get("passed")), str(qc.json()))

            pkg = client.post(

                f"/api/v1/vertical-drama/episodes/{eid}/delivery-packages",

                headers=admin_headers,

            )

            ok("VD delivery", pkg.status_code, pkg.text[:100])



    return _finish(rows)





def secrets_digits() -> str:

    return f"{uuid.uuid4().int % 10_000_000:07d}"





def _finish(rows: list[dict]) -> int:

    failed = [r for r in rows if not r["pass"]]

    out = {

        "api": BASE,

        "app": APP,

        "total": len(rows),

        "pass": len(rows) - len(failed),

        "fail": len(failed),

        "all_green": len(failed) == 0,

        "failed": failed,

    }

    print(json.dumps({k: out[k] for k in ("api", "app", "total", "pass", "fail", "all_green")}, indent=2))

    if failed:

        print("FAILURES:")

        for f in failed:

            print(f"  {f['name']} -> {f['code']} {f.get('detail')}")

    path = os.environ.get("LIVE_OUT", "live_products_200_report.json")

    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:

        json.dump(out, fh, indent=2)

    print("wrote", path)

    return 0 if out["all_green"] else 1





if __name__ == "__main__":

    sys.exit(main())


backend/scripts/seed_ai_core.py
"""Seed admin user, Kardokh/Kurdiya pilot datasets, models, routes, knowledge."""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import uuid4

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.db import SessionLocal
from app.core.enums import DatasetStatus, ModelStatus, RightsStatus
from app.core.security import hash_password
from app.models import Dataset, KnowledgeEntry, RegisteredModel, RightsRecord, RouteRule, User


def main() -> None:
    settings = get_settings()
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        admin = db.query(User).filter(User.email == settings.default_admin_email).first()
        if not admin:
            admin = User(
                id=str(uuid4()),
                email=settings.default_admin_email,
                full_name="Art City Admin",
                password_hash=hash_password(settings.default_admin_password),
                role="super_admin",
                is_active=True,
                email_verified_at=now,
                phone_number="+10000000000",
                phone_verified_at=now,
                account_state="active",
            )
            db.add(admin)
            db.flush()
            print(f"Created admin {admin.email}")
        else:
            if not admin.is_active:
                admin.is_active = True
            if not admin.email_verified_at:
                admin.email_verified_at = now
            if not admin.phone_verified_at:
                admin.phone_verified_at = now
            if not admin.phone_number:
                admin.phone_number = "+10000000000"
            admin.account_state = "active"
            db.add(admin)
            print(f"Admin ready {admin.email}")

        def ensure_dataset(name: str, character: str) -> Dataset:
            ds = db.query(Dataset).filter(Dataset.name == name).first()
            if ds:
                return ds
            ds = Dataset(
                id=str(uuid4()),
                name=name,
                description=f"Verified character reference dataset for {character}",
                category="character_references",
                media_type="image",
                language="ku",
                dialect="sorani",
                owner="Art City",
                copyright_holder="Art City Group",
                licence="Art City proprietary",
                commercial_use=True,
                ai_training_permission=True,
                version="v2",
                status=DatasetStatus.TRAINING_READY.value,
                checksum=sha256(name.encode()).hexdigest(),
                intended_model_use=f"AC-{character.upper()}-IMAGE",
                record_count=24,
                created_by=admin.id,
            )
            db.add(ds)
            db.flush()
            rights = RightsRecord(
                id=str(uuid4()),
                dataset_id=ds.id,
                copyright_owner="Art City Group",
                source_organisation="Art City",
                commercial_use=True,
                ai_training=True,
                fine_tuning=True,
                image_generation=True,
                legal_status=RightsStatus.APPROVED_FOR_TRAINING.value,
                legal_notes="Pilot seed — Art City owned character IP",
                created_by=admin.id,
            )
            db.add(rights)
            return ds

        kd = ensure_dataset("KD-CHARACTER-001-v2", "kardokh")
        ku = ensure_dataset("KD-CHARACTER-002-v2", "kurdiya")

        def ensure_model(name: str, dataset: Dataset, character: str) -> RegisteredModel:
            m = db.query(RegisteredModel).filter(RegisteredModel.name == name).first()
            if m:
                return m
            checksum = sha256(f"{name}:{dataset.id}".encode()).hexdigest()
            m = RegisteredModel(
                id=str(uuid4()),
                name=name,
                version="v1",
                model_type="lora",
                base_model="Approved image base model",
                licence="Art City proprietary",
                commercial_use=True,
                owner="Art City",
                training_dataset_id=dataset.id,
                training_method="lora",
                character_key=character,
                modality="image",
                status=ModelStatus.STAGING.value,
                checkpoint_path=f"models/{name}/checkpoint.safetensors",
                checksum=checksum,
                quality_score=0.86,
                created_by=admin.id,
            )
            db.add(m)
            db.flush()
            return m

        mk = ensure_model("AC-KARDOKH-IMAGE-v1", kd, "kardokh")
        mu = ensure_model("AC-KURDIYA-IMAGE-v1", ku, "kurdiya")

        def ensure_lora(name: str, modality: str, character: str, dataset: Dataset) -> RegisteredModel:
            existing = db.query(RegisteredModel).filter(RegisteredModel.name == name).first()
            if existing:
                return existing
            checksum = sha256(f"{name}:{character}:{modality}".encode()).hexdigest()
            m = RegisteredModel(
                id=str(uuid4()),
                name=name,
                version="v1",
                model_type="lora",
                base_model=f"Art City {modality} base",
                licence="Art City proprietary",
                commercial_use=True,
                owner="Art City",
                training_dataset_id=dataset.id,
                training_method="lora",
                character_key=character,
                modality=modality,
                status=ModelStatus.STAGING.value,
                checkpoint_path=f"models/{name}/adapter.safetensors",
                checksum=checksum,
                quality_score=0.82,
                created_by=admin.id,
            )
            db.add(m)
            db.flush()
            return m

        vk = ensure_lora("AC-KARDOKH-VIDEO-LORA-v1", "video", "kardokh", kd)
        vu = ensure_lora("AC-KURDIYA-VIDEO-LORA-v1", "video", "kurdiya", ku)
        vok = ensure_lora("AC-KARDOKH-VOICE-LORA-v1", "voice", "kardokh", kd)
        vou = ensure_lora("AC-KURDIYA-VOICE-LORA-v1", "voice", "kurdiya", ku)

        for name, modality, character, model, provider, priority in [
            ("Kardokh image", "image", "kardokh", mk, "artcity-image", 10),
            ("Kurdiya image", "image", "kurdiya", mu, "artcity-image", 10),
            ("Kardokh video LoRA", "video", "kardokh", vk, "artcity-video", 10),
            ("Kurdiya video LoRA", "video", "kurdiya", vu, "artcity-video", 10),
            ("Kardokh voice LoRA", "voice", "kardokh", vok, "artcity-voice", 10),
            ("Kurdiya voice LoRA", "voice", "kurdiya", vou, "artcity-voice", 10),
            ("Default image", "image", None, None, "artcity-image", 100),
            ("Default video", "video", None, None, "artcity-video", 100),
            ("Default voice", "voice", None, None, "artcity-voice", 100),
            ("Default music", "music", None, None, "artcity-music", 100),
            ("Default audio", "audio", None, None, "artcity-audio", 100),
            ("Advertising video", "video", None, None, "artcity-video", 20),
        ]:
            exists = (
                db.query(RouteRule)
                .filter(RouteRule.name == name)
                .first()
            )
            if exists:
                continue
            db.add(
                RouteRule(
                    id=str(uuid4()),
                    name=name,
                    modality=modality,
                    character_key=character,
                    model_id=model.id if model else None,
                    provider=provider,
                    priority=priority,
                    is_active=True,
                )
            )

        knowledge = [
            ("Kardokh", "sorani", "Art City boy character — Story Bible hero of homecoming.", "character", "Kardokh", "کاردۆخ گەڕایەوە بۆ ماڵ."),
            ("Kurdiya", "sorani", "Art City girl character — Story Bible companion of homecoming.", "character", "Kurdiya", "کوردیا چیرۆک دەگێڕێتەوە."),
            ("Newroz", "sorani", "Kurdish New Year / spring celebration.", "customs", "Newroz", "نەورۆز جەژنی بەهارە."),
            ("Zagros", "sorani", "Mountain range central to Kurdish geography.", "geography", "Zagros", "زاگرۆس شاخی نیشتمانە."),
            ("Kardokh", "badini", "Art City boy character — Badini Story Bible naming.", "character", "Kardokh", "کاردۆخ ڤەگەڕیا بۆ مال."),
            ("Kurdiya", "badini", "Art City girl character — Badini Story Bible naming.", "character", "Kurdiya", "کوردیا چیرۆکێ دبێژیت."),
            ("Newroz", "kurmanji", "Kurdish New Year celebrated across the mountains.", "customs", "Newroz", "Newroz cejna biharê ye."),
            ("Zagros", "kurmanji", "Mountain range of Kurdish homeland geography.", "geography", "Zagros", "Zagros çiyayên welat in."),
            ("Shayi", "sorani", "Kurdish folk dance / celebration movement.", "customs", "Shayi", "شایی جووڵەی خۆشی و کۆمەڵایەتییە."),
            ("Sorani", "sorani", "Central Kurdish dialect used across Art City scripts.", "terminology", "Central Kurdish", None),
            ("Badini", "badini", "Northern Iraq Kurdish dialect (Behdini).", "terminology", "Badini", None),
            ("Kurmanji", "kurmanji", "Northern Kurdish dialect (Latin script).", "terminology", "Kurmanji", None),
        ]
        for term, dialect, definition, category, translation, example in knowledge:
            exists = (
                db.query(KnowledgeEntry)
                .filter(KnowledgeEntry.term == term, KnowledgeEntry.dialect == dialect)
                .first()
            )
            if exists:
                continue
            db.add(
                KnowledgeEntry(
                    id=str(uuid4()),
                    term=term,
                    language="ku",
                    dialect=dialect,
                    definition=definition,
                    child_friendly_definition=definition,
                    translation=translation,
                    example_sentence=example,
                    category=category,
                    source="Art City Story Bible",
                    licence="Art City proprietary",
                    approval_status="approved",
                    created_by=admin.id,
                )
            )

        speech_ds = db.query(Dataset).filter(Dataset.name == "KD-SPEECH-KU-v1").first()
        if not speech_ds:
            speech_ds = Dataset(
                id=str(uuid4()),
                name="KD-SPEECH-KU-v1",
                description="Kurdish speech corpus — Sorani / Badini / Kurmanji; ASR handoff + Data Lab annotation",
                category="speech",
                media_type="audio",
                language="ku",
                dialect="sorani",
                owner="Art City",
                copyright_holder="Art City Group",
                licence="Art City proprietary",
                commercial_use=True,
                ai_training_permission=True,
                version="v1",
                status=DatasetStatus.EVALUATION_ONLY.value,
                checksum=sha256(b"KD-SPEECH-KU-v1").hexdigest(),
                intended_model_use="AC-KURDISH-ASR",
                record_count=0,
                created_by=admin.id,
            )
            db.add(speech_ds)
            db.flush()
            db.add(
                RightsRecord(
                    id=str(uuid4()),
                    dataset_id=speech_ds.id,
                    copyright_owner="Art City Group",
                    source_organisation="Art City",
                    commercial_use=True,
                    ai_training=True,
                    fine_tuning=True,
                    image_generation=False,
                    legal_status=RightsStatus.APPROVED_FOR_TRAINING.value,
                    legal_notes="Speech corpus — Art City owned; promote via Data Lab review",
                    created_by=admin.id,
                )
            )
        else:
            if "scaffold" in (speech_ds.description or "").lower():
                speech_ds.description = (
                    "Kurdish speech corpus — Sorani / Badini / Kurmanji; ASR handoff + Data Lab annotation"
                )
                db.add(speech_ds)
            rights = (
                db.query(RightsRecord)
                .filter(RightsRecord.dataset_id == speech_ds.id)
                .order_by(RightsRecord.created_at.desc())
                .first()
            )
            if not rights:
                db.add(
                    RightsRecord(
                        id=str(uuid4()),
                        dataset_id=speech_ds.id,
                        copyright_owner="Art City Group",
                        source_organisation="Art City",
                        commercial_use=True,
                        ai_training=True,
                        fine_tuning=True,
                        image_generation=False,
                        legal_status=RightsStatus.APPROVED_FOR_TRAINING.value,
                        legal_notes="Speech corpus — Art City owned; promote via Data Lab review",
                        created_by=admin.id,
                    )
                )

        asr_model = db.query(RegisteredModel).filter(RegisteredModel.name == "AC-KURDISH-ASR-v1").first()
        if not asr_model:
            asr_model = RegisteredModel(
                id=str(uuid4()),
                name="AC-KURDISH-ASR-v1",
                version="v1",
                model_type="asr",
                base_model="Art City speech base",
                licence="Art City proprietary",
                commercial_use=True,
                owner="Art City",
                training_dataset_id=speech_ds.id,
                training_method="supervised",
                character_key=None,
                modality="speech",
                status=ModelStatus.EVALUATING.value,
                checkpoint_path="models/AC-KURDISH-ASR-v1/pilot",
                checksum=sha256(b"AC-KURDISH-ASR-v1").hexdigest(),
                quality_score=0.72,
                created_by=admin.id,
            )
            db.add(asr_model)
            db.flush()

        asr_route = db.query(RouteRule).filter(RouteRule.name == "Kurdish ASR").first()
        if not asr_route:
            db.add(
                RouteRule(
                    id=str(uuid4()),
                    name="Kurdish ASR",
                    modality="speech",
                    character_key=None,
                    model_id=asr_model.id,
                    provider="artcity-asr",
                    priority=10,
                    is_active=True,
                )
            )
        elif asr_route.provider != "artcity-asr":
            asr_route.provider = "artcity-asr"
            asr_route.model_id = asr_model.id
            asr_route.is_active = True
            db.add(asr_route)

        db.commit()
        print("AI Core seed complete")
        print(f"  datasets: {kd.name}, {ku.name}, {speech_ds.name}")
        print(f"  models: {mk.name}, {mu.name}, {asr_model.name}")
    finally:
        db.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

backend/scripts/seed_edit.py
"""Seed Art City Edit plans and internal Art City Group organisation."""



from __future__ import annotations



import sys

from pathlib import Path

from uuid import uuid4



sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))



from app.core.config import get_settings

from app.core.db import SessionLocal

from app.core.security import hash_password

from app.models import User

from app.services.edit_access import ensure_default_plans, seed_internal_art_city





def main() -> None:

    settings = get_settings()

    db = SessionLocal()

    try:

        admin = db.query(User).filter(User.email == settings.default_admin_email).first()

        if not admin:

            admin = User(

                id=str(uuid4()),

                email=settings.default_admin_email,

                full_name="Art City Admin",

                password_hash=hash_password(settings.default_admin_password),

                role="super_admin",

                is_active=True,

                account_state="active",

            )

            db.add(admin)

            db.flush()

            print(f"Created admin {admin.email}")

        else:

            print(f"Admin exists {admin.email}")



        plans = ensure_default_plans(db)

        print(f"Plans ready: {', '.join(p.code for p in plans)}")



        org = seed_internal_art_city(db, admin)

        db.commit()

        print(f"Internal org ready: {org.display_name} ({org.id}) status={org.status}")

        print("Art City Edit seed complete")

    except Exception:

        db.rollback()

        raise

    finally:

        db.close()





if __name__ == "__main__":

    main()


backend/scripts/smoke_200.py
"""Art City API smoke suite — 200 green checks (HTTP 200/201)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import io
import json
import os
import struct
import sys
import wave
from typing import Any

import httpx

BASE = os.environ.get("ARTCITY_API_URL", "https://backend-production-9533.up.railway.app").rstrip("/")
EMAIL = os.environ.get("ARTCITY_ADMIN_EMAIL", "admin@artcity.ai")
PASSWORD = os.environ.get("ARTCITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD", "ArtCityAdmin!2026")
TARGET = 200


def _minimal_wav(seconds: float = 1.0, rate: int = 16000) -> bytes:
    frames = int(rate * seconds)
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    with wave.open(buf, "wb") as wf:
        wf.setnchannels(1)
        wf.setsampwidth(2)
        wf.setframerate(rate)
        silence = struct.pack("<h", 0) * frames
        wf.writeframes(silence)
    return buf.getvalue()


def main() -> int:
    results: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    client = httpx.Client(base_url=BASE, timeout=120.0)

    def check(method: str, path: str, *, json_body: Any = None, ok: set[int] | None = None, auth: bool = True) -> None:
        ok = ok or {200, 201}
        headers = {}
        if auth and token:
            headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"
        try:
            r = client.request(method, path, json=json_body, headers=headers)
            pass_ = r.status_code in ok
            results.append(
                {
                    "method": method,
                    "path": path,
                    "code": r.status_code,
                    "pass": pass_,
                    "err": "" if pass_ else r.text[:160],
                }
            )
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            results.append({"method": method, "path": path, "code": 0, "pass": False, "err": str(exc)[:160]})

    def check_upload(path: str, *, files: dict[str, Any], data: dict[str, str] | None = None, ok: set[int] | None = None) -> httpx.Response | None:
        ok = ok or {200, 201}
        headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"} if token else {}
        try:
            r = client.post(path, files=files, data=data or {}, headers=headers)
            pass_ = r.status_code in ok
            results.append(
                {
                    "method": "POST",
                    "path": path,
                    "code": r.status_code,
                    "pass": pass_,
                    "err": "" if pass_ else r.text[:160],
                }
            )
            return r if pass_ else None
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            results.append({"method": "POST", "path": path, "code": 0, "pass": False, "err": str(exc)[:160]})
            return None

    # Public
    token = ""
    for path in ("/", "/health", "/docs", "/redoc", "/openapi.json"):
        check("GET", path, auth=False, ok={200})

    # Login
    r = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": EMAIL, "password": PASSWORD})
    if r.status_code != 200:
        print("LOGIN FAILED", r.status_code, r.text)
        return 1
    token = r.json()["access_token"]
    results.append({"method": "POST", "path": "/api/auth/login", "code": 200, "pass": True, "err": ""})

    # Auth + lists
    for path in (
        "/api/auth/me",
        "/api/auth/users",
        "/api/projects",
        "/api/datasets",
        "/api/rights",
        "/api/models/registry",
        "/api/training",
        "/api/knowledge",
        "/api/knowledge/query",
        "/api/knowledge/query?terms=Kardokh,Kurdiya",
        "/api/evaluations",
        "/api/data-lab/ingestions",
        "/api/data-lab/annotations",
        "/api/v1/ai/providers",
        "/api/v1/ai/models",
    ):
        check("GET", path)

    # Ensure project
    projects = client.get("/api/projects", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}).json()
    if projects:
        project_id = projects[0]["id"]
    else:
        created = client.post(
            "/api/projects",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
            json={"name": "Smoke Green Project"},
        )
        created.raise_for_status()
        project_id = created.json()["id"]
        results.append({"method": "POST", "path": "/api/projects", "code": created.status_code, "pass": True, "err": ""})

    for suffix in (
        "",
        "/characters",
        "/scripts",
        "/generations",
        "/studio/summary",
        "/assets",
        "/cinema/packages",
        "/publications",
    ):
        check("GET", f"/api/projects/{project_id}{suffix}")

    # Gateway generates (expect 201)
    for modality, path in (
        ("image", "/api/v1/ai/images/generate"),
        ("video", "/api/v1/ai/videos/generate"),
        ("voice", "/api/v1/ai/voices/generate"),
        ("audio", "/api/v1/ai/audio/generate"),
        ("music", "/api/v1/ai/music/generate"),
    ):
        body = {
            "project_id": project_id,
            "prompt": f"Art City smoke {modality}",
            "character_key": "kurdiya" if modality == "image" else None,
            "character_name": "Kurdiya" if modality == "image" else "Art City",
            "duration_seconds": 3.0 if modality in {"video", "music", "voice"} else 4.0,
        }
        body = {k: v for k, v in body.items() if v is not None}
        check("POST", path, json_body=body, ok={201})

    # Latest job + media
    jobs = client.get(
        f"/api/projects/{project_id}/generations",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
    ).json()
    if jobs:
        job_id = jobs[0]["id"]
        check("GET", f"/api/v1/ai/jobs/{job_id}")
        if jobs[0].get("media_url"):
            check("GET", jobs[0]["media_url"], auth=False, ok={200})

    # Models detail
    models = client.get("/api/v1/ai/models", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}).json()
    for m in models[:5]:
        check("GET", f"/api/v1/ai/models/{m['id']}")

    # Speech ASR production path: upload → ASR → job → subtitles
    check("GET", "/api/v1/ai/speech/dialects")
    check(
        "POST",
        "/api/v1/ai/speech/detect",
        json_body={"text": "Silav Newroz Zagros Kardokh"},
        ok={200},
    )
    wav_bytes = _minimal_wav(1.0)
    asr_job_id = None
    audio_key = None
    for dialect in ("sorani", "badini", "kurmanji"):
        up = check_upload(
            "/api/v1/ai/speech/upload",
            files={"file": (f"smoke-{dialect}.wav", wav_bytes, "audio/wav")},
            data={"project_id": project_id},
        )
        if not up:
            continue
        audio_key = up.json().get("audio_storage_key")
        asr = client.post(
            "/api/v1/ai/speech/asr",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
            json={
                "audio_storage_key": audio_key,
                "dialect": dialect,
                "project_id": project_id,
                "create_annotation": True,
            },
        )
        pass_ = asr.status_code in {200, 201}
        results.append(
            {
                "method": "POST",
                "path": f"/api/v1/ai/speech/asr?dialect={dialect}",
                "code": asr.status_code,
                "pass": pass_,
                "err": "" if pass_ else asr.text[:160],
            }
        )
        if pass_:
            asr_job_id = asr.json().get("job_id") or asr_job_id
    if asr_job_id:
        check("GET", f"/api/v1/ai/speech/jobs/{asr_job_id}")
        check("GET", f"/api/v1/ai/speech/jobs/{asr_job_id}/transcript")
        check("GET", f"/api/v1/ai/speech/jobs/{asr_job_id}/subtitles?format=vtt")
        check("GET", f"/api/v1/ai/speech/jobs/{asr_job_id}/subtitles?format=srt")
    # Missing key stays HTTP 200 with silent placeholder WAV (production-safe ASR)
    check(
        "POST",
        "/api/v1/ai/speech/asr",
        json_body={"audio_storage_key": "smoke/missing-does-not-exist.wav", "dialect": "sorani"},
        ok={200, 201},
    )

    # Studio voice + ASR transcript hook (Cinema VO path uses the same run_asr_job)
    voice = client.post(
        f"/api/projects/{project_id}/studio/generate",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
        json={
            "modality": "voice",
            "prompt": "Art City smoke voiceover for ASR",
            "dialect": "sorani",
            "run_asr": True,
            "duration_seconds": 3.0,
            "character_name": "Art City",
        },
    )
    voice_ok = voice.status_code in {200, 201}
    results.append(
        {
            "method": "POST",
            "path": f"/api/projects/{project_id}/studio/generate?voice+asr",
            "code": voice.status_code,
            "pass": voice_ok,
            "err": "" if voice_ok else voice.text[:160],
        }
    )
    if voice_ok:
        vj = voice.json()
        has_asr = bool(vj.get("transcript_job_id") or vj.get("asr_summary") or vj.get("transcript_url"))
        results.append(
            {
                "method": "ASSERT",
                "path": "studio.voice.transcript_attached",
                "code": 200 if has_asr else 0,
                "pass": has_asr,
                "err": "" if has_asr else "missing transcript_job_id/asr_summary on voice job",
            }
        )
        if vj.get("transcript_job_id"):
            check("GET", f"/api/v1/ai/speech/jobs/{vj['transcript_job_id']}")

    # Cinema full production package (MP4 + QC + timeline)
    cinema = client.post(
        f"/api/projects/{project_id}/cinema/packages",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
        json={
            "campaign": "Smoke Full Prod",
            "brief": "Art City advertising production masters for green suite",
            "cta": "Watch now",
            "duration_seconds": 10,
            "dialect": "sorani",
            "character_key": "kurdiya",
            "character_name": "Kurdiya",
            "channels": ["broadcast", "social_vertical", "social_square"],
            "variants": ["A", "B"],
            "delivery_targets": ["youtube", "meta_stories"],
            "music_style": "warm",
        },
    )
    cinema_ok = cinema.status_code in {200, 201}
    results.append(
        {
            "method": "POST",
            "path": f"/api/projects/{project_id}/cinema/packages",
            "code": cinema.status_code,
            "pass": cinema_ok,
            "err": "" if cinema_ok else cinema.text[:160],
        }
    )
    if cinema_ok:
        pkg = cinema.json()
        package_id = pkg.get("package_id")
        results.append(
            {
                "method": "ASSERT",
                "path": "cinema.validation_passed",
                "code": 200 if pkg.get("validation_passed") else 0,
                "pass": bool(pkg.get("validation_passed")),
                "err": "" if pkg.get("validation_passed") else str(pkg.get("validation"))[:160],
            }
        )
        vids = [d for d in (pkg.get("deliverables") or []) if d.get("modality") == "video"]
        mp4ish = any(d.get("is_mp4") or str(d.get("file") or "").endswith(".mp4") for d in vids)
        results.append(
            {
                "method": "ASSERT",
                "path": "cinema.mp4_masters",
                "code": 200 if mp4ish else 0,
                "pass": mp4ish,
                "err": "" if mp4ish else "no mp4 channel masters",
            }
        )
        if package_id:
            check(
                "PATCH",
                f"/api/projects/{project_id}/cinema/packages/{package_id}/timeline",
                json_body={"music_gain_db": -1.0, "voice_gain_db": 0.5, "duck_music_under_vo": True},
            )
            check("GET", f"/api/projects/{project_id}/cinema/packages/{package_id}/zip")
            check("GET", f"/api/projects/{project_id}/cinema/packages/{package_id}/manifest")
        vos = [d for d in (pkg.get("deliverables") or []) if d.get("role") == "voiceover"]
        if vos:
            vo = vos[0]
            has_tx = bool(vo.get("transcript") or vo.get("transcript_job_id") or (pkg.get("campaign_manifest") or {}).get("voiceover_transcript"))
            results.append(
                {
                    "method": "ASSERT",
