"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { api, type Project } from "@/lib/api";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/EmptyState";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/PageHeader";
import { SiteHeader } from "@/components/SiteHeader";

export default function AdvertisingHubPage() {
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<Project[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    api
      .listProjects()
      .then(setProjects)
      .catch((e) => setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to load"))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen pb-20">
      <SiteHeader />
      <div className="ac-container pt-10 md:pt-14">
        <PageHeader
          eyebrow="Art City Advertising"
          title="AI media campaigns for cinema & social"
          description="Model Gateway builds broadcast, vertical, and square films with music, voice-over, end card, cultural KB enrichment, technical QC, and Publish-ready ZIP masters."
        />

        <div className="mb-12 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-4 animate-rise-delay">
          {[
            ["Video", "16:9 · 9:16 · 1:1 cutdowns"],
            ["Audio", "Music bed · SFX · stems"],
            ["Voice", "Dialect-aware VO takes"],
            ["Cinema", "Manifest · QC · ZIP · Publish"],
          ].map(([t, d]) => (
            <div key={t} className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[rgba(10,15,22,0.4)] p-5">
              <p className="ac-display text-[var(--gold-bright)]">{t}</p>
              <p className="ac-serif mt-2 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">{d}</p>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="mb-8 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
          <Link href="/cinema" className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary">
            Open Cinema floor
          </Link>
          <Link href="/studio" className="ac-btn ac-btn-secondary">
            Studio singles
          </Link>
          <Link href="/edit" className="ac-btn ac-btn-secondary">
            Art City Edit
          </Link>
          <Link href="/publish" className="ac-btn ac-btn-ghost">
            Publish masters
          </Link>
        </div>

        {loading ? (
          <p className="text-[var(--mist)]">Loading projects…</p>
        ) : error ? (
          <p className="text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p>
        ) : projects.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            title="No projects yet"
            description="Create a project, then render a full advertising package in Cinema."
            action={
              <Link href="/projects" className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary">
                Projects
              </Link>
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <ul className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
            {projects.map((p) => (
              <li key={p.id}>
                <Link
                  href={`/cinema/${p.id}`}
                  className="block border border-[var(--line)] px-5 py-5 transition hover:border-[var(--gold)]"
                >
                  <p className="ac-display text-lg text-[var(--paper)]">{p.name}</p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">
                    Render advertising campaign → Cinema
                  </p>
                </Link>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

frontend/src/app/cinema/[id]/page.tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { FormEvent, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useParams } from "next/navigation";
import {
  api,
  mediaAbsolute,
  type CinemaDeliverable,
  type CinemaPackage,
  type Project,
} from "@/lib/api";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/EmptyState";
import { SiteHeader } from "@/components/SiteHeader";

function DeliverableCard({ item }: { item: CinemaDeliverable }) {
  const media = mediaAbsolute(item.mp4_url || item.media_url);
  const audio = mediaAbsolute(item.audio_url);
  const isVisual = item.modality === "video" || item.modality === "image";
  const isMp4 = Boolean(item.is_mp4 || item.file?.endsWith(".mp4") || item.mp4_url);

  return (
    <article className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[rgba(10,15,22,0.5)] p-4 md:p-5">
      <div className="mb-3 flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
        <p className="ac-display text-[var(--paper)]">{item.label ?? item.role}</p>
        <span className="ac-display text-[0.65rem] tracking-[0.16em] text-[var(--mist-soft)] uppercase">
          {item.variant ? `${item.variant} · ` : ""}
          {isMp4 ? "MP4 · " : ""}
          {item.aspect ?? item.modality}
        </span>
      </div>
      {isVisual && media && isMp4 ? (
        <video
          controls
          src={media}
          className={`w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-black object-cover ${
            item.aspect === "9:16"
              ? "aspect-[9/16] max-h-[28rem] mx-auto"
              : item.aspect === "1:1"
                ? "aspect-square max-h-[22rem] mx-auto"
                : "aspect-video"
          }`}
        />
      ) : null}
      {isVisual && media && !isMp4 ? (
        // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
        <img
          src={media}
          alt={item.label ?? "Cinema deliverable"}
          className={`w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-black object-cover ${
            item.aspect === "9:16"
              ? "aspect-[9/16] max-h-[28rem] mx-auto"
              : item.aspect === "1:1"
                ? "aspect-square max-h-[22rem] mx-auto"
                : "aspect-video"
          }`}
        />
      ) : null}
      {(audio || (!isVisual && media)) && (
        <audio controls src={audio ?? media ?? undefined} className="mt-3 w-full">
          Audio preview
        </audio>
      )}
      {item.role === "voiceover" && item.transcript?.segments?.length ? (
        <div className="mt-4 border-t border-[var(--line)] pt-3">
          <p className="text-[0.65rem] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist)]">
            VO transcript · {item.transcript.dialect} · conf {item.transcript.average_confidence}
          </p>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-[var(--paper-dim)]">
            {item.transcript.segments
              .slice(0, 3)
              .map((s) => s.text)
              .join(" ")}
            {item.transcript.segments.length > 3 ? "…" : ""}
          </p>
          {item.transcript_job_id ? (
            <p className="mt-1 font-mono text-[0.65rem] text-[var(--mist-soft)]">
              ASR {item.transcript_job_id.slice(0, 8)}
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </article>
  );
}

export default function CinemaProjectPage() {
  const params = useParams();
  const projectId = String(params.id);

  const [project, setProject] = useState<Project | null>(null);
  const [packages, setPackages] = useState<CinemaPackage[]>([]);
  const [activeId, setActiveId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [campaign, setCampaign] = useState("");
  const [brief, setBrief] = useState("");
  const [cta, setCta] = useState("Watch the story");
  const [vo, setVo] = useState("");
  const [musicStyle, setMusicStyle] = useState<"epic" | "warm" | "pulse" | "soft">("epic");
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState(15);
  const [dialect, setDialect] = useState("sorani");
  const [characterKey, setCharacterKey] = useState("");
  const [channels, setChannels] = useState<string[]>([
    "broadcast",
    "social_vertical",
    "social_square",
  ]);
  const [variants, setVariants] = useState<string[]>(["A"]);
  const [deliveryTargets, setDeliveryTargets] = useState<string[]>([
    "youtube",
    "meta_stories",
    "broadcast_tv",
  ]);
  const [musicGain, setMusicGain] = useState(0);
  const [voiceGain, setVoiceGain] = useState(0);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const [p, pkgs] = await Promise.all([
        api.getProject(projectId),
        api.listCinemaPackages(projectId),
      ]);
      setProject(p);
      setPackages(pkgs);
      if (!activeId && pkgs[0]) setActiveId(pkgs[0].package_id);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to open cinema");
      setProject(null);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [projectId, activeId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [projectId]);

  const active = useMemo(
    () => packages.find((p) => p.package_id === activeId) ?? packages[0] ?? null,
    [packages, activeId]
  );

  async function onRender(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!campaign.trim() || !brief.trim()) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const pkg = await api.createCinemaPackage(projectId, {
        campaign: campaign.trim(),
        brief: brief.trim(),
        cta: cta.trim() || "Discover more",
        brand: "Art City",
        voiceover_script: vo.trim() || undefined,
        music_style: musicStyle,
        duration_seconds: duration,
        initiated_by: "art-city-producer",
        dialect,
        character_key: characterKey || undefined,
        character_name: characterKey
          ? characterKey === "kardokh"
            ? "Kardokh"
            : characterKey === "kurdiya"
              ? "Kurdiya"
              : undefined
          : undefined,
        channels,
        variants,
        delivery_targets: deliveryTargets,
      });
      setActiveId(pkg.package_id);
      if (pkg.timeline?.mix) {
        setMusicGain(Number(pkg.timeline.mix.music_gain_db ?? 0));
        setVoiceGain(Number(pkg.timeline.mix.voice_gain_db ?? 0));
      }
      setCampaign("");
      setBrief("");
      const pkgs = await api.listCinemaPackages(projectId);
      setPackages(pkgs);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Package render failed");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen pb-24">
      <SiteHeader />
      <div className="ac-container pt-8 md:pt-12">
        {loading ? (
          <p className="py-16 text-[0.8rem] tracking-[0.18em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase">
            Opening cinema…
          </p>
        ) : !project ? (
          <EmptyState
            title="Cinema unavailable"
            description={error ?? "Project not found."}
            action={
              <Link href="/cinema" className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary">
                Back to cinema
              </Link>
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="mb-10 animate-rise">
              <Link
                href="/cinema"
                className="ac-display text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.28em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase transition hover:text-[var(--gold-bright)]"
              >
                ← Cinema floor
              </Link>
              <h1 className="ac-display mt-4 text-[clamp(2rem,5vw,3.6rem)] tracking-tight">
                {project.name}
              </h1>
              <p className="ac-serif mt-3 max-w-2xl text-[1.05rem] text-[var(--mist)]">
                Art City Cinema builds complete advertising campaigns with technical QC —
                not single Studio takes.
              </p>
              <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                <Link href={`/publish/${projectId}`} className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary">
                  Publish masters
                </Link>
                <Link href={`/studio/${projectId}`} className="ac-btn ac-btn-secondary">
                  Art City Studio
                </Link>
                <Link href={`/hub/${projectId}/script`} className="ac-btn ac-btn-secondary">
                  Production Hub
                </Link>
                <Link href="/edit" className="ac-btn ac-btn-secondary">
                  Art City Edit
                </Link>
                <Link href={`/projects/${projectId}`} className="ac-btn ac-btn-ghost">
                  Project desk
                </Link>
              </div>
            </div>

            {error ? <p className="mb-6 text-sm text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p> : null}

            <div className="grid gap-10 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,0.95fr)_minmax(0,1.15fr)]">
              <form
                onSubmit={onRender}
                className="space-y-5 border border-[var(--line)] bg-[rgba(10,15,22,0.5)] p-5 md:p-6 animate-rise-delay"
              >
                <div>
                  <p className="ac-display text-xl text-[var(--gold-bright)]">Campaign brief</p>
                  <p className="ac-serif mt-1 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">
                    One render builds the full cinema advertising set.
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="ac-label" htmlFor="campaign">
                    Campaign name
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="campaign"
                    className="ac-field"
                    value={campaign}
                    onChange={(e) => setCampaign(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Kardokh & Kurdiya · Homecoming"
                    required
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="ac-label" htmlFor="brief">
                    Creative brief
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    id="brief"
                    className="ac-textarea"
                    rows={5}
                    value={brief}
                    onChange={(e) => setBrief(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Golden-hour village paths, childhood wonder, warm family reunion… cinematic, emotional, premium advertising tone."
                    required
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="ac-label" htmlFor="cta">
                    Call to action
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="cta"
                    className="ac-field"
                    value={cta}
                    onChange={(e) => setCta(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Watch the story"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="ac-label" htmlFor="vo">
                    Voiceover script (optional)
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    id="vo"
                    className="ac-textarea min-h-[6rem]"
                    value={vo}
                    onChange={(e) => setVo(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="In every homecoming, a new adventure begins…"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
                  <div>
                    <label className="ac-label" htmlFor="style">
                      Music style
                    </label>
                    <select
                      id="style"
                      className="ac-field"
                      value={musicStyle}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setMusicStyle(e.target.value as "epic" | "warm" | "pulse" | "soft")
                      }
                    >
                      <option value="epic">Epic cinematic</option>
                      <option value="warm">Warm emotional</option>
                      <option value="pulse">Modern pulse</option>
                      <option value="soft">Soft intimate</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="ac-label" htmlFor="duration">
                      Spot length (sec)
                    </label>
                    <input
                      id="duration"
                      type="number"
                      min={5}
                      max={60}
                      className="ac-field"
                      value={duration}
                      onChange={(e) => setDuration(Number(e.target.value))}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="ac-label" htmlFor="dialect">
                      Kurdish dialect
                    </label>
                    <select
                      id="dialect"
                      className="ac-field"
                      value={dialect}
                      onChange={(e) => setDialect(e.target.value)}
                    >
                      <option value="sorani">Sorani</option>
                      <option value="badini">Badini</option>
                      <option value="kurmanji">Kurmanji</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="ac-label" htmlFor="character">
                      Character focus
                    </label>
                    <select
                      id="character"
                      className="ac-field"
                      value={characterKey}
                      onChange={(e) => setCharacterKey(e.target.value)}
                    >
                      <option value="">Brand general</option>
                      <option value="kardokh">Kardokh</option>
                      <option value="kurdiya">Kurdiya</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <fieldset className="space-y-2">
                  <legend className="ac-label">Advertising channels</legend>
                  {[
                    ["broadcast", "Broadcast 16:9"],
                    ["social_vertical", "Social vertical 9:16"],
                    ["social_square", "Social square 1:1"],
                  ].map(([id, label]) => (
                    <label key={id} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={channels.includes(id)}
                        onChange={(e) => {
                          setChannels((prev) =>
                            e.target.checked
                              ? [...prev, id]
                              : prev.filter((c) => c !== id)
                          );
                        }}
                      />
                      {label}
                    </label>
                  ))}
                </fieldset>
                <fieldset className="space-y-2">
                  <legend className="ac-label">A/B variants</legend>
                  {[
                    ["A", "A · Control"],
                    ["B", "B · Alt CTA"],
                    ["C", "C · Alt music"],
                  ].map(([id, label]) => (
                    <label key={id} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={variants.includes(id)}
                        onChange={(e) => {
                          setVariants((prev) => {
                            const next = e.target.checked
                              ? [...prev, id]
                              : prev.filter((c) => c !== id);
                            return next.length ? next : ["A"];
                          });
                        }}
                      />
                      {label}
                    </label>
                  ))}
                </fieldset>
                <fieldset className="space-y-2">
                  <legend className="ac-label">World delivery targets</legend>
                  {[
                    ["youtube", "YouTube"],
                    ["meta_feed", "Meta Feed"],
                    ["meta_stories", "Meta / TikTok Stories"],
                    ["broadcast_tv", "Broadcast / TV"],
                    ["ctv", "CTV"],
                  ].map(([id, label]) => (
                    <label key={id} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={deliveryTargets.includes(id)}
                        onChange={(e) => {
                          setDeliveryTargets((prev) =>
                            e.target.checked
                              ? [...prev, id]
                              : prev.filter((c) => c !== id)
                          );
                        }}
                      />
                      {label}
                    </label>
                  ))}
                </fieldset>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={busy || channels.length === 0}
                  className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary"
                >
                  {busy ? "Rendering package…" : "Render full advertising package"}
                </button>
              </form>

              <section className="animate-rise-late">
                <div className="mb-5 flex items-end justify-between gap-3">
                  <h2 className="ac-display text-lg text-[var(--paper)]">Packages</h2>
                  <span className="text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist-soft)] uppercase">
                    {packages.length} rendered
                  </span>
                </div>

                {packages.length === 0 ? (
                  <EmptyState
                    title="No cinema packages yet"
                    description="Fill the campaign brief and render. Art City will deliver broadcast, vertical, square, music, VO, and end card."
                  />
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <ul className="mb-8 border-t border-[var(--line)]">
                      {packages.map((pkg) => (
                        <li key={pkg.package_id}>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setActiveId(pkg.package_id)}
                            className={`ac-row w-full py-4 text-left ${
                              active?.package_id === pkg.package_id
                                ? "bg-[rgba(197,161,94,0.06)]"
                                : ""
                            }`}
                          >
                            <p className="ac-display text-lg">{pkg.campaign}</p>
                            <p className="mt-1 text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--mist-soft)] uppercase">
                              {pkg.duration_seconds}s · {pkg.music_style} · $
                              {pkg.total_cost.toFixed(2)}
                            </p>
                          </button>
                          <div className="ac-rule" />
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>

                    {active ? (
                      <div className="space-y-8">
                        <div className="mb-2">
                          <p className="ac-display text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.2em] text-[var(--gold)] uppercase">
                            Art City Cinema
                          </p>
                          <p className="ac-display mt-2 text-2xl text-[var(--gold-bright)]">
                            {active.campaign}
                          </p>
                          <p className="ac-serif mt-2 text-[var(--mist)]">{active.brief}</p>
                          <p className="mt-3 text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist-soft)] uppercase">
                            CTA · {active.cta} · {active.duration_seconds}s · $
                            {active.total_cost.toFixed(2)} ·{" "}
                            {active.production_time_seconds ?? "—"}s render
                          </p>
                          {active.variants?.length ? (
                            <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">
                              Variants{" "}
                              {active.variants.map((v) => v.id).join(" · ")}
                              {active.delivery_targets?.length
                                ? ` · Delivery ${active.delivery_targets
                                    .map((d) => d.label || d.id)
                                    .join(", ")}`
                                : ""}
                            </p>
                          ) : null}
                          {active.timeline?.clips?.length ? (
                            <div className="mt-6 border border-[var(--line)] p-4">
                              <p className="ac-display text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.16em] text-[var(--gold)] uppercase">
                                Finishing timeline
                              </p>
                              <ul className="mt-3 space-y-2">
                                {active.timeline.clips.map((clip) => (
                                  <li
                                    key={clip.id}
                                    className="flex justify-between gap-3 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]"
                                  >
                                    <span>
                                      {clip.track} · {clip.label}
                                    </span>
                                    <span className="font-mono text-[0.7rem] text-[var(--mist-soft)]">
                                      {clip.start.toFixed(1)}–{clip.end.toFixed(1)}s
                                    </span>
                                  </li>
                                ))}
                              </ul>
                              <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                                <label className="text-xs text-[var(--mist)]">
                                  Music gain (dB)
                                  <input
                                    type="number"
                                    className="ac-field mt-1"
                                    value={musicGain}
                                    onChange={(e) => setMusicGain(Number(e.target.value))}
                                  />
                                </label>
                                <label className="text-xs text-[var(--mist)]">
                                  Voice gain (dB)
                                  <input
                                    type="number"
                                    className="ac-field mt-1"
                                    value={voiceGain}
                                    onChange={(e) => setVoiceGain(Number(e.target.value))}
                                  />
                                </label>
                              </div>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                className="ac-btn ac-btn-secondary mt-3"
                                onClick={async () => {
                                  try {
                                    const updated = await api.updateCinemaTimeline(
                                      projectId,
                                      active.package_id,
                                      {
                                        music_gain_db: musicGain,
                                        voice_gain_db: voiceGain,
                                        duck_music_under_vo: true,
                                      }
                                    );
                                    setPackages((prev) =>
                                      prev.map((p) =>
                                        p.package_id === updated.package_id ? updated : p
                                      )
                                    );
                                  } catch (err) {
                                    setError(
                                      err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Timeline update failed"
                                    );
                                  }
                                }}
                              >
                                Save mix
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          ) : null}
                          <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                            <span
                              className={`ac-display text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.14em] uppercase ${
                                active.validation_passed
                                  ? "text-emerald-300"
                                  : "text-[var(--danger)]"
                              }`}
                            >
                              QC {active.validation_passed ? "passed" : "failed"}
                            </span>
                            <a
                              href={api.cinemaZipUrl(projectId, active.package_id)}
                              className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary"
                            >
                              Download ZIP
                            </a>
                            <a
                              href={api.cinemaManifestUrl(projectId, active.package_id)}
                              target="_blank"
                              rel="noreferrer"
                              className="ac-btn ac-btn-secondary"
                            >
                              Manifest
                            </a>
                            <a
                              href={api.cinemaValidationUrl(projectId, active.package_id)}
                              target="_blank"
                              rel="noreferrer"
                              className="ac-btn ac-btn-ghost"
                            >
                              Validation JSON
                            </a>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              className="ac-btn ac-btn-ghost"
                              disabled={busy}
                              onClick={async () => {
                                setBusy(true);
                                try {
                                  const refreshed = await api.validateCinemaPackage(
                                    projectId,
                                    active.package_id
                                  );
                                  setPackages((prev) =>
                                    prev.map((p) =>
                                      p.package_id === refreshed.package_id ? refreshed : p
                                    )
                                  );
                                } catch (err) {
                                  setError(
                                    err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Revalidate failed"
                                  );
                                } finally {
                                  setBusy(false);
                                }
                              }}
                            >
                              Re-run QC
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {active.validation ? (
                          <div className="border border-[var(--line)] p-5">
                            <h3 className="ac-display text-lg text-[var(--paper)]">
                              Technical validation
                            </h3>
                            <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">
                              Completeness:{" "}
                              {active.validation.completeness?.passed ? "all six outputs" : "incomplete"}
                            </p>
                            <ul className="mt-4 space-y-3">
                              {active.validation.deliverables.map((d) => (
                                <li key={d.role} className="border-t border-[var(--line)] pt-3">
                                  <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
                                    <p className="ac-display text-[var(--paper)]">{d.role}</p>
                                    <span
                                      className={`text-[0.65rem] tracking-[0.14em] uppercase ${
                                        d.passed ? "text-emerald-300" : "text-[var(--danger)]"
                                      }`}
                                    >
                                      {d.passed ? "pass" : "fail"}
                                    </span>
                                  </div>
                                  <ul className="mt-2 space-y-1">
                                    {d.checks.map((c) => (
                                      <li
                                        key={`${d.role}-${c.id}`}
                                        className={`text-xs ${
                                          c.passed ? "text-[var(--mist-soft)]" : "text-[var(--danger)]"
                                        }`}
                                      >
                                        {c.passed ? "✓" : "✗"} {c.label}
                                        {!c.passed
                                          ? ` · expected ${String(c.expected)} / actual ${String(c.actual)}`
                                          : ""}
                                      </li>
                                    ))}
                                  </ul>
                                </li>
                              ))}
                            </ul>
                          </div>
                        ) : null}

                        <div className="grid gap-5">
                          {active.deliverables.map((d) => (
                            <DeliverableCard key={d.job_id} item={d} />
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ) : null}
                  </>
                )}
              </section>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

frontend/src/app/cinema/page.tsx
"use client";



import Link from "next/link";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { api, type Project } from "@/lib/api";

import { EmptyState } from "@/components/EmptyState";

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/PageHeader";

import { SiteHeader } from "@/components/SiteHeader";



export default function CinemaHubPage() {

  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<Project[]>([]);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);



  useEffect(() => {

    api

      .listProjects()

      .then(setProjects)

      .catch((e) => setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to load"))

      .finally(() => setLoading(false));

  }, []);



  return (

    <main className="min-h-screen pb-20">

      <SiteHeader />

      <div className="ac-container pt-10 md:pt-14">

        <PageHeader

          eyebrow="Art City Cinema"

          title="Complete advertising campaigns"

          description="Hero film, social adaptations, music, voice-over, end card, campaign manifest, technical QC, and downloadable ZIP — not single assets."

        />



        <div className="mb-12 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3 animate-rise-delay">

          {[

            ["Campaign outputs", "Hero · 9:16 · 1:1 · music · VO · end card"],

            ["Technical QC", "Duration · aspect · loudness · SHA-256"],

            ["Delivery", "Manifest · validation JSON · ZIP package"],

          ].map(([t, d]) => (

            <div key={t} className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[rgba(10,15,22,0.4)] p-5">

              <p className="ac-display text-[var(--gold-bright)]">{t}</p>

              <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">{d}</p>

            </div>

          ))}

        </div>



        {loading ? (

          <p className="text-[0.8rem] tracking-[0.18em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase">

            Loading productions…

          </p>

        ) : error ? (

          <p className="text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p>

        ) : projects.length === 0 ? (

          <EmptyState

            title="No campaigns ready"

            description="Create a project, then open Cinema to render a full advertising package."

            action={

              <Link href="/projects" className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary">

                Create project

              </Link>

            }

          />

        ) : (

          <ul className="border-t border-[var(--line)]">

            {projects.map((p, i) => (

              <li key={p.id} className="ac-row">

                <Link

                  href={`/cinema/${p.id}`}

                  className="group grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr_auto] items-baseline gap-4 py-7 md:gap-8"

                >

                  <span className="ac-display w-8 text-[0.75rem] tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist-soft)]">

                    {String(i + 1).padStart(2, "0")}

                  </span>

                  <div>

                    <p className="ac-display text-2xl tracking-tight transition group-hover:text-[var(--gold-bright)]">

                      {p.name}

                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-2 text-[0.72rem] tracking-[0.16em] text-[var(--mist-soft)] uppercase">

                      Cinema · Advertising · Music · Cutdowns

                    </p>

                  </div>

                  <span className="ac-display text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.18em] text-[var(--gold)] uppercase">

                    Render →

                  </span>

                </Link>

                <div className="ac-rule" />

              </li>

            ))}

          </ul>

        )}

      </div>

    </main>

  );

}

frontend/src/app/dashboard/page.tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { CoreShell } from "@/components/CoreShell";
import { api } from "@/lib/api";

export default function DashboardPage() {
  const [providers, setProviders] = useState<{ name: string; healthy: boolean }[]>([]);
  const [models, setModels] = useState(0);
  const [datasets, setDatasets] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    Promise.all([api.listProviders(), api.listRegistryModels(), api.listDatasets()])
      .then(([p, m, d]) => {
        setProviders(p);
        setModels(m.length);
        setDatasets(d.length);
      })
      .catch(() => undefined);
  }, []);

  return (
    <CoreShell
      title="Dashboard"
      subtitle="Cinema · Studio · Vertical Drama · Edit · Hub · Publish — with Model Gateway, Data Lab, and owned inference control."
    >
      <div className="grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-3">
        <Stat label="Registered models" value={String(models)} />
        <Stat label="Datasets" value={String(datasets)} />
        <Stat
          label="Providers healthy"
          value={`${providers.filter((p) => p.healthy).length}/${providers.length || 0}`}
        />
      </div>
      <div className="mt-10 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        {[
          ["/vertical-drama", "Vertical Drama", "IP Factory · bible · episodes · 9:16"],
          ["/hub", "Production Hub", "AC Script · breakdown · handoff"],
          ["/cinema", "Cinema", "Complete advertising campaigns"],
          ["/studio", "Studio", "Individual production assets"],
          ["/data-bank", "Data Bank", "Project media vault · upload · sync"],
          ["/edit", "Edit", "Long-form to social clips"],
          ["/publish", "Publish", "Masters · QC · release"],
        ].map(([href, label, blurb]) => (
          <Link
            key={href}
            href={href}
            className="border border-[var(--line)] px-4 py-5 transition hover:border-[var(--gold)]"
          >
            <p className="text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--gold-bright)]">{label}</p>
            <p className="mt-2 text-[0.8rem] leading-snug text-[var(--mist)]">{blurb}</p>
          </Link>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-6 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        {[
          ["/data-lab", "Data Lab"],
          ["/data-lab/annotations", "Annotations"],
          ["/models", "Models"],
          ["/training", "Training"],
          ["/knowledge", "Knowledge"],
          ["/speech", "Speech"],
          ["/rights", "Rights"],
          ["/evaluations", "Evaluations"],
        ].map(([href, label]) => (
          <Link
            key={href}
            href={href}
            className="border border-[var(--line)] px-4 py-5 text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--paper-dim)] transition hover:border-[var(--gold)] hover:text-[var(--gold-bright)]"
          >
            {label}
          </Link>
        ))}
      </div>
    </CoreShell>
  );
}

function Stat({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="border border-[var(--line)] px-5 py-6">
      <p className="text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-[var(--mist)]">{label}</p>
      <p className="mt-3 font-[family-name:var(--font-display)] text-3xl text-[var(--paper)]">
        {value}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

frontend/src/app/data-bank/page.tsx
"use client";



import Link from "next/link";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { api, type DataBankHub, type DataBankSeed } from "@/lib/api";

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/PageHeader";

import { SiteHeader } from "@/components/SiteHeader";



export default function DataBankHubPage() {

  const [hub, setHub] = useState<DataBankHub | null>(null);

  const [seed, setSeed] = useState<DataBankSeed | null>(null);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);



  async function load() {

    setLoading(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      setHub(await api.dataBankHub());

    } catch (e) {

      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to load data bank");

    } finally {

      setLoading(false);

    }

  }



  useEffect(() => {

    void load();

  }, []);



  async function onSeed() {

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      const result = await api.seedDataBank();

      setSeed(result);

      await load();

    } catch (e) {

      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Seed failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  }



  return (

    <main className="min-h-screen pb-20">

      <SiteHeader />

      <div className="ac-container pt-10 md:pt-14">

        <PageHeader

          eyebrow="Art City Data Bank"

          title="Project media vault"

          description="Browse, upload, and sync production assets for every project — Studio generations, stills, and reference files in one bank."

          actions={

            <button type="button" className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void onSeed()}>

              {busy ? "Seeding…" : "Seed bank + bank building still"}

            </button>

          }

        />



        {loading ? (

          <p className="text-[0.8rem] tracking-[0.18em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase">Opening vault…</p>

        ) : error ? (

          <p className="text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p>

        ) : (

          <>

            <div className="mb-10 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">

              <Stat label="Projects with assets" value={String(hub?.projects_with_assets ?? 0)} />

              <Stat label="Total bank assets" value={String(hub?.total_assets ?? 0)} />

              <Stat

                label="Central bank"

                value={hub?.bank_project_id ? "Ready" : "Not seeded"}

              />

            </div>



            {seed ? (

              <p className="mb-8 text-sm text-[var(--mist-soft)]">

                Seeded project <span className="text-[var(--gold)]">{seed.project.name}</span> · job{" "}

                {seed.seed_status} · assets {seed.summary.total}

                {seed.project.id ? (

                  <>

                    {" · "}

                    <Link

                      href={`/projects/${seed.project.id}/data-bank`}

                      className="text-[var(--gold)]"

                    >

                      Open bank →

                    </Link>

                  </>

                ) : null}

              </p>

            ) : null}



            {!hub?.projects.length ? (

              <p className="text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

                No project assets yet. Seed the central bank or open a project and upload files.

              </p>

            ) : (

              <ul className="border-t border-[var(--line)]">

                {hub.projects.map((p) => (

                  <li key={p.project_id} className="ac-row">

                    <Link

                      href={`/projects/${p.project_id}/data-bank`}

                      className="group grid grid-cols-[1fr_auto] items-baseline gap-4 py-6"

                    >

                      <div>

                        <p className="ac-display text-2xl tracking-tight transition group-hover:text-[var(--gold-bright)]">

                          {p.name}

                        </p>

                        <p className="mt-2 text-[0.72rem] tracking-[0.16em] text-[var(--mist-soft)] uppercase">

                          {p.total} assets · {Object.keys(p.by_type).join(" · ") || "mixed"}

                        </p>

                      </div>

                      <span className="ac-display text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.18em] text-[var(--gold)] uppercase">

                        Enter →

                      </span>

                    </Link>

                    <div className="ac-rule" />

                  </li>

                ))}

              </ul>

            )}



            {hub?.bank_project_id ? (

              <p className="mt-10">

                <Link

                  href={`/projects/${hub.bank_project_id}/data-bank`}

                  className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary"

                >

                  Open Art City Data Bank project

                </Link>

              </p>

            ) : null}

          </>

        )}

      </div>

    </main>

  );

}



function Stat({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {

  return (

    <div className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[rgba(10,15,22,0.35)] px-5 py-5">

      <p className="ac-display text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.18em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase">{label}</p>

      <p className="ac-display mt-2 text-3xl tracking-tight text-[var(--paper)]">{value}</p>

    </div>

  );

}


frontend/src/app/data-lab/[id]/page.tsx
"use client";



import Link from "next/link";

import { useParams } from "next/navigation";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { CoreShell } from "@/components/CoreShell";

import { api, type DatasetDetail, type DatasetFile } from "@/lib/api";

import { getAccessToken } from "@/lib/auth";



const API_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ?? "http://localhost:8000";



const STATUS_OPTIONS = [

  "needs_review",

  "verified",

  "training_ready",

  "evaluation_only",

  "reference_only",

  "blocked",

  "archived",

];



function triggerDownload(blob: Blob, filename: string) {

  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

  const a = document.createElement("a");

  a.href = url;

  a.download = filename;

  a.click();

  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

}



export default function DatasetDetailPage() {

  const params = useParams();

  const datasetId = String(params.id);

  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<DatasetDetail | null>(null);

  const [files, setFiles] = useState<DatasetFile[]>([]);

  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [previewUrl, setPreviewUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [previewName, setPreviewName] = useState<string | null>(null);



  async function load() {

    try {

      const [d, f] = await Promise.all([

        api.getDatasetDetail(datasetId),

        api.listDatasetFiles(datasetId),

      ]);

      setDetail(d);

      setFiles(f);

    } catch (err) {

      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Load failed");

    }

  }



  useEffect(() => {

    void load();

    return () => {

      if (previewUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl);

    };

    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  }, [datasetId]);



  async function setStatus(status: string) {

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      await api.updateDatasetStatus(datasetId, status);

      await load();

    } catch (err) {

      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Status update failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  }



  async function onExport(format: "jsonl" | "csv") {

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      const blob = await api.exportDataset(datasetId, format, true);

      triggerDownload(blob, `${detail?.name || "dataset"}-export.${format}`);

    } catch (err) {

      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Export failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  }



  async function onManifest() {

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      const manifest = await api.getDatasetManifest(datasetId);

      const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });

      triggerDownload(blob, `${detail?.name || "dataset"}-manifest.json`);

    } catch (err) {

      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Manifest failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  }



  async function previewFile(file: DatasetFile) {

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      if (previewUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl);

      const token = getAccessToken();

      const headers: Record<string, string> = {};

      if (token) headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;

      const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}${file.media_url}`, { headers, cache: "no-store" });

      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Preview failed (${res.status})`);

      const blob = await res.blob();

      setPreviewUrl(URL.createObjectURL(blob));

      setPreviewName(file.filename);

    } catch (err) {

      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Preview failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  }



  if (!detail && !error) {

    return (

      <CoreShell title="Dataset" subtitle="Loading…">

        <p className="text-[var(--mist)]">Loading dataset…</p>

      </CoreShell>

    );

  }



  if (!detail) {

    return (

      <CoreShell title="Dataset" subtitle="Not found">

        <p className="text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p>

        <Link href="/data-lab" className="mt-4 inline-block text-[var(--gold-bright)]">

          Back to Data Lab

        </Link>

      </CoreShell>

    );

  }



  return (

    <CoreShell title={detail.name} subtitle={`${detail.status} · ${detail.media_type} · v${detail.version}`}>

      <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3">

        <Link

          href="/data-lab"

          className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-1.5 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--paper-dim)]"

        >

          All datasets

        </Link>

        <Link

          href={`/data-lab/annotations?dataset=${detail.id}`}

          className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-1.5 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--paper-dim)]"

        >

          Annotations

        </Link>

        <Link

          href="/rights"

          className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-1.5 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--paper-dim)]"

        >

          Rights

        </Link>

      </div>



      {error ? <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p> : null}



      <div className="mb-8 grid gap-4 border border-[var(--line)] p-5 md:grid-cols-3">

        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

          Files <span className="text-[var(--paper)]">{detail.file_count}</span>

        </p>

        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

          Approved labels <span className="text-[var(--paper)]">{detail.approved_annotations}</span>

        </p>

        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

          Pending <span className="text-[var(--paper)]">{detail.pending_annotations}</span>

        </p>

        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--mist)] md:col-span-3">

          Language {detail.language || "—"} · dialect {detail.dialect || "—"} ·{" "}

          {detail.record_count} records · {detail.size_bytes ?? 0} bytes

        </p>

        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--mist)] md:col-span-3">

          Rights:{" "}

          {detail.rights

            ? `${detail.rights.legal_status} · ${detail.rights.copyright_owner}${

                detail.rights.ai_training ? " · AI training" : ""

              }`

            : "none on file — attach via Rights before training_ready"}

        </p>

      </div>



      <div className="mb-8 flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3 border border-[var(--line)] p-5">

        <label className="text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

          Status

          <select

            value={detail.status}

            disabled={busy}

            onChange={(e) => void setStatus(e.target.value)}

            className="mt-1 block min-w-[12rem] border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

          >

            {Array.from(new Set([detail.status, ...STATUS_OPTIONS])).map((s) => (

              <option key={s} value={s}>

                {s}

              </option>

            ))}

          </select>

        </label>

        <button

          type="button"

          disabled={busy}

          onClick={() => void onExport("jsonl")}

          className="border border-[var(--gold)] px-3 py-2 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--gold-bright)]"

        >

          Export JSONL

        </button>

        <button

          type="button"

          disabled={busy}

          onClick={() => void onExport("csv")}

          className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--paper-dim)]"

        >

          Export CSV

        </button>

        <button

          type="button"

          disabled={busy}

          onClick={() => void onManifest()}

          className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--paper-dim)]"

        >

          Manifest

        </button>

      </div>



      {previewUrl ? (

        <div className="mb-8 border border-[var(--line)] p-4">

          <p className="mb-2 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--mist)]">

            Preview · {previewName}

          </p>

          {previewName?.match(/\.(png|jpe?g|gif|webp)$/i) ? (

            // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element

            <img src={previewUrl} alt={previewName || "preview"} className="max-h-80 border border-[var(--line)]" />

          ) : previewName?.match(/\.(wav|mp3|m4a|ogg)$/i) ? (

            <audio controls src={previewUrl} className="w-full" />

          ) : (

            <a href={previewUrl} download={previewName || "file"} className="text-[var(--gold-bright)]">

              Download preview

            </a>

          )}

        </div>

      ) : null}



      <p className="mb-3 text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist)]">

        File inventory

      </p>

      <ul className="space-y-2">

        {files.map((f) => (

          <li

            key={f.id}

            className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border border-[var(--line)] px-4 py-3 text-sm"

          >

            <div>

              <p className="text-[var(--paper)]">{f.filename}</p>

              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--mist)]">

                {f.media_type} · {f.size_bytes} bytes · {f.rights_status}

                {f.duration_seconds != null ? ` · ${f.duration_seconds.toFixed(1)}s` : ""}

              </p>

            </div>

            <button

              type="button"

              disabled={busy}

              onClick={() => void previewFile(f)}

              className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-1 text-[0.65rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--gold-bright)]"

            >

              Preview

            </button>

          </li>

        ))}

        {!files.length ? (

          <li className="text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">No files ingested yet.</li>

        ) : null}

      </ul>

    </CoreShell>

  );

}


frontend/src/app/data-lab/annotations/page.tsx
"use client";



import Link from "next/link";

import { FormEvent, Suspense, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";

import { CoreShell } from "@/components/CoreShell";

import {

  api,

  type AnnotationStats,

  type AnnotationTask,

  type Dataset,

} from "@/lib/api";



type EditState = {

  text: string;

  dialect: string;

  translation: string;

  speaker: string;

  consent: boolean;

  comment: string;

};



function AnnotationsWorkspace() {

  const search = useSearchParams();

  const initialDataset = search.get("dataset") || "";



  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState<AnnotationTask[]>([]);

  const [datasets, setDatasets] = useState<Dataset[]>([]);

  const [stats, setStats] = useState<AnnotationStats | null>(null);

  const [datasetId, setDatasetId] = useState(initialDataset);

  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState("");

  const [filterMedia, setFilterMedia] = useState("");

  const [text, setText] = useState("");

  const [dialect, setDialect] = useState("sorani");

  const [translation, setTranslation] = useState("");

  const [mediaType, setMediaType] = useState("speech");

  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [edits, setEdits] = useState<Record<string, EditState>>({});



  const datasetName = useMemo(() => {

    const map = Object.fromEntries(datasets.map((d) => [d.id, d.name]));

    return (id: string) => map[id] || id.slice(0, 8);

  }, [datasets]);



  function load() {

    Promise.all([

      api.listAnnotations({

        dataset_id: datasetId || undefined,

        status: filterStatus || undefined,

        media_type: filterMedia || undefined,

      }),

      api.listDatasets(),

      api.annotationStats(datasetId || undefined),

    ])

      .then(([a, d, s]) => {

        setTasks(a);

        setDatasets(d);

        setStats(s);

        if (!datasetId && d[0]) setDatasetId(d[0].id);

        const next: Record<string, EditState> = {};

        for (const t of a) {

          const labels = (t.labels || {}) as {

            dialect?: string;

            translation?: string;

            speaker?: string;

            consent?: boolean;

          };

          const payload = t.payload as { text?: string };

          next[t.id] = {

            text: payload.text || "",

            dialect: labels.dialect || "sorani",

            translation: labels.translation || "",

            speaker: labels.speaker || "speaker_1",

            consent: Boolean(labels.consent),

            comment: "",

          };

        }

        setEdits(next);

      })

      .catch((err) => setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Load failed"));

  }



  useEffect(() => {

    load();

    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  }, [datasetId, filterStatus, filterMedia]);



  async function onCreate(e: FormEvent) {

    e.preventDefault();

    if (!datasetId || !text.trim()) return;

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      await api.createAnnotation({

        dataset_id: datasetId,

        media_type: mediaType,

        payload: { text: text.trim(), language: "ku" },

        labels: {

          dialect,

          translation: translation.trim() || null,

          source: "manual",

          speaker: "speaker_1",

          consent: false,

        },

      });

      setText("");

      setTranslation("");

      load();

    } catch (err) {

      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Create failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  }



  async function saveReview(task: AnnotationTask, status: string) {

    const edit = edits[task.id];

    if (!edit) return;

    if (status === "rejected" && !edit.comment.trim()) {

      setError("Comment required to reject");

      return;

    }

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      await api.updateAnnotation(task.id, {

        payload: { text: edit.text, language: "ku" },

        labels: {

          ...(task.labels || {}),

          dialect: edit.dialect,

          translation: edit.translation.trim() || null,

          speaker: edit.speaker,

          consent: edit.consent,

        },

        status,

        comment:

          edit.comment.trim() ||

          (status === "approved"

            ? "Approved in Annotations workspace"

            : status === "in_review"

              ? "Moved to review"

              : status === "conflict"

                ? "Marked conflict"

                : "Updated"),

      });

      load();

    } catch (err) {

      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Update failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  }



  function patchEdit(id: string, patch: Partial<EditState>) {

    setEdits((prev) => ({ ...prev, [id]: { ...prev[id], ...patch } }));

  }



  return (

    <>

      <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3">

        <Link

          href="/data-lab"

          className="border border-[var(--line)] px-4 py-2 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--paper-dim)]"

        >

          Data Lab

        </Link>

        {datasetId ? (

          <Link

            href={`/data-lab/${datasetId}`}

            className="border border-[var(--line)] px-4 py-2 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--paper-dim)]"

          >

            Dataset detail

          </Link>

        ) : null}

      </div>



      {error ? <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p> : null}



      {stats ? (

        <div className="mb-8 grid gap-3 border border-[var(--line)] p-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5">

          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

            Total <span className="text-[var(--paper)]">{stats.total}</span>

          </p>

          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

            Pending <span className="text-[var(--paper)]">{stats.by_status.pending ?? 0}</span>

          </p>

          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

            Approved <span className="text-[var(--paper)]">{stats.by_status.approved ?? 0}</span>

          </p>

          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

            ASR-sourced <span className="text-[var(--paper)]">{stats.asr_sourced}</span>

          </p>

          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

            Ingest <span className="text-[var(--paper)]">{stats.ingest_sourced}</span>

          </p>

        </div>

      ) : null}



      <div className="mb-6 grid gap-3 border border-[var(--line)] p-4 md:grid-cols-3">

        <select

          value={datasetId}

          onChange={(e) => setDatasetId(e.target.value)}

          className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

        >

          <option value="">All datasets</option>

          {datasets.map((d) => (

            <option key={d.id} value={d.id}>

              {d.name}

            </option>

          ))}

        </select>

        <select

          value={filterStatus}

          onChange={(e) => setFilterStatus(e.target.value)}

          className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

        >

          <option value="">All statuses</option>

          <option value="pending">pending</option>

          <option value="in_review">in_review</option>

          <option value="approved">approved</option>

          <option value="rejected">rejected</option>

          <option value="conflict">conflict</option>

        </select>

        <select

          value={filterMedia}

          onChange={(e) => setFilterMedia(e.target.value)}

          className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

        >

          <option value="">All media</option>

          <option value="speech">speech</option>

          <option value="text">text</option>

          <option value="subtitle">subtitle</option>

          <option value="image">image</option>

        </select>

      </div>



      <form onSubmit={onCreate} className="mb-10 grid gap-3 border border-[var(--line)] p-5 md:grid-cols-3">

        <select

          value={datasetId}

          onChange={(e) => setDatasetId(e.target.value)}

          className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

          required

        >

          {datasets.map((d) => (

            <option key={d.id} value={d.id}>

              {d.name}

            </option>

          ))}

        </select>

        <select

          value={mediaType}

          onChange={(e) => setMediaType(e.target.value)}

          className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

        >

          <option value="speech">speech</option>

          <option value="text">text</option>

          <option value="subtitle">subtitle</option>

        </select>

        <select

          value={dialect}

          onChange={(e) => setDialect(e.target.value)}

          className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

        >

          <option value="sorani">Sorani</option>

          <option value="badini">Badini</option>

          <option value="kurmanji">Kurmanji</option>

        </select>

        <textarea

          value={text}

          onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)}

          placeholder="Transcript / source text"

          rows={3}

          className="md:col-span-3 border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

          required

        />

        <input

          value={translation}

          onChange={(e) => setTranslation(e.target.value)}

          placeholder="Translation (optional)"

          className="md:col-span-3 border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

        />

        <button

          type="submit"

          disabled={busy || !datasetId}

          className="md:col-span-3 border border-[var(--gold)] px-4 py-2 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--gold-bright)] disabled:opacity-50"

        >

          {busy ? "Saving…" : "Create annotation task"}

        </button>

      </form>



      <ul className="space-y-4">

        {tasks.map((t) => {

          const labels = (t.labels || {}) as {

            dialect?: string;

            translation?: string;

            source?: string;

            source_job_id?: string;

            needs_transcript?: boolean;

            average_confidence?: number;

          };

          const edit = edits[t.id] || {

            text: "",

            dialect: "sorani",

            translation: "",

            speaker: "speaker_1",

            consent: false,

            comment: "",

          };

          const asrSourced = Boolean(

            labels.source_job_id || labels.source === "asr" || labels.source === "ingest"

          );

          const open = expanded === t.id;

          const comments = (t.comments || []) as { by?: string; text?: string; at?: string }[];

          const history = (t.revision_history || []) as {

            by?: string;

            at?: string;

            before_status?: string;

          }[];



          return (

            <li key={t.id} className="border border-[var(--line)] px-4 py-4">

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">

                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">

                  <p className="text-[var(--paper)]">

                    {t.media_type} · {t.status}

                    {asrSourced ? (

                      <span className="ml-2 text-[0.65rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--teal)]">

                        {labels.source_job_id ? "ASR" : labels.source || "ingest"}

                      </span>

                    ) : null}

                  </p>

                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[var(--mist-soft)]">

                    {datasetName(t.dataset_id)}

                    {labels.source_job_id ? ` · job ${labels.source_job_id.slice(0, 8)}` : ""}

                    {labels.average_confidence != null

                      ? ` · conf ${labels.average_confidence}`

                      : ""}

                  </p>

                  <textarea

                    value={edit.text}

                    onChange={(e) => patchEdit(t.id, { text: e.target.value })}

                    rows={3}

                    className="mt-3 w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-sm text-[var(--paper)]"

                    placeholder={labels.needs_transcript ? "Transcript pending" : "Transcript"}

                  />

                  <div className="mt-3 grid gap-2 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">

                    <select

                      value={edit.dialect}

                      onChange={(e) => patchEdit(t.id, { dialect: e.target.value })}

                      className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-2 py-1.5 text-sm text-[var(--paper)]"

                    >

                      <option value="sorani">Sorani</option>

                      <option value="badini">Badini</option>

                      <option value="kurmanji">Kurmanji</option>

                    </select>

                    <input

                      value={edit.translation}

                      onChange={(e) => patchEdit(t.id, { translation: e.target.value })}

                      placeholder="Translation"

                      className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-2 py-1.5 text-sm text-[var(--paper)]"

                    />

                    <input

                      value={edit.speaker}

                      onChange={(e) => patchEdit(t.id, { speaker: e.target.value })}

                      placeholder="Speaker"

                      className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-2 py-1.5 text-sm text-[var(--paper)]"

                    />

                    <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

                      <input

                        type="checkbox"

                        checked={edit.consent}

                        onChange={(e) => patchEdit(t.id, { consent: e.target.checked })}

                      />

                      Consent

                    </label>

                  </div>

                  <input

                    value={edit.comment}

                    onChange={(e) => patchEdit(t.id, { comment: e.target.value })}

                    placeholder="Review comment (required to reject)"

                    className="mt-2 w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-2 py-1.5 text-sm text-[var(--paper)]"

                  />

                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">

                  <button

                    type="button"

                    disabled={busy}

                    onClick={() => void saveReview(t, "in_review")}

                    className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-1 text-[0.65rem] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--paper-dim)]"

                  >

                    In review

                  </button>

                  <button

                    type="button"

                    disabled={busy}

                    onClick={() => void saveReview(t, "approved")}

                    className="border border-[var(--teal)] px-3 py-1 text-[0.65rem] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--teal)]"

                  >

                    Approve

                  </button>

                  <button

                    type="button"

                    disabled={busy}

                    onClick={() => void saveReview(t, "rejected")}

                    className="border border-[var(--danger)] px-3 py-1 text-[0.65rem] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--danger)]"

                  >

                    Reject

                  </button>

                  <button

                    type="button"

                    disabled={busy}

                    onClick={() => void saveReview(t, "conflict")}

                    className="border border-[var(--gold)] px-3 py-1 text-[0.65rem] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--gold-bright)]"

                  >

                    Conflict

                  </button>

                  <button

                    type="button"

                    onClick={() => setExpanded(open ? null : t.id)}

                    className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-1 text-[0.65rem] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist)]"

                  >

                    {open ? "Hide thread" : "Thread"}

                  </button>

                </div>

              </div>

              {open ? (

                <div className="mt-4 grid gap-4 border-t border-[var(--line)] pt-3 md:grid-cols-2">

                  <div>

                    <p className="text-[0.65rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--mist)]">

                      Comments

                    </p>

                    <ul className="mt-2 space-y-2 text-xs text-[var(--mist)]">

                      {comments.length ? (

                        comments.map((c, i) => (

                          <li key={`${t.id}-c-${i}`}>

                            <span className="text-[var(--paper-dim)]">{c.by}</span>: {c.text}

                          </li>

                        ))

                      ) : (

                        <li>No comments yet.</li>

                      )}

                    </ul>

                  </div>

                  <div>

                    <p className="text-[0.65rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--mist)]">

                      Revisions

                    </p>

                    <ul className="mt-2 space-y-2 text-xs text-[var(--mist)]">

                      {history.length ? (

                        history

                          .slice()

                          .reverse()

                          .slice(0, 8)

                          .map((h, i) => (

                            <li key={`${t.id}-h-${i}`}>

                              {h.at?.slice(0, 19)} · {h.by} · was {h.before_status}

                            </li>

                          ))

                      ) : (

                        <li>No revisions yet.</li>

                      )}

                    </ul>

                  </div>

                </div>

              ) : null}

            </li>

          );

        })}

        {!tasks.length ? (

          <li className="text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">No annotation tasks match filters.</li>

        ) : null}

      </ul>

    </>

  );

}



export default function AnnotationsPage() {

  return (

    <CoreShell

      title="Annotations"

      subtitle="Production review workspace — dialect, transcript, consent, approve / reject / conflict, export-ready labels."

    >

      <Suspense fallback={<p className="text-[var(--mist)]">Loading annotations…</p>}>

        <AnnotationsWorkspace />

      </Suspense>

    </CoreShell>

  );

}


frontend/src/app/data-lab/page.tsx
"use client";



import Link from "next/link";

import { FormEvent, useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { CoreShell } from "@/components/CoreShell";

import { api, type Dataset, type IngestionRun } from "@/lib/api";



export default function DataLabPage() {

  const [datasets, setDatasets] = useState<Dataset[]>([]);

  const [ingestions, setIngestions] = useState<IngestionRun[]>([]);

  const [datasetName, setDatasetName] = useState("");

  const [dialect, setDialect] = useState("sorani");

  const [lastReport, setLastReport] = useState<IngestionRun | null>(null);

  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);



  function load() {

    Promise.all([api.listDatasets(), api.listIngestions()])

      .then(([d, i]) => {

        setDatasets(d);

        setIngestions(i.slice(0, 8));

      })

      .catch((e) => setError(String(e.message || e)));

  }



  useEffect(() => {

    load();

  }, []);



  async function onIngest(e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {

    e.preventDefault();

    const form = e.currentTarget;

    const input = form.elements.namedItem("files") as HTMLInputElement;

    if (!input.files?.length) {

      setError("Select at least one file");

      return;

    }

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      const run = await api.ingestFiles({

        files: input.files,

        datasetName: datasetName.trim() || undefined,

        language: "ku",

        dialect,

      });

      setLastReport(run);

      input.value = "";

      setDatasetName("");

      load();

    } catch (err) {

      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Ingest failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  }



  return (

    <CoreShell

      title="Data Lab"

      subtitle="Ingest archives, review rights, annotate labels, and export training manifests. Upload is not training."

    >

      <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap gap-4">

        <Link

          href="/data-lab/annotations"

          className="border border-[var(--line)] px-4 py-2 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--paper-dim)]"

        >

          Annotations

        </Link>

        <Link

          href="/rights"

          className="border border-[var(--line)] px-4 py-2 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--paper-dim)]"

        >

          Rights

        </Link>

      </div>



      {error ? <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p> : null}



      <form onSubmit={onIngest} className="mb-10 space-y-3 border border-[var(--line)] p-5">

        <p className="text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist)]">

          Ingest files

        </p>

        <input

          value={datasetName}

          onChange={(e) => setDatasetName(e.target.value)}

          placeholder="New dataset name (optional)"

          className="w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

        />

        <select

          value={dialect}

          onChange={(e) => setDialect(e.target.value)}
