          className="w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

        >

          <option value="sorani">Sorani</option>

          <option value="badini">Badini</option>

          <option value="kurmanji">Kurmanji</option>

        </select>

        <input

          name="files"

          type="file"

          multiple

          className="w-full text-sm text-[var(--paper)] file:mr-3 file:border file:border-[var(--line)] file:bg-[var(--ink-soft)] file:px-3 file:py-1.5 file:text-xs file:uppercase file:tracking-[0.12em] file:text-[var(--gold-bright)]"

        />

        <button

          type="submit"

          disabled={busy}

          className="border border-[var(--gold)] bg-[rgba(197,161,94,0.14)] px-4 py-2 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--gold-bright)] disabled:opacity-50"

        >

          {busy ? "Ingesting…" : "Upload & ingest"}

        </button>

      </form>



      {lastReport?.report ? (

        <div className="mb-10 border border-[var(--teal)]/40 p-4 text-sm text-[var(--paper-dim)]">

          <p className="text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--teal)]">

            Last ingestion · {lastReport.status}

          </p>

          <p className="mt-2">

            imported {lastReport.report.imported ?? 0} · duplicates {lastReport.report.duplicates ?? 0}{" "}

            · failed {lastReport.report.failed ?? 0} · unknown rights{" "}

            {lastReport.report.unknown_rights ?? 0} ·{" "}

            {lastReport.report.total_bytes ?? 0} bytes

          </p>

          {lastReport.dataset_id ? (

            <Link

              href={`/data-lab/${lastReport.dataset_id}`}

              className="mt-2 inline-block text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--gold-bright)]"

            >

              Open dataset

            </Link>

          ) : null}

        </div>

      ) : null}



      <div className="grid gap-10 lg:grid-cols-2">

        <section>

          <p className="mb-3 text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist)]">

            Datasets

          </p>

          <ul className="space-y-3">

            {datasets.map((d) => (

              <li key={d.id}>

                <Link

                  href={`/data-lab/${d.id}`}

                  className="block border border-[var(--line)] px-4 py-4 hover:border-[var(--gold)]"

                >

                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-2">

                    <p className="text-[var(--paper)]">{d.name}</p>

                    <span className="text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--teal)]">

                      {d.status}

                    </span>

                  </div>

                  <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

                    {d.category} · {d.media_type} · v{d.version} · {d.record_count} records

                    {d.ai_training_permission ? " · AI training permitted" : ""}

                  </p>

                </Link>

              </li>

            ))}

            {!datasets.length && !error ? (

              <p className="text-[var(--mist)]">No datasets yet. Ingest files above.</p>

            ) : null}

          </ul>

        </section>



        <section>

          <p className="mb-3 text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist)]">

            Recent ingestions

          </p>

          <ul className="space-y-3">

            {ingestions.map((run) => (

              <li key={run.id} className="border border-[var(--line)] px-4 py-3 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

                <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-between gap-2">

                  <span className="font-mono text-xs text-[var(--paper-dim)]">{run.id.slice(0, 8)}</span>

                  <span className="text-[0.65rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--teal)]">

                    {run.status}

                  </span>

                </div>

                <p className="mt-1">

                  +{run.report?.imported ?? 0} files · dup {run.report?.duplicates ?? 0} · fail{" "}

                  {run.report?.failed ?? 0}

                </p>

                {run.dataset_id ? (

                  <Link

                    href={`/data-lab/${run.dataset_id}`}

                    className="mt-1 inline-block text-xs text-[var(--gold-bright)]"

                  >

                    Dataset

                  </Link>

                ) : null}

              </li>

            ))}

            {!ingestions.length ? (

              <li className="text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">No ingestion runs yet.</li>

            ) : null}

          </ul>

        </section>

      </div>

    </CoreShell>

  );

}


frontend/src/app/edit/[id]/page.tsx
"use client";



import Link from "next/link";

import { useParams } from "next/navigation";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";

import {

  api,

  type EditCandidate,

  type EditProject,

  type EditRenderJob,

  type EditTimelineVersion,

} from "@/lib/api";

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/PageHeader";

import { SiteHeader } from "@/components/SiteHeader";



export default function EditProjectWorkspacePage() {

  const params = useParams();

  const projectId = String(params.id);

  const [project, setProject] = useState<EditProject | null>(null);

  const [candidates, setCandidates] = useState<EditCandidate[]>([]);

  const [timelines, setTimelines] = useState<EditTimelineVersion[]>([]);

  const [renders, setRenders] = useState<EditRenderJob[]>([]);

  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string[]>([]);

  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [packageJson, setPackageJson] = useState<Record<string, unknown> | null>(null);



  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {

    try {

      const [p, c, t, r] = await Promise.all([

        api.editGetProject(projectId),

        api.editListCandidates(projectId),

        api.editListTimelines(projectId),

        api.editListRenders(projectId),

      ]);

      setProject(p);

      setCandidates(c);

      setTimelines(t);

      setRenders(r);

    } catch (e) {

      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to load project");

    }

  }, [projectId]);



  useEffect(() => {

    void refresh();

    const timer = setInterval(() => void refresh(), 4000);

    return () => clearInterval(timer);

  }, [refresh]);



  const run = async (fn: () => Promise<void>) => {

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      await fn();

      await refresh();

    } catch (e) {

      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Action failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  };



  const toggle = (id: string) => {

    setSelected((prev) => (prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((x) => x !== id) : [...prev, id]));

  };



  return (

    <main className="min-h-screen pb-20">

      <SiteHeader />

      <div className="ac-container pt-10 md:pt-14">

        <PageHeader

          eyebrow="Art City Edit"

          title={project?.title ?? "Edit project"}

          description={`Status: ${project?.status?.replaceAll("_", " ") ?? "…"} — analyse, pin candidates, build a timeline, render multi-ratio packages.`}

          actions={

            <Link href="/edit" className="ac-btn">

              Hub

            </Link>

          }

        />



        {error ? <p className="mb-4 text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p> : null}



        <div className="mb-8 flex flex-wrap gap-3">

          <button

            type="button"

            className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary"

            disabled={busy}

            onClick={() => void run(async () => { await api.editStartAnalysis(projectId); })}

          >

            Run analysis

          </button>

          <button

            type="button"

            className="ac-btn"

            disabled={busy || selected.length === 0}

            onClick={() =>

              void run(async () => {

                await api.editCreateTimeline(projectId, selected, "First cut");

              })

            }

          >

            Build timeline from pinned

          </button>

        </div>



        <section className="mb-12">

          <h2 className="ac-display mb-4 text-xl">Candidate clips</h2>

          {candidates.length === 0 ? (

            <p className="text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

              No candidates yet. Run analysis (worker processes the queue).

            </p>

          ) : (

            <ul className="space-y-3">

              {candidates.map((c) => (

                <li

                  key={c.id}

                  className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[rgba(10,15,22,0.35)] p-4"

                >

                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">

                    <div>

                      <p className="ac-display text-[var(--gold-bright)]">

                        {c.source_in.toFixed(1)}s – {c.source_out.toFixed(1)}s · score{" "}

                        {c.score.toFixed(2)}

                      </p>

                      <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">{c.explanation}</p>

                      {c.risks_json && c.risks_json.length > 0 ? (

                        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[var(--danger)]">

                          Risks: {JSON.stringify(c.risks_json)}

                        </p>

                      ) : null}

                    </div>

                    <div className="flex gap-2">

                      <button

                        type="button"

                        className={`ac-btn ${selected.includes(c.id) || c.user_decision === "pin" ? "ac-btn-primary" : ""}`}

                        disabled={busy}

                        onClick={() =>

                          void run(async () => {

                            await api.editCandidateDecision(c.id, "pin");

                            toggle(c.id);

                          })

                        }

                      >

                        Pin

                      </button>

                      <button

                        type="button"

                        className="ac-btn"

                        disabled={busy}

                        onClick={() =>

                          void run(async () => {

                            await api.editCandidateDecision(c.id, "reject");

                          })

                        }

                      >

                        Reject

                      </button>

                    </div>

                  </div>

                </li>

              ))}

            </ul>

          )}

        </section>



        <section className="mb-12">

          <h2 className="ac-display mb-4 text-xl">Timeline versions</h2>

          <ul className="space-y-3">

            {timelines.map((t) => (

              <li key={t.id} className="border border-[var(--line)] p-4">

                <p className="ac-display">

                  v{t.version_number} {t.name ?? ""} · {t.status}

                </p>

                <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">

                  <button

                    type="button"

                    className="ac-btn"

                    disabled={busy}

                    onClick={() =>

                      void run(async () => {

                        await api.editSubmitTimelineReview(t.id);

                      })

                    }

                  >

                    Submit review

                  </button>

                  <button

                    type="button"

                    className="ac-btn"

                    disabled={busy}

                    onClick={() =>

                      void run(async () => {

                        await api.editDecideTimeline(t.id, "approve", "Approved for export");

                      })

                    }

                  >

                    Approve

                  </button>

                  <button

                    type="button"

                    className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary"

                    disabled={busy}

                    onClick={() =>

                      void run(async () => {

                        await api.editStartRender(projectId, t.id);

                      })

                    }

                  >

                    Render 9:16 / 16:9 / 4:5 / 1:1

                  </button>

                </div>

              </li>

            ))}

          </ul>

        </section>



        <section>

          <h2 className="ac-display mb-4 text-xl">Renders & export</h2>

          <ul className="space-y-3">

            {renders.map((r) => (

              <li key={r.id} className="border border-[var(--line)] p-4">

                <p className="ac-display">

                  {r.state} · {r.preset} · ${r.cost_usd.toFixed(2)}

                </p>

                <button

                  type="button"

                  className="ac-btn mt-3"

                  disabled={busy}

                  onClick={() =>

                    void run(async () => {

                      setPackageJson(await api.editExportPackage(r.id));

                    })

                  }

                >

                  View package / QC

                </button>

              </li>

            ))}

          </ul>

          {packageJson ? (

            <pre className="mt-4 overflow-auto border border-[var(--line)] p-4 text-xs text-[var(--mist)]">

              {JSON.stringify(packageJson, null, 2)}

            </pre>

          ) : null}

        </section>

      </div>

    </main>

  );

}


frontend/src/app/edit/admin/applications/page.tsx
"use client";



import Link from "next/link";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { api, type EditAccessApplication } from "@/lib/api";

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/PageHeader";

import { SiteHeader } from "@/components/SiteHeader";



export default function EditAdminApplicationsPage() {

  const [rows, setRows] = useState<EditAccessApplication[]>([]);

  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);



  const load = async () => {

    try {

      setRows(await api.editListApplications());

    } catch (e) {

      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Admin access required");

    }

  };



  useEffect(() => {

    void load();

  }, []);



  const review = async (id: string, action: string) => {

    setBusy(id);

    setError(null);

    try {

      await api.editReviewApplication(id, {

        action,

        reason: action === "reject" ? "Does not meet Art City criteria" : undefined,

        plan_code: action === "approve" ? undefined : undefined,

      });

      await load();

    } catch (e) {

      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Review failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(null);

    }

  };



  return (

    <main className="min-h-screen pb-20">

      <SiteHeader />

      <div className="ac-container pt-10 md:pt-14">

        <PageHeader

          eyebrow="Art City Edit · Admin"

          title="Access approval queue"

          description="Approve, reject, or request more information. Approval alone does not activate processing until billing/entitlements are complete (internal plans activate immediately)."

          actions={

            <Link href="/edit" className="ac-btn">

              Edit hub

            </Link>

          }

        />



        {error ? <p className="mb-4 text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p> : null}



        <ul className="border-t border-[var(--line)]">

          {rows.map((a) => (

            <li key={a.id} className="border-b border-[var(--line)] py-6">

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">

                <div>

                  <p className="ac-display text-xl text-[var(--paper)]">{a.organisation_name}</p>

                  <p className="mt-2 text-[0.72rem] tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist-soft)] uppercase">

                    {a.state.replaceAll("_", " ")} · plan {a.requested_plan_code}

                  </p>

                  {a.use_case ? (

                    <p className="mt-2 max-w-xl text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">{a.use_case}</p>

                  ) : null}

                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">

                  <button

                    type="button"

                    className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary"

                    disabled={busy === a.id}

                    onClick={() => void review(a.id, "approve")}

                  >

                    Approve

                  </button>

                  <button

                    type="button"

                    className="ac-btn"

                    disabled={busy === a.id}

                    onClick={() => void review(a.id, "request_info")}

                  >

                    Request info

                  </button>

                  <button

                    type="button"

                    className="ac-btn"

                    disabled={busy === a.id}

                    onClick={() => void review(a.id, "reject")}

                  >

                    Reject

                  </button>

                  <button

                    type="button"

                    className="ac-btn"

                    disabled={busy === a.id}

                    onClick={() => void review(a.id, "suspend")}

                  >

                    Suspend

                  </button>

                </div>

              </div>

            </li>

          ))}

        </ul>

        {rows.length === 0 && !error ? (

          <p className="mt-8 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">No applications in queue.</p>

        ) : null}

      </div>

    </main>

  );

}


frontend/src/app/edit/admin/page.tsx
"use client";



import Link from "next/link";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { api, type EditOrganisation, type EditPlan, type EditSummary } from "@/lib/api";

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/PageHeader";

import { SiteHeader } from "@/components/SiteHeader";



export default function EditAdminHomePage() {

  const [summary, setSummary] = useState<EditSummary | null>(null);

  const [orgs, setOrgs] = useState<EditOrganisation[]>([]);

  const [plans, setPlans] = useState<EditPlan[]>([]);

  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);



  useEffect(() => {

    void Promise.all([api.editSummary(), api.editListOrganisations(), api.editListPlans()])

      .then(([s, o, p]) => {

        setSummary(s);

        setOrgs(o);

        setPlans(p);

      })

      .catch((e) => setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed"));

  }, []);



  return (

    <main className="min-h-screen pb-20">

      <SiteHeader />

      <div className="ac-container pt-10 md:pt-14">

        <PageHeader

          eyebrow="Art City Edit · Admin"

          title="Operations console"

          description="Approval queue, customer accounts, plan configuration, and feature flags."

          actions={

            <Link href="/edit/admin/applications" className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary">

              Approval queue

            </Link>

          }

        />



        {error ? <p className="mb-4 text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p> : null}



        {summary ? (

          <div className="mb-10 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">

            <div className="border border-[var(--line)] p-5">

              <p className="ac-display text-[var(--gold-bright)]">Pending applications</p>

              <p className="mt-2 text-3xl text-[var(--paper)]">{summary.pending_applications}</p>

            </div>

            <div className="border border-[var(--line)] p-5">

              <p className="ac-display text-[var(--gold-bright)]">Workspaces</p>

              <p className="mt-2 text-3xl text-[var(--paper)]">{summary.workspaces}</p>

            </div>

            <div className="border border-[var(--line)] p-5">

              <p className="ac-display text-[var(--gold-bright)]">Feature flags</p>

              <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

                {Object.entries(summary.feature_flags)

                  .map(([k, v]) => `${k}: ${v ? "on" : "off"}`)

                  .join(" · ")}

              </p>

            </div>

          </div>

        ) : null}



        <section className="mb-12">

          <h2 className="ac-display mb-4 text-xl">Plans</h2>

          <ul className="border-t border-[var(--line)]">

            {plans.map((p) => (

              <li key={p.id} className="py-4 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

                <span className="ac-display text-[var(--paper)]">{p.name}</span>

                <span className="ml-3">{p.code}</span>

                {p.price_usd_monthly != null ? (

                  <span className="ml-3">${p.price_usd_monthly}/mo</span>

                ) : null}

              </li>

            ))}

          </ul>

        </section>



        <section>

          <h2 className="ac-display mb-4 text-xl">Organisations</h2>

          <ul className="border-t border-[var(--line)]">

            {orgs.map((o) => (

              <li key={o.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 py-4">

                <div>

                  <p className="ac-display text-[var(--paper)]">{o.display_name}</p>

                  <p className="text-[0.72rem] tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist-soft)] uppercase">

                    {o.status.replaceAll("_", " ")} · {o.org_type}

                  </p>

                </div>

                {o.status === "approved_pending_billing" ? (

                  <button

                    type="button"

                    className="ac-btn"

                    onClick={() =>

                      void api

                        .editActivateSubscription(o.id, "creator")

                        .then(() => api.editListOrganisations().then(setOrgs))

                        .catch((e) => setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Activate failed"))

                    }

                  >

                    Activate invoice

                  </button>

                ) : null}

              </li>

            ))}

          </ul>

        </section>

      </div>

    </main>

  );

}


frontend/src/app/edit/apply/page.tsx
"use client";



import Link from "next/link";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { api, type EditAccessApplication, type EditPlan } from "@/lib/api";

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/PageHeader";

import { SiteHeader } from "@/components/SiteHeader";



export default function EditApplyPage() {

  const [plans, setPlans] = useState<EditPlan[]>([]);

  const [mine, setMine] = useState<EditAccessApplication[]>([]);

  const [organisationName, setOrganisationName] = useState("");

  const [planCode, setPlanCode] = useState("creator");

  const [useCase, setUseCase] = useState("");

  const [country, setCountry] = useState("");

  const [website, setWebsite] = useState("");

  const [minutes, setMinutes] = useState(120);

  const [accepted, setAccepted] = useState(false);

  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [ok, setOk] = useState<string | null>(null);



  useEffect(() => {

    void Promise.all([api.editListPlans(), api.editMyApplications()])

      .then(([p, m]) => {

        setPlans(p.filter((x) => x.code !== "internal_art_city"));

        setMine(m);

      })

      .catch((e) => setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed"));

  }, []);



  const submit = async () => {

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    setOk(null);

    try {

      const app = await api.editSubmitApplication({

        organisation_name: organisationName,

        requested_plan_code: planCode,

        use_case: useCase,

        expected_monthly_minutes: minutes,

        country,

        website,

        declarations_accepted: accepted,

      });

      setOk(`Application submitted (${app.state}). Art City will review before activation.`);

      setMine(await api.editMyApplications());

    } catch (e) {

      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Submit failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  };



  return (

    <main className="min-h-screen pb-20">

      <SiteHeader />

      <div className="ac-container pt-10 md:pt-14">

        <PageHeader

          eyebrow="Art City Edit"

          title="Request access"

          description="Registration creates an identity, not a production account. Art City must approve your organisation and activate entitlements before media processing."

          actions={

            <Link href="/edit" className="ac-btn">

              Back to Edit

            </Link>

          }

        />



        {error ? <p className="mb-4 text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p> : null}

        {ok ? <p className="mb-4 text-[var(--mist)]">{ok}</p> : null}



        <form

          className="max-w-xl space-y-4 border border-[var(--line)] p-6"

          onSubmit={(e) => {

            e.preventDefault();

            void submit();

          }}

        >

          <input

            className="ac-input w-full"

            required

            placeholder="Organisation name"

            value={organisationName}

            onChange={(e) => setOrganisationName(e.target.value)}

          />

          <select

            className="ac-input w-full"

            value={planCode}

            onChange={(e) => setPlanCode(e.target.value)}

          >

            {plans.map((p) => (

              <option key={p.id} value={p.code}>

                {p.name}

                {p.price_usd_monthly != null ? ` · $${p.price_usd_monthly}/mo` : " · enterprise"}

              </option>

            ))}

          </select>

          <textarea

            className="ac-input w-full min-h-[100px]"

            placeholder="Intended use case"

            value={useCase}

            onChange={(e) => setUseCase(e.target.value)}

          />

          <input

            className="ac-input w-full"

            placeholder="Country"

            value={country}

            onChange={(e) => setCountry(e.target.value)}

          />

          <input

            className="ac-input w-full"

            placeholder="Website"

            value={website}

            onChange={(e) => setWebsite(e.target.value)}

          />

          <label className="block text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

            Expected monthly minutes

            <input

              type="number"

              className="ac-input mt-1 w-full"

              value={minutes}

              onChange={(e) => setMinutes(Number(e.target.value))}

            />

          </label>

          <label className="flex items-start gap-3 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

            <input

              type="checkbox"

              checked={accepted}

              onChange={(e) => setAccepted(e.target.checked)}

              className="mt-1"

              required

            />

            I accept Terms, Privacy, Acceptable Use, and rights warranty declarations.

          </label>

          <button type="submit" className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary" disabled={busy || !accepted}>

            {busy ? "Submitting…" : "Submit for Art City review"}

          </button>

        </form>



        {mine.length > 0 ? (

          <section className="mt-12">

            <h2 className="ac-display mb-4 text-xl">Your applications</h2>

            <ul className="border-t border-[var(--line)]">

              {mine.map((a) => (

                <li key={a.id} className="py-4 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

                  <span className="ac-display text-[var(--paper)]">{a.organisation_name}</span>

                  <span className="ml-3 uppercase tracking-[0.14em]">{a.state.replaceAll("_", " ")}</span>

                  {a.decision_reason ? <p className="mt-1">{a.decision_reason}</p> : null}

                </li>

              ))}

            </ul>

          </section>

        ) : null}

      </div>

    </main>

  );

}


frontend/src/app/edit/page.tsx
"use client";



import Link from "next/link";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import {

  api,

  type EditProject,

  type EditSummary,

  type EditWorkspace,

} from "@/lib/api";

import { EmptyState } from "@/components/EmptyState";

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/PageHeader";

import { SiteHeader } from "@/components/SiteHeader";



export default function EditHubPage() {

  const [summary, setSummary] = useState<EditSummary | null>(null);

  const [workspaces, setWorkspaces] = useState<EditWorkspace[]>([]);

  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<EditProject[]>([]);

  const [workspaceId, setWorkspaceId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [seeding, setSeeding] = useState(false);



  const refresh = async () => {

    setLoading(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      const [s, ws] = await Promise.all([api.editSummary(), api.editListWorkspaces()]);

      setSummary(s);

      setWorkspaces(ws);

      const active = workspaceId && ws.some((w) => w.id === workspaceId) ? workspaceId : ws[0]?.id ?? null;

      setWorkspaceId(active);

      if (active) {

        setProjects(await api.editListProjects(active));

      } else {

        setProjects([]);

      }

    } catch (e) {

      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to load Edit");

    } finally {

      setLoading(false);

    }

  };



  useEffect(() => {

    void refresh();

    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  }, []);



  const seedInternal = async () => {

    setSeeding(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      const ws = await api.editSeedInternal();

      setWorkspaceId(ws.id);

      await refresh();

    } catch (e) {

      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Seed failed");

    } finally {

      setSeeding(false);

    }

  };



  return (

    <main className="min-h-screen pb-20">

      <SiteHeader />

      <div className="ac-container pt-10 md:pt-14">

        <PageHeader

          eyebrow="Art City Edit"

          title="Edit and repurpose long-form footage"

          description="Transform interviews and programmes into branded multi-ratio social clips — guided by a prompt, approved by people, governed by Art City."

          actions={

            <>

              <Link href="/edit/apply" className="ac-btn">

                Request access

              </Link>

              <Link href="/edit/admin" className="ac-btn">

                Admin

              </Link>

            </>

          }

        />



        <div className="mb-12 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3 animate-rise-delay">

          {[

            ["Editorial intelligence", "Candidates with scores, explanations, and risk flags"],

            ["Brand memory", "Profiles for captions, tone, and compliance"],

            ["Governed access", "Art City approval before processing entitlements"],

          ].map(([t, d]) => (

            <div key={t} className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[rgba(10,15,22,0.4)] p-5">

              <p className="ac-display text-[var(--gold-bright)]">{t}</p>

              <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">{d}</p>

            </div>

          ))}

        </div>



        {summary ? (

          <p className="mb-8 text-[0.72rem] tracking-[0.16em] text-[var(--mist-soft)] uppercase">

            Workspaces {summary.workspaces} · Projects {summary.projects} · Pending apps{" "}

            {summary.pending_applications}

          </p>

        ) : null}



        {loading ? (

          <p className="text-[0.8rem] tracking-[0.18em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase">

            Opening Edit…

          </p>

        ) : error ? (

          <p className="text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p>

        ) : workspaces.length === 0 ? (

          <EmptyState

            title="No Edit workspace yet"

            description="Seed the internal Art City Edit workspace (admins) or submit an access application."

            action={

              <button

                type="button"

                className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary"

                disabled={seeding}

                onClick={() => void seedInternal()}

              >

                {seeding ? "Seeding…" : "Seed internal workspace"}

              </button>

            }

          />

        ) : (

          <>

            <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">

              <label className="text-[0.72rem] tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase">

                Workspace

              </label>

              <select

                className="ac-input max-w-md"

                value={workspaceId ?? ""}

                onChange={(e) => {

                  const id = e.target.value;

                  setWorkspaceId(id);

                  void api.editListProjects(id).then(setProjects).catch((err) => {

                    setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed");

                  });

                }}

              >

                {workspaces.map((w) => (

                  <option key={w.id} value={w.id}>

                    {w.name} ({w.status})

                  </option>

                ))}

              </select>

              {workspaceId ? (

                <Link href={`/edit/workspace/${workspaceId}`} className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary">

                  Open workspace

                </Link>

              ) : null}

            </div>



            {projects.length === 0 ? (

              <EmptyState

                title="No Edit projects"

                description="Open a workspace to upload long-form video and create a project."

                action={

                  workspaceId ? (

                    <Link

                      href={`/edit/workspace/${workspaceId}`}

                      className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary"

                    >

                      Create project

                    </Link>

                  ) : null

                }

              />

            ) : (

              <ul className="border-t border-[var(--line)]">

                {projects.map((p, i) => (

                  <li key={p.id} className="ac-row">

                    <Link

                      href={`/edit/${p.id}`}

                      className="group grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr_auto] items-baseline gap-4 py-7 md:gap-8"

                    >

                      <span className="ac-display w-8 text-[0.75rem] tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist-soft)]">

                        {String(i + 1).padStart(2, "0")}

                      </span>

                      <div>

                        <p className="ac-display text-2xl tracking-tight transition group-hover:text-[var(--gold-bright)]">

                          {p.title}

                        </p>

                        <p className="mt-2 text-[0.72rem] tracking-[0.16em] text-[var(--mist-soft)] uppercase">

                          {p.status.replaceAll("_", " ")}

                        </p>

                      </div>

                      <span className="text-[0.72rem] tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase">

                        Open

                      </span>

                    </Link>

                  </li>

                ))}

              </ul>

            )}

          </>

        )}

      </div>

    </main>

  );

}


frontend/src/app/edit/workspace/[id]/page.tsx
"use client";



import Link from "next/link";

import { useParams } from "next/navigation";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { api, type EditMediaAsset, type EditProject } from "@/lib/api";

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/PageHeader";

import { SiteHeader } from "@/components/SiteHeader";



export default function EditWorkspacePage() {

  const params = useParams();

  const workspaceId = String(params.id);

  const [assets, setAssets] = useState<EditMediaAsset[]>([]);

  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<EditProject[]>([]);

  const [title, setTitle] = useState("Interview cutdown");

  const [assetId, setAssetId] = useState("");

  const [rights, setRights] = useState(false);

  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [message, setMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);



  const load = async () => {

    try {

      const [a, p] = await Promise.all([

        api.editListAssets(workspaceId),

        api.editListProjects(workspaceId),

      ]);

      setAssets(a);

      setProjects(p);

      if (!assetId && a[0]) setAssetId(a[0].id);

    } catch (e) {

      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to load workspace");

    }

  };



  useEffect(() => {

    void load();

    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  }, [workspaceId]);



  const onUpload = async (file: File | null) => {

    if (!file) return;

    if (!rights) {

      setError("Confirm rights attestation before upload.");

      return;

    }

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      const asset = await api.editUploadAsset(workspaceId, file, true, "Uploader attested rights");

      setMessage(`Uploaded ${asset.filename}`);

      setAssetId(asset.id);

      await load();

    } catch (e) {

      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Upload failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  };



  const createProject = async () => {

    if (!assetId) {

      setError("Upload or select a source asset first.");

      return;

    }

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      const project = await api.editCreateProject(workspaceId, {

        title,

        source_asset_id: assetId,

        brief: {

          objective: "engagement",

          platforms: ["instagram_reels", "youtube_shorts"],

          target_duration: { min: 25, max: 50 },

          languages: ["ckb", "en"],

        },

      });

      window.location.href = `/edit/${project.id}`;

    } catch (e) {

      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Create failed");

      setBusy(false);

    }

  };



  return (

    <main className="min-h-screen pb-20">

      <SiteHeader />

      <div className="ac-container pt-10 md:pt-14">

        <PageHeader

          eyebrow="Art City Edit"

          title="Workspace ingest"

          description="Upload authorised long-form video with rights attestation, then create an Edit project."

          actions={

            <Link href="/edit" className="ac-btn">

              All projects

            </Link>

          }

        />



        {error ? <p className="mb-4 text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p> : null}

        {message ? <p className="mb-4 text-[var(--mist)]">{message}</p> : null}



        <section className="mb-12 border border-[var(--line)] p-6">

          <h2 className="ac-display text-xl text-[var(--paper)]">Upload source</h2>

          <label className="mt-4 flex items-start gap-3 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

            <input

              type="checkbox"

              checked={rights}

              onChange={(e) => setRights(e.target.checked)}

              className="mt-1"

            />

            I own or am authorised to process this material (rights attestation required).

          </label>

          <input

            type="file"

            accept="video/*,audio/*"

            className="mt-4 block w-full text-sm text-[var(--mist)]"

            disabled={busy}

            onChange={(e) => void onUpload(e.target.files?.[0] ?? null)}

          />

        </section>



        <section className="mb-12 border border-[var(--line)] p-6">

          <h2 className="ac-display text-xl text-[var(--paper)]">New project</h2>

          <input

            className="ac-input mt-4 w-full max-w-lg"

            value={title}

            onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}

            placeholder="Project title"

          />

          <select

            className="ac-input mt-3 w-full max-w-lg"

            value={assetId}

            onChange={(e) => setAssetId(e.target.value)}

          >

            <option value="">Select source asset</option>

            {assets.map((a) => (

              <option key={a.id} value={a.id}>

                {a.filename} · {(a.size_bytes / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MB

              </option>

            ))}

          </select>

          <button

            type="button"

            className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary mt-4"

            disabled={busy}

            onClick={() => void createProject()}

          >

            Create & open

          </button>

        </section>



        <section>

          <h2 className="ac-display mb-4 text-xl text-[var(--paper)]">Projects in workspace</h2>

          <ul className="border-t border-[var(--line)]">

            {projects.map((p) => (

              <li key={p.id} className="ac-row">

                <Link href={`/edit/${p.id}`} className="block py-5">

                  <span className="ac-display text-lg">{p.title}</span>

                  <span className="ml-4 text-[0.72rem] tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist-soft)] uppercase">

                    {p.status}

                  </span>

                </Link>

              </li>

            ))}

          </ul>

        </section>

      </div>

    </main>

  );

}


frontend/src/app/evaluations/page.tsx
"use client";



import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { CoreShell } from "@/components/CoreShell";

import { api, type EvaluationRun } from "@/lib/api";



export default function EvaluationsPage() {

  const [runs, setRuns] = useState<EvaluationRun[]>([]);



  useEffect(() => {

    api.listEvaluations().then(setRuns).catch(() => undefined);

  }, []);



  return (

    <CoreShell

      title="Evaluations"

      subtitle="No candidate model replaces production without benchmark comparison and human approval."

    >

      <ul className="space-y-3">

        {runs.map((r) => (

          <li key={r.id} className="border border-[var(--line)] px-4 py-4">

            <p className="text-[var(--paper)]">{r.modality} evaluation</p>

            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

              {r.status}

              {r.human_decision ? ` · ${r.human_decision}` : ""}

            </p>

          </li>

        ))}

        {!runs.length ? <p className="text-[var(--mist)]">No evaluation runs yet.</p> : null}

      </ul>

    </CoreShell>

  );

}


frontend/src/app/globals.css
@tailwind base;
@tailwind components;
@tailwind utilities;

:root {
  --void: #05070b;
  --ink: #0a0f16;
  --ink-soft: #121a24;
  --ink-panel: rgba(12, 18, 28, 0.78);
  --mist: #8d9aad;
  --mist-soft: rgba(141, 154, 173, 0.5);
  --paper: #f3f6fa;
  --paper-dim: #b7c2d1;
  --gold: #c5a15e;
  --gold-bright: #efd39a;
  --gold-deep: #8f7238;
  --teal: #3aa39c;
  --teal-glow: rgba(58, 163, 156, 0.22);
  --danger: #d97868;
  --line: rgba(243, 246, 250, 0.08);
  --line-strong: rgba(243, 246, 250, 0.16);
  --font-display: var(--font-syne), ui-sans-serif, sans-serif;
  --font-body: var(--font-literata), ui-serif, Georgia, serif;
  --font-ui: var(--font-figtree), ui-sans-serif, sans-serif;
  --font-ckb: var(--font-kurdish), var(--font-figtree), ui-sans-serif, sans-serif;
  --radius: 1px;
  --max: 72rem;
  --header-h: 4.5rem;
}

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

html,
body {
  min-height: 100%;
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--paper);
  background: var(--void);
  font-family: var(--font-ui);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}

body[data-locale="ckb-IQ"] {
  font-family: var(--font-ckb);
}

a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}

button,
input,
textarea {
  font: inherit;
}

::selection {
  background: rgba(197, 161, 94, 0.38);
  color: var(--paper);
}

.ac-shell {
  min-height: 100vh;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 100% 70% at 50% -20%, rgba(197, 161, 94, 0.1), transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 50% at -5% 40%, var(--teal-glow), transparent 50%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 45% 40% at 105% 70%, rgba(197, 161, 94, 0.08), transparent 45%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #070a10 0%, #0b1119 45%, #06090e 100%);
}

.ac-grain {
  pointer-events: none;
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  opacity: 0.055;
  mix-blend-mode: overlay;
  background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 220 220' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.85' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
  z-index: 0;
}

.ac-vignette {
  pointer-events: none;
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse 75% 70% at 50% 40%, transparent 35%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55) 100%);
  z-index: 0;
}

.ac-content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

.ac-display {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
}

.ac-serif {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
}

.ac-container {
  width: min(100% - 2rem, var(--max));
  margin-inline: auto;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .ac-container {
    width: min(100% - 4.5rem, var(--max));
  }
}

/* —— Buttons —— */
.ac-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 0.9rem 1.55rem;
  font-family: var(--font-ui);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  transition:
    background 180ms ease,
    border-color 180ms ease,
    color 180ms ease,
    box-shadow 180ms ease,
    transform 180ms ease;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}

.ac-btn:active {
  transform: translateY(1px);
}

.ac-btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  transform: none;
}

.ac-btn-primary {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--gold-bright) 0%, var(--gold) 100%);
  color: var(--void);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(239, 211, 154, 0.15), 0 12px 40px rgba(197, 161, 94, 0.18);
}

.ac-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f5e0ad 0%, var(--gold-bright) 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(239, 211, 154, 0.25), 0 16px 48px rgba(197, 161, 94, 0.28);
}

.ac-btn-secondary {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
  color: var(--paper);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
}

.ac-btn-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: rgba(58, 163, 156, 0.65);
  color: #fff;
  background: rgba(58, 163, 156, 0.06);
}

.ac-btn-ghost {
  background: transparent;
  border-color: transparent;
  color: var(--mist);
  padding-inline: 0.75rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}

.ac-btn-ghost:hover:not(:disabled) {
  color: var(--gold-bright);
}

/* —— Fields —— */
.ac-field {
  width: 100%;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 0;
  color: var(--paper);
  padding: 0.95rem 0;
  outline: none;
  font-family: var(--font-ui);
  transition: border-color 180ms ease;
}

.ac-field::placeholder {
  color: var(--mist-soft);
}

.ac-field:focus {
  border-bottom-color: var(--gold);
}

select.ac-field {
  background: rgba(5, 7, 11, 0.85);
  color: var(--paper);
  cursor: pointer;
}

select.ac-field option {
  background: #0a0f16;
  color: var(--paper);
}

.ac-textarea {
  width: 100%;
  resize: vertical;
  background: rgba(5, 7, 11, 0.55);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  color: var(--paper);
  padding: 1.1rem 1.15rem;
  outline: none;
  min-height: 9rem;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 1.02rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
  transition: border-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease;
}

.ac-textarea::placeholder {
  color: var(--mist-soft);
  font-family: var(--font-ui);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.ac-textarea:focus {
  border-color: rgba(197, 161, 94, 0.55);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(197, 161, 94, 0.08);
}

.ac-label {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
  font-family: var(--font-ui);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--mist);
}

.ac-empty {
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 3rem 1.75rem;
  text-align: center;
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(197, 161, 94, 0.04), transparent 40%),
    rgba(10, 15, 22, 0.5);
}

/* —— Hero atmosphere —— */
.ac-hero-plane {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.ac-hero-beam {
  position: absolute;
  top: -20%;
  right: -10%;
  width: 55%;
  height: 140%;
  background: linear-gradient(
    118deg,
    transparent 20%,
    rgba(197, 161, 94, 0.07) 45%,
    rgba(58, 163, 156, 0.05) 62%,
    transparent 78%
  );
  transform: skewX(-18deg);
  animation: beam-drift 14s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}

.ac-hero-horizon {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 18%;
  height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent,
    rgba(239, 211, 154, 0.35) 30%,
    rgba(58, 163, 156, 0.25) 60%,
    transparent
  );
  animation: horizon-pulse 5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.ac-mark {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 2rem;
  height: 2rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(239, 211, 154, 0.45);
  color: var(--gold-bright);
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}

@keyframes rise-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(22px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

@keyframes soft-fade {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

@keyframes sheen {
  from {
    background-position: 130% 0;
  }
  to {
    background-position: -30% 0;
  }
}

@keyframes beam-drift {
  from {
    transform: skewX(-18deg) translateX(0);
    opacity: 0.7;
  }
  to {
    transform: skewX(-18deg) translateX(-4%);
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

@keyframes horizon-pulse {
  0%,
  100% {
    opacity: 0.45;
  }
  50% {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

@keyframes pulse-dot {
  0%,
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1);
  }
  50% {
    opacity: 0.45;
    transform: scale(0.85);
  }
}

.animate-rise {
  animation: rise-in 0.85s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both;
}

.animate-rise-delay {
  animation: rise-in 0.95s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) 0.12s both;
}

.animate-rise-late {
  animation: rise-in 1.05s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) 0.24s both;
}

.animate-fade {
  animation: soft-fade 1.2s ease both;
}

.ac-brand-sheen {
  background-image: linear-gradient(
    105deg,
    var(--gold-deep) 0%,
    var(--gold-bright) 28%,
    #fff8e8 48%,
    var(--gold) 68%,
    var(--gold-bright) 100%
  );
  background-size: 240% 100%;
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  color: transparent;
  animation: sheen 6s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}

.status-dot {
  animation: pulse-dot 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.ac-row {
  transition: background 180ms ease, padding 180ms ease;
}

.ac-row:hover {
  background: rgba(239, 211, 154, 0.03);
}

.ac-rule {
  height: 1px;
  border: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--line-strong), transparent 85%);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .animate-rise,
  .animate-rise-delay,
  .animate-rise-late,
  .animate-fade,
  .ac-brand-sheen,
  .status-dot,
  .ac-hero-beam,
  .ac-hero-horizon {
    animation: none;
  }

  .ac-brand-sheen {
    color: var(--gold-bright);
    background: none;
  }
}

@media print {
  .ac-grain,
  .ac-vignette,
  header,
  .print\:hidden {
    display: none !important;
  }

  body,
  .ac-shell,
  .ac-content {
    background: #fff !important;
    color: #111 !important;
  }

  .report-prose,
  .report-prose * {
    color: #111 !important;
    background: transparent !important;
    border-color: #ccc !important;
  }

  .report-prose a {
    color: #333 !important;
    text-decoration: underline !important;
  }

  .report-prose table {
    page-break-inside: avoid;
  }

  .ac-container {
    max-width: 100% !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
  }
}

frontend/src/app/hub/[projectId]/breakdown/page.tsx
"use client";



import Link from "next/link";

import { useParams } from "next/navigation";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { CoreShell } from "@/components/CoreShell";

import { useLocale } from "@/components/LocaleProvider";

import { hubApi, type HubBreakdownItem, type HubScene, type HubScript, type HubScriptVersion } from "@/lib/api";



export default function HubBreakdownPage() {

  const params = useParams<{ projectId: string }>();

  const projectId = params.projectId;

  const { t } = useLocale();

  const [scripts, setScripts] = useState<HubScript[]>([]);

  const [version, setVersion] = useState<HubScriptVersion | null>(null);

  const [scenes, setScenes] = useState<HubScene[]>([]);

  const [items, setItems] = useState<HubBreakdownItem[]>([]);

  const [status, setStatus] = useState("");



  useEffect(() => {

    (async () => {

      try {

        const list = await hubApi.listScripts(projectId);

        setScripts(list);

        const s = list[0];

        if (!s) return;

        const vs = await hubApi.listVersions(s.id);

        const current = vs.find((v) => v.id === s.current_version_id) || vs[0];

        if (!current) return;

        setVersion(current);

        setScenes(await hubApi.listScenes(current.id).catch(() => []));

        setItems(await hubApi.listBreakdown(current.id));

      } catch (e) {

        setStatus(String((e as Error).message || e));

      }

    })();

  }, [projectId]);



  async function propose() {

    if (!version) return;

    const proposed = await hubApi.proposeBreakdown(version.id);

    setItems(proposed);

    setStatus(`${t("breakdown.propose")}: ${proposed.length}`);

  }



  async function decide(id: string, decision: "approved" | "rejected") {

    const updated = await hubApi.decideBreakdown(id, decision);

    setItems((prev) => prev.map((i) => (i.id === id ? updated : i)));

  }



  return (

    <CoreShell title={t("hub.breakdown")} subtitle={version?.version_label || projectId}>

      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">

        <Link href={`/hub/${projectId}/script`} className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase">

          {t("hub.script")}

        </Link>

        <button

          type="button"

          disabled={!version}

          onClick={() => propose().catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))}

          className="border border-[var(--gold)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase text-[var(--gold-bright)] disabled:opacity-40"

        >

          {t("breakdown.propose")}

        </button>

      </div>



      {!scripts.length ? <p className="text-[var(--mist)]">Create a script first.</p> : null}



      <div className="mb-6 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

        Scenes: {scenes.length} · Items: {items.length}

      </div>



      <div className="overflow-x-auto">

        <table className="w-full text-left text-sm">

          <thead>

            <tr className="text-[0.65rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--mist)]">

              <th className="py-2">{t("breakdown.category")}</th>

              <th>Name</th>

              <th>{t("breakdown.status")}</th>

              <th>Source</th>

              <th />

            </tr>

          </thead>

          <tbody>

            {items.map((item) => (

              <tr key={item.id} className="border-t border-[var(--line)]">

                <td className="py-2">{item.category}</td>

                <td>{item.display_text}</td>

                <td>{item.approval_status}</td>

                <td>{item.source}</td>

                <td className="space-x-2">

                  {item.approval_status === "proposed" ? (

                    <>

                      <button

                        type="button"

                        onClick={() => decide(item.id, "approved").catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))}

                        className="text-[0.7rem] uppercase text-[var(--teal)]"

                      >

                        {t("breakdown.approve")}

                      </button>

                      <button

                        type="button"

                        onClick={() => decide(item.id, "rejected").catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))}

                        className="text-[0.7rem] uppercase text-[var(--danger)]"

                      >

                        {t("breakdown.reject")}

                      </button>

                    </>

                  ) : null}

                </td>

              </tr>

            ))}

          </tbody>

        </table>

      </div>

      {status ? <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">{status}</p> : null}

    </CoreShell>

  );

}


frontend/src/app/hub/[projectId]/script/page.tsx
"use client";



import Link from "next/link";

import { useParams } from "next/navigation";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

import { CoreShell } from "@/components/CoreShell";

import { useLocale } from "@/components/LocaleProvider";

import {

  hubApi,

  type HubElement,

  type HubScene,

  type HubScript,

  type HubScriptVersion,

} from "@/lib/api";

import { getAccessToken } from "@/lib/auth";



const ELEMENT_TYPES = [

  "scene_heading",

  "action",

  "character",

  "parenthetical",

  "dialogue",

  "transition",

  "shot",

] as const;



type DraftElement = {

  key: string;

  element_type: string;

  display_text: string;

  locale?: string | null;

  id?: string;

};



export default function HubScriptPage() {

  const params = useParams<{ projectId: string }>();

  const projectId = params.projectId;

  const { t, locale } = useLocale();



  const [scripts, setScripts] = useState<HubScript[]>([]);

  const [script, setScript] = useState<HubScript | null>(null);

  const [version, setVersion] = useState<HubScriptVersion | null>(null);

  const [versions, setVersions] = useState<HubScriptVersion[]>([]);

  const [elements, setElements] = useState<DraftElement[]>([]);

  const [scenes, setScenes] = useState<HubScene[]>([]);

  const [title, setTitle] = useState("Untitled Screenplay");

  const [seed, setSeed] = useState("");

  const [status, setStatus] = useState("");

  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const [stale, setStale] = useState<string[]>([]);



  const locked = version?.status === "locked";



  const loadScripts = useCallback(async () => {

    const list = await hubApi.listScripts(projectId);

    setScripts(list);

    if (list[0]) {

      const s = list[0];

      setScript(s);

      const vs = await hubApi.listVersions(s.id);

      setVersions(vs);

      const current = vs.find((v) => v.id === s.current_version_id) || vs[0];

      if (current) {

        setVersion(current);

        const els = await hubApi.listElements(current.id);

        setElements(

          els.map((e) => ({

            key: e.id,

            id: e.id,

            element_type: e.element_type,

            display_text: e.display_text,

            locale: e.locale,

          })),

        );

        const sc = await hubApi.listScenes(current.id).catch(() => [] as HubScene[]);

        setScenes(sc);

      }

      const flags = await hubApi.listStale(projectId).catch(() => []);

      setStale(flags.map((f) => f.reason));

    }

  }, [projectId]);



  async function openScript(s: HubScript) {

    setScript(s);

    const vs = await hubApi.listVersions(s.id);

    setVersions(vs);

    const current = vs.find((v) => v.id === s.current_version_id) || vs[0];

    if (current) await openVersion(current);

    const flags = await hubApi.listStale(projectId).catch(() => []);

    setStale(flags.map((f) => f.reason));

  }



  async function openVersion(v: HubScriptVersion) {

    setVersion(v);

    const els = await hubApi.listElements(v.id);

    setElements(

      els.map((e) => ({

        key: e.id,

        id: e.id,

        element_type: e.element_type,

        display_text: e.display_text,

        locale: e.locale,

      })),

    );

    const sc = await hubApi.listScenes(v.id).catch(() => [] as HubScene[]);

    setScenes(sc);

  }



  useEffect(() => {

    loadScripts().catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)));

  }, [loadScripts]);



  const sceneNav = useMemo(

    () => scenes.map((s) => ({ id: s.id, label: `${s.scene_number}. ${s.heading_display || s.location_name || ""}` })),

    [scenes],

  );



  async function createScript() {

    setStatus("Creating…");

    const s = await hubApi.createScript(projectId, {

      title,

      entry_mode: seed ? "synopsis" : "blank",

      primary_locale: locale === "ckb-IQ" ? "ckb-IQ" : "en",

      content_languages: locale === "ckb-IQ" ? ["ckb-IQ", "en"] : ["en"],

      seed_text: seed || undefined,

    });

    setStatus("Created");

    await openScript(s);

    await loadScripts();

  }



  async function save() {

    if (!version || locked) return;

    setSaving(true);

    try {

      const saved = await hubApi.saveElements(

        version.id,

        elements.map((e) => ({

          element_type: e.element_type,

          display_text: e.display_text,

          locale: e.locale || undefined,

        })),

      );

      setElements(

        saved.map((e: HubElement) => ({

          key: e.id,

          id: e.id,

          element_type: e.element_type,

          display_text: e.display_text,

          locale: e.locale,

        })),

      );

      setStatus(t("script.save") + " ✓");

    } catch (e) {

      setStatus(String((e as Error).message || e));

    } finally {

      setSaving(false);

    }

  }



  async function parseScenes() {

    if (!version || locked) return;

    await save();

    const sc = await hubApi.parseScenes(version.id);

    setScenes(sc);

    setStatus(`${t("script.parseScenes")}: ${sc.length}`);

  }



  async function lockVersion() {

    if (!version) return;

    const v = await hubApi.lockVersion(version.id);

    setVersion(v);

    setStatus(t("script.lock") + " ✓");

  }



  async function newRevision() {

    if (!script) return;

    const v = await hubApi.newRevision(script.id);

    setVersions((prev) => [v, ...prev]);

    await openVersion(v);

    setStatus(t("script.newDraft") + " ✓");

  }



  async function runAi(command: string, apply = false) {

    if (!version || locked) return;

    const res = await hubApi.aiCommand(version.id, {

      command,

      target_locale: locale === "ckb-IQ" ? "ckb-IQ" : "en",

      apply,

    });

    if (apply && res.elements?.length) {

      setElements(

        res.elements.map((e, i) => ({

          key: `ai-${i}`,

          element_type: e.element_type || "action",

          display_text: e.display_text || "",

          locale: (e as { locale?: string }).locale,

        })),

      );

    }

    setStatus(`AI ${command} via ${res.provider}`);

  }



  async function exportFile(fmt: "pdf" | "docx") {

    if (!version) return;

    const token = getAccessToken();

    const res = await fetch(hubApi.exportUrl(version.id, fmt), {

      headers: token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {},

    });

    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Export failed ${res.status}`);

    const blob = await res.blob();

    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

    const a = document.createElement("a");

    a.href = url;

    a.download = `screenplay.${fmt}`;

    a.click();

    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

  }



  async function handoff(target: "cinema" | "studio" | "edit") {

    const res = await hubApi.handoff(projectId, target, {

      script_version_id: version?.id,

    });

    setStatus(`Handoff ${target} ✓`);

    if (res.redirect) window.location.href = res.redirect;

  }



  function updateElement(index: number, patch: Partial<DraftElement>) {

    setElements((prev) => prev.map((e, i) => (i === index ? { ...e, ...patch } : e)));

  }



  function addElement(after = elements.length - 1) {

    const next = [...elements];

    next.splice(after + 1, 0, {

      key: `new-${Date.now()}`,

      element_type: "action",

      display_text: "",

      locale: locale === "ckb-IQ" ? "ckb-IQ" : "en",

    });

    setElements(next);

  }



  function removeElement(index: number) {

    setElements((prev) => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));

  }



  return (

    <CoreShell title={t("hub.script")} subtitle={script?.title || projectId}>

      {stale.length ? (

        <div className="mb-4 border border-[var(--danger)] px-3 py-2 text-sm text-[var(--danger)]">

          {stale[0] || t("stale.scriptChanged")}

        </div>

      ) : null}



      <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap gap-2">

        <input

          value={title}

          onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}

          className="min-w-[12rem] flex-1 border border-[var(--line)] bg-transparent px-3 py-2"

          placeholder={t("hub.newScript")}

        />

        <button

          type="button"

          onClick={() => createScript().catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))}

          className="border border-[var(--gold)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--gold-bright)]"

        >

          {t("hub.newScript")}

        </button>

        <Link

          href={`/hub/${projectId}/breakdown`}

          className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em]"

        >

          {t("hub.breakdown")}

        </Link>

        <Link

          href={`/hub/${projectId}/script/versions`}

          className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em]"

        >

          {t("script.compare")}

        </Link>

      </div>



      <textarea

        value={seed}

        onChange={(e) => setSeed(e.target.value)}

        rows={2}

        placeholder="Optional seed: idea / logline / synopsis / pasted screenplay…"

        className="mb-4 w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-transparent px-3 py-2 text-sm"

        dir="auto"

      />



      {scripts.length > 1 ? (

        <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">

          {scripts.map((s) => (

            <button

              key={s.id}

              type="button"

              onClick={() => openScript(s)}

              className={`border px-2 py-1 text-[0.7rem] ${

                script?.id === s.id ? "border-[var(--gold)] text-[var(--gold-bright)]" : "border-[var(--line)]"

              }`}

            >

              {s.title}

            </button>

          ))}

        </div>

      ) : null}



      {version ? (

        <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[0.75rem] text-[var(--mist)]">

          <span>

            {version.version_label} · {version.status} · {version.page_eighths}/8 pages

          </span>

          <select

            value={version.id}

            onChange={(e) => {

              const v = versions.find((x) => x.id === e.target.value);

              if (v) openVersion(v);

            }}

            className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-transparent px-2 py-1"

          >

            {versions.map((v) => (

              <option key={v.id} value={v.id}>

                {v.version_label} ({v.status})

              </option>

            ))}

          </select>

          {locked ? <span className="text-[var(--danger)]">{t("script.locked")}</span> : null}

        </div>

      ) : null}



      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[14rem_1fr]">

        <aside className="border border-[var(--line)] p-3">

          <p className="mb-2 text-[0.65rem] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist)]">{t("scene.sceneNumber")}</p>

          <ul className="space-y-1 text-sm">

            {sceneNav.map((s) => (

              <li key={s.id} className="truncate text-[var(--paper-dim)]" title={s.label}>

                {s.label}

              </li>

            ))}

            {!sceneNav.length ? <li className="text-[var(--mist)]">—</li> : null}

          </ul>

        </aside>



        <div className="space-y-2">

          {elements.map((el, index) => (

            <div key={el.key} className="border border-[var(--line)] p-2">

              <div className="mb-1 flex flex-wrap gap-2">

                <select

                  disabled={locked}

                  value={el.element_type}

                  onChange={(e) => updateElement(index, { element_type: e.target.value })}

                  className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-transparent px-2 py-1 text-[0.7rem]"

                >

                  {ELEMENT_TYPES.map((type) => (

                    <option key={type} value={type}>

                      {type}

                    </option>

                  ))}

                </select>

                <button

                  type="button"

                  disabled={locked}

                  onClick={() => addElement(index)}

                  className="text-[0.65rem] uppercase text-[var(--mist)]"

                >

                  +

                </button>

                <button

                  type="button"

                  disabled={locked}

                  onClick={() => removeElement(index)}

                  className="text-[0.65rem] uppercase text-[var(--danger)]"

                >

                  ×

                </button>

              </div>

              <textarea

                disabled={locked}

                dir={el.element_type === "scene_heading" ? "ltr" : "auto"}

                value={el.display_text}

                onChange={(e) => updateElement(index, { display_text: e.target.value })}

                rows={el.element_type === "action" || el.element_type === "dialogue" ? 3 : 2}

                className={`w-full bg-transparent px-2 py-1 text-sm outline-none ${

                  el.element_type === "character" ? "text-center uppercase tracking-[0.08em]" : ""

                } ${el.element_type === "scene_heading" ? "font-semibold uppercase" : ""}`}

              />

            </div>

          ))}

          {!elements.length ? (

            <p className="text-[var(--mist)]">Create a script to start editing structured screenplay elements.</p>

          ) : null}

        </div>

      </div>



      <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-2">

        <button

          type="button"

          disabled={!version || locked || saving}

          onClick={() => save().catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))}

          className="border border-[var(--gold)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--gold-bright)] disabled:opacity-40"

        >

          {t("script.save")}

        </button>

        <button

          type="button"

          disabled={!version || locked}

          onClick={() => parseScenes().catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))}

          className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em]"

        >

          {t("script.parseScenes")}

        </button>

        <button

          type="button"

          disabled={!version || locked}

          onClick={() => lockVersion().catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))}

          className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em]"

        >

          {t("script.lock")}

        </button>

        <button

          type="button"

          disabled={!script}

          onClick={() => newRevision().catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))}

          className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em]"

        >

          {t("script.newDraft")}

        </button>

        <button

          type="button"

          disabled={!version || locked}

          onClick={() => runAi("polish", true).catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))}

          className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em]"

        >

          {t("script.aiPolish")}

        </button>

        <button

          type="button"

          disabled={!version || locked}

          onClick={() => runAi("translate", true).catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))}

          className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em]"

        >

          {t("script.aiTranslate")}

        </button>

        <button

          type="button"

          disabled={!version}

          onClick={() => exportFile("docx").catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))}

          className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em]"

        >

          {t("script.exportDocx")}

        </button>

        <button

          type="button"

          disabled={!version}

          onClick={() => exportFile("pdf").catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))}

          className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em]"

        >

          {t("script.exportPdf")}

        </button>

        <button

          type="button"

          disabled={!version}

          onClick={() => handoff("cinema").catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))}

          className="border border-[var(--teal)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--teal)]"

        >

          {t("action.handoffCinema")}

        </button>

        <button

          type="button"

          disabled={!version}

          onClick={() => handoff("studio").catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))}

          className="border border-[var(--teal)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--teal)]"

        >

          {t("action.handoffStudio")}

        </button>

        <button

          type="button"

          disabled={!version}

          onClick={() => handoff("edit").catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))}

          className="border border-[var(--teal)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--teal)]"

        >

          {t("action.handoffEdit")}

        </button>

      </div>

      {status ? <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">{status}</p> : null}

    </CoreShell>

  );

}


frontend/src/app/hub/[projectId]/script/versions/page.tsx
"use client";



import Link from "next/link";

import { useParams } from "next/navigation";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { CoreShell } from "@/components/CoreShell";

import { useLocale } from "@/components/LocaleProvider";

import { hubApi, type HubScript, type HubScriptVersion } from "@/lib/api";



export default function HubScriptVersionsPage() {

  const params = useParams<{ projectId: string }>();

  const projectId = params.projectId;

  const { t } = useLocale();

  const [scripts, setScripts] = useState<HubScript[]>([]);

  const [scriptId, setScriptId] = useState("");

  const [versions, setVersions] = useState<HubScriptVersion[]>([]);

  const [a, setA] = useState("");

  const [b, setB] = useState("");

  const [diff, setDiff] = useState<{ left: string[]; right: string[]; added: number; removed: number } | null>(null);

  const [status, setStatus] = useState("");



  useEffect(() => {

    hubApi

      .listScripts(projectId)

      .then(async (list) => {

        setScripts(list);

        if (list[0]) {

          setScriptId(list[0].id);

          const vs = await hubApi.listVersions(list[0].id);

          setVersions(vs);

          if (vs[1]) setA(vs[1].id);

          if (vs[0]) setB(vs[0].id);

        }

      })

      .catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)));

  }, [projectId]);



  async function loadVersions(id: string) {

    setScriptId(id);

    const vs = await hubApi.listVersions(id);

    setVersions(vs);

    setA(vs[1]?.id || "");

    setB(vs[0]?.id || "");

    setDiff(null);

  }



  async function compare() {

    if (!a || !b) return;

    const res = await hubApi.compareVersions(a, b);

    setDiff(res);

  }



  async function lock(id: string) {

    const v = await hubApi.lockVersion(id);

    setVersions((prev) => prev.map((x) => (x.id === id ? v : x)));

    setStatus(t("script.lock") + " ✓");

  }



  return (

    <CoreShell title={t("script.compare")} subtitle={projectId}>

      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">

        <Link href={`/hub/${projectId}/script`} className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase">

          {t("hub.script")}

        </Link>

        <select

          value={scriptId}

          onChange={(e) => loadVersions(e.target.value).catch((err) => setStatus(String(err.message || err)))}

          className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-transparent px-2 py-2"

        >

          {scripts.map((s) => (

            <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>

              {s.title}

            </option>

          ))}

        </select>

      </div>



      <div className="mb-4 overflow-x-auto">

        <table className="w-full text-left text-sm">

          <thead>

            <tr className="text-[0.65rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--mist)]">

              <th className="py-2">Label</th>

              <th>Status</th>

              <th>Pages</th>

              <th />

            </tr>

          </thead>

          <tbody>

            {versions.map((v) => (

              <tr key={v.id} className="border-t border-[var(--line)]">

                <td className="py-2">{v.version_label}</td>

                <td>{v.status}</td>

                <td>{(v.page_eighths / 8).toFixed(2)}</td>

                <td>

                  {v.status !== "locked" ? (

                    <button

                      type="button"

                      onClick={() => lock(v.id).catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))}

                      className="text-[0.7rem] uppercase text-[var(--gold-bright)]"

                    >

                      {t("script.lock")}

                    </button>

                  ) : (

                    <span className="text-[var(--danger)]">{t("script.locked")}</span>

                  )}

                </td>

              </tr>

            ))}

          </tbody>

        </table>

      </div>



      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">

        <select value={a} onChange={(e) => setA(e.target.value)} className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-transparent px-2 py-2">

          <option value="">Version A</option>

          {versions.map((v) => (

            <option key={v.id} value={v.id}>

              {v.version_label}

            </option>

          ))}

        </select>

        <select value={b} onChange={(e) => setB(e.target.value)} className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-transparent px-2 py-2">

          <option value="">Version B</option>

          {versions.map((v) => (
