            <option key={v.id} value={v.id}>

              {v.version_label}

            </option>

          ))}

        </select>

        <button

          type="button"

          onClick={() => compare().catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))}

          className="border border-[var(--gold)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase text-[var(--gold-bright)]"

        >

          {t("script.compare")}

        </button>

      </div>



      {diff ? (

        <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">

          <pre className="overflow-auto border border-[var(--line)] p-3 text-xs whitespace-pre-wrap">{diff.left.join("\n")}</pre>

          <pre className="overflow-auto border border-[var(--line)] p-3 text-xs whitespace-pre-wrap">{diff.right.join("\n")}</pre>

          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--mist)] md:col-span-2">

            +{diff.added} / −{diff.removed}

          </p>

        </div>

      ) : null}

      {status ? <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">{status}</p> : null}

    </CoreShell>

  );

}


frontend/src/app/hub/page.tsx
"use client";



import Link from "next/link";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { CoreShell } from "@/components/CoreShell";

import { useLocale } from "@/components/LocaleProvider";

import { api, hubApi, type HubFeatures, type Project } from "@/lib/api";



export default function HubHomePage() {

  const { t } = useLocale();

  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<Project[]>([]);

  const [features, setFeatures] = useState<HubFeatures | null>(null);

  const [error, setError] = useState("");



  useEffect(() => {

    Promise.all([api.listProjects(), hubApi.features()])

      .then(([p, f]) => {

        setProjects(p);

        setFeatures(f);

      })

      .catch((e) => setError(String(e.message || e)));

  }, []);



  const modules = [

    {

      key: "script",

      title: t("hub.script"),

      enabled: features?.script ?? true,

      href: (id: string) => `/hub/${id}/script`,

    },

    {

      key: "storyboard",

      title: t("hub.storyboard"),

      enabled: features?.storyboard ?? false,

      href: () => "#",

    },

    {

      key: "budget",

      title: t("hub.budget"),

      enabled: features?.budget ?? false,

      href: () => "#",

    },

    {

      key: "call",

      title: t("hub.call"),

      enabled: features?.call ?? false,

      href: () => "#",

    },

  ];



  return (

    <CoreShell title={t("hub.title")} subtitle={t("hub.subtitle")}>

      {error ? <p className="text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p> : null}

      <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">

        {modules.map((m) => (

          <div key={m.key} className="border border-[var(--line)] px-4 py-5">

            <p className="text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--gold-bright)]">{m.title}</p>

            <p className="mt-2 text-[0.8rem] text-[var(--mist)]">

              {m.enabled ? t("hub.openScript") : t("hub.comingSoon")}

            </p>

          </div>

        ))}

      </div>

      <h2 className="mt-10 text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-[var(--mist)]">{t("project.title")}</h2>

      <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3">

        {projects.map((p) => (

          <div

            key={p.id}

            className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border border-[var(--line)] px-4 py-4"

          >

            <div>

              <p className="text-[var(--paper)]">{p.name}</p>

              <p className="text-[0.75rem] text-[var(--mist)]">{p.id}</p>

            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">

              <Link

                href={`/hub/${p.id}/script`}

                className="border border-[var(--gold)] px-3 py-1.5 text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--gold-bright)]"

              >

                {t("hub.script")}

              </Link>

              <Link

                href={`/hub/${p.id}/breakdown`}

                className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-1.5 text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--mist)]"

              >

                {t("hub.breakdown")}

              </Link>

              <Link

                href={`/cinema/${p.id}`}

                className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-1.5 text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--mist)]"

              >

                Cinema

              </Link>

              <Link

                href={`/studio/${p.id}`}

                className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-1.5 text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--mist)]"

              >

                Studio

              </Link>

            </div>

          </div>

        ))}

        {!projects.length ? (

          <p className="text-[var(--mist)]">

            No projects yet. Create one under{" "}

            <Link href="/projects" className="text-[var(--gold-bright)]">

              Projects

            </Link>

            .

          </p>

        ) : null}

      </div>

    </CoreShell>

  );

}


frontend/src/app/knowledge/page.tsx
"use client";



import { FormEvent, useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { CoreShell } from "@/components/CoreShell";

import { api, type KnowledgeEntry } from "@/lib/api";



const DIALECTS = [

  { id: "", label: "All dialects" },

  { id: "sorani", label: "Sorani" },

  { id: "badini", label: "Badini" },

  { id: "kurmanji", label: "Kurmanji" },

];



export default function KnowledgePage() {

  const [q, setQ] = useState("");

  const [dialect, setDialect] = useState("");

  const [entries, setEntries] = useState<KnowledgeEntry[]>([]);

  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [term, setTerm] = useState("");

  const [definition, setDefinition] = useState("");

  const [translation, setTranslation] = useState("");

  const [entryDialect, setEntryDialect] = useState("sorani");

  const [category, setCategory] = useState("terminology");



  function load(termQ?: string, d?: string) {

    api

      .listKnowledge(termQ, d || undefined)

      .then(setEntries)

      .catch(() => undefined);

  }



  useEffect(() => {

    load();

  }, []);



  function onSearch(e: FormEvent) {

    e.preventDefault();

    load(q, dialect);

  }



  async function onCreate(e: FormEvent) {

    e.preventDefault();

    if (!term.trim() || !definition.trim()) return;

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      await api.createKnowledge({

        term: term.trim(),

        definition: definition.trim(),

        translation: translation.trim() || undefined,

        dialect: entryDialect,

        category,

        language: "ku",

      });

      setTerm("");

      setDefinition("");

      setTranslation("");

      load(q, dialect);

    } catch (err) {

      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Create failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  }



  async function onApprove(id: string) {

    setBusy(true);

    try {

      await api.approveKnowledge(id);

      load(q, dialect);

    } catch (err) {

      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Approve failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  }



  return (

    <CoreShell

      title="Kurdish Knowledge Base"

      subtitle="Sorani, Badini, and Kurmanji terminology for Cinema and Studio cultural consistency."

    >

      <form onSubmit={onSearch} className="mb-8 flex flex-wrap gap-2">

        <input

          value={q}

          onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}

          placeholder="Search terms"

          className="min-w-[12rem] flex-1 border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

        />

        <select

          value={dialect}

          onChange={(e) => setDialect(e.target.value)}

          className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

        >

          {DIALECTS.map((d) => (

            <option key={d.id || "all"} value={d.id}>

              {d.label}

            </option>

          ))}

        </select>

        <button

          type="submit"

          className="border border-[var(--gold)] px-4 py-2 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--gold-bright)]"

        >

          Search

        </button>

      </form>



      <form onSubmit={onCreate} className="mb-10 grid gap-3 border border-[var(--line)] p-5 md:grid-cols-2">

        <p className="md:col-span-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist)]">

          Add knowledge entry

        </p>

        <input

          value={term}

          onChange={(e) => setTerm(e.target.value)}

          placeholder="Term"

          className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

          required

        />

        <select

          value={entryDialect}

          onChange={(e) => setEntryDialect(e.target.value)}

          className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

        >

          <option value="sorani">Sorani</option>

          <option value="badini">Badini</option>

          <option value="kurmanji">Kurmanji</option>

        </select>

        <textarea

          value={definition}

          onChange={(e) => setDefinition(e.target.value)}

          placeholder="Definition"

          rows={3}

          className="md:col-span-2 border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

          required

        />

        <input

          value={translation}

          onChange={(e) => setTranslation(e.target.value)}

          placeholder="Translation (optional)"

          className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

        />

        <select

          value={category}

          onChange={(e) => setCategory(e.target.value)}

          className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

        >

          <option value="terminology">Terminology</option>

          <option value="character">Character</option>

          <option value="geography">Geography</option>

          <option value="customs">Customs</option>

        </select>

        <button

          type="submit"

          disabled={busy}

          className="md:col-span-2 border border-[var(--gold)] bg-[rgba(197,161,94,0.14)] px-4 py-2 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--gold-bright)] disabled:opacity-50"

        >

          {busy ? "Saving…" : "Save draft"}

        </button>

      </form>



      {error ? <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p> : null}



      <ul className="space-y-3">

        {entries.map((e) => (

          <li key={e.id} className="border border-[var(--line)] px-4 py-4">

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">

              <div>

                <p className="text-[var(--paper)]">

                  {e.term}{" "}

                  <span className="text-xs text-[var(--mist)]">

                    {e.dialect || e.language} · {e.category} · {e.approval_status}

                  </span>

                </p>

                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">{e.definition}</p>

                {e.translation ? (

                  <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-[var(--paper-dim)]">Translation · {e.translation}</p>

                ) : null}

                {e.example_sentence ? (

                  <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-[var(--mist-soft)]">{e.example_sentence}</p>

                ) : null}

              </div>

              {e.approval_status !== "approved" ? (

                <button

                  type="button"

                  disabled={busy}

                  onClick={() => void onApprove(e.id)}

                  className="border border-[var(--teal)] px-3 py-1 text-[0.65rem] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--teal)]"

                >

                  Approve

                </button>

              ) : null}

            </div>

          </li>

        ))}

      </ul>

    </CoreShell>

  );

}

frontend/src/app/login/page.tsx
"use client";

import { FormEvent, Suspense, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { BrandMark } from "@/components/BrandMark";
import { useAuth } from "@/components/AuthProvider";

function LoginForm() {
  const { login } = useAuth();
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useSearchParams();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  async function onSubmit(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await login(email, password);
      router.replace(params.get("next") || "/dashboard");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Login failed");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="mt-8 space-y-4">
      <label className="block text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist)]">
        Email
        <input
          className="mt-2 w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"
          type="email"
          value={email}
          onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
          required
        />
      </label>
      <label className="block text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist)]">
        Password
        <input
          className="mt-2 w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"
          type="password"
          value={password}
          onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
          required
        />
      </label>
      {error ? <p className="text-sm text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p> : null}
      <button
        type="submit"
        disabled={busy}
        className="w-full border border-[var(--gold)] bg-[rgba(197,161,94,0.16)] px-4 py-3 text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--gold-bright)] disabled:opacity-50"
      >
        {busy ? "Signing in…" : "Sign in"}
      </button>
    </form>
  );
}

export default function LoginPage() {
  return (
    <main className="ac-container flex min-h-[100dvh] flex-col justify-center py-16">
      <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-md">
        <BrandMark product="platform" />
        <h1 className="mt-10 font-[family-name:var(--font-display)] text-3xl text-[var(--paper)]">
          Art City sign in
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">
          Private production OS and AI Core. Customers sign up with email + phone verification.
        </p>
        <Suspense fallback={<p className="mt-8 text-[var(--mist)]">Loading…</p>}>
          <LoginForm />
        </Suspense>
        <p className="mt-6 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">
          New customer?{" "}
          <a href="/signup" className="text-[var(--gold-bright)]">
            Create account
          </a>
        </p>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

"use client";



import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { CoreShell } from "@/components/CoreShell";

import { api, type RegistryModel } from "@/lib/api";



export default function ModelsPage() {

  const [models, setModels] = useState<RegistryModel[]>([]);



  useEffect(() => {

    api.listRegistryModels().then(setModels).catch(() => undefined);

  }, []);



  return (

    <CoreShell

      title="Model Registry"

      subtitle="Official inventory of Art City foundation models, LoRAs, character adapters, and evaluation status."

    >

      <ul className="space-y-3">

        {models.map((m) => (

          <li key={m.id} className="border border-[var(--line)] px-4 py-4">

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-2">

              <p className="text-[var(--paper)]">

                {m.name} <span className="text-[var(--mist)]">{m.version}</span>

              </p>

              <span className="text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--gold)]">

                {m.status}

              </span>

            </div>

            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

              {m.model_type} · {m.modality}

              {m.character_key ? ` · ${m.character_key}` : ""}

              {m.checksum ? ` · ${m.checksum.slice(0, 12)}…` : ""}

            </p>

          </li>

        ))}

        {!models.length ? <p className="text-[var(--mist)]">No models registered.</p> : null}

      </ul>

    </CoreShell>

  );

}

frontend/src/app/projects/[id]/data-bank/page.tsx
"use client";



import Link from "next/link";

import { FormEvent, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { useParams } from "next/navigation";

import {

  api,

  mediaAbsolute,

  withAccessToken,

  type DataBankAsset,

  type DataBankSummary,

  type Project,

} from "@/lib/api";

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/PageHeader";

import { SiteHeader } from "@/components/SiteHeader";



export default function ProjectDataBankPage() {

  const params = useParams();

  const projectId = String(params.id);



  const [project, setProject] = useState<Project | null>(null);

  const [summary, setSummary] = useState<DataBankSummary | null>(null);

  const [assets, setAssets] = useState<DataBankAsset[]>([]);

  const [q, setQ] = useState("");

  const [assetType, setAssetType] = useState("");

  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<DataBankAsset | null>(null);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);



  const load = useCallback(async () => {

    setLoading(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      const [p, s, rows] = await Promise.all([

        api.getProject(projectId),

        api.dataBankSummary(projectId),

        api.listDataBank(projectId, {

          q: q || undefined,

          asset_type: assetType || undefined,

        }),

      ]);

      setProject(p);

      setSummary(s);

      setAssets(rows);

      if (rows[0] && !selected) setSelected(rows[0]);

    } catch (e) {

      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to load data bank");

    } finally {

      setLoading(false);

    }

  }, [projectId, q, assetType, selected]);



  useEffect(() => {

    void load();

    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  }, [projectId]);



  async function onSearch(e: FormEvent) {

    e.preventDefault();

    await load();

  }



  async function onUpload(e: FormEvent) {

    e.preventDefault();

    if (!file) return;

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      const asset = await api.uploadDataBank(projectId, file, {

        tags: "data-bank,upload",

      });

      setFile(null);

      setSelected(asset);

      await load();

    } catch (err) {

      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Upload failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  }



  async function onSync() {

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      await api.syncDataBank(projectId);

      await load();

    } catch (err) {

      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Sync failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  }



  const preview = selected?.media_url

    ? withAccessToken(mediaAbsolute(selected.media_url) || "")

    : null;



  return (

    <main className="min-h-screen pb-20">

      <SiteHeader />

      <div className="ac-container pt-10 md:pt-14">

        <PageHeader

          eyebrow="Project Data Bank"

          title={project?.name || "Data Bank"}

          description="Upload reference files, sync Studio generations, and browse every project asset in one vault."

          actions={

            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">

              <Link href="/data-bank" className="ac-btn">

                All banks

              </Link>

              <Link href={`/studio/${projectId}`} className="ac-btn">

                Studio

              </Link>

              <button type="button" className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void onSync()}>

                {busy ? "Working…" : "Sync generations"}

              </button>

            </div>

          }

        />



        {error ? <p className="mb-6 text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p> : null}



        <div className="mb-8 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">

          <Stat label="Assets" value={String(summary?.total ?? 0)} />

          <Stat

            label="Types"

            value={Object.entries(summary?.by_type || {})

              .map(([k, v]) => `${k}:${v}`)

              .join(" · ") || "—"}

          />

          <Stat

            label="Sources"

            value={Object.entries(summary?.by_source || {})

              .map(([k, v]) => `${k}:${v}`)

              .join(" · ") || "—"}

          />

        </div>



        <div className="grid gap-10 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_1.1fr]">

          <div className="space-y-8">

            <form onSubmit={onSearch} className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">

              <input

                value={q}

                onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}

                placeholder="Search name, prompt, tags"

                className="min-w-[12rem] flex-1 border border-[var(--line)] bg-[rgba(10,15,22,0.55)] px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[var(--gold)]"

              />

              <select

                value={assetType}

                onChange={(e) => setAssetType(e.target.value)}

                className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[rgba(10,15,22,0.55)] px-3 py-2 text-sm"

              >

                <option value="">All types</option>

                {["image", "video", "voice", "audio", "music", "script", "other"].map((t) => (

                  <option key={t} value={t}>

                    {t}

                  </option>

                ))}

              </select>

              <button type="submit" className="ac-btn">

                Search

              </button>

            </form>



            <form onSubmit={onUpload} className="space-y-3 border border-[var(--line)] p-4">

              <p className="ac-display text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.18em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase">

                Upload to bank

              </p>

              <input

                type="file"

                onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}

                className="block w-full text-sm text-[var(--mist)]"

              />

              <button type="submit" disabled={!file || busy} className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary">

                {busy ? "Uploading…" : "Upload file"}

              </button>

            </form>



            {loading ? (

              <p className="text-[0.8rem] tracking-[0.18em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase">Loading…</p>

            ) : assets.length === 0 ? (

              <p className="text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">Bank empty — upload a file or sync Studio generations.</p>

            ) : (

              <ul className="border-t border-[var(--line)]">

                {assets.map((a) => (

                  <li key={a.id}>

                    <button

                      type="button"

                      onClick={() => setSelected(a)}

                      className={`ac-row w-full text-left ${

                        selected?.id === a.id ? "text-[var(--gold-bright)]" : ""

                      }`}

                    >

                      <div className="py-4">

                        <p className="ac-display text-lg tracking-tight">{a.name}</p>

                        <p className="mt-1 text-[0.68rem] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist-soft)]">

                          {a.asset_type} · {a.source || "—"} ·{" "}

                          {a.created_at ? new Date(a.created_at).toLocaleString() : ""}

                        </p>

                      </div>

                      <div className="ac-rule" />

                    </button>

                  </li>

                ))}

              </ul>

            )}

          </div>



          <div className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[rgba(10,15,22,0.35)] p-5">

            {selected && preview ? (

              <div className="space-y-4">

                <p className="ac-display text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.18em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase">

                  Preview · {selected.asset_type}

                </p>

                {selected.asset_type === "image" || selected.content_type?.startsWith("image/") ? (

                  // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element

                  <img

                    src={preview}

                    alt={selected.name}

                    className="w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-black object-cover aspect-video"

                  />

                ) : selected.asset_type === "video" || selected.content_type?.startsWith("video/") ? (

                  <video controls src={preview} className="w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-black aspect-video" />

                ) : selected.asset_type === "audio" ||

                  selected.asset_type === "voice" ||

                  selected.asset_type === "music" ? (

                  <audio controls src={preview} className="w-full" />

                ) : (

                  <a href={preview} className="text-[var(--gold)]" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">

                    Open file

                  </a>

                )}

                <p className="text-sm text-[var(--mist-soft)]">{selected.prompt || selected.name}</p>

                {selected.tags?.length ? (

                  <p className="text-[0.68rem] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist)]">

                    {selected.tags.join(" · ")}

                  </p>

                ) : null}

              </div>

            ) : (

              <p className="text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">Select an asset to preview.</p>

            )}

          </div>

        </div>

      </div>

    </main>

  );

}



function Stat({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {

  return (

    <div className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[rgba(10,15,22,0.35)] px-4 py-4">

      <p className="ac-display text-[0.65rem] tracking-[0.18em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase">{label}</p>

      <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-[var(--paper)] break-words">{value}</p>

    </div>

  );

}


frontend/src/app/projects/[id]/page.tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { FormEvent, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useParams } from "next/navigation";
import { api, type Character, type Project, type Script } from "@/lib/api";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/EmptyState";
import { SiteHeader } from "@/components/SiteHeader";

export default function ProjectDetailPage() {
  const params = useParams();
  const projectId = String(params.id);

  const [project, setProject] = useState<Project | null>(null);
  const [characters, setCharacters] = useState<Character[]>([]);
  const [scripts, setScripts] = useState<Script[]>([]);
  const [charName, setCharName] = useState("");
  const [charDescription, setCharDescription] = useState("");
  const [scriptTitle, setScriptTitle] = useState("");
  const [scriptBody, setScriptBody] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [savingChar, setSavingChar] = useState(false);
  const [savingScript, setSavingScript] = useState(false);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const [p, c, s] = await Promise.all([
        api.getProject(projectId),
        api.listCharacters(projectId),
        api.listScripts(projectId),
      ]);
      setProject(p);
      setCharacters(c);
      setScripts(s);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to load project");
      setProject(null);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [projectId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);

  async function addCharacter(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!charName.trim()) return;
    setSavingChar(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await api.createCharacter(projectId, {
        name: charName.trim(),
        description: charDescription.trim() || undefined,
      });
      setCharName("");
      setCharDescription("");
      await load();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to add character");
    } finally {
      setSavingChar(false);
    }
  }

  async function addScript(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!scriptTitle.trim() || !scriptBody.trim()) return;
    setSavingScript(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await api.createScript(projectId, {
        title: scriptTitle.trim(),
        body: scriptBody.trim(),
        language: "ku",
      });
      setScriptTitle("");
      setScriptBody("");
      await load();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to add script");
    } finally {
      setSavingScript(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen pb-24">
      <SiteHeader />

      <div className="ac-container pt-10 md:pt-14">
        {loading ? (
          <p className="py-20 text-[0.8rem] tracking-[0.18em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase">
            Opening project…
          </p>
        ) : !project ? (
          <div className="py-10">
            <EmptyState
              title="Project unavailable"
              description={error ?? "This production could not be opened."}
              action={
                <Link href="/projects" className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary">
                  Return to slate
                </Link>
              }
            />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="mb-14 animate-rise">
              <Link
                href="/projects"
                className="ac-display text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.28em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase transition hover:text-[var(--gold-bright)]"
              >
                ← Production slate
              </Link>
              <h1 className="ac-display mt-5 max-w-4xl text-[clamp(2.4rem,6vw,4.2rem)] leading-[0.98] tracking-tight text-[var(--paper)]">
                {project.name}
              </h1>
              {project.description ? (
                <p className="ac-serif mt-5 max-w-2xl text-[1.1rem] leading-relaxed text-[var(--mist)]">
                  {project.description}
                </p>
              ) : null}
              <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-x-8 gap-y-2 text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.18em] text-[var(--mist-soft)] uppercase">
                <span>Status · {project.status}</span>
                <span>Characters · {characters.length}</span>
                <span>Scripts · {scripts.length}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-7 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                <Link href={`/cinema/${project.id}`} className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary">
                  Cinema
                </Link>
                <Link href={`/studio/${project.id}`} className="ac-btn ac-btn-secondary">
                  Studio
                </Link>
                <Link href={`/hub/${project.id}/script`} className="ac-btn ac-btn-secondary">
                  Hub Script
                </Link>
                <Link href={`/projects/${project.id}/data-bank`} className="ac-btn ac-btn-secondary">
                  Data Bank
                </Link>
                <Link href="/edit" className="ac-btn ac-btn-secondary">
                  Edit
                </Link>
                <Link href={`/publish/${project.id}`} className="ac-btn ac-btn-ghost">
                  Publish
                </Link>
              </div>
              <div className="ac-rule mt-10" />
            </div>

            {error ? <p className="mb-8 text-sm text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p> : null}

            <section className="mb-20 animate-rise-delay">
              <div className="mb-8 flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-end sm:justify-between">
                <div>
                  <h2 className="ac-display text-2xl text-[var(--gold-bright)]">Character library</h2>
                  <p className="ac-serif mt-2 max-w-xl text-[var(--mist)]">
                    Permanent identities for consistent faces, costume, and voice across the episode.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <form
                onSubmit={addCharacter}
                className="mb-10 grid gap-5 border border-[var(--line)] bg-[rgba(10,15,22,0.4)] p-5 md:grid-cols-[1fr_1fr_auto] md:p-6"
              >
                <div>
                  <label className="ac-label" htmlFor="char-name">
                    Character
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="char-name"
                    value={charName}
                    onChange={(e) => setCharName(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Kardokh"
                    className="ac-field"
                    required
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="ac-label" htmlFor="char-desc">
                    Identity notes
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="char-desc"
                    value={charDescription}
                    onChange={(e) => setCharDescription(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Costume, palette, expression rules"
                    className="ac-field"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-end">
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={savingChar}
                    className="ac-btn ac-btn-secondary w-full md:w-auto"
                  >
                    {savingChar ? "Saving…" : "Register"}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </form>

              {characters.length === 0 ? (
                <EmptyState
                  title="Cast not registered"
                  description="Add Kardokh, Kurdiya, and supporting roles before generating storyboards or shots."
                />
              ) : (
                <ul>
                  {characters.map((c, i) => (
                    <li key={c.id} className="ac-row grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr] gap-5 py-5">
                      <span className="ac-display text-[0.72rem] tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist-soft)]">
                        {String(i + 1).padStart(2, "0")}
                      </span>
                      <div>
                        <p className="ac-display text-xl text-[var(--paper)]">{c.name}</p>
                        {c.description ? (
                          <p className="ac-serif mt-1 text-[var(--mist)]">{c.description}</p>
                        ) : null}
                      </div>
                      <div className="ac-rule col-span-2" />
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              )}
            </section>

            <section className="animate-rise-late">
              <div className="mb-8">
                <h2 className="ac-display text-2xl text-[var(--gold-bright)]">Script desk</h2>
                <p className="ac-serif mt-2 max-w-xl text-[var(--mist)]">
                  Kurdish drafts for scene breakdown, dialogue timing, and prompt generation.
                </p>
              </div>

              <form
                onSubmit={addScript}
                className="mb-12 space-y-5 border border-[var(--line)] bg-[rgba(10,15,22,0.4)] p-5 md:p-6"
              >
                <div>
                  <label className="ac-label" htmlFor="script-title">
                    Script title
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="script-title"
                    value={scriptTitle}
                    onChange={(e) => setScriptTitle(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Episode 01 — Master draft"
                    className="ac-field"
                    required
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="ac-label" htmlFor="script-body">
                    Body
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    id="script-body"
                    value={scriptBody}
                    onChange={(e) => setScriptBody(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Write or paste the Kurdish script…"
                    rows={9}
                    className="ac-textarea"
                    required
                  />
                </div>
                <button type="submit" disabled={savingScript} className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary">
                  {savingScript ? "Saving…" : "Save to archive"}
                </button>
              </form>

              {scripts.length === 0 ? (
                <EmptyState
                  title="No scripts on desk"
                  description="Save the first draft to begin scene and shot planning for the pilot."
                />
              ) : (
                <ul className="space-y-10">
                  {scripts.map((s) => (
                    <li key={s.id}>
                      <div className="ac-rule mb-6" />
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
                        <p className="ac-display text-2xl text-[var(--paper)]">{s.title}</p>
                        <span className="ac-display text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.2em] text-[var(--mist-soft)] uppercase">
                          Language · {s.language}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <pre className="ac-serif mt-5 whitespace-pre-wrap text-[1.02rem] leading-[1.8] text-[var(--paper-dim)]">
                        {s.body}
                      </pre>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              )}
            </section>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

frontend/src/app/projects/page.tsx
"use client";



import Link from "next/link";

import { FormEvent, useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { api, type Project } from "@/lib/api";

import { EmptyState } from "@/components/EmptyState";

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/PageHeader";

import { SiteHeader } from "@/components/SiteHeader";



function formatDate(value: string) {

  try {

    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, {

      dateStyle: "medium",

      timeStyle: "short",

    }).format(new Date(value));

  } catch {

    return value;

  }

}



export default function ProjectsPage() {

  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<Project[]>([]);

  const [name, setName] = useState("");

  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);



  async function load() {

    setLoading(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      const data = await api.listProjects();

      setProjects(data);

      if (data.length === 0) setShowForm(true);

    } catch (e) {

      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to load projects");

    } finally {

      setLoading(false);

    }

  }



  useEffect(() => {

    void load();

  }, []);



  async function onCreate(e: FormEvent) {

    e.preventDefault();

    if (!name.trim()) return;

    setSaving(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      await api.createProject({

        name: name.trim(),

        description: description.trim() || undefined,

      });

      setName("");

      setDescription("");

      setShowForm(false);

      await load();

    } catch (err) {

      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to create project");

    } finally {

      setSaving(false);

    }

  }



  return (

    <main className="min-h-screen pb-20">

      <SiteHeader />



      <div className="ac-container pt-10 md:pt-14">

        <PageHeader

          eyebrow="Production slate"

          title="Projects"

          description="Commission-grade productions under Art City control — characters, scripts, generations, and masters."

          actions={

            <button

              type="button"

              className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary"

              onClick={() => setShowForm((v) => !v)}

            >

              {showForm ? "Close" : "New project"}

            </button>

          }

        />



        {showForm ? (

          <form

            onSubmit={onCreate}

            className="mb-14 space-y-6 border border-[var(--line)] bg-[rgba(10,15,22,0.45)] p-6 md:p-8 animate-rise-delay"

          >

            <div>

              <label className="ac-label" htmlFor="project-name">

                Project title

              </label>

              <input

                id="project-name"

                value={name}

                onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}

                placeholder="Kardokh & Kurdiya — 365 Days"

                className="ac-field text-lg"

                required

                autoFocus

              />

            </div>

            <div>

              <label className="ac-label" htmlFor="project-description">

                Production note

              </label>

              <textarea

                id="project-description"

                value={description}

                onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}

                placeholder="Episode intent, tone, and delivery targets"

                rows={3}

                className="ac-textarea min-h-[6rem]"

              />

            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 pt-1">

              <button type="submit" disabled={saving} className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary">

                {saving ? "Creating…" : "Create project"}

              </button>

              <button

                type="button"

                className="ac-btn ac-btn-ghost"

                onClick={() => setShowForm(false)}

              >

                Cancel

              </button>

            </div>

            {error ? <p className="text-sm text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p> : null}

          </form>

        ) : null}



        {!showForm && error ? (

          <p className="mb-6 text-sm text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p>

        ) : null}



        <section className="animate-rise-late">

          {loading ? (

            <div className="space-y-4 py-8">

              <div className="h-px w-full bg-[var(--line)]" />

              <p className="text-[0.8rem] tracking-[0.18em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase">

                Loading slate…

              </p>

            </div>

          ) : projects.length === 0 ? (

            <EmptyState

              title="Your slate is empty"

              description="Open the first Art City production. Character libraries, Kurdish scripts, and review workflows start here."

              action={

                <button

                  type="button"

                  className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary"

                  onClick={() => setShowForm(true)}

                >

                  Begin first project

                </button>

              }

            />

          ) : (

            <ul className="border-t border-[var(--line)]">

              {projects.map((p, index) => (

                <li key={p.id} className="ac-row">

                  <Link

                    href={`/projects/${p.id}`}

                    className="group grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr_auto] items-baseline gap-4 py-7 md:gap-8"

                  >

                    <span className="ac-display w-8 text-[0.75rem] tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist-soft)]">

                      {String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}

                    </span>

                    <div className="min-w-0">

                      <p className="ac-display text-2xl tracking-tight text-[var(--paper)] transition group-hover:text-[var(--gold-bright)]">

                        {p.name}

                      </p>

                      {p.description ? (

                        <p className="ac-serif mt-2 max-w-2xl text-[0.98rem] text-[var(--mist)]">

                          {p.description}

                        </p>

                      ) : null}

                      <p className="mt-3 text-[0.7rem] tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist-soft)] uppercase">

                        Updated {formatDate(p.updated_at)}

                      </p>

                    </div>

                    <span className="ac-display shrink-0 text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.2em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase">

                      {p.status}

                    </span>

                  </Link>

                  <div className="ac-rule" />

                </li>

              ))}

            </ul>

          )}

        </section>

      </div>

    </main>

  );

}


frontend/src/app/publish/[id]/page.tsx
"use client";



import Link from "next/link";

import { FormEvent, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

import { useParams } from "next/navigation";

import {

  api,

  mediaAbsolute,

  withAccessToken,

  type CinemaPackage,

  type Project,

  type Publication,

  type PublicationMaster,

} from "@/lib/api";

import { EmptyState } from "@/components/EmptyState";

import { SiteHeader } from "@/components/SiteHeader";



const API_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ?? "http://localhost:8000";



function statusTone(status: string) {

  if (status === "published" || status === "ready") return "text-emerald-300";

  if (status === "blocked" || status === "failed") return "text-[var(--danger)]";

  return "text-[var(--gold-bright)]";

}



function MasterCard({ master }: { master: PublicationMaster }) {

  const media = mediaAbsolute(master.media_url);

  const audio = mediaAbsolute(master.audio_url);

  const visual = master.modality === "video" || master.modality === "image";



  return (

    <article className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[rgba(10,15,22,0.5)] p-4">

      <div className="mb-3 flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3">

        <p className="ac-display text-[var(--paper)]">{master.label}</p>

        <span className="text-[0.65rem] tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist-soft)] uppercase">

          {master.aspect ?? master.modality}

        </span>

      </div>

      {visual && media ? (

        // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element

        <img

          src={media}

          alt={master.label}

          className={`w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-black object-cover ${

            master.aspect === "9:16"

              ? "aspect-[9/16] max-h-80 mx-auto"

              : master.aspect === "1:1"

                ? "aspect-square max-h-72 mx-auto"

                : "aspect-video"

          }`}

        />

      ) : null}

      {(audio || (!visual && media)) && (

        <audio controls className="mt-3 w-full" src={audio ?? media ?? undefined} />

      )}

      {master.checksum_sha256 ? (

        <p className="mt-3 break-all font-mono text-[0.65rem] text-[var(--mist-soft)]">

          sha256 {master.checksum_sha256.slice(0, 24)}…

        </p>

      ) : null}

    </article>

  );

}



export default function PublishProjectPage() {

  const params = useParams();

  const projectId = String(params.id);



  const [project, setProject] = useState<Project | null>(null);

  const [packages, setPackages] = useState<CinemaPackage[]>([]);

  const [publications, setPublications] = useState<Publication[]>([]);

  const [selectedPackage, setSelectedPackage] = useState("");

  const [channel, setChannel] = useState("art_city_channel");

  const [note, setNote] = useState("");

  const [activeId, setActiveId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);



  const load = useCallback(async () => {

    setLoading(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      const [p, pkgs, pubs] = await Promise.all([

        api.getProject(projectId),

        api.listCinemaPackages(projectId),

        api.listPublications(projectId),

      ]);

      setProject(p);

      setPackages(pkgs);

      setPublications(pubs);

      if (!selectedPackage && pkgs[0]) setSelectedPackage(pkgs[0].package_id);

      if (!activeId && pubs[0]) setActiveId(pubs[0].publication_id);

    } catch (e) {

      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to open publish");

      setProject(null);

    } finally {

      setLoading(false);

    }

  }, [projectId, selectedPackage, activeId]);



  useEffect(() => {

    void load();

    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  }, [projectId]);



  const active = useMemo(

    () => publications.find((p) => p.publication_id === activeId) ?? publications[0] ?? null,

    [publications, activeId]

  );



  async function onPackage(e: FormEvent) {

    e.preventDefault();

    if (!selectedPackage) return;

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      const pub = await api.createPublication(projectId, {

        cinema_package_id: selectedPackage,

        channel,

        auto_approve_missing: true,

        publisher_note: note.trim() || undefined,

      });

      setActiveId(pub.publication_id);

      setPublications(await api.listPublications(projectId));

    } catch (err) {

      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Packaging failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  }



  async function onRelease() {

    if (!active) return;

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      const pub = await api.finalizePublish(projectId, active.publication_id);

      setActiveId(pub.publication_id);

      setPublications(await api.listPublications(projectId));

    } catch (err) {

      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Publish failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  }



  return (

    <main className="min-h-screen pb-24">

      <SiteHeader />

      <div className="ac-container pt-8 md:pt-12">

        {loading ? (

          <p className="py-16 text-[0.8rem] tracking-[0.18em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase">

            Opening delivery desk…

          </p>

        ) : !project ? (

          <EmptyState

            title="Publish unavailable"

            description={error ?? "Project not found."}

            action={

              <Link href="/publish" className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary">

                Back to publish

              </Link>

            }

          />

        ) : (

          <>

            <div className="mb-10 animate-rise">

              <Link

                href="/publish"

                className="ac-display text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.28em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase transition hover:text-[var(--gold-bright)]"

              >

                ← Publish floor

              </Link>

              <h1 className="ac-display mt-4 text-[clamp(2rem,5vw,3.5rem)] tracking-tight">

                {project.name}

              </h1>

              <p className="ac-serif mt-3 max-w-2xl text-[var(--mist)]">

                Package approved cinema masters into a checksummed Art City delivery for broadcast

                and social release.

              </p>

              <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3">

                <Link href={`/cinema/${projectId}`} className="ac-btn ac-btn-secondary">

                  Cinema packages

                </Link>

                <Link href={`/studio/${projectId}`} className="ac-btn ac-btn-ghost">

                  Media studio

                </Link>

              </div>

            </div>



            {error ? <p className="mb-6 text-sm text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p> : null}



            <div className="grid gap-10 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,0.9fr)_minmax(0,1.2fr)]">

              <form

                onSubmit={onPackage}

                className="space-y-5 border border-[var(--line)] bg-[rgba(10,15,22,0.5)] p-5 md:p-6 animate-rise-delay"

              >

                <div>

                  <p className="ac-display text-xl text-[var(--gold-bright)]">Build delivery</p>

                  <p className="ac-serif mt-1 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

                    Select a cinema package to export 16:9 / 9:16 / 1:1 masters + stems.

                  </p>

                </div>



                {packages.length === 0 ? (

                  <EmptyState

                    title="No cinema package"

                    description="Render a cinematic advertising package before publishing."

                    action={

                      <Link href={`/cinema/${projectId}`} className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary">

                        Go to cinema

                      </Link>

                    }

                  />

                ) : (

                  <>

                    <div>

                      <label className="ac-label" htmlFor="pkg">

                        Cinema package

                      </label>

                      <select

                        id="pkg"

                        className="ac-field"

                        value={selectedPackage}

                        onChange={(e) => setSelectedPackage(e.target.value)}

                        required

                      >

                        {packages.map((pkg) => (

                          <option key={pkg.package_id} value={pkg.package_id}>

                            {pkg.campaign} · {pkg.duration_seconds}s

                          </option>

                        ))}

                      </select>

                    </div>

                    <div>

                      <label className="ac-label" htmlFor="channel">

                        Delivery channel

                      </label>

                      <select

                        id="channel"

                        className="ac-field"

                        value={channel}

                        onChange={(e) => setChannel(e.target.value)}

                      >

                        <option value="art_city_channel">Art City Channel</option>

                        <option value="youtube_16x9">YouTube 16:9</option>

                        <option value="social_vertical">Social vertical</option>

                        <option value="archive_master">Archive master</option>

                      </select>

                    </div>

                    <div>

                      <label className="ac-label" htmlFor="note">

                        Publisher note

                      </label>

                      <textarea

                        id="note"

                        className="ac-textarea min-h-[5rem]"

                        value={note}

                        onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)}

                        placeholder="Final delivery for Kardokh pilot promo week…"

                      />

                    </div>

                    <button type="submit" disabled={busy} className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary">

                      {busy ? "Packaging…" : "Package masters"}

                    </button>

                  </>

                )}

              </form>



              <section className="animate-rise-late">

                <div className="mb-5 flex items-end justify-between gap-3">

                  <h2 className="ac-display text-lg">Publications</h2>

                  <span className="text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist-soft)] uppercase">

                    {publications.length} packaged

                  </span>

                </div>



                {publications.length === 0 ? (

                  <EmptyState

                    title="No publications yet"

                    description="Package a cinema campaign to generate the delivery checklist and masters."

                  />

                ) : (

                  <>

                    <ul className="mb-8 border-t border-[var(--line)]">

                      {publications.map((pub) => (

                        <li key={pub.publication_id}>

                          <button

                            type="button"

                            onClick={() => setActiveId(pub.publication_id)}

                            className={`ac-row w-full py-4 text-left ${

                              active?.publication_id === pub.publication_id

                                ? "bg-[rgba(197,161,94,0.06)]"

                                : ""

                            }`}

                          >

                            <p className="ac-display text-lg">{pub.campaign}</p>

                            <p className={`mt-1 text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.12em] uppercase ${statusTone(pub.status ?? "")}`}>

                              {pub.status} · {pub.progress}% · {pub.channel}

                            </p>

                          </button>

                          <div className="ac-rule" />

                        </li>

                      ))}

                    </ul>



                    {active ? (

                      <div className="space-y-8">

                        <div className="border border-[var(--line)] p-5">

                          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-4">

                            <div>

                              <p className="ac-display text-2xl text-[var(--gold-bright)]">

                                {active.campaign}

                              </p>

                              <p className={`mt-2 text-[0.75rem] tracking-[0.16em] uppercase ${statusTone(active.status ?? "")}`}>

                                {active.status} · progress {active.progress}%

                              </p>

                            </div>

                            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">

                              {active.manifest_url ? (

                                <a

                                  href={withAccessToken(`${API_URL}${active.manifest_url}`)}

                                  target="_blank"

                                  rel="noreferrer"

                                  className="ac-btn ac-btn-secondary"

                                >

                                  Manifest

                                </a>

                              ) : null}

                              {active.report_url ? (

                                <a

                                  href={withAccessToken(`${API_URL}${active.report_url}`)}

                                  target="_blank"

                                  rel="noreferrer"

                                  className="ac-btn ac-btn-ghost"

                                >

                                  Report

                                </a>

                              ) : null}

                              {active.status === "ready" ? (

                                <button

                                  type="button"

                                  disabled={busy}

                                  onClick={() => void onRelease()}

                                  className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary"

                                >

                                  {busy ? "Releasing…" : "Release to channel"}

                                </button>

                              ) : null}

                            </div>

                          </div>



                          <div className="mt-5 h-1.5 w-full bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.06)]">

                            <div

                              className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[var(--gold-deep)] to-[var(--gold-bright)] transition-all"

                              style={{ width: `${active.progress}%` }}

                            />

                          </div>

                        </div>



                        <div>

                          <h3 className="ac-display mb-4 text-[var(--paper)]">Delivery checklist</h3>

                          <ul className="space-y-0 border-t border-[var(--line)]">

                            {active.checklist.map((item) => (

                              <li key={item.id} className="border-b border-[var(--line)] py-3">

                                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">

                                  <div>

                                    <p className="text-[var(--paper)]">{item.label}</p>

                                    {item.detail ? (

                                      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[var(--mist-soft)]">{item.detail}</p>

                                    ) : null}

                                  </div>

                                  <span

                                    className={`ac-display shrink-0 text-[0.65rem] tracking-[0.14em] uppercase ${statusTone(item.status)}`}

                                  >

                                    {item.status}

                                  </span>

                                </div>

                              </li>

                            ))}

                          </ul>

                        </div>



                        <div>

                          <h3 className="ac-display mb-4 text-[var(--paper)]">Exported masters</h3>

                          <div className="grid gap-4">

                            {active.masters.map((m) => (

                              <MasterCard key={`${m.role}-${m.filename}`} master={m} />

                            ))}

                          </div>

                        </div>

                      </div>

                    ) : null}

                  </>

                )}

              </section>

            </div>

          </>

        )}

      </div>

    </main>

  );

}


frontend/src/app/publish/page.tsx
"use client";



import Link from "next/link";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { api, type Project } from "@/lib/api";

import { EmptyState } from "@/components/EmptyState";

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/PageHeader";

import { SiteHeader } from "@/components/SiteHeader";



export default function PublishHubPage() {

  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<Project[]>([]);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);



  useEffect(() => {

    api

      .listProjects()

      .then(setProjects)

      .catch((e) => setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to load"))

      .finally(() => setLoading(false));

  }, []);



  return (

    <main className="min-h-screen pb-20">

      <SiteHeader />

      <div className="ac-container pt-10 md:pt-14">

        <PageHeader

          eyebrow="Art City delivery"

          title="Publish"

          description="Approve → package → export masters. Broadcast 16:9, vertical 9:16, square 1:1, stems, checksums, and delivery checklist."

        />



        <div className="mb-12 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-4 animate-rise-delay">

          {[

            ["01", "Select cinema package"],

            ["02", "Package masters"],

            ["03", "Pass checklist"],

            ["04", "Release to channel"],

          ].map(([n, t]) => (

            <div key={n} className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[rgba(10,15,22,0.4)] p-4">

              <p className="ac-display text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.2em] text-[var(--gold)]">{n}</p>

              <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-[var(--paper-dim)]">{t}</p>

            </div>

          ))}

        </div>



        {loading ? (

          <p className="text-[0.8rem] tracking-[0.18em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase">

            Loading projects…

          </p>

        ) : error ? (

          <p className="text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p>

        ) : projects.length === 0 ? (

          <EmptyState

            title="Nothing to publish"

            description="Create a project and cinema package first, then open Publish for delivery."

            action={

              <Link href="/cinema" className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary">

                Open cinema

              </Link>

            }

          />

        ) : (

          <ul className="border-t border-[var(--line)]">

            {projects.map((p, i) => (

              <li key={p.id} className="ac-row">

                <Link

                  href={`/publish/${p.id}`}

                  className="group grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr_auto] items-baseline gap-4 py-7 md:gap-8"

                >

                  <span className="ac-display w-8 text-[0.75rem] tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist-soft)]">

                    {String(i + 1).padStart(2, "0")}

                  </span>

                  <div>

                    <p className="ac-display text-2xl tracking-tight transition group-hover:text-[var(--gold-bright)]">

                      {p.name}

                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-2 text-[0.72rem] tracking-[0.16em] text-[var(--mist-soft)] uppercase">

                      Masters · Checklist · Channel release

                    </p>

                  </div>

                  <span className="ac-display text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.18em] text-[var(--gold)] uppercase">

                    Publish →

                  </span>

                </Link>

                <div className="ac-rule" />

              </li>

            ))}

          </ul>

        )}

      </div>

    </main>

  );

}
