frontend/src/app/signup/page.tsx
"use client";



import Link from "next/link";

import { FormEvent, useState } from "react";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";

import { BrandMark } from "@/components/BrandMark";

import { api } from "@/lib/api";

import { setSession } from "@/lib/auth";



export default function SignupPage() {

  const router = useRouter();

  const [fullName, setFullName] = useState("");

  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");

  const [phone, setPhone] = useState("");

  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");

  const [accept, setAccept] = useState(false);

  const [emailToken, setEmailToken] = useState("");

  const [phoneCode, setPhoneCode] = useState("");

  const [step, setStep] = useState<"form" | "verify">("form");

  const [message, setMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);



  async function onSignup(e: FormEvent) {

    e.preventDefault();

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    setMessage(null);

    try {

      const res = await api.signup({

        email,

        full_name: fullName,

        phone_number: phone,

        password,

        accept_terms: accept,

      });

      setMessage(res.message);

      if (res.email_token) setEmailToken(res.email_token);

      if (res.phone_code) setPhoneCode(res.phone_code);

      setStep("verify");

    } catch (err) {

      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Signup failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  }



  async function onVerify(e: FormEvent) {

    e.preventDefault();

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      await api.verifyEmail(email, emailToken);

      await api.verifyPhone(email, phoneCode);

      const tokens = await api.login(email, password);

      setSession(tokens);

      router.replace("/dashboard");

    } catch (err) {

      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Verification failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  }



  return (

    <main className="ac-container flex min-h-[100dvh] flex-col justify-center py-16">

      <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-md">

        <BrandMark product="platform" />

        <h1 className="mt-10 font-[family-name:var(--font-display)] text-3xl text-[var(--paper)]">

          Customer sign up

        </h1>

        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

          Email and phone verification required before Cinema, Studio, and Edit production access.

        </p>



        {step === "form" ? (

          <form onSubmit={onSignup} className="mt-8 space-y-4">

            <label className="block text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist)]">

              Full name

              <input

                className="mt-2 w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

                value={fullName}

                onChange={(e) => setFullName(e.target.value)}

                required

              />

            </label>

            <label className="block text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist)]">

              Email

              <input

                className="mt-2 w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

                type="email"

                value={email}

                onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}

                required

              />

            </label>

            <label className="block text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist)]">

              Phone

              <input

                className="mt-2 w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

                type="tel"

                placeholder="+9647xxxxxxxx"

                value={phone}

                onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)}

                required

              />

            </label>

            <label className="block text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist)]">

              Password

              <input

                className="mt-2 w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

                type="password"

                minLength={8}

                value={password}

                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}

                required

              />

            </label>

            <label className="flex items-start gap-3 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

              <input

                type="checkbox"

                className="mt-1"

                checked={accept}

                onChange={(e) => setAccept(e.target.checked)}

                required

              />

              I accept Art City Terms, Privacy, and rights declarations.

            </label>

            {error ? <p className="text-sm text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p> : null}

            <button

              type="submit"

              disabled={busy || !accept}

              className="w-full border border-[var(--gold)] bg-[rgba(197,161,94,0.16)] px-4 py-3 text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--gold-bright)] disabled:opacity-50"

            >

              {busy ? "Creating…" : "Create account"}

            </button>

          </form>

        ) : (

          <form onSubmit={onVerify} className="mt-8 space-y-4">

            {message ? <p className="text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">{message}</p> : null}

            <label className="block text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist)]">

              Email verification token

              <input

                className="mt-2 w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

                value={emailToken}

                onChange={(e) => setEmailToken(e.target.value)}

                required

              />

            </label>

            <label className="block text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist)]">

              Phone verification code

              <input

                className="mt-2 w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

                value={phoneCode}

                onChange={(e) => setPhoneCode(e.target.value)}

                required

              />

            </label>

            {error ? <p className="text-sm text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p> : null}

            <button

              type="submit"

              disabled={busy}

              className="w-full border border-[var(--gold)] bg-[rgba(197,161,94,0.16)] px-4 py-3 text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--gold-bright)] disabled:opacity-50"

            >

              {busy ? "Verifying…" : "Verify & enter production"}

            </button>

          </form>

        )}



        <p className="mt-6 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

          Already verified?{" "}

          <Link href="/login" className="text-[var(--gold-bright)]">

            Sign in

          </Link>

        </p>

      </div>

    </main>

  );

}


frontend/src/app/speech/page.tsx
"use client";



import { FormEvent, useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { CoreShell } from "@/components/CoreShell";

import { api, type AsrManifest, type SpeechDialect, type SpeechUploadResult } from "@/lib/api";



function triggerDownload(blob: Blob, filename: string) {

  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

  const a = document.createElement("a");

  a.href = url;

  a.download = filename;

  a.click();

  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

}



export default function SpeechPage() {

  const [dialects, setDialects] = useState<SpeechDialect[]>([]);

  const [model, setModel] = useState("AC-KURDISH-ASR-v1");

  const [dialect, setDialect] = useState("sorani");

  const [audioKey, setAudioKey] = useState("");

  const [uploadInfo, setUploadInfo] = useState<SpeechUploadResult | null>(null);

  const [fileName, setFileName] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [detectText, setDetectText] = useState("Silav, Newroz û Zagros");

  const [detection, setDetection] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [manifest, setManifest] = useState<AsrManifest | null>(null);

  const [recentJobs, setRecentJobs] = useState<string[]>([]);

  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);



  useEffect(() => {

    api

      .listSpeechDialects()

      .then((r) => {

        setDialects(r.dialects);

        setModel(r.model);

      })

      .catch(() => undefined);

    try {

      const raw = localStorage.getItem("artcity.speech.recentJobs");

      if (raw) setRecentJobs(JSON.parse(raw) as string[]);

    } catch {

      /* ignore */

    }

  }, []);



  function rememberJob(jobId: string) {

    setRecentJobs((prev) => {

      const next = [jobId, ...prev.filter((id) => id !== jobId)].slice(0, 8);

      localStorage.setItem("artcity.speech.recentJobs", JSON.stringify(next));

      return next;

    });

  }



  async function onDetect(e: FormEvent) {

    e.preventDefault();

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      const r = await api.detectLanguage(detectText);

      setDetection(`${r.language}/${r.dialect} · ${r.script} · conf ${r.confidence}`);

      setDialect(r.dialect);

    } catch (err) {

      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Detect failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  }



  async function onUpload(file: File | null) {

    if (!file) return;

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    setFileName(file.name);

    try {

      const uploaded = await api.uploadSpeechAudio(file);

      setUploadInfo(uploaded);

      setAudioKey(uploaded.audio_storage_key);

    } catch (err) {

      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Upload failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  }



  async function onAsr(e: FormEvent) {

    e.preventDefault();

    if (!audioKey.trim()) {

      setError("Upload audio or enter a storage key first");

      return;

    }

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      const r = await api.runAsr({

        audio_storage_key: audioKey.trim(),

        dialect,

        project_id: uploadInfo?.project_id,

        create_annotation: true,

      });

      setManifest(r);

      if (r.job_id) rememberJob(r.job_id);

    } catch (err) {

      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "ASR failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  }



  async function loadJob(jobId: string) {

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      const r = await api.getSpeechJob(jobId);

      setManifest(r);

      if (r.audio_storage_key) setAudioKey(r.audio_storage_key);

      if (r.dialect) setDialect(r.dialect);

    } catch (err) {

      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Load job failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  }



  async function download(kind: "vtt" | "srt" | "json") {

    if (!manifest?.job_id) return;

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      if (kind === "json") {

        const blob = await api.downloadSpeechTranscript(manifest.job_id);

        triggerDownload(blob, `transcript-${manifest.job_id}.json`);

      } else {

        const blob = await api.downloadSpeechSubtitle(manifest.job_id, kind);

        triggerDownload(blob, `subtitles-${manifest.job_id}.${kind}`);

      }

    } catch (err) {

      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Download failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  }



  return (

    <CoreShell

      title="Kurdish Speech"

      subtitle={`${model} — upload audio, transcribe Sorani / Badini / Kurmanji, download VTT/SRT.`}

    >

      {error ? <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p> : null}



      <div className="grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-2">

        <form onSubmit={onDetect} className="space-y-3 border border-[var(--line)] p-5">

          <p className="text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist)]">

            Language / dialect detect

          </p>

          <textarea

            value={detectText}

            onChange={(e) => setDetectText(e.target.value)}

            rows={4}

            className="w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

          />

          <button

            type="submit"

            disabled={busy}

            className="border border-[var(--gold)] px-4 py-2 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--gold-bright)]"

          >

            Detect

          </button>

          {detection ? <p className="text-sm text-[var(--teal)]">{detection}</p> : null}

        </form>



        <form onSubmit={onAsr} className="space-y-3 border border-[var(--line)] p-5">

          <p className="text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist)]">

            Transcribe audio

          </p>

          <label className="block">

            <span className="mb-1 block text-xs text-[var(--mist)]">Audio file</span>

            <input

              type="file"

              accept="audio/*,.wav,.mp3,.m4a,.ogg"

              onChange={(e) => void onUpload(e.target.files?.[0] ?? null)}

              className="w-full text-sm text-[var(--paper)] file:mr-3 file:border file:border-[var(--line)] file:bg-[var(--ink-soft)] file:px-3 file:py-1.5 file:text-xs file:uppercase file:tracking-[0.12em] file:text-[var(--gold-bright)]"

            />

          </label>

          {uploadInfo ? (

            <p className="text-xs text-[var(--teal)]">

              Uploaded {fileName ?? "audio"} · {uploadInfo.bytes} bytes

              {uploadInfo.duration_seconds != null

                ? ` · ${uploadInfo.duration_seconds.toFixed(1)}s`

                : ""}

            </p>

          ) : null}

          <input

            value={audioKey}

            onChange={(e) => setAudioKey(e.target.value)}

            className="w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

            placeholder="or paste MinIO audio storage key"

          />

          <select

            value={dialect}

            onChange={(e) => setDialect(e.target.value)}

            className="w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-soft)] px-3 py-2 text-[var(--paper)]"

          >

            {(dialects.length

              ? dialects

              : [

                  { id: "sorani", label: "Sorani", script: "arabic" },

                  { id: "badini", label: "Badini", script: "arabic" },

                  { id: "kurmanji", label: "Kurmanji", script: "latin" },

                ]

            ).map((d) => (

              <option key={d.id} value={d.id}>

                {d.label}

              </option>

            ))}

          </select>

          <button

            type="submit"

            disabled={busy || !audioKey.trim()}

            className="border border-[var(--gold)] bg-[rgba(197,161,94,0.14)] px-4 py-2 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--gold-bright)] disabled:opacity-50"

          >

            {busy ? "Transcribing…" : "Transcribe"}

          </button>

        </form>

      </div>



      {recentJobs.length ? (

        <div className="mt-8 border border-[var(--line)] p-5">

          <p className="text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist)]">Recent jobs</p>

          <ul className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">

            {recentJobs.map((id) => (

              <li key={id}>

                <button

                  type="button"

                  disabled={busy}

                  onClick={() => void loadJob(id)}

                  className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs text-[var(--paper-dim)] hover:border-[var(--gold)] hover:text-[var(--gold-bright)]"

                >

                  {id.slice(0, 8)}…

                </button>

              </li>

            ))}

          </ul>

        </div>

      ) : null}



      {manifest ? (

        <div className="mt-10 border border-[var(--line)] p-5">

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-3">

            <p className="text-[var(--paper)]">

              {manifest.engine}

              {manifest.model ? ` · ${manifest.model}` : ""} · {manifest.dialect} · avg conf{" "}

              {manifest.average_confidence} · {manifest.segment_count} segments · {manifest.status}

              {manifest.job_id ? (

                <span className="ml-2 font-mono text-xs text-[var(--mist)]">

                  job {manifest.job_id.slice(0, 8)}

                </span>

              ) : null}

            </p>

            {manifest.job_id ? (

              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">

                <button

                  type="button"

                  disabled={busy}

                  onClick={() => void download("vtt")}

                  className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-1.5 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--gold-bright)]"

                >

                  Download VTT

                </button>

                <button

                  type="button"

                  disabled={busy}

                  onClick={() => void download("srt")}

                  className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-1.5 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--gold-bright)]"

                >

                  Download SRT

                </button>

                <button

                  type="button"

                  disabled={busy}

                  onClick={() => void download("json")}

                  className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-1.5 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--paper-dim)]"

                >

                  Transcript JSON

                </button>

              </div>

            ) : null}

          </div>

          <ul className="mt-4 space-y-2">

            {manifest.segments.map((s, i) => (

              <li key={`${s.start}-${i}`} className="text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">

                <span className="text-[var(--paper-dim)]">

                  {s.start.toFixed(1)}–{s.end.toFixed(1)}s

                </span>{" "}

                {s.speaker}: {s.text}{" "}

                <span className="text-[var(--mist-soft)]">({s.confidence})</span>

              </li>

            ))}

          </ul>

        </div>

      ) : null}

    </CoreShell>

  );

}


frontend/src/app/studio/[id]/page.tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { FormEvent, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useParams } from "next/navigation";
import {
  api,
  type Character,
  type GenerationJob,
  type Modality,
  type Project,
  type StudioSummary,
} from "@/lib/api";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/EmptyState";
import { MediaPreview } from "@/components/MediaPreview";
import { SiteHeader } from "@/components/SiteHeader";

const TABS: { id: Modality | "review"; label: string; blurb: string }[] = [
  { id: "video", label: "Video", blurb: "Shot proxies with picture + sound bed" },
  { id: "voice", label: "Conversation", blurb: "Dialogue and character voice takes" },
  { id: "music", label: "Music", blurb: "Themes, beds, and instrumentals" },
  { id: "audio", label: "Sounds", blurb: "SFX and atmospheric hits" },
  { id: "image", label: "Image", blurb: "Frames, posters, storyboard stills" },
  { id: "review", label: "Review", blurb: "Approve, reject, or request changes" },
];

export default function ProjectStudioPage() {
  const params = useParams();
  const projectId = String(params.id);

  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Modality | "review">("video");

  const [project, setProject] = useState<Project | null>(null);
  const [characters, setCharacters] = useState<Character[]>([]);
  const [jobs, setJobs] = useState<GenerationJob[]>([]);
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState<StudioSummary | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState("");
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState(4);
  const [dialogue, setDialogue] = useState("");
  const [characterName, setCharacterName] = useState("");
  const [dialect, setDialect] = useState("sorani");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [selectedJobId, setSelectedJobId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const [p, c, g, s] = await Promise.all([
        api.getProject(projectId),
        api.listCharacters(projectId),
        api.listGenerations(projectId),
        api.studioSummary(projectId),
      ]);
      setProject(p);
      setCharacters(c);
      setJobs(g);
      setSummary(s);
      if (!selectedJobId && g[0]) setSelectedJobId(g[0].id);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to open studio");
      setProject(null);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [projectId, selectedJobId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
    // intentionally once / when project changes
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [projectId]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    if (tab === "review") return jobs.filter((j) => j.status === "succeeded");
    return jobs.filter((j) => j.modality === tab);
  }, [jobs, tab]);

  const selected = jobs.find((j) => j.id === selectedJobId) ?? filtered[0] ?? null;

  async function onGenerate(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (tab === "review") return;
    if (!prompt.trim()) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const lines = dialogue
        .split("\n")
        .map((l) => l.trim())
        .filter(Boolean);
      const job = await api.generate(projectId, {
        modality: tab,
        prompt: prompt.trim(),
        duration_seconds: duration,
        dialogue_lines: tab === "voice" && lines.length ? lines : undefined,
        character_name: characterName.trim() || undefined,
        dialect,
      });
      setPrompt("");
      setDialogue("");
      setSelectedJobId(job.id);
      const [g, s] = await Promise.all([
        api.listGenerations(projectId),
        api.studioSummary(projectId),
      ]);
      setJobs(g);
      setSummary(s);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Generation failed");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function onReview(decision: "approve" | "reject" | "request_changes") {
    if (!selected) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await api.review(projectId, selected.id, { decision, quality_score: decision === "approve" ? 8 : 5 });
      const s = await api.studioSummary(projectId);
      setSummary(s);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Review failed");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen pb-24">
      <SiteHeader />
      <div className="ac-container pt-8 md:pt-12">
        {loading ? (
          <p className="py-16 text-[0.8rem] tracking-[0.18em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase">
            Powering studio…
          </p>
        ) : !project ? (
          <EmptyState
            title="Studio unavailable"
            description={error ?? "Project not found."}
            action={
              <Link href="/studio" className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary">
                Back to studio
              </Link>
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="mb-8 animate-rise">
              <Link
                href="/studio"
                className="ac-display text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.28em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase transition hover:text-[var(--gold-bright)]"
              >
                ← Studio floor
              </Link>
              <h1 className="ac-display mt-4 text-[clamp(2rem,5vw,3.4rem)] tracking-tight">
                {project.name}
              </h1>
              <p className="ac-serif mt-3 max-w-2xl text-[var(--mist)]">
                Full production desk — generate media, listen/watch, and review takes.
              </p>
              <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                <Link href={`/cinema/${projectId}`} className="ac-btn ac-btn-secondary">
                  Cinema
                </Link>
                <Link href={`/hub/${projectId}/script`} className="ac-btn ac-btn-secondary">
                  Hub Script
                </Link>
                <Link href="/edit" className="ac-btn ac-btn-secondary">
                  Edit
                </Link>
                <Link href={`/publish/${projectId}`} className="ac-btn ac-btn-ghost">
                  Publish
                </Link>
              </div>
              {summary ? (
                <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap gap-x-6 gap-y-2 text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.16em] text-[var(--mist-soft)] uppercase">
                  <span>Pending review · {summary.pending_review}</span>
                  <span>Approved · {summary.approved}</span>
                  <span>Spend · ${summary.spent.toFixed(2)}</span>
                  <span>Video · {summary.totals.video ?? 0}</span>
                  <span>Voice · {summary.totals.voice ?? 0}</span>
                  <span>Music · {summary.totals.music ?? 0}</span>
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </div>

            <div className="mb-8 flex flex-wrap gap-2 border-b border-[var(--line)] pb-3 animate-rise-delay">
              {TABS.map((t) => (
                <button
                  key={t.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setTab(t.id)}
                  className={`ac-display px-3 py-2 text-[0.72rem] tracking-[0.16em] uppercase transition ${
                    tab === t.id
                      ? "text-[var(--gold-bright)]"
                      : "text-[var(--mist)] hover:text-[var(--paper)]"
                  }`}
                >
                  {t.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            {error ? <p className="mb-6 text-sm text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p> : null}

            <div className="grid gap-10 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1.05fr)]">
              <section className="animate-rise-delay">
                {tab !== "review" ? (
                  <form onSubmit={onGenerate} className="space-y-5 border border-[var(--line)] bg-[rgba(10,15,22,0.45)] p-5 md:p-6">
                    <div>
                      <p className="ac-display text-xl text-[var(--gold-bright)]">
                        {TABS.find((t) => t.id === tab)?.label}
                      </p>
                      <p className="ac-serif mt-1 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">
                        {TABS.find((t) => t.id === tab)?.blurb}
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <label className="ac-label" htmlFor="prompt">
                        Creative direction
                      </label>
                      <textarea
                        id="prompt"
                        value={prompt}
                        onChange={(e) => setPrompt(e.target.value)}
                        className="ac-textarea"
                        rows={4}
                        placeholder={
                          tab === "video"
                            ? "Wide shot of Kardokh walking through Kurdiya village at golden hour…"
                            : tab === "voice"
                              ? "Warm Kurdish narration about friendship and home…"
                              : tab === "music"
                                ? "Gentle children’s theme in major key, soft strings…"
                                : tab === "audio"
                                  ? "Soft footstep on dry earth, distant wind…"
                                  : "Character poster, Kurdish clothing, soft landscape light…"
                        }
                        required
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <label className="ac-label" htmlFor="dialect">
                        Kurdish dialect
                      </label>
                      <select
                        id="dialect"
                        value={dialect}
                        onChange={(e) => setDialect(e.target.value)}
                        className="ac-field"
                      >
                        <option value="sorani">Sorani</option>
                        <option value="badini">Badini</option>
                        <option value="kurmanji">Kurmanji</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>

                    {(tab === "video" || tab === "music") && (
                      <div>
                        <label className="ac-label" htmlFor="duration">
                          Duration (seconds)
                        </label>
                        <input
                          id="duration"
                          type="number"
                          min={1}
                          max={30}
                          value={duration}
                          onChange={(e) => setDuration(Number(e.target.value))}
                          className="ac-field"
                        />
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {tab === "voice" && (
                      <>
                        <div>
                          <label className="ac-label" htmlFor="character">
                            Character (optional)
                          </label>
                          <input
                            id="character"
                            list="cast"
                            value={characterName}
                            onChange={(e) => setCharacterName(e.target.value)}
                            className="ac-field"
                            placeholder="Kardokh"
                          />
                          <datalist id="cast">
                            {characters.map((c) => (
                              <option key={c.id} value={c.name} />
                            ))}
                          </datalist>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <label className="ac-label" htmlFor="dialogue">
                            Conversation lines (one per line)
                          </label>
                          <textarea
                            id="dialogue"
                            value={dialogue}
                            onChange={(e) => setDialogue(e.target.value)}
                            className="ac-textarea min-h-[7rem]"
                            placeholder={"Kardokh: Hello, my friend.\nKurdiya: Welcome home."}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </>
                    )}

                    <button type="submit" disabled={busy} className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary">
                      {busy ? "Rendering…" : `Generate ${tab}`}
                    </button>
                  </form>
                ) : (
                  <div className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[rgba(10,15,22,0.45)] p-5 md:p-6">
                    <p className="ac-display text-xl text-[var(--gold-bright)]">Quality control</p>
                    <p className="ac-serif mt-2 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">
                      Select a take on the right, then record the production decision.
                    </p>
                    <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        disabled={!selected || busy}
                        className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary"
                        onClick={() => void onReview("approve")}
                      >
                        Approve
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        disabled={!selected || busy}
                        className="ac-btn ac-btn-secondary"
                        onClick={() => void onReview("request_changes")}
                      >
                        Request changes
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        disabled={!selected || busy}
                        className="ac-btn ac-btn-ghost"
                        onClick={() => void onReview("reject")}
                      >
                        Reject
                      </button>
                    </div>
                    <Link
                      href={`/projects/${projectId}`}
                      className="mt-8 inline-block text-sm text-[var(--mist)] transition hover:text-[var(--gold-bright)]"
                    >
                      Open project desk →
                    </Link>
                  </div>
                )}
              </section>

              <section className="animate-rise-late">
                <div className="mb-4 flex items-end justify-between gap-3">
                  <h2 className="ac-display text-lg text-[var(--paper)]">Takes</h2>
                  <span className="text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist-soft)] uppercase">
                    {filtered.length} items
                  </span>
                </div>

                {selected ? (
                  <div className="mb-6">
                    <MediaPreview job={selected} />
                    <p className="ac-serif mt-3 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">{selected.prompt}</p>
                    <p className="mt-2 text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist-soft)] uppercase">
                      {selected.modality} · {selected.status} · $
                      {(selected.actual_cost ?? 0).toFixed(2)}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ) : null}

                {filtered.length === 0 ? (
                  <EmptyState
                    title="No takes yet"
                    description="Generate your first media asset for this bay. Outputs are stored in Art City object storage."
                  />
                ) : (
                  <ul className="max-h-[28rem] space-y-0 overflow-auto border-t border-[var(--line)]">
                    {filtered.map((j) => (
                      <li key={j.id}>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setSelectedJobId(j.id)}
                          className={`ac-row w-full py-4 text-left ${
                            selected?.id === j.id ? "bg-[rgba(197,161,94,0.06)]" : ""
                          }`}
                        >
                          <p className="ac-display text-[0.95rem] text-[var(--paper)] line-clamp-1">
                            {j.prompt}
                          </p>
                          <p className="mt-1 text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--mist-soft)] uppercase">
                            {j.modality} · {j.status}
                          </p>
                        </button>
                        <div className="ac-rule" />
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                )}
              </section>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

frontend/src/app/studio/bank-building/page.tsx
"use client";



import Link from "next/link";

import { FormEvent, useState } from "react";

import {

  api,

  mediaAbsolute,

  withAccessToken,

  type GenerationJob,

} from "@/lib/api";

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/PageHeader";

import { SiteHeader } from "@/components/SiteHeader";



export default function BankBuildingImagePage() {

  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");

  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [job, setJob] = useState<GenerationJob | null>(null);



  async function onGenerate(e: FormEvent) {

    e.preventDefault();

    setBusy(true);

    setError(null);

    try {

      const result = await api.generateBankBuilding({

        notes: notes.trim() || undefined,

        prefer_external: true,

      });

      setJob(result);

    } catch (err) {

      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Generation failed");

    } finally {

      setBusy(false);

    }

  }



  const media = withAccessToken(mediaAbsolute(job?.media_url) || "");



  return (

    <main className="min-h-screen pb-20">

      <SiteHeader />

      <div className="ac-container pt-10 md:pt-14">

        <PageHeader

          eyebrow="Art City Studio · Image test"

          title="Bank building generate"

          description="Frontend + backend Studio path that generates a cinematic bank building still, then shows the production image."

        />



        <p className="mb-8">

          <Link

            href="/studio"

            className="text-[0.72rem] uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-[var(--gold)] hover:text-[var(--gold-bright)]"

          >

            ← Studio floor

          </Link>

        </p>



        <form onSubmit={onGenerate} className="max-w-xl space-y-5">

          <label className="block space-y-2">

            <span className="ac-display text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.18em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase">

              Extra direction (optional)

            </span>

            <textarea

              value={notes}

              onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}

              rows={3}

              placeholder="e.g. night rain, glass atrium reflection, Art City plaza"

              className="w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-[rgba(10,15,22,0.55)] px-3 py-3 text-sm text-[var(--paper)] outline-none focus:border-[var(--gold)]"

            />

          </label>

          <button type="submit" disabled={busy} className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary">

            {busy ? "Generating…" : "Generate bank building image"}

          </button>

        </form>



        {error ? <p className="mt-6 text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p> : null}



        {job ? (

          <section className="mt-12 max-w-3xl space-y-4">

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-4 text-[0.72rem] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist)]">

              <span>Status · {job.status}</span>

              <span>Provider · {job.provider}</span>

              {job.provider_job_id ? <span>Job · {job.provider_job_id}</span> : null}

            </div>

            {media ? (

              // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element

              <img

                src={media}

                alt={job.prompt || "Bank building"}

                className="w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-black object-cover aspect-video"

              />

            ) : (

              <p className="text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">No media URL on job.</p>

            )}

            <p className="text-sm text-[var(--mist-soft)]">{job.prompt}</p>

            <Link

              href={`/studio/${job.project_id}`}

              className="inline-block text-[0.72rem] uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-[var(--gold)]"

            >

              Open project studio →

            </Link>

          </section>

        ) : null}

      </div>

    </main>

  );

}


frontend/src/app/studio/page.tsx
"use client";



import Link from "next/link";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { api, type Project } from "@/lib/api";

import { EmptyState } from "@/components/EmptyState";

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/PageHeader";

import { SiteHeader } from "@/components/SiteHeader";



export default function StudioHubPage() {

  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<Project[]>([]);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);



  useEffect(() => {

    api

      .listProjects()

      .then(setProjects)

      .catch((e) => setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to load"))

      .finally(() => setLoading(false));

  }, []);



  return (

    <main className="min-h-screen pb-20">

      <SiteHeader />

      <div className="ac-container pt-10 md:pt-14">

        <PageHeader

          eyebrow="Art City Studio"

          title="Individual production assets"

          description="Create single images, videos, voice tracks, music tracks, or scene/shot takes — then review. For full campaigns, use Art City Cinema."

        />



        <div className="mb-10 border border-[var(--line)] bg-[rgba(10,15,22,0.35)] px-5 py-6 md:px-7">

          <p className="ac-display text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.18em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase">

            Image generate test

          </p>

          <p className="ac-display mt-2 text-2xl tracking-tight">Bank building</p>

          <p className="mt-2 max-w-xl text-sm text-[var(--mist-soft)]">

            Dedicated frontend + backend Studio path that generates a bank building still and previews the image.

          </p>

          <Link href="/studio/bank-building" className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary mt-5 inline-flex">

            Open bank building generate

          </Link>

        </div>



        {loading ? (

          <p className="text-[0.8rem] tracking-[0.18em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase">Opening floor…</p>

        ) : error ? (

          <p className="text-[var(--danger)]">{error}</p>

        ) : projects.length === 0 ? (

          <EmptyState

            title="No productions on the floor"

            description="Create a project first, then open the media studio for video, voice, and sound."

            action={

              <Link href="/projects" className="ac-btn ac-btn-primary">

                Create project

              </Link>

            }

          />

        ) : (

          <ul className="border-t border-[var(--line)]">

            {projects.map((p, i) => (

              <li key={p.id} className="ac-row">

                <Link

                  href={`/studio/${p.id}`}

                  className="group grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr_auto] items-baseline gap-4 py-7 md:gap-8"

                >

                  <span className="ac-display w-8 text-[0.75rem] tracking-[0.14em] text-[var(--mist-soft)]">

                    {String(i + 1).padStart(2, "0")}

                  </span>

                  <div>

                    <p className="ac-display text-2xl tracking-tight transition group-hover:text-[var(--gold-bright)]">

                      {p.name}

                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-2 text-[0.72rem] tracking-[0.16em] text-[var(--mist-soft)] uppercase">

                      Video · Voice · Music · Image · Review

                    </p>

                  </div>

                  <span className="ac-display text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.18em] text-[var(--gold)] uppercase">

                    Enter →

                  </span>

                </Link>

                <div className="ac-rule" />

              </li>

            ))}

          </ul>

        )}

      </div>

    </main>

  );

}

frontend/src/app/vertical-drama/[vdId]/episodes/[episodeId]/page.tsx
"use client";



import { useParams } from "next/navigation";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { CoreShell } from "@/components/CoreShell";

import { VdNav } from "@/components/VdNav";

import { vdApi, type VdProject } from "@/lib/api";



export default function EpisodePage() {

  const { vdId, episodeId } = useParams<{ vdId: string; episodeId: string }>();

  const [p, setP] = useState<VdProject | null>(null);

  const [ep, setEp] = useState<Record<string, unknown> | null>(null);

  const [status, setStatus] = useState("");

  const [script, setScript] = useState("INT. ROOM - DAY\nShe waits.\n\nHERO\nWe finish this tonight.");



  async function load() {

    setP(await vdApi.get(vdId));

    const data = await vdApi.episode(episodeId);

    setEp(data);

  }

  useEffect(() => {

    load().catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)));

  }, [vdId, episodeId]);



  async function saveScript() {

    const elements = script.split("\n").filter(Boolean).map((line) => {

      if (line.startsWith("INT.") || line.startsWith("EXT.")) return { element_type: "scene_heading", display_text: line };

      if (line === line.toUpperCase() && line.length < 40) return { element_type: "character", display_text: line };

      return { element_type: "action", display_text: line };

    });

    await vdApi.saveScreenplay(episodeId, { title: ep?.title, elements });

    await load();

    setStatus("Screenplay saved");

  }



  return (

    <CoreShell title={String(ep?.title || "Episode")} subtitle={String(ep?.status || "")}>

      {p ? <VdNav vdId={p.id} projectId={p.project_id} /> : null}

      {ep?.stale ? <p className="mb-3 border border-[var(--danger)] px-3 py-2 text-sm text-[var(--danger)]">{String(ep.stale_reason)}</p> : null}

      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">

        {["drafted", "reviewed", "approved", "production_ready", "locked"].map((s) => (

          <button key={s} type="button" onClick={() => vdApi.patchEpisode(episodeId, { status: s }).then(load).catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))} className="border border-[var(--line)] px-2 py-1 text-[0.65rem] uppercase">

            {s}

          </button>

        ))}

      </div>

      <textarea value={script} onChange={(e) => setScript(e.target.value)} rows={8} className="w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-transparent px-3 py-2 text-sm" dir="auto" />

      <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">

        <button type="button" onClick={() => saveScript().catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))} className="border border-[var(--gold)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase text-[var(--gold-bright)]">

          Save screenplay

        </button>

        <button type="button" onClick={() => vdApi.decoupage(episodeId).then(load).catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))} className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase">

          Découpage

        </button>

        <button type="button" onClick={() => vdApi.qc(episodeId).then((r) => setStatus(JSON.stringify(r))).catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))} className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase">

          QC

        </button>

        <button type="button" onClick={() => vdApi.assemble(episodeId).then((r) => setStatus(JSON.stringify(r))).catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))} className="border border-[var(--teal)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase text-[var(--teal)]">

          Handoff Edit

        </button>

        <button

          type="button"

          onClick={() =>

            vdApi.localize(episodeId, { language: "ckb-IQ", kind: "subtitle", body: String(ep?.hook || "") }).then(load)

          }

          className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase"

        >

          Sorani subtitle

        </button>

        <button type="button" onClick={() => vdApi.delivery(episodeId).then((r) => setStatus(JSON.stringify(r))).catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))} className="border border-[var(--gold)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase">

          Delivery package

        </button>

      </div>

      <div className="mt-6 space-y-2">

        {((ep?.shots as Record<string, unknown>[]) || []).map((s) => (

          <div key={String(s.id)} className="flex items-center justify-between border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2 text-sm">

            <span>

              Shot {String(s.shot_number)} · {String(s.framing)} · {String(s.status)}

            </span>

            <button type="button" onClick={() => vdApi.generateShot(String(s.id)).then(load)} className="text-[0.7rem] uppercase text-[var(--gold-bright)]">

              Generate

            </button>

          </div>

        ))}

      </div>

      {status ? <p className="mt-4 whitespace-pre-wrap text-xs text-[var(--mist)]">{status}</p> : null}

    </CoreShell>

  );

}

"use client";



import { useParams } from "next/navigation";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { CoreShell } from "@/components/CoreShell";

import { VdNav } from "@/components/VdNav";

import { vdApi, type VdProject } from "@/lib/api";



export default function IpVaultPage() {

  const { vdId } = useParams<{ vdId: string }>();

  const [p, setP] = useState<VdProject | null>(null);

  const [rights, setRights] = useState<Record<string, unknown>[]>([]);

  const [contrib, setContrib] = useState<Record<string, unknown>[]>([]);

  const [prov, setProv] = useState<Record<string, unknown>[]>([]);

  const [name, setName] = useState("");



  async function load() {

    const proj = await vdApi.get(vdId);

    setP(proj);

    setRights(await vdApi.rights(vdId));

    setContrib(await vdApi.contributors(vdId));

    setProv(await vdApi.provenance(vdId));

  }

  useEffect(() => {

    load().catch(() => undefined);

  }, [vdId]);



  return (

    <CoreShell title="IP Vault" subtitle={p?.title || ""}>

      {p ? <VdNav vdId={p.id} projectId={p.project_id} /> : null}

      <div className="mb-4 flex gap-2">

        <input value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Contributor" className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-transparent px-3 py-2" />

        <button

          type="button"

          onClick={() => vdApi.addContributor(vdId, { display_name: name || "Creator", role: "creator" }).then(load)}

          className="border border-[var(--gold)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase text-[var(--gold-bright)]"

        >

          Add

        </button>

        <button type="button" onClick={() => vdApi.addRights(vdId, { territory: "IQ", rights_type: "original" }).then(load)} className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase">

          Add rights

        </button>

      </div>

      <h3 className="mt-6 text-sm uppercase text-[var(--mist)]">Rights</h3>

      <pre className="mt-2 overflow-auto text-xs">{JSON.stringify(rights, null, 2)}</pre>

      <h3 className="mt-6 text-sm uppercase text-[var(--mist)]">Contributors</h3>

      <pre className="mt-2 overflow-auto text-xs">{JSON.stringify(contrib, null, 2)}</pre>

      <h3 className="mt-6 text-sm uppercase text-[var(--mist)]">Provenance</h3>

      <pre className="mt-2 overflow-auto text-xs">{JSON.stringify(prov, null, 2)}</pre>

    </CoreShell>

  );

}

"use client";



import Link from "next/link";

import { useParams } from "next/navigation";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { CoreShell } from "@/components/CoreShell";

import { VdNav } from "@/components/VdNav";

import { vdApi, type VdProject } from "@/lib/api";



type Episode = {

  id: string;

  episode_number: number;

  title: string;

  hook?: string;

  cliffhanger?: string;

  status: string;

  stale?: boolean;

};



export default function SeasonsPage() {

  const { vdId } = useParams<{ vdId: string }>();

  const [p, setP] = useState<VdProject | null>(null);

  const [seasons, setSeasons] = useState<{ id: string; title: string; episodes: Episode[] }[]>([]);

  const [count, setCount] = useState(10);



  async function load() {

    setP(await vdApi.get(vdId));

    setSeasons((await vdApi.seasons(vdId)) as { id: string; title: string; episodes: Episode[] }[]);

  }

  useEffect(() => {

    load().catch(() => undefined);

  }, [vdId]);



  return (

    <CoreShell title="Season board" subtitle={p?.title || ""}>

      {p ? <VdNav vdId={p.id} projectId={p.project_id} /> : null}

      <div className="mb-4 flex gap-2">

        <input type="number" value={count} onChange={(e) => setCount(Number(e.target.value))} className="w-24 border border-[var(--line)] bg-transparent px-3 py-2" />

        <button type="button" onClick={() => vdApi.createSeason(vdId, { title: "Season 1", target_episode_count: count }).then(load)} className="border border-[var(--gold)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase text-[var(--gold-bright)]">

          Generate grid

        </button>

      </div>

      {seasons.map((s) => (

        <div key={s.id} className="overflow-x-auto">

          <table className="w-full text-left text-sm">

            <thead>

              <tr className="text-[0.65rem] uppercase text-[var(--mist)]">

                <th className="py-2">#</th>

                <th>Title</th>

                <th>Hook</th>

                <th>Cliffhanger</th>

                <th>Status</th>

              </tr>

            </thead>

            <tbody>

              {s.episodes.map((e) => (

                <tr key={e.id} className="border-t border-[var(--line)]">

                  <td className="py-2">{e.episode_number}</td>

                  <td>

                    <Link href={`/vertical-drama/${vdId}/episodes/${e.id}`} className="text-[var(--gold-bright)]">

                      {e.title}

                    </Link>

                    {e.stale ? <span className="ml-2 text-[var(--danger)]">stale</span> : null}

                  </td>

                  <td>{e.hook}</td>

                  <td>{e.cliffhanger}</td>

                  <td>{e.status}</td>

                </tr>

              ))}

            </tbody>

          </table>

        </div>

      ))}

    </CoreShell>

  );

}

"use client";

  const [bible, setBible] = useState<Record<string, unknown> | null>(null);

  const [tone, setTone] = useState("Intimate, high-stakes, 9:16 close-ups.");



  async function load() {

    setP(await vdApi.get(vdId));

    setBible(await vdApi.bible(vdId));

  }

  useEffect(() => {

    load().catch(() => undefined);

  }, [vdId]);



  const current = (bible?.current || {}) as Record<string, unknown>;

  const versionId = current.id as string | undefined;



  return (

    <CoreShell title="Story Bible" subtitle={p?.title || ""}>

      {p ? <VdNav vdId={p.id} projectId={p.project_id} /> : null}

      <textarea value={tone} onChange={(e) => setTone(e.target.value)} rows={2} className="mb-3 w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-transparent px-3 py-2" dir="auto" />

        <button type="button" onClick={() => vdApi.saveBible(vdId, { world, tone, language: p?.primary_locale }).then(load)} className="border border-[var(--gold)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase text-[var(--gold-bright)]">

          Save version

        </button>

        {versionId ? (

          <button type="button" onClick={() => vdApi.approveBible(versionId).then(load)} className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase">

            Approve / lock

          </button>

        ) : null}

      </div>

      <pre className="mt-6 overflow-auto text-xs">{JSON.stringify(bible, null, 2)}</pre>

    </CoreShell>

  );

}


frontend/src/app/vertical-drama/[vdId]/world/page.tsx
"use client";



import { useParams } from "next/navigation";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { CoreShell } from "@/components/CoreShell";

import { VdNav } from "@/components/VdNav";

import { vdApi, type VdProject } from "@/lib/api";



export default function WorldPage() {

  const { vdId } = useParams<{ vdId: string }>();

  const [p, setP] = useState<VdProject | null>(null);

  const [chars, setChars] = useState<Record<string, unknown>[]>([]);

  const [locs, setLocs] = useState<Record<string, unknown>[]>([]);

  const [canon, setCanon] = useState<Record<string, unknown>[]>([]);

  const [name, setName] = useState("");

  const [key, setKey] = useState("rule");

  const [value, setValue] = useState("");



  async function load() {

    const proj = await vdApi.get(vdId);

    setP(proj);

    setChars(await vdApi.characters(vdId));

    setLocs(await vdApi.locations(vdId));

    setCanon(await vdApi.canon(vdId));

  }

  useEffect(() => {

    load().catch(() => undefined);

  }, [vdId]);



  return (

    <CoreShell title="Story World" subtitle={p?.title || ""}>

      {p ? <VdNav vdId={p.id} projectId={p.project_id} /> : null}

      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">

        <input value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Character / location" className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-transparent px-3 py-2" dir="auto" />

        <button type="button" onClick={() => vdApi.addCharacter(vdId, { display_name: name, identity_locked: true, locale: p?.primary_locale }).then(load)} className="border border-[var(--gold)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase text-[var(--gold-bright)]">

          Character

        </button>

        <button type="button" onClick={() => vdApi.addLocation(vdId, { display_name: name, locale: p?.primary_locale }).then(load)} className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase">

          Location

        </button>

      </div>

      <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap gap-2">

        <input value={key} onChange={(e) => setKey(e.target.value)} className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-transparent px-3 py-2" />

        <input value={value} onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)} className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-transparent px-3 py-2" dir="auto" />

        <button type="button" onClick={() => vdApi.addCanon(vdId, { fact_key: key, fact_value: value }).then(load)} className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase">

          Canon fact

        </button>

      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">

        <div>

          <h3 className="text-sm uppercase text-[var(--mist)]">Characters</h3>

          <ul className="mt-2 text-sm">{chars.map((c) => <li key={String(c.id)}>{String(c.display_name)} {c.identity_locked ? "· locked" : ""}</li>)}</ul>

        </div>

        <div>

          <h3 className="text-sm uppercase text-[var(--mist)]">Locations</h3>

          <ul className="mt-2 text-sm">{locs.map((c) => <li key={String(c.id)}>{String(c.display_name)}</li>)}</ul>

        </div>

      </div>

      <h3 className="mt-8 text-sm uppercase text-[var(--mist)]">Canon</h3>

      <ul className="mt-2 space-y-2 text-sm">

        {canon.map((c) => (

          <li key={String(c.id)} className="flex gap-2">

            <span>{String(c.fact_key)} = {String(c.fact_value)} ({String(c.status)})</span>

            {c.status !== "locked" ? (

              <button type="button" onClick={() => vdApi.approveCanon(String(c.id)).then(load)} className="text-[var(--teal)]">

                Lock

              </button>

            ) : null}

          </li>

        ))}

      </ul>

    </CoreShell>

  );

}

"use client";



import Link from "next/link";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { CoreShell } from "@/components/CoreShell";

import { useLocale } from "@/components/LocaleProvider";

import { vdApi, type VdProject } from "@/lib/api";



export default function VerticalDramaHome() {

  const { t } = useLocale();

  const router = useRouter();

  const [rows, setRows] = useState<VdProject[]>([]);

  const [title, setTitle] = useState("New Vertical Drama");

  const [logline, setLogline] = useState("");

  const [locale, setLoc] = useState("en");

  const [status, setStatus] = useState("");

  const [enabled, setEnabled] = useState(true);



  useEffect(() => {

    vdApi

      .features()

      .then((f) => {

        setEnabled(f.enabled);

        if (f.enabled) return vdApi.list().then(setRows);

      })

      .catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)));

  }, []);



  async function create(seed = false) {

    setStatus("Creating…");

    const p = await vdApi.create({

      title,

      logline,

      source_type: seed ? "generate" : "idea",

      primary_locale: locale,

      content_languages: locale === "ckb-IQ" ? ["ckb-IQ", "en"] : ["en"],

      seed_golden_a: seed,

    });

    router.push(`/vertical-drama/${p.id}`);

  }



  return (

    <CoreShell title={t("vd.title")} subtitle={t("vd.subtitle")}>

      {!enabled ? <p className="text-[var(--danger)]">Vertical Drama is not entitled.</p> : null}

      {status ? <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">{status}</p> : null}

      <div className="mb-8 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">

        <input value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-transparent px-3 py-2" />

        <select value={locale} onChange={(e) => setLoc(e.target.value)} className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-transparent px-3 py-2">

          <option value="en">English</option>

          <option value="ckb-IQ">کوردی سۆرانی</option>

          <option value="ar">Arabic</option>

        </select>

        <textarea value={logline} onChange={(e) => setLogline(e.target.value)} rows={2} placeholder="Logline / idea…" className="md:col-span-2 border border-[var(--line)] bg-transparent px-3 py-2" dir="auto" />

        <button type="button" onClick={() => create(false).catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))} className="border border-[var(--gold)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase text-[var(--gold-bright)]">

          {t("vd.newProject")}

        </button>

        <button type="button" onClick={() => create(true).catch((e) => setStatus(String(e.message || e)))} className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-2 text-[0.7rem] uppercase">

          {t("vd.goldenA")}

        </button>

      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-3">

        {rows.map((r) => (

          <Link key={r.id} href={`/vertical-drama/${r.id}`} className="border border-[var(--line)] px-4 py-4 hover:border-[var(--gold)]">

            <p className="text-[var(--paper)]">{r.title}</p>

            <p className="text-[0.75rem] text-[var(--mist)]">{r.project_id}</p>

          </Link>

        ))}

      </div>

    </CoreShell>

  );

}

frontend/src/components/ApiStatus.tsx
"use client";



import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { api, type Health } from "@/lib/api";



export function ApiStatus() {

  const [health, setHealth] = useState<Health | null>(null);

  const [error, setError] = useState(false);



  useEffect(() => {

    let alive = true;



    const load = () => {

      api

        .health()

        .then((h) => {

          if (!alive) return;

          setHealth(h);

          setError(false);

        })

        .catch(() => {

          if (!alive) return;

          setError(true);

          setHealth(null);

        });

    };



    load();

    const id = window.setInterval(load, 20000);

    return () => {

      alive = false;

      window.clearInterval(id);

    };

  }, []);



  const ok = health?.status === "ok";

  const label = error

    ? "Offline"

    : ok

      ? "Live"

      : health

        ? "Degraded"

        : "Syncing";



  return (

    <div

      className="flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-[var(--radius)] border border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--ink-panel)] px-3.5 py-1.5 text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.16em] uppercase text-[var(--mist)] backdrop-blur-sm"

      title={

        health

          ? `Database ${health.database} · Redis ${health.redis} · Storage ${health.minio}`

          : undefined

      }

    >

      <span

        className={`status-dot inline-block h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${

          error ? "bg-[var(--danger)]" : ok ? "bg-emerald-400" : "bg-[var(--gold)]"

        }`}

      />

      <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{label}</span>

    </div>

  );

}


frontend/src/components/AuthProvider.tsx
"use client";

import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { usePathname, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import {
  AuthUser,
  SESSION_EXPIRED_EVENT,
  SESSION_UPDATED_EVENT,
  clearSession,
  getAccessToken,
  getRefreshToken,
  getStoredUser,
  setSession,
} from "@/lib/auth";
import { api, refreshAccessSession } from "@/lib/api";

type AuthContextValue = {
  user: AuthUser | null;
  loading: boolean;
  login: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<void>;
  logout: () => void;
};

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextValue | null>(null);

const PUBLIC_PATHS = new Set(["/", "/login", "/signup"]);

function toAuthUser(u: {
  user_id?: string;
  id?: string;
  email: string;
  full_name: string;
  role: string;
}): AuthUser {
  return {
    user_id: u.user_id || u.id || "",
    email: u.email,
    full_name: u.full_name,
    role: u.role,
  };
}

export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<AuthUser | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const router = useRouter();

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function boot() {
      const stored = getStoredUser();
      const token = getAccessToken();
      if (!stored || !token) {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setUser(null);
          setLoading(false);
        }
        return;
      }

      try {
        const me = await api.me();
        if (cancelled) return;
        setUser(
          toAuthUser({
            id: me.id,
            email: me.email,
            full_name: me.full_name,
            role: me.role,
          }),
        );
      } catch {
        if (getRefreshToken()) {
          const ok = await refreshAccessSession();
          if (ok && !cancelled) {
            const next = getStoredUser();
            setUser(next);
            setLoading(false);
            return;
          }
        }
        clearSession();
        if (!cancelled) setUser(null);
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      }
    }

    void boot();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onUpdated = () => setUser(getStoredUser());
    const onExpired = () => {
      setUser(null);
      if (!PUBLIC_PATHS.has(pathname)) {
        router.replace(`/login?next=${encodeURIComponent(pathname)}`);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener(SESSION_UPDATED_EVENT, onUpdated);
    window.addEventListener(SESSION_EXPIRED_EVENT, onExpired);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener(SESSION_UPDATED_EVENT, onUpdated);
      window.removeEventListener(SESSION_EXPIRED_EVENT, onExpired);
    };
  }, [pathname, router]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (loading) return;
    if (PUBLIC_PATHS.has(pathname)) return;
    if (!getAccessToken() || !user) {
      router.replace(`/login?next=${encodeURIComponent(pathname)}`);
    }
  }, [loading, pathname, router, user]);

  const value = useMemo<AuthContextValue>(
    () => ({
      user,
      loading,
      login: async (email, password) => {
        const res = await api.login(email, password);
        setSession(res);
        setUser(
          toAuthUser({
            user_id: res.user_id,
            email: res.email,
            full_name: res.full_name,
            role: res.role,
          }),
        );
      },
      logout: () => {
        clearSession();
        setUser(null);
        router.replace("/login");
      },
    }),
    [user, router],
  );

  return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
}

export function useAuth() {
  const ctx = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error("useAuth requires AuthProvider");
  return ctx;
}

frontend/src/components/LocaleProvider.tsx
"use client";



import {

  createContext,

  useCallback,

  useContext,

  useEffect,

  useMemo,

  useState,

  type ReactNode,

} from "react";

import en from "@/i18n/en/common.json";

import ckb from "@/i18n/ckb-IQ/common.json";



export type UiLocale = "en" | "ckb-IQ";



const dictionaries: Record<UiLocale, Record<string, string>> = {

  en,

  "ckb-IQ": ckb,

};



type LocaleContextValue = {

  locale: UiLocale;

  dir: "ltr" | "rtl";

  setLocale: (locale: UiLocale) => void;

  t: (key: string) => string;

};



const LocaleContext = createContext<LocaleContextValue | null>(null);



export function LocaleProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {

  const [locale, setLocaleState] = useState<UiLocale>("en");



  useEffect(() => {

    const saved = window.localStorage.getItem("artcity.uiLocale") as UiLocale | null;

    if (saved === "en" || saved === "ckb-IQ") setLocaleState(saved);

  }, []);



  const setLocale = useCallback((next: UiLocale) => {

    setLocaleState(next);

    window.localStorage.setItem("artcity.uiLocale", next);

  }, []);



  const dir: "ltr" | "rtl" = locale === "ckb-IQ" ? "rtl" : "ltr";



  useEffect(() => {

    document.documentElement.lang = locale === "ckb-IQ" ? "ckb" : "en";

    document.documentElement.dir = dir;

    document.body.dataset.locale = locale;

  }, [locale, dir]);



  const t = useCallback(

    (key: string) => dictionaries[locale][key] || dictionaries.en[key] || key,

    [locale],

  );



  const value = useMemo(

    () => ({ locale, dir, setLocale, t }),

    [locale, dir, setLocale, t],

  );



  return <LocaleContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</LocaleContext.Provider>;

}



export function useLocale() {

  const ctx = useContext(LocaleContext);

  if (!ctx) throw new Error("useLocale must be used within LocaleProvider");

  return ctx;

}


frontend/src/components/MediaPreview.tsx
"use client";



import { mediaAbsolute, type GenerationJob } from "@/lib/api";



export function MediaPreview({ job }: { job: GenerationJob }) {

  const media = mediaAbsolute(job.media_url);

  const audio = mediaAbsolute(job.audio_url);



  if (!media) {

    return <p className="text-sm text-[var(--mist)]">No preview yet.</p>;

  }



  if (job.modality === "video") {

    return (

      <div className="space-y-3">

        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}

        <img

          src={media}

          alt={job.prompt ?? "Video proxy"}

          className="w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-black object-cover aspect-video"

        />

        {audio ? (

          <audio controls src={audio} className="w-full">

            Your browser does not support audio.

          </audio>

        ) : null}

      </div>

    );

  }



  if (job.modality === "image") {

    return (

      // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element

      <img

        src={media}

        alt={job.prompt ?? "Image"}

        className="w-full border border-[var(--line)] bg-black object-cover aspect-video"

      />

    );

  }



  return (

    <div className="border border-[var(--line)] bg-[rgba(10,15,22,0.55)] p-4">

      <p className="ac-display mb-3 text-[0.68rem] tracking-[0.2em] text-[var(--mist)] uppercase">

        {job.modality} playback

      </p>

      <audio controls src={media} className="w-full">

        Your browser does not support audio.

      </audio>

    </div>

  );

}

            {children}

          </h2>

        ),

        h3: ({ children }) => (

          <h3 className="ac-display mb-3 mt-8 text-lg text-[var(--paper)]">{children}</h3>

        ),

        p: ({ children }) => (

        ),

        ul: ({ children }) => (

          </ul>

        ),

        ol: ({ children }) => (

          <ol className="ac-serif mb-4 list-decimal space-y-2 pl-6 text-[var(--paper-dim)]">

          </ol>

        ),

        li: ({ children }) => <li className="leading-[1.7]">{children}</li>,

        a: ({ href, children }) => (

        ),

              {children}

        hr: () => <hr className="my-10 border-[var(--line)]" />,

        strong: ({ children }) => (

          <strong className="font-semibold text-[var(--paper)]">{children}</strong>

        ),

        blockquote: ({ children }) => (

            {children}

          </blockquote>

        ),

      }}

    >

      {content}

    </ReactMarkdown>

  );

}

  { href: "/studio", label: "Studio" },
  { href: "/vertical-drama", label: "Vertical Drama" },
  { href: "/hub", label: "Hub" },
  { href: "/data-bank", label: "Data Bank" },
  { href: "/edit", label: "Edit" },
  { href: "/publish", label: "Publish" },
];

const core = [
  { href: "/data-lab", label: "Data Lab" },
  { href: "/data-lab/annotations", label: "Annotations" },
  { href: "/knowledge", label: "Knowledge" },
  { href: "/speech", label: "Speech" },
  { href: "/rights", label: "Rights" },
  { href: "/models", label: "Models" },
  { href: "/training", label: "Training" },
  { href: "/evaluations", label: "Evaluations" },
  { href: "/costs", label: "Costs" },
  { href: "/users", label: "Users" },
  { href: "/settings", label: "Settings" },
];

export function SiteHeader({ transparent = false }: { transparent?: boolean }) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const { user, logout } = useAuth();
  const { locale, setLocale, t } = useLocale();
  const product =
    pathname.startsWith("/cinema")
      ? "cinema"
      : pathname.startsWith("/studio")
        ? "studio"
        : pathname.startsWith("/edit")
          ? "edit"
          : pathname.startsWith("/vertical-drama")
            ? "vertical"
          : pathname.startsWith("/hub")
            ? "hub"
            : "platform";

  return (
    <header
      className={`sticky top-0 z-20 border-b ${
        transparent
          ? "border-transparent bg-transparent"
          : "border-[var(--line)] bg-[rgba(5,7,11,0.72)] backdrop-blur-md"
      }`}
    >
      <div className="ac-container flex min-h-[var(--header-h)] flex-col justify-center gap-2 py-2">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-6">
          <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-8">
            <BrandMark product={product} />
            <nav className="hidden items-center gap-1 lg:flex" aria-label="Primary">
              {primary.map((link) => {
                const active =
                  pathname === link.href || pathname.startsWith(`${link.href}/`);
                return (
                  <Link
                    key={link.href}
                    href={link.href}
                    className={`relative px-2.5 py-2 text-[0.72rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] transition ${
                      active
                        ? "text-[var(--gold-bright)]"
                        : "text-[var(--mist)] hover:text-[var(--paper)]"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {link.href === "/hub" ? t("hub.title") : link.href === "/vertical-drama" ? t("vd.title") : link.label}
                  </Link>
                );
              })}
            </nav>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <select
              value={locale}
              onChange={(e) => setLocale(e.target.value as "en" | "ckb-IQ")}
              className="hidden border border-[var(--line)] bg-transparent px-2 py-1 text-[0.65rem] uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-[var(--paper-dim)] sm:block"
              aria-label="UI language"
            >
              <option value="en">{t("locale.en")}</option>
              <option value="ckb-IQ">{t("locale.ckb")}</option>
            </select>
            {user ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={logout}
                className="hidden text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--mist)] hover:text-[var(--paper)] sm:inline"
              >
                {user.full_name.split(" ")[0]} · Sign out
              </button>
            ) : null}
            <ApiDocsLink />
            <ApiStatus />
          </div>
        </div>
        <nav
          className="flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto pb-1 lg:hidden"
          aria-label="Primary mobile"
        >
          {primary.map((link) => {
            const active =
              pathname === link.href || pathname.startsWith(`${link.href}/`);
            return (
              <Link
                key={link.href}
                href={link.href}
                className={`whitespace-nowrap px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[0.68rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] ${
                  active
                    ? "text-[var(--gold-bright)]"
                    : "text-[var(--mist)] hover:text-[var(--paper)]"
                }`}
              >
                {link.label}
              </Link>
            );
          })}
        </nav>
        <nav
          className="hidden gap-1 overflow-x-auto pb-1 md:flex"
          aria-label="AI Core"
        >
          {core.map((link) => {
            const active = pathname === link.href || pathname.startsWith(`${link.href}/`);
            return (
              <Link
                key={link.href}
                href={link.href}
                className={`whitespace-nowrap px-2 py-1 text-[0.65rem] uppercase tracking-[0.14em] ${
                  active ? "text-[var(--teal)]" : "text-[var(--mist-soft)] hover:text-[var(--mist)]"
                }`}
              >
                {link.label}
              </Link>
            );
          })}
        </nav>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}

"use client";



import Link from "next/link";



export function VdNav({ vdId, projectId }: { vdId: string; projectId: string }) {

  const base = `/vertical-drama/${vdId}`;

  const links = [

    ["Overview", `${base}`],

    ["IP Vault", `${base}/ip-vault`],

    ["World", `${base}/world`],

    ["Story Bible", `${base}/story-bible`],

    ["Season", `${base}/seasons`],

    ["Hub Script", `/hub/${projectId}/script`],

    ["Cinema", `/cinema/${projectId}`],

    ["Edit", `/edit`],

  ];

  return (

    <nav className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap gap-2">

      {links.map(([label, href]) => (

        <Link

          key={href}

          href={href}

          className="border border-[var(--line)] px-3 py-1.5 text-[0.7rem] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--mist)] hover:border-[var(--gold)] hover:text-[var(--gold-bright)]"

        >

          {label}

        </Link>

      ))}

    </nav>

  );

}
