frontend/src/lib/api.ts
import {
  clearSession,
  emitSessionExpired,
  getAccessToken,
  getRefreshToken,
  setSession,
} from "@/lib/auth";

const API_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ?? "http://localhost:8000";

export type TokenResponse = {
  access_token: string;
  refresh_token: string;
  token_type: string;
  role: string;
  email: string;
  full_name: string;
  user_id: string;
  phone_number?: string | null;
  email_verified?: boolean;
  phone_verified?: boolean;
};

let refreshInFlight: Promise<boolean> | null = null;

function isAuthPublicPath(path: string): boolean {
  return (
    path.startsWith("/api/auth/login") ||
    path.startsWith("/api/auth/signup") ||
    path.startsWith("/api/auth/refresh") ||
    path.startsWith("/api/auth/verify-email") ||
    path.startsWith("/api/auth/verify-phone") ||
    path.startsWith("/api/auth/token")
  );
}

/** Refresh access token using stored refresh token. Returns true when a new session is stored. */
export async function refreshAccessSession(): Promise<boolean> {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return false;
  if (refreshInFlight) return refreshInFlight;

  refreshInFlight = (async () => {
    const refreshToken = getRefreshToken();
    if (!refreshToken) return false;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}/api/auth/refresh`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ refresh_token: refreshToken }),
        cache: "no-store",
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        clearSession();
        return false;
      }
      const data = (await res.json()) as TokenResponse;
      if (!data.access_token || !data.refresh_token) {
        clearSession();
        return false;
      }
      setSession(data);
      return true;
    } catch {
      clearSession();
      return false;
    } finally {
      refreshInFlight = null;
    }
  })();

  return refreshInFlight;
}

export function mediaAbsolute(path?: string | null): string | null {
  if (!path) return null;
  if (path.startsWith("http")) return path;
  return `${API_URL}${path}`;
}

/** Append JWT for browser downloads (ZIP, manifest) that cannot send Authorization headers. */
export function withAccessToken(url: string): string {
  const token = getAccessToken();
  if (!token) return url;
  const sep = url.includes("?") ? "&" : "?";
  return `${url}${sep}access_token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`;
}

function formatApiError(status: number, text: string): string {
  try {
    const data = JSON.parse(text) as {
      message?: string;
      detail?: unknown;
    };
    if (typeof data.message === "string" && data.message.trim()) {
      return data.message;
    }
    if (Array.isArray(data.detail)) {
      return data.detail
        .map((item) => {
          if (typeof item === "string") return item;
          if (item && typeof item === "object") {
            const row = item as { field?: string; message?: string; msg?: string; loc?: unknown[] };
            const field =
              row.field ||
              (Array.isArray(row.loc)
                ? row.loc.filter((x) => x !== "body").join(".")
                : undefined);
            const msg = row.message || row.msg || "Invalid value";
            return field ? `${field}: ${msg}` : msg;
          }
          return String(item);
        })
        .join("; ");
    }
    if (typeof data.detail === "string") return data.detail;
  } catch {
    /* plain text */
  }
  return text || `Request failed: ${status}`;
}

async function request<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit, retried = false): Promise<T> {
  const token = getAccessToken();
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    ...(init?.headers as Record<string, string> | undefined),
  };
  if (token) headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;

  const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}${path}`, {
    ...init,
    headers,
    cache: "no-store",
  });

  if (res.status === 401 && !retried && !isAuthPublicPath(path)) {
    const refreshed = await refreshAccessSession();
    if (refreshed) {
      return request<T>(path, init, true);
    }
    clearSession();
    emitSessionExpired();
    const text = await res.text();
    throw new Error(formatApiError(401, text || '{"detail":"Not authenticated"}'));
  }

  if (!res.ok) {
    const text = await res.text();
    throw new Error(formatApiError(res.status, text));
  }
  if (res.status === 204) return undefined as T;
  return res.json() as Promise<T>;
}

export const api = {
  health: () => request<Health>("/health"),
  login: (email: string, password: string) =>
    request<TokenResponse>("/api/auth/login", {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ email, password }),
    }),
  signup: (body: {
    email: string;
    full_name: string;
    phone_number: string;
    password: string;
    accept_terms: boolean;

  uploadSpeechAudio: async (file: File, projectId?: string) => {
    const token = getAccessToken();
    const form = new FormData();
    form.append("file", file);
    if (projectId) form.append("project_id", projectId);
    const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
    if (token) headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
    const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}/api/v1/ai/speech/upload`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers,
      body: form,
      cache: "no-store",
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const text = await res.text();
      throw new Error(formatApiError(res.status, text));
    }
    return res.json() as Promise<SpeechUploadResult>;
  },

    const res = await fetch(

    return res.blob();

  ingestFiles: async (opts: {
    files: FileList | File[];
    datasetId?: string;
    datasetName?: string;
    language?: string;
    dialect?: string;
  }) => {
    const token = getAccessToken();
    const form = new FormData();
    const list = Array.from(opts.files);
    for (const file of list) form.append("files", file);
    if (opts.datasetId) form.append("dataset_id", opts.datasetId);
    if (opts.datasetName) form.append("dataset_name", opts.datasetName);
    if (opts.language) form.append("language", opts.language);
    if (opts.dialect) form.append("dialect", opts.dialect);
    const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
    if (token) headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
    const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}/api/data-lab/ingest`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers,
      body: form,
      cache: "no-store",
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const text = await res.text();
      throw new Error(formatApiError(res.status, text));
    }
    return res.json() as Promise<IngestionRun>;
  },

export type CinemaDeliverable = {
  role?: string | null;
  type?: string | null;
  modality: string;
  job_id: string;
  label?: string | null;
  aspect?: string | null;
  aspect_ratio?: string | null;
  media_url?: string | null;
  audio_url?: string | null;
  mp4_url?: string | null;
  video_file?: string | null;
  audio_file?: string | null;
  file?: string | null;
  is_mp4?: boolean | null;
  mood?: string | null;
  variant?: string | null;
  script?: string | null;
  transcript?: AsrManifest | null;
  transcript_job_id?: string | null;
  subtitle_vtt?: string | null;
  subtitle_srt?: string | null;
};

export type CinemaTimelineClip = {
  id: string;
  track: string;
  role?: string;
  label?: string;
  start: number;
  end: number;
  job_id?: string;
  media_url?: string | null;
  mp4_url?: string | null;
  gain_db?: number;
  duck_music?: boolean;
};

export type CinemaTimeline = {
  duration_seconds: number;
  fps?: number;
  tracks?: { id: string; label: string }[];
  clips?: CinemaTimelineClip[];
  mix?: {
    music_gain_db?: number;
    voice_gain_db?: number;
    duck_music_under_vo?: boolean;
  };
  status?: string;
};

export type ValidationCheck = {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  passed: boolean;
  expected: unknown;
  actual: unknown;
  detail: string;
};

export type DeliverableValidation = {
  role: string;
  passed: boolean;
  checks: ValidationCheck[];
  technical?: Record<string, unknown>;
};

export type PackageValidation = {
  passed: boolean;
  completeness?: ValidationCheck;
  deliverables: DeliverableValidation[];
  presets?: Record<string, unknown>;
  targets?: Record<string, unknown>;
};

export type CinemaPackage = {
  package_id: string;
  asset_id: string;
  product?: string;
  campaign: string;

export const hubApi = {
  features: () => request<HubFeatures>("/api/v1/hub/features"),
  listScripts: (projectId: string) =>
    request<HubScript[]>(`/api/v1/hub/projects/${projectId}/scripts`),
  createScript: (
    projectId: string,
    body: {
      title: string;
      entry_mode?: string;
      primary_locale?: string;
      content_languages?: string[];
      seed_text?: string;
    },
  ) =>
    request<HubScript>(`/api/v1/hub/projects/${projectId}/scripts`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    }),
  getScript: (scriptId: string) => request<HubScript>(`/api/v1/hub/scripts/${scriptId}`),
  listVersions: (scriptId: string) =>
    request<HubScriptVersion[]>(`/api/v1/hub/scripts/${scriptId}/versions`),
  newRevision: (scriptId: string) =>
    request<HubScriptVersion>(`/api/v1/hub/scripts/${scriptId}/versions`, { method: "POST" }),
  lockVersion: (versionId: string) =>
    request<HubScriptVersion>(`/api/v1/hub/versions/${versionId}/lock`, { method: "POST" }),
  listElements: (versionId: string) =>
    request<HubElement[]>(`/api/v1/hub/versions/${versionId}/elements`),
  saveElements: (versionId: string, elements: Partial<HubElement>[]) =>
    request<HubElement[]>(`/api/v1/hub/versions/${versionId}/elements`, {
      method: "PUT",
      body: JSON.stringify({ elements }),
    }),
  parseScenes: (versionId: string) =>
    request<HubScene[]>(`/api/v1/hub/versions/${versionId}/parse-scenes`, { method: "POST" }),
  listScenes: (versionId: string) =>
    request<HubScene[]>(`/api/v1/hub/versions/${versionId}/scenes`),
  proposeBreakdown: (versionId: string) =>
    request<HubBreakdownItem[]>(`/api/v1/hub/versions/${versionId}/breakdown/propose`, {
      method: "POST",
    }),
  listBreakdown: (versionId: string) =>
    request<HubBreakdownItem[]>(`/api/v1/hub/versions/${versionId}/breakdown`),
  decideBreakdown: (itemId: string, approval_status: "approved" | "rejected" | "proposed") =>
    request<HubBreakdownItem>(`/api/v1/hub/breakdown/${itemId}/decision`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ approval_status }),
    }),
  compareVersions: (a: string, b: string) =>
    request<{ left: string[]; right: string[]; added: number; removed: number }>(
      `/api/v1/hub/versions/compare?a=${encodeURIComponent(a)}&b=${encodeURIComponent(b)}`,
    ),
  aiCommand: (
    versionId: string,
    body: { command: string; target_locale?: string; element_ids?: string[]; apply?: boolean },
  ) =>
    request<{ provider: string; elements: Partial<HubElement>[]; apply: boolean }>(
      `/api/v1/hub/versions/${versionId}/ai`,
      { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(body) },
    ),
  exportUrl: (versionId: string, fmt: "pdf" | "docx") =>
    `${API_URL}/api/v1/hub/versions/${versionId}/export/${fmt}`,
  handoff: (projectId: string, target: "cinema" | "studio" | "edit", body?: object) =>
    request<{ ok: boolean; redirect: string; asset_id: string }>(
      `/api/v1/hub/projects/${projectId}/handoff/${target}`,
      { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(body || {}) },
    ),
  listStale: (projectId: string) =>
    request<{ id: string; resource_type: string; resource_id: string; reason: string }[]>(
      `/api/v1/hub/projects/${projectId}/stale`,
    ),
};

frontend/src/lib/auth.ts
const TOKEN_KEY = "artcity_access_token";

const REFRESH_KEY = "artcity_refresh_token";

const USER_KEY = "artcity_user";



export const SESSION_UPDATED_EVENT = "artcity:session-updated";

export const SESSION_EXPIRED_EVENT = "artcity:session-expired";



export type AuthUser = {

  user_id: string;

  email: string;

  full_name: string;

  role: string;

};



export function getAccessToken(): string | null {

  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;

  return localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY);

}



export function getRefreshToken(): string | null {

  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;

  return localStorage.getItem(REFRESH_KEY);

}



export function getStoredUser(): AuthUser | null {

  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;

  const raw = localStorage.getItem(USER_KEY);

  if (!raw) return null;

  try {

    return JSON.parse(raw) as AuthUser;

  } catch {

    return null;

  }

}



export function setSession(tokens: {

  access_token: string;

  refresh_token: string;

  user_id: string;

  email: string;

  full_name: string;

  role: string;

}) {

  localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, tokens.access_token);

  localStorage.setItem(REFRESH_KEY, tokens.refresh_token);

  localStorage.setItem(

    USER_KEY,

    JSON.stringify({

      user_id: tokens.user_id,

      email: tokens.email,

      full_name: tokens.full_name,

      role: tokens.role,

    }),

  );

  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {

    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(SESSION_UPDATED_EVENT));

  }

}



export function clearSession() {

  localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY);

  localStorage.removeItem(REFRESH_KEY);

  localStorage.removeItem(USER_KEY);

}



export function emitSessionExpired() {

  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;

  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(SESSION_EXPIRED_EVENT));

}

README.md
# Art City AI Studio

**Private Art City project.** Standalone local MVP for Art City’s proprietary AI content-generation platform (video, image, audio, voice, music).

Not part of Nova. Not part of Alltra. No shared stack with either.

## Prerequisites

- Docker Desktop (for PostgreSQL, Redis, MinIO)
- Python 3.11+
- Node.js 20+
- Windows CMD or PowerShell

## Quick start

### 1. Infrastructure

```bat
cd C:\Users\novac\Documents\art-city-ai-studio
copy .env.example .env
docker compose up -d
```

Services:

| Service        | URL                         |
|----------------|-----------------------------|
| Frontend       | http://localhost:3000       |
| Backend API    | http://localhost:8000       |
| API Docs       | http://localhost:8000/docs  |
| MinIO Console  | http://localhost:9001       |

MinIO login: `artcity_minio` / `artcity_minio_secret`

### 2. Backend

```bat
cd backend
python -m venv venv
venv\Scripts\activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
alembic upgrade head
uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
```

### 3. Frontend

```bat
cd frontend
npm install
npm run dev
```

## Publish (delivery pipeline)

Open **http://localhost:3000/publish**

1. Select a cinema package  
2. Package masters (16:9 / 9:16 / 1:1 + stems)  
3. Pass delivery checklist + checksums  
4. Release to Art City channel  

Outputs: `MASTER_MANIFEST.json`, `DELIVERY_REPORT.md`, published masters in MinIO.

## Art City Cinema · Studio · Edit · Publish

| Product | Purpose | Outputs |
|---------|---------|---------|
| **Art City Cinema** | Complete advertising campaigns | Hero film, social cutdowns, music, VO, end card, campaign manifest, technical QC, ZIP |
| **Art City Studio** | Individual production assets | Single image / video / voice / music / scene takes |
| **Art City Edit** | Long-form editing & social repurposing | Upload → analyse → candidate clips → timeline → multi-ratio export + QC (Art City approval + entitlements) |
| **Art City Publish** | Delivery packaging | Masters, checklist, checksums, channel release |

### Art City Edit (local)

Open **http://localhost:3000/edit**

```bat
cd backend
venv\Scripts\activate
alembic upgrade head
python scripts\seed_edit.py
```

1. Seed the internal Art City Edit workspace (or call `POST /api/edit/seed/internal` as admin)  
2. Upload long-form video with rights attestation  
3. Run analysis (start worker: `python -m app.worker`)  
4. Pin candidates → timeline → approve → render multi-ratio package  

PRD: [`docs/ART_CITY_EDIT_PRD.md`](docs/ART_CITY_EDIT_PRD.md)

## Cinema technical QC

Every Cinema render automatically runs deep validation:

- Video duration · aspect ratio (true 16:9 / 9:16 / 1:1) · resolution presets (1920×1080, 1080×1920, 1080×1080)
- Frame rate documented (24 fps) · audio sync · loudness · voice clarity proxy
- End card branding/CTA · SHA-256 · package completeness (six outputs)
- Provider cost + generation history (prompt, model, version)

Demo campaign (real Art City brand brief):

```bat
cd backend
venv\Scripts\activate
python scripts\demo_art_city_campaign.py
```

ZIP + manifest land in `backend/demo_output/`.

## Cloud deploy (Railway)

Private stack: **Postgres + Redis + S3 bucket + FastAPI + Next.js**.

1. `railway login` (if needed)
2. From repo root: `railway init -n art-city-ai-studio -y`
3. Add data: `railway add --database postgres` and `railway add --database redis`
4. Create bucket: `railway bucket create art-city-assets`
5. Deploy API: `railway up backend --path-as-root -s backend -y`
6. Generate API domain: `railway domain -s backend`
7. Set frontend `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` to the API domain, deploy: `railway up frontend --path-as-root -s frontend -y`
8. Generate frontend domain and set backend `CORS_ORIGINS` to that URL

GitHub autodeploy (optional): connect each service to `zaragoza444/artcity-lab` on `main`.
Gitea mirror: `https://gitea.d-bis.org/zaragoza444/artcity-lab`.

## Project layout

- `frontend/` — Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- `backend/` — FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Alembic
- `docker-compose.yml` — PostgreSQL, Redis, MinIO

## Branch policy

`feature/*` → `development` → `staging` → `main`

Production deploys only from `main` after approval. Never commit `.env`, datasets, or model weights.

## API documentation

- **Complete reference:** [docs/API.md](docs/API.md)
- **Swagger UI:** http://localhost:8000/docs · https://backend-production-9533.up.railway.app/docs
- **ReDoc:** http://localhost:8000/redoc

## AI Core

Art City AI Core adds Model Gateway, Data Lab, Rights, Model Registry, Training, Evaluations, and async inference workers under Cinema / Studio / Publish. See [docs/ART_CITY_AI_CORE_DIRECTIVE.md](docs/ART_CITY_AI_CORE_DIRECTIVE.md).

Local worker (after Redis is up):

```bat
cd backend
venv\Scripts\activate
python -m app.worker
```

Default admin (after seed): set `DEFAULT_ADMIN_EMAIL` / `DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD` in the environment — do not commit credentials.

## Ownership principle

Art City owns the platform, source code, data, characters, workflows, datasets, fine-tuned models, and IP. External AI models are optional replaceable providers only.
